rnying rgyud/ 6snyo (1༷3)1126 lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 3dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor sgrib pa mchog tu sel ba'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor bde ba chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 6gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po las bag chags gtan la 'bebs pa gnyis su med par gleng ba'i le'u/ 11bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes pa'i mchog las gar gyi le'u/ 14lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i bde ba sdom pa thams cad kyi mchog gi le'u/ 161

drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 18bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mchod pa de kho na nyid de le'u/ 22brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba de kho na nyid las mchod yon dam pa dang snying rje'i le'u / 23dgu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa khro bo'i sprin rnam par spros pa bdud btul ba'i le'u/ 25bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba las rnam par bsgyur ba'i ye shes 'khor lo'i le'u/ 69bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba mnyes pa las sngags kyi le'u/ 70bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi he ru ka 'dus pa chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 72bsdur mchan/(76) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(87)1127 gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i bla ma chen po/ 88dang po/ dbyings dang ye shes gsang ba'i bde ba'i bla ma nges pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 88gnyis pa/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngang du sems kyi rang bzhin cir yang 'grub pa'i le'u/ 92gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u/ 97bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang gsang sngags kyi le'u/ 992

lnga pa/ phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u/ 103drug pa/ rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig dang dbang sbyin pa'i le'u/ 107bdun pa/ thugs rje gdung ba'i le'u/ 111brgyad pa/ tshogs chen po rnam pa gnyis mnyes pa'i le'u/ 113dgu pa/ bdud btul ba dang nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan phyogs bcur gsal ba'i le'u/ 114bcu pa/ 'jigs byed chen po gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig rdo rje'i le'u/ 133bcu gcig pa/ man ngag snying po byang chub sems bde ba chen po'i le'u/ 137bcu gnyis pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las dang yongs su mnyes pa'i le'u/ 140bcu gsum pa/ gdeng chen po'i le'u/ 145bsdur mchan/(147) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(158)1128 'phags pa 'jam dpal las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud / 159rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 159dang po/ gleng gzhi'i rtsa ba'i le'u/ 159gnyis pa/ thams cad zhi ba'i le'u/ 164gsum pa/ thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i le'u/ 165bzhi pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 166lnga pa/ drag po'i le'u/ 168drug pa/ ngan sngags dbang sdud kyi le'u/ 1703

bdun pa/ ro langs kyi sgrub pa la/ ngan sngags kyi phur bus gdab pa'i le'u/ 173brgyad pa/ 'jam dpal tshe sgrub pa'i le'u/ 176dgu pa/ log 'dren mthar byed kyis mnan pa'i le'u/ 178bcu pa/ gnod sbyin mthar byed kyis gnon pa'i le'u/ 183bcu gcig pa/ klu mthar byed kyis gnon pa'i thabs kyi le'u/ 185bcu gnyis pa/ ya ma mthar byed kyis gnon pa'i le'u/ 186bcu gsum pa/ mjug bskul ba dang gnang ba'i le'u/ 188rgyud phyi ma/ 190le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 190bsdur mchan/(198) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(207)1129 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa gsang ba rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po zhes bya ba/ 208dang po/ rnam par sprul pa'i le'u/ 208gnyis pa/ thugs rje sprul pa'i rol pa'i le'u/ 214gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u/ 217bzhi pa/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 228lnga pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 233drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 236bdun pa/ gzugs brnyan brtsam pa'i le'u/ 240brgyad pa/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa'i le'u/ 257dgu pa/ bdud kyi sde dang bcas pa shugs 'byung ba'i le'u/ 2684

bcu pa/ mdzad pa chen po'i le'u/ 273bcu gcig pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i le'u/ 277bcu gnyis pa/ rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i le'u/ 281bcu gsum pa/ thugs ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor 'phrul pa'i le'u / 284bcu bzhi pa/ mkha' 'gro ma sprul pa'i le'u/ 286bcwa lnga pa/ khams gsum gnon pa'i le'u/ 288bcu drug pa/ khro bo phrin las rol pa'i le'u/ 290bcu bdun pa/ rin chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'phrul pa'i le'u/ 292bcwa brgyad pa/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad khro bor byung ba'i le'u/ 294bcu dgu pa/ bde ba chen po'i le'u/ 296nyi shu pa/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgral bya'i le'u/ 297nyer gcig pa/ gsang chen 'dus pa'i le'u/ 300nyer gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor rgyu'i don phyung ba'i le'u/ 307nyer gsum pa/ khro bo rngom brjid ston pa'i le'u/ 313nyer bzhi pa/ ro langs bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 315nyer lnga pa/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 317nyer drug pa/ tshe bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 320nyer bdun pa/ bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 321nyer brgyad pa/ bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba'i rim pa'i le'u/ 323nyer dgu pa/ rten gyi sgo nas spyad pa'i le'u/ 325sum cu pa/ bsrung ba'i le'u/ 326bsdur mchan/(328) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(354)5

1130 dpal he ru ka snying rje rol pa'i rgyud gsang ba zab mo'i mchog ces bya ba/ 355dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyi gsang ba chen po rnal 'byor ma dbang phyug chen mo rnams kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 355gnyis pa/ ye shes kyi khro bo dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 375gsum pa/ gsang ba'i lha mo mchod pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 395bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i khro po'i bsnyen pa'i le'u/ 412lnga pa/ rdo rje pho nya'i le'u/ 425drug pa/ bzlas pa'i le'u/ 441bdun pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 467brgyad pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 476dgu pa/ mchod pa gsang ba'i le'u/ 478bcu pa/ dam tshig gi le'u/ 479bcu gcig pa/ snod brtag pa'i le'u/ 480bcu gnyis pa/ bdud 'dul ba'i le'u/ 484bcu gsum pa/ khro bo bskyed rdzogs las kyi bzlas pa'i le'u/ ga0bcu bzhi pa/ khro bo mnan bzlog gi le'u/ 502bcwa lnga pa/ phra men ma bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 512bcu drug pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dbyig bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 516bcu bdun pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 518rgya gar gyi lots+tsha ba mkhas par lobs pa bal po shrī khrir tis gtan la phab ste/ skad gsar pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(521) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)6

1131 thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub chen po nye ba'i snying po mchog bam po chen po brgyad pa/ 560bsdur mchan/(563) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(564)1132 tshangs pa la sogs pa drang srong dang / lha dang klu dang mi'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 565bsdur mchan/(576) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(579)1133 bcom ldan 'das gnyis med kyi rgyal po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo 580bsdur mchan/(583) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(584)1134 'bras bu chen po lnga bsgral ba'o// 585bsdur mchan/(593) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(596)1135 rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 597bsdur mchan/(601) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(602)1136 bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo 6037

bsdur mchan/(609) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(611)1137 bdud rtsi bum pa'i lung / 612bsdur mchan/(621) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(625)1138 bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rnon po la phyag 'tshal lo// 626bsdur mchan/(635) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(638)1139 mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud/ 639dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 639gnyis pa/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 661gsum pa/ lta ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 662bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 663lnga pa/ dpon g.yog gi dam rdzas bstan pa'i le'u/ 663drug pa/ sku gzugs bstan pa'i le'u/ 665bdun pa/ ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u/ 666brgyad pa/ sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 668dgu pa/ phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ 671bcu pa/ mchod pa'i le'u/ 673bcu gcig pa/ dam tshig gi le'u/ 674bcu gnyis pa/ drod tshad bstan pa'i le'u/ 678bcu gsum pa/ spogs shing thugs dam skong ba'i le'u/ 682bcu bzhi pa/ ma mo rtag tu bsten pa'i le'u/ 6848

bcwa lnga pa/ dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 685bcu drug pa/ las so so ma mo'i bye brag bstan pa'i le'u/ 688bcu bdun pa/ mar me bstan pa'i le'u/ 697bcwa brgyad pa/ ye shes kyi thig le bshad pa'i le'u/ 699bcu dgu pa/ rdzu 'phrul bcu drug gi le'u/ 700nyi shu pa/ bstod pa'i le'u/ 702nyer gcig pa/ 'khor la gtad pa'i le'u/ 703nyer gnyis pa/ yongs su lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 704bsdur mchan/(706) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(725)1140 drag sngags 'dus pa rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 726dang po/ cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 726gnyis pa/ byin brlabs chen pos dbang du bsdu ba'i le'u/ 728gsum pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu bkod pa'i le'u/ 731bzhi pa/ don dam pa'i gnas nye bar bstan pa'i le'u/ 734lnga pa/ sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa'i le'u/ 737drug pa/ dmod pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 738bdun pa/ dregs pa'i sde so so'i las la sbyar ba drag sngags kyi le'u/ 742brgyad pa/ dregs pa can gyi sde rigs dbye ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 748dgu pa/ phrin las dmigs pa'i khyad par las sbyar ba'i le'u/ 750bcu pa/ bstod pa yon tan brjod pa'i le'u/ 755bcu gcig pa/ phrin las kyi gnyer phul ba'i le'u/ 759rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba bdag 9

ṭ+wāṃ / ༵ nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(761) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(773)1141 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 774dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 774gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i las kyi gnyer gtad pa'i le'u/ 780gsum pa/ dam tshig mchod bstod kyi le'u/ 785bzhi pa/ rdo rje dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i le'u / 792lnga pa/ mchod bstod rgya chen po'i sgo nas nye bar bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 795drug pa/ zab pa'i mchod bstod gnad kyi le'u/ 809bdun pa/ phrin las drag po'i las la sbyar ba'i le'u/ 811brgyad pa/ las sna tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i snying po gnad kyi le'u/ 812dgu pa/ rtags kyi le'u/ 814bcu pa/ rten rdzas dang las kyi gnyer bsgo ba'i le'u/ 816bcu gcig pa/ chos sku mthar thug tu sgrub par gdams pa'i le'u/ 818bsdur mchan/(819) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(835)10

༄ga /lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud/① ༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ de bī dzā li ma hā mā yā tan+t+ra ②nā ma/ bod skad du/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen mo zhes ①bya ba'i rgyud/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis gsungs pa nyid du gyur pa'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor chen po dang / rnal 'byor ma chen mo dang / shin tu mos pa chen mo dang / mos pa dang bcas pa srung bar byed pa/ rab tu rnam par srung bar byed ④nye ba mo dang bcas pa nye bar zhi ba chen po dang zhi bar mdzad pa chen po mdzes pa dang mdog tu ldan pa/ shes pa dang skyabs su ldan pa ni 'di lta ste/gtso bo rnal 'byor 'khor lo zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor chen po rdo rje nyid du 'dus pa zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor chen po btang snyoms zhes bya ba dang /rnal 'byor chen po dbang du mdzad pa zhes bya ba dang / rnal 'byor shin tu rnam 103—3

par rgya gram gyi tshul 'dzin pa dang bcas pa ni cir yang ston pa'i gzugs kyis kha dog bzhi dang ldan te 'dug pa'i cha lugs kyis cod pan lnga dang ldan te/ ma bsgribs mi sgrib bsgrib 17pa mi 'gog sgrib (btu med pa'i dbyings nas yang dag pa'i gzhal yas chen po na mnyam pa chen po'i tshul rdo rjes sku ma bkag pas mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bzhugs so/ /de yang 'di (5)ltar so sor gsal bar mnyam pa chen po dang 'khor dang bcas pa mnyam pa chen pos yo byad chen po ni kun gyi gdung 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa ni brten pas phyin ci ma log pa dang gnyis su du ma med pa ni gzungs rnal 'byor ma chen mo ste/ byang chub chen mo nam mkha' zhes bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo nam mkha' 'dzin ma zhes bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo sa srung (5tshom zhes bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo rlan 6par byed pa chen mo dang / byang chub chen mo rnam par khengs pa spang ba (bezhes bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo las grub par mdzad ma zhes bya ba dang /byang chub chen mo rdo rje rab tu chags pa chen po 87'dzin zhes bya ba dang / rab tu ma chags pa gsod ces bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo rab tu rmongs sel zhes bya ba dang / byang chub chen mo gsung gi 9)'khor lo ma zhes bya ba ste/ de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ shin tu ut+pa la lta bu'i mdog dang / shag kra dang / bai ḍūr+ya tu rmedang / pad+ma rā ga dang / asma gar ba 11la sogs pa rdzas kyi bsngags pas 'phags par 'tsher ba ma smin 12pa med par bzhugs pa ni rnal 'byor ma kun du bzang po 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /de yang gus pa chen po gsang ba dang /gus pa chen po sna tshogs pa'i dri dang / gus pa chen po dbang sgyur ba ni gsang ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba dang / gsal ba 'dzin byed ma dang / rnam par dri yi (1216)(3—4

gnas su gyur pa dang / rnam par sgra byed pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /de nyid mthong bar byed pa'i dbang po dang / nyan par byed pa'i dbang po dang /bsung 6)byed chen po'i dbang po dang / btar (mib chen po'i dbang po dang /shin tu gtong bar mdzad pa dang / shin tu rtog par mdzad pa dang / shin tu 'dzin dbang chen po dang / shin tu grub par mdzad pa dang / cha lugs mi gtong ba'i btsun mo dang bcas pa'o/ /yod pa rnam par rtog par mdzad pa dang / med pa sel bar mdzad pa dang / rnam par 'du shes rgyal ba yin par mdzad pa dang / shin tu 'gog pa rnam par 'joms pa chen mo dang / mngon spyod kyi las kyis gnyis su med par 'khril nas chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i gzhal yas na bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen mo'i rnal 'byor ma'i gzhal yas su dgyes nas ma skyes pa'i dbyings shes rab kyi tshogs chen mo mu khyud kun dang ldan pa/ zla rgyas lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dbus med par khyab pa/ rin po che kun dang ldan pa/ grwa (kyedang ngos dang kha dog dang dbyibs rgya khyon dpag tu med par gyur pa/ ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa (4)cha lugs kyis rnam par mdzes pa/ yid bzhin chen po'i rgyan gyis rnam par spras pa/ sna tshogs pa'i bye brag gis rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung 'dzin pa/sgyu 'phrul chen po'i sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ theg pa phyi'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi theg pa chen po 'bab gzhol dge sdig chen po'i mchog shin tu gsang ba chen mo dang bcas pa/ pad+ma chen po'i dbus na lce kha dog bzhi'i bye brag gis mdzes par gyur pa/ phyogs bzhi bre ba rim pa gsum gyi cha lugs kyis gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor 103—5

sgrib pa mchog tu sel ba ste le'u dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das longs spyod chen po gdung ba mchog tu sel bar mdzad pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ 'dzum pa chen pos rab tu chags pa chen po la dbang sgyur bar dgyes te/ gsang ba chen mo'i mkha' la pad+ma dbang gi mdog gis rgyas par mdzad de/ oṃ su ra twa su khe zhes brjod pas rdo rje rigs bsam gyis 6)mi khyab pa btsun mo dang bcas par gyur to/ /de nas rab tu 'di brjod par mdzad do/ /bzhi pa kha dog dkar la 'tsher/ /btang snyoms kun gyi spro bsdu yis/ /gsum pa rdzogs par gsal ba dang / /phyag rgya'i tshogs mchog 97de dag las/ /rgyal mo dag dang mnyam du dgyes/ /phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yi cha lugs kyis/ /che chung med par gsal bar bsgom/ /dbu la gnyis pa'i yi ger ldan/ /gsal ba nyid kyi dus dag tu//cod pan lnga yi 97rin chen las/ /rgyan gyi rigs ni gsal ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba rgyan dam pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa mthing 47'bar yi ge che/ /rigs kyi rin chen spro bsdu las/ /phyag rgyar gsal bas skur gsal ba/ /rgyal mo dag dang mnyam du dgyes/ /sgrib pa kun spangs sdig med sdoms/ /gnyis pa yi ni yi ge las/ /cod pan lnga ldan yi ger gsal/ /thams cad blo sbyangs yid bzhin gter/ /mnyam pa 'khril ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rin chen rigs kyi phyag rgyar gsal/ /las thams cad kyi mchog rgyal mo rnam par rol pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba'i mdog /chos sku zla tshes rab ldan pa/ /gsal ba'i kha dog mdzes pa ni/ /thams cad ma 1003—6

lus dbang du mdzad/ /sbyar dang bskyed dang bsdu ba yis4)/ /phyag rgyar gsal bas dbang gi (snyesku/ /btsun mo dag dang mnyam du dgyes/ /gnyis su med par 'khril ba yis/ /dbu ru yi ge gnyis pa ldan/ /rin chen rigs kyi spro bsdu las / /cod pan rigs lnga kha dog ste/ /ji bzhin pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyag rgya bzhugs tshul pad+ma'i tshul/ /mnyam par bsam pas dkyil 'khor yin/ /mi 'byed pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor kun 'dus mchog /pad+ma (mirigs kyi phyag rgyar gsal/ /mun pa sel ba'i mar me bzhin/ /gsal ngag yid gnyis med par bsgom/ /chu skyes 'dzum pa'i 'od du ldan/ /steg dang sprod pa'i rol mo yis/ /dgyes shing mnyam pa'i mchod par bsham54)/ /'di ltar gsal bas dbang yang rdzogs/ /thams cad sdud (5)pa zhes su bya/ /de bzhin dbang ste las thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /dus gsum pa yi mdzad pa che/ /rigs kun 'dus pa bde gshegs las/ /mnyam pa ji bzhin ting 'dzin te/ /yi ge 'bru gcig kun gyi mchog /bshad pas khyad (6)par las kun rdzogs/ /chu skyes gsal ba'i 'dab ma steng 57)/ /gnyis su med par gsal 8rib ni/ /rnam pa gnyis kyi bye brag gis/ /'dus pa gsal bas skur gyur pa/ /'dod cing chags pa ma yin zhing / /blo la yid gnyis med pa dang / /phyag rgyar gsal bas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rgyal mo dang ni mnyam du dgyes/ /dbu gnyis pa yi yi ger ldan/ /sbyin pa rgya chen khengs pa na/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i gnas su bsdu/ /bong tshod 9)lo grangs khyad par med/ /gnyis su med par 'khril bar gsal / /dus kun du ni mnyam ldan pas/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rab tu rdzogs / /zla rgyas lta bu'i gtso bo bsgom/ /chags pa med par 'dod sdud pa'i/ /103—7

yum dang lhan cig bsgom pa ni/ /ā li kā li byed pa'i don/ /phyag rgya las kyi bye brag gis/ /bde ba chen po'i tshul gnas pa/ /rgyal ba kun kyang de bzhin mthun(1sta / /phyag lag (misnol mar gnas pa yi/ /kun kyang sems dpa'i skyidakyil 'khor ro/ /phyag rgya thal mo rdo rje ni/ /kun kyang yum gyi rgyab tu bsnol(ri)/ /zhal gnyis mdzes par rab rgyas nas/ /zla gam pa yi (1ljags gnyis mdzes/ /dung gi phur bus mkhur tshos la/ /gdab cing sdebs 6)pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /bsnyen pa nye bsnyen dbang rdzogs pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi ( )mchog /bzhad ⑧dang 'dzum pa'i gtso gzungs bsgom/ /rnal 'byor dka' thub chen po'i don/ /gsang ba spyod (9)la shin tu bgyesakyi/ /gsang ba nyid du sems can 'dren/ /thams cad kun gyi rmongs pa sel/ /yum gyi las kyi khyad par ni/ /sa yi rim pa kun sbyong zhing / /zas la bgo la dbang med pa/ /nyan thos 'gog pa la sogs pa/ /byang chub sems kyi char chen gyis/ /dam por bcings pa tshar gcod mdzad/ /dam tshig chen po sdom pa ste/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dkyil 'khor yin / /phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs mchog ni/ /dag pa don gyi rigs mchog yin/ /myur bar rtag tu ma yengs (1nyan/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub pa ni/ /'dod khams lha yi nyin phyed kyis/ /gsang ba kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /kun tu bzang po rnal 'byor mchog /gsang ba nyid kyi mkha' dbyings nasayi / /yi ge a ldan tsheg drag bcas/ /rnal 'byor bde chen thugs kyi sras/ /gzugs khams la sogs byin brlabs 1snyenas/ /phyag mtshan 'khor lor gsal ba dang / /bde ba rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs/ /btso skam gser gyi kha dog la/ /nyi ma zer gyi 103—8

'od bzhin du/ /gsal ba 'tsher ba bcom ldan 'das/ /dbu ru yi 0)ge gnyis pa las/ /rin chen myu gu khang pa 'bar/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan gyis/ /legs par brgyan pa mtshan rnams rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i bzhugs tshul dang ske/ /ting 'dzin mthun ②pas 'gro la dmigs/ /pad+ma ge sar dbus gnas pa'i / /thig bzhi gsang ba bzhi dang ldan/ /mdun du lha mo chags pa mo/ /lo grangs nyi shu mdzes dang ldan/ /ma hā su ma'i (guganas la dgyes/ /mdzes pa'i lag pa gar dang chas/ /gnyis su med pa'i bzhugs tshul ni/ /gtso la brten ④pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /rgyab tu lha mo dgyes chen mo/ /sangs rgyas brten par mdzad tshul gyis/ /thal mos 'dzin pa sku brtan 5pa/ /sku tshe bcu drug rtsa dmar sku/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'dzin chags pas spyod/ /'dod chags can la mthun (6)par mdzad/ /g.yas su zhe sdang gdul ba mo/ /rdo rje pad+mor tso)sbyor la dgyes / /ma dad pa rnams dbang med par/ /drag por sbyor mdzad zhe sdang sel / /chags pa chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /gnyis su med par sbyor ba yis/ /gtong ba med par bstan pa'i tshul/ /sngo bsangs mdangs ldan khyad par che/ /khru tshad bcwa (9lnga chags pa can/ /dus mtha' med par sbyor la dgyes/ /steg dang sgeg pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal 'khru/ /rab tu skams kyisapa 'gog pa rnams/ /rlang yonas rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur/ /asto 5nyam li'i phrin tshelas kyis/ /thams cad byang chub chen por mdzad/ /mig gnyis 'dzums kyi dang sbom po yis/ /dbang mor ldan par byas pa na/ /gnyis su med par sbyor 'dod yin/ /sna yi rtse mor mthe'u chung 'dzin/ /ma btang bzhugs la brtson byos pa'o/ /so rnams bsdams nas kha phye ba/ /dus la bab ces bya ba 103—9

ste / /ting 'dzin gsal bar rgyu ba na/ /dus la bab ces bya ba yin/ /'di ltar brda ldan ting 'dzin la/ /dam can bud med mi 'dud pa/ /dngos grub mi 'gyur dam tshig nyams/ /tshe rabs kun du brlag par 'gyur/ /'di ltar rtsen 1par byed pa na/ /g.yan ( pa bslang ba rnam bzhi yis/ /skyes bu na chung tshul bzhin du/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i mtshams (7nyid du/ /dbyings phyug lnga yi sbyor ldan pas / /dal bus dal bus gzhug (4)pa dang / /dal bus dal bus rab tu bskul5 / /drag po'i yi ge spros pa na(6ri/ /byang chub sems kyis (7)pad+ma dgang / /sbom po dbang ngam lnga rnams kyis/ /yum gyis blangs te gtso la mchod/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa la sogs pas/ /bsnyen pa che chung rdzogs par bsgom/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /mchod pa brgyad kyis bstod par mchod/ /de ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /gnyis su med par lung bzhin du/ /mnyam par 'khril ba'i tshul du bstan/ /dus gsum kun du gdung 'dzin pa/ /g.yon phyogs brten pa'i skal dang ldan/ /bong tshod lo ni bcu dgu pa'i/ /sdong po dul ba dag la dgyes/ /g.yas par bzur (8)ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /dril bu sgra snyan 'khrol 9la brtson7/ /rdo rje rab tu sgrogs byed ma/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /mngon du sbyor la rab brtson pa/ /brda dang bcas pa'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la slong mdzad ma/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin chen gyis/ /mchod pa chen pos rab mchod mnyes/ /sprul pa bsam yas mtha' klas pa/ /dus gsum 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /ngo sor chags pa'i mdangs kyis ni/ /mnyes dang bcas pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /gru chad 11)bzhi yi rim pa la12/ /thos byed gsal byed gsung ba che/ /dri dang ldan pa la sogs 1043—10

pas / /btsun mo dag dang thabs cig 6)tu/ /gnyis su med pa'i tshul du bzhugs / /bar khyams (7bzhi la gnas pa ni/ /thos byed dbang dang nyan byed dbang / /dri mchog dbang du (5)lta byed dbang / /dus ni bzhi rnams lha mo bzhi//btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /zhe sdang 'joms byed la sogs pas/ /sgo rnams kun du gnas pa ni/ /snying rje'i yum dang bcas par gnas/ /nyi ma zla ba pad+ma mchog /rin chen dung dang bcas pa ste/ /tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis gnyis kyis/ /bteg 49pa'i khri la rab tu bzhugs/ /rdzogs pa chen por kun kyang gnas/ /sems dpa' chen po'i bzhugs tshul du/ /kun kyang rab tu gnas par bstan/ /zhal ni kun du sal 55)le ba/ /thugs ni (7kun du lhan ne ba / /sku ni kun la khyab par gsal/ /e ma mi skye mi 'gag mchog /e ma mi sel mi len mchog /e ma tsham ri cingam drag shul spyod/ /e ma gshegs pa'i stabs (8ridang bcas/ /e ma mtshan ma sel bar ston/ /e ma gsung rab rgya mtsho sgrogs(9)/ /e ma byol song spro ba bskyed/ /e ma sprul pa bsam yas mchog /e ma mya ngan 'das par mdzad/ /e ma gsang ba nges don mdzad/ /e ma gzungs dang mnyam par sbyor/ /e ma ci yang mi mdzad mchog /ngo mtshar sprin las 'di dag gis/ /sa yi rim pa 'byongs par 'gyur/ /zhes sangs rgyas pa nyid mngon par sangs rgyas pa la 'igleng ste 11)mnyes par gyur totshoge/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs 1 kyi gsang ba rnal 'byor bde ba chos kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po kun du bzang mo rnal 'byor ma la 103—11

'jug par dgyes te rab tu 'dris pa chen po dgongs pa dang / kun du bzang mo rnal 'byor mas(1 / zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa②/ e ma sems dpa' ①thig le che/ /bag chags kun gyi gnyen (ri)por gsungs/ /'di las 'jug pa'i chos 'ga' gemed/ /zhes (5)brjod do/ /de nas gsang ba chen mo dang gnyis su med par 'khril bar gyur te/ g.yon pa bskyed pa rnam pa mang pos mnyes pa dang pad+ma sbas pa la sogs pa 'byung ba spel bar mdzad nas rab tu dgyes te glu 'di blangs so/ /e ma bde ba mchog las skyes pa phyag na rdo rje can/ /chos kun dngos po med par gsal ba la/ /'byung gnas (7)chen pos ya mtshan 'byung bar mkhyen pa e ma ngo mtshar che/ /rgyu nyid stong pas 'bras bu btsal med pa'i/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid kyang rgyal bas yong mi rnyed/ /stong pa nyid la dga' ba'i chags pa'i cho 'phrul ba/ /de phyir skye 'gag med ces rgyal ba rnams kyis (she'adi la brjod/ /chos kun dbyer med ma rnyings 1)pa nyid las/ /kun gyi dga' ba 'byung ba rgyal ba kun bas shin tu 'phags/ /zhes 7brjod pas gsang ba'i mkha' la kun du bzang po rnal 'byor 'jug par mdzad de shin tu rngam pa'i glu 'di blangs so/ /sgyu 1nyam kun las 'phags pas dbyer med rnam par 'phrul byed pa / /kun du bzang po rnal 'byor de ni bder gshegs yum chen kun gyi (snyegasos / /sdug 1 bsngal kun sbyong bder gshegs yum la 'jug pa thugs dam yin zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /oṃ hūm̐ mi 'gog ji ṇi/yang mdzad pa nyid ni mi mdzad mnyam pa yin lozhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /'di ni glu ru blangs pa yis/ /mya ngan 'das kun 'gro ba'i mgon/ /stong pa chos kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /dka' thub chen po thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gnyis su med par glengs sol/ /103—12

de nas snying po mchog gi yi ge ni/ /dang po'i gnas su bsgom par bya/ /de snying ye ge bzhi pa ste/ /rdo rje chen po gsal 6)ba mchog /yi ge a ldan thig le che/ /chos kun 'dus par rnam par bsgom/ /dang por me long lta bu ste/ /mnyes pa'i kha dog shin tu 'bar/ /phyag lag 'khyud pa sprod pa yis/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar gsal/ /oṃ hūm̐ su ra ta su ke dz+nyā na da oṃ rmā (mirtsu/ bder gshegs rgyal mo mkha' dbyings su/ /gsal dag las rnams 'grub par bsgom/ /chu skyes pad+ma 'dab ma stong / /bshad pa'i sgras ni rnam par brgyan/ /de steng chos kyi sku ru gsal/ /zla rgyas lta bu'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /thams cad bsdu ba gsum gyis bsdus/ /oṃ su ra twa su khe dharma dhā (gutu swa bhā ba (4)i āḥ(nyertsu/ gnyis su med pa'i yi ge mchog /mi skye ba ni a dang ldan/ /byin brlabs (6)rgyal ba kun gyi gnas/ /mchod pa brgyad dang gsal bar ldan/ /so sor gsal ba'i mkha' dbyings la/ /rdzu gi zer gyis reg par mdzad/ /oṃ su ra twa su (7)khe na pra dz+nyā ji bha k+ṣa na swa bhā ba 5)i āḥ7rgyu/ byang chub sems kyi char (nyachen ni/ /yi ge gnyis pa rtsa dmar sku/ /gnyis su med par ldan pa na/ /bdud kun rnam par btul 7ba dang / /dbyings kyi bde la gsal ba ni/ /sgo dbye ba yi tshul gyis ni / /pad+ma dbye ba sna tshogs bya/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba yis/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes bskyed/ /'di ltar rgyal ba kun mdzad pa/ /sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab las / /mchod pa mang po lha mor ldan/ /oṃ su ra twa su khe na duṣ+ṭa dz+nyā /shen badz+ra swa bhā ba skem āḥ4 rtsu/ rnal 'byor skal ldan chen po ni/ /skal ngan kun gyi gsos su gsungs / /gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems/ /me sa bshang gci rdzas rnams ni / /dogs pa med pa'i dngos grub ste/ /rgyal ba nyid la rgyal bas mchod/ /103—13

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po las bag chags gtan la 'bebs pa gnyis su med par gleng ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i snying po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa'i phyag rgya'i mchog ni 'di lta ste/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i phyag rgya las/ /mdzes par gsal ba yab yum bcu/ /sor mo phan tshun spel legs pa/ /rdo rje thal mo byang chub rgya/ /gsang ba rnal 'byor thugs kyi mchog /dam tshig sdom pa 'da' bar dka'/ /rnal 'byor pa la a lī gsal/ /kun du bzang la ka ra byed / /lnga char zur (1)du ldan pa ni/ /gcig tu gyur pas gar gyi gzhi/ /oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ āḥrgyu/ mā ā kā hūm̐ rā/ thal mo btang snyoms tshul gyis ni/ /mdzes pa'i mtha' nyan gar gyis bya/ /snying gar (8)bcings pas rnal 'byor don/ /gar gyi phyag rgya dang nyid tsho pas/ /gar du byas pas thal mo bsnol/ /mjug (5)tu dbul pa'i tshul gyis bstod/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /g.yon pa rtse gsum g.yas pas gzung / /de nyid gzhan du 'bigs 96)par bya/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /dga' ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa yis/ /g.yas su 'dud 97pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /g.yas pa yi ni thugs kur bsgreng (8)/ /g.yon pa gsung nyan 'khril pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /mdzes pa'i mtha' (9nonas gar byas shing / /gzhan nas bsdus nas g.yas g.yon 'jog /rdo rje gar ni de dag las / /lag pa g.yas pa 'degs 7pa dang / /dbul ba'i tshul du rnam par brtag /rdo rje gar ni de dag las/ /spyan dang dbu ni g.yon du 'dud/ /cang te'u thogs pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /mchod pa byed par rnam par bsngags/ /1003—14

rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /lus ni g.yas g.yon bsgyur ba 'byedang / /gar ②las lag pa phral chabaskyed ④pa'o/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las/ /g.yon pas g.yas pa'i gru mo gzung / /g.yas pa nyug pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /de nyid rdo rje gar dag las/ /dam tshig phyag rgya 'thor bar bstan/ /rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya las / /dam tshig phyag rgya steng du bsgyur/ /de nyid g.yon pa'i nang dag las/ /g.yas pa'i dam tshig phyag rgyas gtor/ /de nyid g.yas pas drangs par ldan/ /de nyid gnyis pas gzung ba yin/ /de nyid gnyis ka thal mo bsdam/ /de nyid dril bu 'dzin par bsgom/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ mu ka ka ra su khe na oṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma rā ga s+t+waṃ su khe 55rin hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā (6)ga ta dz+wa la ya nā nā ⑦ma ma hā su khe na rta(8ri/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharma bha shra su khe na hā hā hā/ de nyid gtso bo'i 6)phyag rgyar bcas/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bud+dha lo tsā na ād+ma ni⑩/su ra twa su khe 1ston maṇ+ḍal dzapu dza ya pū dza ya/ oṃ oṃ ituge/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dhu dza dzam/ oṃ su ra twa su khe na bhan+dha bhan+dha/ pū dza ya pū dza ya/ rtsu rtsu hūm̐ ā/oṃ su ra twa su khe na/ man sha mo ha/ pū dza ya pū dza ya/ hri hri hri/ oṃ su ra twa su khe na sarba ta thā ga ta dharma dan+t+ra'/ sā dha kun da ho ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī yibadz+ra lā phye/ / badz+ra gar+bhe 51 su khe na pū dza ya pū dza ya/ oṃ hūṃ hūm̐ ju ayi/sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra gar+bhe su khe na pū dza ya pū dza ya/ traṃ traṃ lnga ( )a/ oṃ sarba ta thā ru ga ta shrī badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra gar+bhe su khe na/ dhe pa dhe pa/ pū dza ya pū dza ya/ hri hri hri sa a/ oṃ shesarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra nir te badz+ra gar+bhe ma hā ti la ka su ke na pū dza ya pū dza ya/ a a a/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra dhū khusten/badz+ra gar+bhe su khe tsho rin pū dza ya pū dza ya/ oṃ tang tang tang hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 103—15

shrī badz+ra m+buPROB 1)badz+ra gar+bhe su khe na pū dza ya pu dza ya/ lhu lhu hṝ i/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra a du lo ka dz+nyā na (7maṇ+ḍa la ti la ④ka /bud+dha su khe na pū dza ya pū dza ya/ oṃ hri snyehri hri oṃ āḥ46)rgyu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra gasne(pe/ badz+ra gar+bhe ma hā maṇ+ḍa la ti la ka su khe 58)na pū dza ya pū dza ya/ a a a/ oṃ āḥ6)rgyu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes pa'i mchog las gar gyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen mo dang bcas pa dam tshig bla na med pa'i rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /thams cad sdom pa la gnas par mkhyen no/ /dam tshig chen po 'di dag gsungs/ /so so'i theg pa bsam yas pa/ /so sor nyes pa med na bde/ /'jig rten pa la chad mdo btsan7/ /'dul ba 'dzin la bsrungs (men bde/ /gtsang sbrar spyod la gtsang sbrar spyad/ /mi dge bzlog 1sten dge ba bcu/ /spyad pas lhag pa'i 'jig rten 'dzin/ /rang gi don gyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /byang chub sa la gnas pa'i rnams/ /nyams pa med de ma bcol na/ /nyams pa med de las kyang 'grub/ /rnal 'byor spyad pa spyod pas 'grub/ /tshig cis (nyagoms pas theg r+shapa 'joms/ /gtso mchog bshes gnyen mi spong snyizhing / /bkur sti rim gro tshamachog kyang bskyed/ /ting 'dzin goms par cha lugs bsgom/ /tshig gi bzlas pa bar mi gcad1 / /dam tshig mched la gdung ba bskyed/ /sku yi dam tshig bsam mi khyab/ /gsung gi dam tshig bsngags yo pa yin/ /thugs kyi dam tshig 19lhag par gsungs 1/ /rigs lnga bsrungs pa'i 9 medam tshig rnams/ /nyams na shin tu bskang bar sa dka'/ /spyad pa'i dam tshig rdzas rnams ni/ /1003—16

nyams na myur bar bskang 6)ba yin/ /nyams pa ma bskangs le lo yis /sangs rgyas kun dang gcugs chen te/ /'khyam (mipa rnam pa bcu por ni/ /myur bar skye bar nges pa ste/ /de bas rigs kyi bu mchog ni/ /mchog dang tha ma 'bring gi rnams/ /rab kyis chabar chad med par spyad/ /'bring gis lo zla dus drug ste/ /tha mas lo mtshams (gemi bzla zhes/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis shin tu gsungs / /rdo rje dri dang byang chub sems/ /rak+ta dri chen tshe chen po/ /dag pa'i snod dang rab ldan pas/ /byin gyis brlabs te 'thung byed pa/ /dam tshig sdom la gnas pa ste/ /'das na brlag (5)pa chen por 'gyur/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i chos thams cad/ /mnyam par shes pas spyad pa dang / /mnyam pa nyid du gsal ba na/ /rnal 'byor sems dpa' yin zhes gsungs/ /rnal 'byor snod (6du bya ba gang / /rdzas kyi bsngags 7)pa yod pa rnams/ /rab tu bkru zhing byi dor bya/ /ka la ping ma'i mdog bzhin du/ / gzhong bu phur (nyebu snod kyi rnams/ /dri ma bkru zhing mdzes par bya/ /dus gsum du ni sman sbyar ba / /dang por dngul gyi gzhing par sbyar tshor/ /de nas ra gan gzhong pa ste/ /zangs kyi gzhong par sbyar ba ni/ /srang re sbyar ba'i sman rnams las/ /zangs dang dngul dang ra gan nam/ /gser dang lcags su rab bsres layi/ /rnam rtog nad la sman sbyar ba/ /man dā ra ba'i mdog bzhin sbyar/ /man dā ra bar ma gyur tshe/ /nam yang sbyar bas tsho ma gsungs te/ /nyi zla dus gcig shar ba na//de nas rdzas kyi bsngags pa las/ /sman gyi sbyor ba rab tu brtsam/ /shin tu sman rnams tso'abyor pa na/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsam yas su/ /ka la ping ku'i mdog tu brtag /'di la gang zhig mi brtson pa/ /dam tshig mi btsun tsho sdom pa 103—17

med / /rdo rje spun las dben par gdon/ /lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la/ /bag med par ni brnyas pa dang / /rmongs pas ma mthong g.yel ba dang / /dam chos srog la mi lta ba/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba bdun la brnyas/ /dkyil 'khor ba yi las byas pa/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po ste/ /tshe thung nad kyis 6)btab pa dang / /'jig rten 'di ru gnod pa mang / /shi nas dmyal ba ngan song skye/ /de bas sdom pa 'di dag las/ /'da' bar mdzad pa gang yang med/ /'di las 'das par mi byed pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba'i sku/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sa la gnas/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid la (5)nyid dam tshig chen po'i sdom pa 'dis shin tu bsnyengs par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i bde (da ba sdom pa thams cad kyi mchog gi le'u zhes bya ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po rnal 'byor ma dang bcas pa dgongs pa gcig tu gnas par mdzad do/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po spyad 5pa mchog dang ldan pa'i spyod pa ma lus pa nyid dang zab mo'i don yin par mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i thabs 'di gsungs so/ /e ma chos dbyings rnam dag spyod yul las/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ston ya mtshan 'phrul chen yin/ /de yang ye shes tshogs las sna tshogs snang mod kyi/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma las ni rab tu sprul te 'char/ /bden gnyis so sor snang ba nyid kyang yum gyi mkha' zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /ma nor lam chen sgom na kun du bzang mo bsgoms pas lam du zhugs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 1003—18

dgongs pa kun shes rab bud med 6)las ni mchod cing bsnyen pas ye shes chen por 'grub bo/ /dkyil 'khor gdon pa'i las kyi dngos grub mchog gi la rdo rje glu'i don de nyid kyis (miganyis su med pa'i dgongs pa la gsal bar gyur te③/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal kun du bzang pos thabs dang shes rab kyi longs spyod 'di gsungs so/ /mngon spyod las kyi (ge'ajug pa ni/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyod pa/ /rnal 'byor sdom la gnas pa yin / /de la mchod pa dam pa ni/ /sbyor ba rab tu sbyor ba ste/ /kun du khyab pa kun du sbyor(5)/ /rjes su chags pa dam tshig mchog /de phyir kur sham mdog dang ldan/ /bcu drug bong tshod ring ba las(6ri/ /lugs su blugs pa lta bu ste/ /lus legs mdzes dang ldan pa dang / /dpral ba dbyes che kos ko phra/ /nu ma chung zhing sor mo ring / /yid tsam bzur 57)la mig dkyus (8)ring / /dkar zhing rtsa dmar mdangs su chags/ /so dkar thags bzangs ('o)'tshams thung zhing / /skad sbom gdangs dang ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas mchog ste/ /'di la rtse bar byed pa ni/ /rigs kyi rdo rje gdon mi za/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnas rab dben par rab brtag ste/ )/ /sha dkar mdangs ldan mdog dang ldan/ /lus 'bring zlum pa tshonacha byad can/ /so dkar thags dam mig nyu dkyus zlum/ /skad phra mdog dkar spro ring ba/ /dpral dbyes la sogs bzang gnas pa/ /rma dag gnas pa la sogs ni/ /rtag par chos la 'dud pa yin/ /tshangs pa dbyangs 1 kyi rigs can te/ /'di la brtson byas bsgrub pa yis/ /de bzhin rigs kyi ting 'dzin la/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyad na/ /tshangs pa'i snga dro gcig tsam gyis/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub 103—19

par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba dgab pa 0)ni/ /sbyor ba brtson ②pas 'grub par gsungs/ /bud med cha lugs legs pa ni/ /bong tshod mi ring lus phra zhing ske/ /rkang lag chung zhing skad gsal ba/ /mig legs ngo zlum rtsa dmar che / /lhun du chags la mi shes med/ /lus la mtshan gyi ④ma 'dras brgyan/ /tshig gsal rmi lam nyung ba dang / /so dkar mchu legs dad par ldan/ /chos sems pa yi (7ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang ba'i mkha' la nyi zla'i 'od/ /rdo rje pad+mar ldan byas te/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyad na/ /'dod khams lha yi skad cig gis/ /'grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /lus zlum brtun dang nga rgyal bcas / /khong na tshig rnon sems la 'dzin/ /bya bar dran la mi gtong ldan/ /bslab pa blo rtul sha rus che/ — /mdangs bkrag brtags na phyi phyir che/ /sbyin la dga' zhing chos la dad/ /rin chen rigs kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /bag chags yi shes du tshomad gcod cing / /ting 'dzin blo la gsal ba na/ /bsgrub pa dus la bab pa ste/ /de tshe rab tu brtson pa yis/ /yum gyi pad+ma kha phye ( ste/ /bde ba thugs kyi 'du 'phro yis/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyad na/ /rigs kyi rin chen 'grub pa ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /thugs rje mdzad spyod bye brag gis/ /'jig rten dag na dman pa'i rigs/ /rab tu bkug ste dga' spyod na/ /snying rje mchog dang thabs ldan pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa chen por gsungs / /shan pa rigs ngan smad 9gyi'atshong ba/ /ngan pa'i rigs dang longs spyod rnams/ /'joms pa po yis ting 'dzin gyis/ /myur du spyad na 'grub par gsungs/ /yi dgas (9)gnod sbyin byol song dang / / khyi dang rus 7sbal spre'u la sogs/ /mi dang lha yi gnas mchog kun/ /so sor 'tsham 67par dga' 103—20

spyad na/ /dregs pa can la zhi ba che/ /brtson la dga' ba brtson par 6)mdzad/ /thabs kyi mdzad spyod kun gyi mchog /sems can 'di dag don gyi phyir/ /phyin ci log tu gang spyod rnams/ /'dul ba'i mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mi mdzad pa ni ci yang med/ /shin tu gtum pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /gtum po thams cad dbang du mdzad/ /shin tu zhi ba'i cha lugs kyis/ /dregs pa can rnams dbang du mdzad/ /shin tu mdangs ldan cha lugs kyis/ /chags pa'i yid rnams dbang du mdzad/ /e ma shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /ci yang yin pas cir mi dgongs / /zhes gsungs pas thams cad rab tu brtson pa chen po dang ldan par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rdul phra mo'i rdul snyed rab tu 'dun pa'i thugs kyis mnyan ②pa brtson par mdzad do/ /rdo rje chos kyi mchog la sogs pa rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu mnyan pa dang gus pa mchog dang ldan pas yongs su gzung ba'i le'u mdzad/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor chen mos rab tu brtson pa mdzad / rab tu brtson pa'i yid kyis sprod pa dang 'khyud pa dang gyad kyi dgyes pa dang mgu ba bla na med pas phan tshun du dga' ba spyad do/ /de nas de bzhin nyid kyi (midabyings nas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ hūṃ ye shes rnal 'byor mchog ldan pas/ /skal bzang (cadamachog gi dngos grub stsol / /rab tu rmongs pa bsal 5༄phyir 'gog pa kun slong ba/ /rnal 'byor bde mchog gnyis su med pa 'di dag shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /rin chen yid bzhin gzungs (6)ni kun gyi dbang ldan pa/ /tshangs ma'i mdangs ldan gzungs ma drangs te de brtson pas/ /grub par 'gyur ba 'di la dga' spyod a la la/ /103—21

shin tu srid ①pa 'di dag bzhin du spyad pas 'grub par gsungs pas sa la gnas pas kun pas (mi'aphags/ /rgyal ba kun gyi nang na kun du bzang po rgyal ba kun pas 'phags/ /de yang kun du bzang mo yin zhes sngon gyi rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs/ /mtshan ma kun bral rab tu dga' sbyor mi gtong bas/ /sems dpa' rdo rje nyid kyang de yin rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs/ /tshangs pa mchog gi glu 'di dag /brtson par byed cing len pa ni/ /dka' thub rnal 'byor ting 'dzin te/ /tshangs pa mchog gi dro gcig gis/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par gsungs / /zhes brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu brtson pa chen pos gcig gi rang bzhin du gyur par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ri gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas dus gsum gyi ston pa thams (4)cad bde bar gshegs pa'i rang bzhin te rab tu mchod pa chen pos mnyes shing ma rig pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dul bar mkhyen to/ /mkhyen nas ma rig pa grol bar mdzad pa dang zhe sdang rnam par grol bar dgyes te/ de dag mnyam pa chen po'i rang bzhin gyis 'dul ba'i thabs su sgrol ba dang / dbang gi rigs kyi sbyor bas rab tu bsrungs shing bsrung ba (5)mdzad do/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor kun du bzang / /mtshan nyid kun brtags gnyis su med/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor 96na/ /mnyam pa'i sa la gnas pa yin/ /rang sems zla rgyas dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin te/ /don rtogs gsal bar gyur pa yis/ /rab tu bsgral ba chen po ste//mchog gi sa la gnas rgyud yin/ /sku yi cho 'phrul rigs kun rdzogs/ /gsung 7103—22

gi ston pa bla na med/ /thugs kyi mdzad pa rtags dang ldan/ /ting 'dzin 'di ltar gsal ba yis/ /blo rmongs sdug bsngal sbyang ba'i phyir1)/ /gnyis su med par gsal ba yis/ / dzaḥs 'di hos bsdu ba mdzad/ /mngon spyod las kyis yisgrol ba mdzad/ /gnyis su med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtags dang shes pa phun sum tshogs/ /byams pa mdzad (4 pa rnal 'byor thugs/ /gzungs kyi mchod pa mnyam ldan pas/ /rgyal ba mnyes par sbyor shes na/ /mnyes pa chen pos (5)bdag nyid mchod/ /bden pa'i tshul du dbyer med pa'i/ /sems nyid rtogs pa rnam sbyang (6/phyir/ /ting 'dzin shugs kyis kun bsgral te/ /mngon spyod las kyis sgrol bar mdzad/ /gsang ba'i mkha' la kun tu sbyor/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mdzad spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa las mchod pa de kho na nyid de le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor rab tu skyong ba la dgyes te/ slob ma mchog dang 'bring dang tha mas yon gyi dbul ba mang po byas te dkyil 'khor du gzud pa mdzad ri do/ /bgegs tshar gcad pa'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 8)'dzin gyis gdong par bstan rin po ches lag sor bkang ste snying po 'di zlos su gzhug ri(go/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzi khodhi dha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā maṇ+ḍal 11de ba ka ra pū dza ya pū dza ya hūṃ a/ zhes brjod de me tog 'thor du gzhug go/ /gang la bab pa'i bshes sna gnyen bstan/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 1gedam tshig bstan/ /de nas dam tshig chu blud cing / /tshig 'di rab tu go bar bsgo/ /sems can gyi ni gzugs chen po/ /las la sogs te dbang bskur ba1 / / rgyal ba'i sras 103—23

su dbang bskur yin/ /6)de ②ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ /dam ③tshig gnyan po 'di dag ni/ /srog gi ④phyir yang mi gtong ⑤zhing / /slob dpon ma btang ⑥grogs la mchod/ /bka' la gus par mnyan par byos/ /gal te bka' las 'das gyur ( stan/ /gzhom dang gzhig dang dam rtsal dang / /spro dang spar dang dmyal bar skye/ /sems la chu 'di gnas pa ni/ /phrin (8)las rnam bzhi 'tsham par bya/ /zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor dang / /kun du bzang dang mched la sogs/ /zhabs la gtugs dang gus par bya/ /rgyud kyi mnyan pa thams cad bya/ /bsgrub 6)pa'i gzugs la brten pas 'grubatso/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog la/ /gsang ba'i ming gi dbang yang bskur/ /gus par ldan pa'i bu mchog des/ /rgyal po dbang yod rgyal po srid/ /rang lus gnas dang 'khor yul dang / /bu dang chung ma tsha rgyud dang / /rin po che dang shel dang dngul/ /sna bdun rin chen nor gyi dbyig /rta dang glang po shing rta dang —/ /ma he ne'u le ci yod rnams/ /gter dang dbyig dang yid 'thad pa/ /sems la the tshom 17med pa yis/ /bkur sti rim gro mchog bskyed la/ /phul na rgyal ba mnyes par 'gyur/ /de nas dbang mnod tu theg pa'i tshad/ /rim pa bzhin du mnod 12par bya/ /mnyan pa grub pa la sogs dang / /las dang ging dang rgyal 'theb dang / /spyan dang rdo rje tshad 'dzin pa/ /bye brag mngag pa la sogs rnams/ /gsang ba'i dbang rnams gang nod pa/ /nyi shu'am bcu gnyis lon pa la/ /gos dang dbu rgyan bza' btung dang / /phyag rgya dril bu la sogs pa / /dkyil 'khor 'di ltar gsal bsgoms te/ /rgyal ba kun gyis byin gyis brlabs / /mngon du stan 'bating dga' spyod cing / /steng nas rgyal pos 1043—24

dbang bskur 0)na/ /gdon mi za bar dngos grub thob/ /tshig gi legs pa bstod ra ②bya/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /zhabs la gtugs te ①gtang rag gtong ④/ /rdo rje spun dang gzungs ma yis/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal ba yin zhes brjod/ /dus gsum kun gyi sras chen po/ /dus gsum kun gyi spyad pa spyod/ /khams gsum kun gyi sgrol ba po/ /sgrol ba mchog gi (9spyad pa spyod/ /shin tu rnal 'byor skal ldan pa/ /dam tshig sdom la gnas pa dang / /mtshan ma med pa'i chu 'thung zhing / /ji ltar bsgo ba'i (6)las byed pa/ /kun la phyad tsopar rab grags yin/ /phyi rabs 'dren pa'i gdung 'dzin pa/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sa la gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba de kho na nyid las mchod yon dam pa dang snying rje'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te gnas par mdzad do/ /mdzad nas snrel zhi dang bya byed yan man mang po mi 'gog pa la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas yang las la ltos (kyepa rang thad kyi sdug bsngal rnams mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'jog dzinapar mdzad do/ /de nas yang mu stegs rtag par lta ba ther zug pa la rtag pa tsother zug gi cha lugs kyis /1'dul bar mdzad do/ /chad pa phyis mi 'dod ces bya ba la cha lugs des mnyam pa la 'dzud par mdzad do/ /mdzad nas rab tu 'gog pa'i dka' thub kyis myur ba bde ba la gnas par mi ster ba rnams la dka' thub 'gyur ba chen po'i tshul gyis 'dul dbang chen po mdzad do/ /drag shul gyi btsan mthabs la dga' ba de thags zangs sna ris kyi cha lugs 7kyis 103—25

'dul bar mdzad do/ /gzhan la snying rjer ma gyur pa'i phyogs gcig pa'i sa rgyal rnams la yid bzhin gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dul bar mdzad do/ /gling bzhi'i dge sdig cha mi shes pa la 'khor los sgyur 0)ba chen por mdzad nas 'dul bar mdzad do/ /sbrebs pa chen po dang gtub (gupa chen po dang / btso (gub dang rab tu so tham tham che chung rnams gnyen po dang zangs kha dang / gshed po chen po'i tshul gyis 'dul bar mdzad do/ /de dag kyang chos mnyam pa chen po byang chub kyi tshul rdo rje theg pa kun gyi mchog rang bzhin gyi tshul gyis 94)gnas pa thabs (5)dang shes rab dbyer med de rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas par mdzad do / /thabs kyi mdzad pa khro bo rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po bdud 96)'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par mdzad do/ /de nas bdud zhe sdang chen po zhes bya ba de bskal pa stong gi dus na sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa blangs pas byang chub tu sems ma bskyed 7)pa/ rab tu gdug pa/ skyi bung ba/ bong dzo che zhing tshor sang che ba/ mtshon cha dang khrag gi gdug nga/sa sems can la gnod pa/ mtshon gyi mche ba dang bcas pa dpag tshad nas dri tshor te rab tu gsod gcod 9za 'thung byed cing me dpung gi dkyil na gdug pa'i mda' 1 'phen cing g.yo ba chen pos bsngo ba drag po dang tsham ngam du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas kun du bzang mo la 'dzum pa 11mdzad do/ /yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyi sprin las/oṃ dhu dhu dhu dhu ra dhu ra dhu ra 12ho ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hri hri hri/ ho ho zhes brjod pas tshangs pa'i chung ma dang / dbang po'i chung ma dang / khyab 'jug gi 1210 (3—26

chung ma dang / 0)tsakra'i chung ma dang / de ba'i chung ma dang / ru tra'i chung ma dang / ga ru ḍa'i 97chung ma dang / yul 'khor srung gi (7chung ma dang / rnam thos kyi chung ma dang / 'phags skyes kyi chung ma dang / mig mi bzang gi chung ma rnams rab tu chags pa'i 'du shes rang dbang med par skyes te 'du bar mdzad do / /de yang byang chub sems kyi sprin las/ satwa badz+ra lihi ru ka /ma hā sa ma ya sarba sidhi/ rtsu rtsu hūm̐/ ho ho ho zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mang pos mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur te bzhugs pa la tshangs pa'i chung ma la sogs pa 'dus pa thams cad kyis so so re re shin tu chags pa chen po'i yid skyes te 'khril bar gyur to/ /'khril nas kyang rol pa'i byang chub kyi sems las chu'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jig rten 'khru zhing 'jig par mdzad do/ /me'i dkyil 'khor mang pos 'jig rten rab tu sreg (5)par mdzad do / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mang pos 'jig rten sems can gtor bar mdzad do / /de nas byang chub sems kyi sprin gyis rigs nges par dbang bskur 6bar mdzad do/ /de nas gnyis su med pa las bzhengs te/ oṃ oṃ sarba bi si du shasba 57dza dza dza zhes brjod pas tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gi chung ma la sogs pa/gzungs las bran mor dam mnos te slar gnas su phyin par gyur to/ /de nas sku'i cha lugs de las mnyam pa chen po la naganas par mdzad de59)/ oṃ bha rā khulamu tā ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa tsa kur 11 yo gi ni maṇ+ḍal 12gro dha ha la ha la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas so so'i chung ma dang bu sring rdo rje gsod /dbyed ma chen mor gyur te/ bdud gdug pa chen po zhe sdang can la sogs pa la jo bo dam mnos 7bzhengs zhes smras te / bdud gdug pa'i lus la khrag bzhibs lonas gnas so/ /'on kyang dam 103—27

nyan par ma btub ste g.yo bag med par shin tu sngo 0)bar gnas par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sprul pa (gethams cad gcig tu sdu ②ba mdzad de dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi tho ba dang rdo rje dang / rde'u chung dang / mda' gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / sdigs pa'i mdzub ④mo dang / bhan dha (snye'akhrug pa'i rol pas kun tu bzang mo dang 'khril nas dbu gsum gsigs te/sarba bha tha sarba bha tha hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud bzhi dang / tshangs pa dang brgya (6)byin la sogs pa rgyal chen chos 7skyong bsdus te/khā hi khā hi phaṭa phaṭa ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐ hūṃ zhes pas bsgral te/ bharnya ra bkang (kyinas gsol te mi gnas par mdzad do/ /yang zhabs g.yas pa 'phen 6)cing 'greng sbyor gyi botshul gyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dz+nyā na gar bha 0ho dhu ho dhu ho dhu / tsaṇ+ḍal bha la ma hā shrī he ru ka hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ r+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hri hri hri/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas so so'i chung ma bu mos rang dbang med par bteg ste phyin to / /de nas bdud zhe sdang chen po de yang dregs pa'i chung mas bteg 7ste phyin to / /phyin nas bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan chen pos/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 1gem hā sa ma ya shrī he ru ka duṣ+ṭi dha ka ha na/ da ha da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa pa tsa/ hā hā hā hā hā zhes brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen mo rnal 'byor ma skul 7byed ma dang / rnal 'byor ma gsod byed ma dang / za byed ma dang / rnal 'byor ma chagatum mo dang / las la grub pa chen mo dang / rdo rje sreg 7byed ma dang / dbang sdud chen mo yinarnams yum gyi gsang ba'i mkha' las byang chub kyi sems kyi sprin las 'thon yoshenas gdug pa'i tshogs bdud mgo nas bzung ste mtshon cha dang phral nas bsgral te lhu 103—28

sug phral nas bsnams 6)shing bstabs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po'i dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung chen pos 'gro ba gnod sbyin bdud kyi rigs kyi 'khor dang yi dgas gokyi lus rta'i lus can gyi gasrin mo chen mo dang / 'ug pa mo chen mo dang / dur bya chen mo dang / stag dang / seng ge ba glang rtsi/ wa dang / khyi dang / pha wang dang / spre'u dang / bya rog dang / bya rgod dang /rnga mo dang / phag la sogs pa ma tang (5)ru tra dang chas te gnas pa la mtshan mar ma chags pa'i sbyor ba mdzad nas/ he he he he he/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas byang chub kyi sems kyi sprin las seng ge stabs yichen po dang / stag gi cha lugs chen mo dang / myos byed rta mgo chen mo dang / 'ug pa'i mgo can dang / bya rog dang / bya rgod dang / mchu rings gal sogs pa srin mo'i cha lugs dang ma bral ba'i mdog gis 'thon nasal/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā maṇ+ḍal hūṃ phaṭa zhes brjod pas gdug pa'i tshogs bsgral bar mdzad de bya dang / mche ba can dang / sder chags kyi za stangs kyis 'phrog cing gsol ba 6)mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal 7sgyu 'phrul chen mos yang phyis bstan pa la mi sgrib par bya ba'i /heched du las kyi 'das 7pa 'di bka' stsal to / /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu ru/ /khor yi yug dur khrod chen po ste/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'gyur yinas/ /drag po 'dul ba'i don ched du//dkyil 'khor 'bar ba de dbus su/ /khrag 'thung ye shes chen po ste/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgradatshe/ /ser nag 'jigs pa chen po'i sku/ /sangs rgyas khros pa'i rgyal mo dang / /ma hā su kha'i tshul du 'khril/ /rnam par thar pa'i zhal gsum gyis/ /khams gsum ma lus rngub cing gsol/ /thugs 103—29

dam nyusisnying rje chen po yis/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor chen por bsdus/ /rdo rje bhan dhar ldan pa yis/ /khrag chen po dag 'khrug cing gsol/ /'jigs pa'i ral pa gyen du 'khyil/ /bskal pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus/ /gshog sgra drag pos stong gsum g.yo/ /rkan sgra drag pos srog chags brgyal/ /spyugs pas bsod nams lus 'jig cing 2/ /yum chen mo dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sdig tshipa rde'u chung tri shu 4zhing / /phyag na bsnams (5)shing ril mid (6)mdzad/ /stabs (7steglu phyag rgya sngags tshig gis/ /zhing shubacu gsod cing tshul bzhin du/ /ha ha has ni dgyes par mdzad/ /he he nyes ni yum dang rol/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis char 5)chen 'bebs/ /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis za byed che/ /zhabs bzhi bdud bzhi sgrol zhing gnon/ /gzhal yas mthing nag chen pos ni/ /'jig rten khams gsum gyur pa ste/ /klu chen rgyal po mang po rnams/ /khyad par chen po'i sku la brgyan/ /srog chags chen po'i pags 7chen yang / /tsham ngam chen po'i na bzar 67gsol / /ci yang sgyur yang gzugs can te/ /'jigs byed sku ste cho 'phrul ba/ /drag shul gsung gi nga ro yis/ /gsod cing 'thung ba'i tshogs chen po/ /snying rje mngan 1 sems khrag chen 'thung / /gsod cing sbyor ba'i mchod pa la/ /shin tu dgyes pa chen por ston/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ha/ khā hi khā hi khā hi/ha ha ha sa/ ru ru rak+ta/ ka ka kur ma/ yo gi ni/ ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ rdo rje rigs chen mi bskyod thugs/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad/ /zhing chen gshibs 1 pa'i gdan stengs 7na/ /zhabs bzhi bdud bzhi rab tu gnon/ /smug nag 'jigs pa chen po'i sku/ /rdo rje khros pa'i rgyal mo dang / /ma hā su kha'i 15tshul du 'khril/ /rnam par thar 16343—30

pa'i zhal gsum gyis/ /khams gsum ma lus rngub cing gsol/ /thugs dam snying rje chen po yis/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bsdus/ /snying rje bhan dhar ldan pa yis/ /khrag chen po dag 'khrug cing gsol/ /'jigs ①pa'i ral pa gyen du 'khril/ /bskal pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus/ /gshog sgra drag pos stong gsum g.yo/ /rkan (gyisgras rigs kun brgyal zhing 'bub / /spyugs pas bsod nams lus 'jig cing (4)/ /yum chen mo dang mnyam par sbyor/ / sdig pa'i (5)ri rab tri shul ne༄zhing / /phyag na bsnams (dzo)shing khrag 'thung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun du bzang mo dang / /rol pa'i tshul gyis mnyam sbyor zhing / /stabs glu (85phyag rgya sngags tshig gis/ /zhing chen gsod cing phung mdzad pa/ /ha ha has ni dgyes par mdzad/ /he he nyes ni yum dang rol/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ gis char chen 'bebs/ /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis za byed che/ /gzhal yas smug nag chen po ste/ /'jig rten stong gsum gyur pa ste/ /klu chen rgyal po mang po rnams / /khyad par chen po'i sku la brgyan/ /srog chags chen po'i pags chen yang / /tsham ngam chen po na tsho bzar gsol/ /cir (7yang sgyur yonaba'i gzugs chen po/ /che'o che'o dpal chen po/ /sangs rgyas sku yang chem chem gsol/ /srog chags gzhan lta smos / ci dgos/ / 'jigs byed zhu sku ste cho 'phrul ba/ /drag shul gsung gi nga ro yis/ /gsod cing 'thung ba'i tshogs chen po/ /snying rje mngan lasems khrag chen 'thung / /gsod cing sbyor ba'i tsomachod pa la/ /shin tu dgyes pa chen por ston/ /khras 'thung 'bar ma ma gtogs yipar/ /gcig kyang gson par mi mdzad de/ /de bzhin thugs dam nyid pas na/ / / gsad pa'i / rgyu la shin tu dgyes/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ha/ khā hi khā hi khā 103—31

'khor lo gsal ba la ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang nam mkha'i dbyings (1)ltar rgya phyogs bcur yongs su ma (michad pa/ yon tan bla ma chen po dpag tu med pas rgyas pa'i phyir gru bzhir gyur pa/ lhag pa'i ye shes rin po che bla ma'i glo 'bur bzhis mdzes pa/ rtse mo phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thams cad so so ma yin tha mi dad pa'i ngo bo nyid gcig pa'i ye shes bla mas kun (5)du 'khyil (gerab/ ye shes bla ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings (snyedang / kha dog la sogs pa rnam pa tha dad pa'i bye brag dang khyad par du gyur pa/ spags 56)pa/ tshad dpag tu med pa/ ye shes rin po che bla ma'i phreng ba dang / chun 'phyang ri ridang / shar bu'i rgyan dang / gzugs dang sgra dang / dri ro (4)reg bya la sogs pa mi sgrib par gsal bar rang byung la/gsal ba'i rgyan khyad par can bla mas bklubs (9)pa/ tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'jug pa'i sgo khyud can/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi rta babs dang ldan pa/phyi dang nang med pa kun 〉yang bla ma chen po nang du gyur pa/ shin tu gsang ba bas khyab bdal ba'i bla ma chen po'i gzhal yas khang na pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i khri/mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri dang / stobs glang po che'i khri dang / rdzu 'phrul rta'i khri dang / dbang rma bya'i khri dang / thogs pa med pa nam mkha' /stelding gi khri dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal 15ba nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang / gos pa med pa pad+ma rin po che'i gdan brtsegs pa ni/ ye nas gsang ba bla ma'i phyir/ /yum gyi gzhal yas phyogs bcur 'bar/ /ye nas pha rol phyin pa'i phyir/ /thogs pa med pa'i khri rkang brtan/ /rang bzhin ye nas 'od gsal phyir/ /nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan 'bar zhing / /gdod nas dri ma med pa'i phyir/ /rnam 103—89

par dag pa pad+mo gdan/ /re ba yid bzhin skong ba'i phyir/ /yid bzhin rin chen gter gyi gdan/ /ma bsags lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyan/ /yon tan chen po'i gdan stengs 6)na/ /sku mdun dang rgyab med par thams cad tu zhal bla ma tha le bar gsal zhing mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pas thams cad du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin ri las sna tshogs par snang ba/ thabs dang shes rab kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs kyi skyil mo krung (bdu bzhugs pa/ ye shes drug gi phyag 4)ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i phyag rgya can/ sku gsung thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbu gsum dang ldan pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po bla ma dang / btsun mo dam pa sra ba'i dbyings kyi bla ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs kyi rgyal po bla ma dang /btsun mo dam pa snang ba'i dbyings kyi bla ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa tshor ba'i rgyal po bla ma dang / btsun mo dam pa mnyen (3)pa'i dbyings kyi bla ma dang /de bzhin gshegs pa 'du shes kyi rgyal po bla ma dang / btsun mo dam pa dro ba'i dbyings kyi bla ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'du byed kyi rgyal po bla ma dang /btsun mo dam pa bskyod pa'i dbyings kyi bla ma la sogs pa ye shes rgyal po stangs (6)dpyal tsho kun kyang mthing ga (8)dang / dkar po dang / ser po dang / le brgan 9dang / ljang gu'i sgyu mdog bla mar 'tsher ba ste/ gnyis su med par 'khril bas chos kyi dbyings kun tu mtha' yas par bla ma chen po'i spyod pas khyab pa ni 'di lta ste/ dper na til gyi gang bu'am mngar gyi sgrom 41)bu bzhin kun du bde ba chen pos khyab par bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub chen po rdo rje mthong 103—90

dbang bla ma dang / btsun mo gzigs par bya ba'i bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje thos dbang bla ma dang / btsun mo gsan par bya ba'i bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje snom dbang bla ma dang / btsun mo mnam 0)par bya ba'i bla ma dang —/ byang chub chen po rdo rje myang (snyedabang bla ma dang / btsun mo myang bar bya ba'i bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje sogs (5)shes bla ma dang / btsun mo sgron (4)ma'i bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje gcod shes bla ma dang / btsun mo gdug pa'i bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje 'jug shes bla ma dang / btsun mo char 'bebs bla ma dang / byang chub chen po rdo rje 'dus pa'i bla ma dang /btsun mo rgyas pa'i bla ma dang / 'joms pa chen po rdo rje reg g.yas bla ma (5)dang /btsun mo rtag par ma yin pa'i bla ma dang / 'joms pa chen po rdo rje reg g.yon bla ma dang / btsun mo chad par ma yin pa'i bla ma dang / 'joms pa chen po rdo rje reg gsang bla ma dang / btsun mo bdag tu ma yin pa'i bla ma dang /'joms pa chen po rdo rje reg 'dus bla ma dang / btsun mo mtshan mar ma yin pa'i bla ma dang / de lta bu'i tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba dang gnyis su med par gsang ba dgyes pa'i dbyings bla ma na bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma de nyid kyi gsang ba bla ma 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin ( skalas rdo rje las byung ngo / /e ma'o de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid dbang sgyur 57༄dkyil 'khor bla ma'i ngang / /ngang nyid rnam dag bde mchog gsang ba'i dbyings/ /dbyings nyid mnyam sbyor bde mchog rin na chen gter/ /mi zad gter ldan bdud rtsi gsang ba'i bla/ /bla med byang chub thig le ya mtshan dkyil 'khor snang / /rang 103—91

snang ba nyid ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan rnam dag snang ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs yon 1niphrin (snyelas sel gemed pa'i yid bzhin rin chen mi zad par ldan pa rgyan gyi 'khor 4)lo bla ma rdo rje mchog gi gnas nyid do/ /rdo rje gsang ba bla ma'i nges don du'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i bla ma las dbyings dang ye shes gsang ba'i bde ba'i bla ma nges pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das yid byed pa bla ma rdo rje kun du bzang po thams cad ma lus pa'i tshul rdo rjes (5)btsun mo bya ba mo kun du bzang mo'i bla ma la 'jug par gyur to/ /gsang ba'i bla ma'i tshig 'di ched du brjod do/ /oṃ chos kyi chos nyid bya ba'i dbyings/ /kun du bzang mo bde ba'i yum/ /ma g.yos rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bdag yin bdag gi spyod yul bas/ /phyag rgya sna byo1gas so sor gsal/ /nub phyogs 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /ma chags pad+ma'i gdan bting (6ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba bzhugs (7)pa'i gnas/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi (8)la/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dbang med skal ngan bsal 991ba'i phyir/ /nang gtan phyi rim lcags dang ldan/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi khogasang ba'i chos/ /sus 17kyang gting dpag dka' ba ste/ /kun du bzang po nyid kyis gzigs/ /hoḥnya de nas btsun mo bya ba tu kun du bzang mos gsang ba bla ma'i tshig 'di ched du brjod do/ /oṃ sems kyi sems nyid byed pa'i gtso / /kun du bzang po rdo rje yid/ /ye shes brgyad kyi rang bzhin te/ /shar phyogs mngon dga' bsam yas nas/ /nī tshosal lta bu'i gter 'byin kepa/ /gsang 'dus 'phrul gyi lde mig gis/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo phye ste/ /byang chub 1003—92

mchog gi nang gtan bkrol0)/ /ma chags pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'gro don byang chub sems bskyed de/ /'gro lnga skye bzhi (snyedabang du bsdus/ /sku gsung thugs nas dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gleng ngo / /de nas bya ba mo kun du bzang mos gsang ba bla ma'i mchod pa 'di ched du phul lo/ /oṃ rin chen pad+ma'i dkyil 'jam 'di/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis 'bul lags kyis / /bla med 'phrul gyi lde mig ste/ /dgyes mchog rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /bdud rtsi ⑨char chen dbab tu gsol/ /zhes ched du gleng ngo / /de nas yang yid byed pa po rdo rje kun du bzang pos bdud rtsi bla ma'i char pas snod bcud kyi 'dzam bu'i gling tshim par bya ba'i phyir gsang ba bla ma'i tshig 'di ched du brjod do/ /oṃ rdo rje bla ma'i dgyes rab 'di/ /gsor (rinanas bdud rtsi'i char dbab phyir/ /'dzum zhing 'khyil ba'i gnas su gsor/ /mi dmigs bde dang spro ba 'di(6)/ /kun du bzang mo dbyings su bskyil/ /zhes ched du gleng ste/ gnyis su med pa las nyid kyi spyod yul thams cad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma khyad par du spags pa rdul phra mo snyed 'thon (7༄nas sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul chen po bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad pa ni/ la la ni gsang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs (2)te yan lag thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis rlob/ la la ni 'gro ba drug 'dul 5skaba'i don du thub pa chen po drug tu bzhugs pa 'di lta ste/ / lha yi / ciganas na brgya byin mgon / /lha ma yin la thags zangs 17ris/ /mi la bdud 'dul shākya mgon/ /yi dgas tsoganas na kha 'bar bde/ /byol song seng ge nyid du smra/ /dmyal ba la ni gshin rje mgon/ /sku dang cha lugs tshul ston cing / /la la lhums tshonazhugs sku la bltamasas/ /la la tshul bsrung tsherab tu byung / /la la bsnyen rdzogs 103—93

dka' 6)thub byed/ /la la dam nod 'gro ba sgrol/ /la la bcu drug chos la btsud / /la la mer (gyi'abar chur yang 'brug( ) /la la nam mkha' ④sgra ru 'bar / /la la rdo rje brag tu sra/ /la la gso gsod 'pham ⑧rgyal byed/ /la la bcing sgrol 'gug sgrol byed/ /la la bdud 'dul ⑥ngan song sbyong / /la la dkyil 'khor mchod sprin 'khril/ /kun kyang chos kyi ⑦'khor lo skor(kye/ /de ltar rtag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni (9)'di lta ste/ theg pa dang po bcu drug mgon / /gnyis pa bzhi yi lta spyod bsrung / /gsum pa bcu gnyis nges par bstan / /bzhi pa gnyis kyi lta spyod sbyangs7/ /bzhi pa'i theg pa mdor bsdus na / /bla 11med theg pa'i dbyings su btsud/ /theg pa bzhi yi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor sgyu 'phrul che/ /mang la 'brel bas dra ba'i don/ /thun 8mong min pas gsang ba'i don/ /theg pa'i bcud de snying po'i dbyings/ /zhes ched du gleng ste/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsang bar gnas yi sgyur 7ba dang / phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsang ba bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gzigs mos mnyes 7par gyur to/ /de nas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad dang 1 / snyigs ma med par gsang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par sangs rgyas nas ched du brjod pa 'di 1nyabarjod do/ /e ma'o rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /skye 67mched khams rnams mang po kun/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /sa chu spyan ( )dang mā ma khri 1 / /me rlung 22gos dkar sgrol ma ste/ /nam mkha' 9 2dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma / /srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas zhing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /103—94

sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi rnyed do/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis ched du brjod pa 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o phyogs bcu'i stong khams ye nas dben/ /srid pa gsum nyid dag pa'i zhing / /snyigs ma lnga nyid bde ldan gnas/ /phung po lnga nyid mngon sangs rgyas/ /thams cad mchog gi snying po bas/ /gzhan du rgyal bas chos mi btsal/ /nyid las gzhan zhes bya ba'i chos / /btsal kyang rgyal bas mi rnyed do/ /zhes brjod pas chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to/ /de nas dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa las ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /sna tshogs snang ba rang bzhin gsang / /0)gsang mchog snying po bla na med/ /thams cad gsang ba'i dbyings su nges/ /bla ma mchog gi snying po las/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /ces brjod pas thams cad dbyings su nges par mkhyen to/ /de ltar yin na yang 'gro ba'i rnam par rtog pas 'gro ba'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab par smin pa la thugs rje chen po sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje bla ma'i tshig (ge'adi ched du brjod do/ /e ma'o bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul / /sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang / /gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs (mipa'i/ /bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin/ /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin/ /rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa yis/ /nan gyis mkha' la mdud pa bor/ /bcings med rnam par grol 103—95

med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun 6)rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /bstan phyir spro ba sna tshogs mdzad / /spros kyang 'phel 'grib med pa'i dbyings/ /de ltar yin na yang de ltar ma rtogs 9shepa rnams la kun rdzob kyi phung po byang chub kyi sems bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du sems kyi ngo bo bskyed pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di ched du brjod do/ /stong zhing dben pa'i sems nyid ni/ /rigs dang kha dog dbyibs med de / /ci yang zhu med la cir ④yang snang / /mi bskyod (5)rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung / /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyang / /sems kyi sgyu 'phrul chen po yin / /gcig dang du mar mi dmigs te/ /mngon shes drug gis thams cad byed / /bla ma'i ting 'dzin chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor chen po byed par bstan / /rgyu 967lnga rkyen bzhis bsdus pa la/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che phra 9)bsgom / /bzhi yi rim pa tshul bzhin byed/ /rgyan dang phyag rgya'i tshul rnams kun / /til 'bru'i nang du ri rab bskyed(8)/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor dang / / stangs dpyal (9)gnyis kyi phyag rgya yang / /ri rab til 'bru'i tshul bzhin du/ /dpe byad rgyan gyis brgyan spras pa'o/ /nges pas bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bsgom / /dbyings (7dang ye shes stangs dpyal 6nyaganyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed pa po/ /hoḥgazugs ni rnam par snang mdzad de/ /yul la kun du bzang mo'o hoḥ/ /tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /yul la khams gsum byams ma'o (1rnyehoḥ / /'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /yul la na bza' dkar mo'o 4)hoḥ/ /'du byed don yod grub pa ste/ /yul la dam/ tshig sgrol ma'o hoḥ/ /rnam kha7shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /yul la yangs pa'i spyan can ma hoḥ/ /mig lil sa yi glusnying po ste/ /yul la dkar mo sgeg chen no hoḥ/ /sna la nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /103—96

yul la me tog dpa' phreng 0)ma'o hoḥ/ /lce la spyan ras dbang phyug ste/ /yul la chos kyi dbyangs can no hoḥ/ /rna bar phyag na rdo rje ste/ /yul la las kyi gar mkhan ma'o hoḥ/ /kun 'dus sgrib pa rnam ④sel te/ /yul la me tog char 'bebs hoḥ / /①kun shes kun du bzang po ste/ /yul la gsal ba'i sgron ④ma'o hoḥ / /gcod shes byams pa'i bdag nyid de/ /yul la gdug zhu)pa'i sprin 'phro 6rihoḥ / /'jug shes 'jam dpal gzhon nu ste/ /yul la tsan+dan char 'bebs so(pe / /g.yas gnyis stobs chen khro bo ste/ /yul la gdong mo 'jigs tshul hoḥ//g.yon gnyis gshin rje'i (8)gshed po ste/ /yul la sder 5)'phro 'jigs tshul hoḥ/ /gsang ba rta mgrin dpa' bo ste/ /yul la dur khrod bdag mo 8hoḥ/ /lte bar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ /yul la gtum /nyamo 'jigs tshul hoḥ/ /rgyud drug 'khor ba'i gnas drug tu/ /thub drug phyag rgya chen po'o/ /kun du sku dang kun du gsung / /kun du thugs kyi phyag rgya yang / /lus ngag yid la de bzhin hoḥ/ /sems nyid sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul chen po las/ /dra ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu lnga/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nges pa las/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yin/ /zhes brjod pas sems can thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dbyer med par dgyes skute mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings na bzhugs so/ /gsang ba'i snying po de kho na nyid nges pa'i bla ma las dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngang du sems kyi rang bzhin cir yang 'grub pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang bzhin gcig dang du mar 103—97

dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin thams cad kyis 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad la nyid kyi che ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma 'di dbyung bar bzhed 0)nas ched du brjod pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ye shes bla ma rol pa yis/ /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar brtags na/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun gyis grub/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /kun 'byung dkyil 'khor chen por spyod/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /gru ②chad bzhis brgyan ①rdo rje'i khyams/ /kun du gru bzhi sgo khyud ldan/ /rol mo sna tshogs sprin phung bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis kyis brgyan/ /seng ge glang chen rta dang khyung / /nam mkha' lding gi khri chen la/ /nyi zla pad+ma rin po che/ /gdan la rdzogs dang sems dpa'i tshul/ /'khor lo rgyal po rgyal mo dang / /g.yas nas mthong thos mnam ④pa dang / /myong dang btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas/ /gru chad la ni gcod byed dang ske/ /snang byed sogs (5)byed 'jug (5)byed rnams/ /btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas par gnas/ /bar khyams la ni thub drug dag /rgyud drug sbyong ba'i phyag rgyar gnas/ /de bzhin thig le chen po dag /mdun dang rgyab tu byed pa dag /bya ba dag ni gnas par bstan/ /sgo khyud bzhi la 'joms pa dag /btsun mo'i tshogs dang ldan par gnas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma'i ral gri nor bu 'bar/ /ut+pal (7)klu shing la sogs mtshan/ /mdzes tshul mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dzin/ /mthing ga dzo8)dkar po ser le brgan(9)/ /ljang gu 6 skul sogs sna tshogs mdog /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhin tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun stug gzi byin 'bar/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs chen po/ /'bar ba'i phreng yisteb 'khrigs pa ste/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab pa yi(2/ /dkyil 'khor bsam 103—98

yas lhun gyis ༅grub hoḥ/ zhes brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa thams cad du dkyil 'khor bla ma chen po brjod kyis mi lang ba zhing gi rdul snyed ②du gsal bar gyur gto/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa btsun mo'i tshogs dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor de dag nyid kyi gsang ba bla ma 'di sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las (4)'di dag phyung ngo / /a hoḥ/ bde mchog ngo mtshar byang chub sems chen po/ /thig le mnyam sbyor sgyu (5)'phrul bla ma'i dbyings/ /rnam dag thig le byang chub sems kyis rol/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung bla ma chen po'i dbyings hoḥ/ / dmigs bya dmigs (6)byed mi dmigs gsang ba'i dbyings/ /ye shes rang rig (7)dkyil 'khor bla ma bsam mi khyab/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam kun khyab gsang ba'i dbyings/ /ye shes kun gsal (8) dkyil 'khor spros med bla ma'i ngang / /ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po nges pa'i yorabla ma chen po las dkyil 'khor spros pa'i le'u ste tsogasum pa'o// //de nas ye shes rgyal po de btsun mo bla 41ma'i dbyings dang gnyis su med par gyur nas/ bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems rim par gsal ba zhes bya ba'i dgongs pa rtser chib nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa phyogs bcu dus bzhir dgos 4 gepar bzhed nas sku gsung thugs bla ma'i dbyings nas 'di dag phyung ngo / /dang po bla ma'i lung bstan pa/ /mtshon du med pa'i byang chub sems/ /ye shes snying po gsal ba dang / /bsgom sna pa rnam gsum dus gcig rdzogs/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le la/ /ma bkag lhun gyis rdzogs pas na/ /de ni thig le chen 103—99

po'i don/ /de ni de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /de ni kun du snang ba'i ngang / /de ni rgyu yi rim par ldan hoḥ/ /gsang ba bla ma'i tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba bla ma'i nges don las/ /gsang ba gsung gi dkyil 'khor grags/ /: 6)bi shwa bi shud dhe badz+ra swā hā/ hūm̐ rtsu hūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta oṃ/ a a a badz+ra pa ta sa ma ya oṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra dh+ri ka /sbo (tsan+d+ra tu yī ri 0shwa ri/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka /lī de ṣa lir ti/ swā rat+na ṣ+ṭṛ ka /māṃ 55)mo ha ra ti/ iḥ.a ro li ka /r+pā ra yig ra ti/ ha pradz+nyā lhaka /ṭ+wāṃ ⑦badz+ra ra ti(8)/ k+ṣi hi rā dzā (9)ya/ rtsu lā yise sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ (1a gar+bha ya/ ṭ+wāṃ mā 7le sa ma ya hoḥ/ hrīḥdzi)ha ho pad+ma brnya ma/ hrīḥgī ti ra hoḥ/ haṃ dzi yiku ru pa na hrīḥ/ āḥkṛ t+ya rā ga yā mi/ be+e dhā ri ṇi 8swā hā/ dzaḥdhū pa yisra be sha / sgyu ni sa ra ma bā ya maswā hā/ rtsu put+pa a be (nyasha /hūm̐ sa rā 6)dzā ya swā hā/ bo dhū ( )pi su k+ṣa ṇi/ m+bi shrī ā ro gā ya ( nyes hā/ hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta/ oṃ ( rtenu ne kṛ zhu swā hā/oṃ mu ne rtsu hūm̐ tsho rig hā/ oṃ mu ne 253 swā hā/ oṃ mu ne sum̐ nitswaswā hā/ oṃ mu ne k+ṣi swā hā / oṃ 9 mu ne ye swā hā/ hūm̐ ya mān+ta kṛta na phaṭa/ oṃ na ma hā badz+ra dha ra ma hā gro dhī 'a snashā ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta ra/phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā rat+na dha ra ma hā gro dhī da shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsū pad+mān+ta zhi kṛta ri )rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma dha ra ma hā gro dhī 8rnyishā ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bighān+ta kṛta 55rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kurma rtenadha ra ma hā kro dhī /shwa ri7ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga bān )/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ ༈/ sa ma ya 2sdi/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥ nya/ oṃ āḥ tsho/ swā hā/ badz+ra sa ma ya badz+ra sa ma ya cho badz+ra sa ma ya badz+ra sa ma ya badz+ra sa ma ya/oṃ rmāḥ ༷rtsu swā hā/ oṃ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin 6 las rmad po che/ /skyon bral byang chub sems 88chen po/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor 10(3—10()

bas / /phyag rgya bla mar bdag sbyor cig① /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ༅/ dzaḥni: baṃ hoḥli/ zhes gsungs pas gsung gi dkyil 'khor bla ma chen pos 'jig rten drug (9gi phyogs bcu thams cad du grags/rab tu grags/ kun tu grags so/ /grags pas snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma chen pos khyab (6)par gyur to/ /de nas yang ye shes ⑦rgyal po stangs dpyal (shedag gnyis su med par rol pa mdzad pa bla ma la thim par gyur te6)/ de nas ye shes rgyal po de nyid dang byin bsdu ba zhes bya ba 'di sku gsung thugs rdo rje las byung yingo / /oṃ chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po las / /ye shes gsal ba rnam par dag /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /skye hunyamed chos la dbang sgyur shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma shu n+ya tā (sridharma dz+nyā na swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta8/ hūm̐ dag cing gsal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /skyon med sems nyid rin po che/ me long lta yibu'i ye shes kyis/ /srid apa gsum la dbang sgyur shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma hā ā dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rta/ sī yikhams gsum re skong rgyal po ste/ /yid bzhin rin chen gter gyi mchog /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /'gro ba re skong rgyal por shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma hā sa man+ta ā be sha / 5dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3hi/ i 4 nyes pa'i skyon bral dri ma med / /skye 'gag med pa'i dngos grub ste/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /srid gsum nyes dmigs sel bar shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma hā pra ti 4)pra be ( )sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta/ hā 1dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor mthar phyin cing / /grub pa las kyi bye brag ( gelas/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis/ /skye 'gro dbyings su sgrol bar shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma hā kṛ ta ri shes nu ṣā na dz+nyā na skabadz+ra swa bhā ba 103—101

ād+ma ko3rtasti/ a ni stong dang mi stong gnyis/ /dbu ma la yang mi gnas shing ske/ /stong pa chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /mi 'gyur dbyings la dbang sgyur shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya ma hā ā ②the sha shu t+yā (mitā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko338/ oṃ bder ⑤gshegs sku yi ngo bo las/ /mi shigs 6)rdo rje rgyal ba'i gtso/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje sku yi gtso bor shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta(7)/ i bder ⑧gshegs gsung gi ngo bo lasal/ /mi shigs rdo rje chos kyi dbyings/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje gsung gi ngo bor shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya sarba ta thā ga ta bā ka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko3rta57/ rtsu bder 7gshegs thugs kyi gtso bo las/ /mi shigs rdo rje rdo rje'i thugs/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje thugs kyi (7byin rlobs shog /oṃ ma hā gu h+ya sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa tibhā ba ād+ma ko3rta8/ swe ④mi 'gyur ba yi 8zhing khams nas/ /ma bskyed pa yi ⑩'bras bu lags/ /ma bsags pa yi longs spyod 'byung / /cir yang grub 1)pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rang dbang thabs kyis sgyur bar shog /swe ma hā (1nyagu h+ya sarba ta thā (7ga ta ma hā pu 4) dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3hi lha/ zhes gsungs pas gsal la 'bar bas thim par gyur to/ /e ma ngo mtshar rab 'byam gyi ste/ /ngo mtshar ya mtshan gsang ba'i chos / /sgra dang ming tshig kun las 'das/ /sna tshogs sgra rnams dbyings su gsal / /gsung gcig yan lag dkyil rdo nya'akhor ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab khyab mchog dbyings/ /thams cad gsung gi phyag rgya mchog hoḥ/ gsang ba'i snying po nges pa'i bla ma chen po las dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang gsang sngags kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //103—102

de nas ye shes rgyal po de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yan lag thams cad dkyil 'khor bla mar lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa rtser chib nas rdo rje bla ma'i tshig 'di ched du gsungs so/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /thams cad byang chub mchog gi rgya/ /gsang ba de nyid nges pa yi/ /snying po phyag rgya 'da' dka'o①/ /mi bskyod nyi ma'i dkyil yi ge/ /rin chen zla ba'i dkyil yi ge/ /lnga gnyis zung du spros pa las/ /sbyar ba'i phyag rgya 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /hūm̐ dang sum̐ gnyis rtse sbyar te/ /'bru brgyad bsnol nas thugs kur bkan/ /rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /bde ba chen po sbyin pa'i rgya/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /ཿ bsgreng rtse mor rdo rje 'bar/ /zla brtul 'bru sbas dril gsil cing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan(mi/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas ④thugs kur bkan/ /sum̐ ④bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta(5)/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte dbus na/ /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' dag /yum mchog yangs ma'i spyan dang ni/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /oṃ bsgreng rtse mor 'khor lo 'bar/ /zla brtul ('chi'abru sbas dril gsil cing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan(7)/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /lo bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas 48)las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta5)/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs nas7/ /bde gshegs rnam par snang mdzad dag /yum mchog kun du bzang mo dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /'bru bzhi 103—103
