sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /swa rtse 'bar ba rin po che/ /zla brtul ①'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan②/ /'bru sbas bzhi nas thugs kur bkan/ /mi bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ltag/ /lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs nas/ /bder dugashegs rin chen 'byung ldan dag /yum mchog khams gsum byams ma dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril / /'bru sbas bzhi dunas thugs kur bkan/ /māṃ dubasgreng rtse mor pad+ma 'bar / /zla brtul ⑦'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan6)ske/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /paṃ bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis lta'o/ /nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs nasatso/ /bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas dag /yum ⑩mchog na bza' dkar mo dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /ha bsgreng rtse mor ral gri 'bar/ /zla brtul ⑩'bru sbas dril gsil zhing / /'khril ba'i tshul gyis chos la brtan3ge/ /'bru bzhi sbas nas thugs kur bkan/ /ṭ+wāṃ bsgreng rtse mor dril gsil 'bar/ /nyi ma 'bru lngas ④las su 'khril/ /btud de 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ltami/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs nasatso/ /bde gshegs don yod grub pa dang / /yum mchog dam tshig sgrol ma dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /rin chen myu (nyegu g.yas phyogs na/ /sgeg cing 'gying ba g.yon phyogs na/ /sa snying dkar po rdo rje'i rigs/ /yum mchog dkar mo sgeg chen dang / /dkyil 'khor bar khyams 12shar phyogs na/ /gnyis 103—104

med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /ral gri 'byin pa g.yas phyogs na/ /phreng ba bgrang ba g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams nyulho phyogs na/ /nam snying ser po rin chen rigs/ /yum mchog dpal gyi phreng ba dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yas phyogs na/ /pi bang ②'gyed pa g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams ②nub phyogs na/ /spyan ras le brgan 0pad+ma rigs/ /yum mchog chos kyi dbyangs dumakhan dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /rdo rje 0rtse lnga g.yas phyogs na/ /bar ⑦gyi cod pan g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams ⑧byang phyogs na/ /phyag na mthing ga ⑨las kyi rigs/ /yum mchog gar gyi 0cod pan dang ⑪/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /mdzes pa'i klu 8shing g.yas phyogs na/ /bdug spos 'dren pa g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams tsoshar lho na/ /byams pa dkar ser bder cigashegs rigs/ /yum mchog bdug pa'i sprin 'phro dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /gser gyi 'khor lo g.yas phyogs na/ /me tog 'thor ba g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams 8lho nub na/ /sgrib sel dmar ser rin chen rigs/ /yum mchog me tog char 'bebs dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /rin chen snye ma g.yas phyogs na/ /sgron ma 'degs pa g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams tshunub byang na/ /kun bzang dmar ljang las kyi rigs/ /yum mchog gsal ba'i sgron rtso tshom dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /ut+pal (3sngon po g.yas phyogs na/ /tsan+dan 'thor ba g.yon phyogs na/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams /tsho/byang shar na/ /'jam dpal dkar ljang rdo rje'i rigs/ /103—105

yum mchog tsan+dan char 'bebs dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang hu)du 'khril//thub drug phyag rgya chen po ni/ /rgyud drug gnas nas 'dren pa ste/ /gseg ②par phyag rgya tshul 'dzin pas/ /sku mdog ser pos mi rnams 'dren/ /pi bang ②phyag rgya tshul 'dzin pasali/ /sku mdog dkar po lha rnams 'dren/ /go cha mdung thung phyag rgya yis/ /sku mdog mthing nag lha min 'dren/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /sku mdog sngon po yi dgas (snye'adren/ /po ti brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /sku mdog ser nag byol song 'dren/ /me 'bar chu 'bebs phyag rgya yis/ /sku mdog sngon po dmyal ba 'dren/ /sgo bzhi phyag rgya tshul gnas pa / /rdo rje gnod pa g.yas phyogs na/ /lcags kyu 'phen pa g.yon phyogs na/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yang / /yum mchog rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /dṛ 4)mgo gdengs pa g.yas phyogs na/ /zhags pa 'phen pa g.yon phyogs na/ /khro chen gshin rje gshed po yang / /yum mchog rdo rje zhags pa dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /sbrul mgo gdengs pa g.yas phyogs na/ /lcags sgrog 9)sdom pa g.yon phyogs na/ /khro chen rta mgrin dpa' bo yang / /yum mchog rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / /gnyis med dbyings kyi ngang du 'khril/ /rgya gram gnon pa g.yas phyogs na/ /dril bu 'khrol ba g.yon phyogs na/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yang / /yum mchog rdo rje dril 'khrol dang / /byang gi sgo nas dbyings su 'khril/ /kun bzang (nyamanyam bzhag 9yi shes 'phro/ /yum 'gyur mnyam rdzogs pad+ma'i bodakyil/ /gnyis med dbyings kyi gsang chen spro/ /bde mchog ngo mtshar thugs kyi dkyil/ /spro bsdu rdo rje thal mo dag /bsgyur bas rang sems ye shes gsal/ /de nyid shes rab 1003—106

thabs su rdzogs/ /sgyu ①'phrul dra ba nges pa'i bla ma chen po las phyag rgya spros pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas ye shes rgyal po de rdo rje bkod pa'i gsang ba'i dam tshig rgyan rnam par spros pa'i dgongs pa la cig ②char bzhugs te/ rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig 'di brjod do/ /shin tu phra ba'i ting 'dzin mchog /dpe dang tshad du mi gzung zhing ske/ /gzhal yas phyag rgya la (gyisogs te/ /mtshon du med la snang bar bsgom/ /shin tu phra bas rnam sbyangs te/ /rig pas rgya khyon tshad med pa/ /gzhal yas phyag rgya la ④sogs pa'i/ /mtshon du med la snang bar bsgom/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /tshogs chen gnyis las 'grub pa yi/ /'dod pa lnga yi yon tan rnams/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam rdzogs te/ /rags dang phra dang 'bring la (bsogs/ /ji ltar 'dod pa rang gar bya/ /tsa ka ⑥mi dang tshon rtsi dag /bya dang mi bya med pas na/ /de la dgag par ma gsungs so/ /'gro don 'tsham pa de bzhin te/ /sna tshogs mchod pas rgyas par mchod/ /bdag nyid chen pos mchod pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /dga' ba chen pos tshim pa yin/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dgongs pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus dang / /rigs drug 'gro ba mngon du 'gyur/ /lus ngag sems dang chos thams cad/ /gang na'ang yod pa ma yin te/ /rnam dag ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /dbyings la dbyings nyid sgom pa yis/ /kun byas dbang phyug rig pas 'jug /de nas dad ldan gus 'jug pa/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ /103—107

bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul/ /snying yang yon gyi mchog yin te/ /bla ma mnyes phyir gus ldan dbul/ /dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyes pa yin/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /skyon rnams ma lus nges par ①'byang ②/ /dad ldan brtson 'grus bskyed byas na/ /phan pa'i dbang nod theg tshad sbyin/ /des na dbang phyug rgyal po yis/ /dbang gi rim pa rnams bstan to/ /'gro la phan phyir las rnams sbyin/ /grub pa sa 'dzin rgyal po sbyin/ /mi 'gyur rab 'byam ②bde chen no/ /gang 'dod rim gyis gosbyin par bya/ /blo dang ldan pas theg tshad nod/ /yang na sras kyi dam pa ste/ /chud ma zos par rdzogs dbang sbyin / /sems kyi rnam pa nying gu abludakyi/ /sgo 'byed bde bas gyen du bskyilasti//de nas dbang phyug chen po des/ /mi 'gyur sgron ⑧mar sku bskyod cing / /sems kyi thig le sgo phye ste/ /tshangs pa chen po'i dbyangs bzhed nas/ /go yonye'abyed rdo rje'i ljags brkyang ste/ /dad ldan skyes bu dbang bskur ba/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i bde dbang ni/ /che mchog gong na med pa na/ /gsang ba'i dbu rgyan bigyi dbang dang / /thabs mkhas byin brlabs (7che bas na/ /las rnams kun gyi dbang dang ni/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdus pas ni/ /slob dpon zhal chab kyi dbang ngo / /hūm̐ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i byin brlabs tu)kyis/ /rigs kyi bu mchog dbang bskur phyir/ /gsang ba'i dbu rgyan 'di bcings pas//rigs kyi bu mchog deng phan chad/ /'jig rten che ba kun gyi bla/ /che ba'i che ba zil gyis gnon/ /sangs rgyas che ba'i mchod gnas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po khyod nyid yin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga to gu h+ya badz+ra rat+na ma ku ṭa (ste: ṭ+wāṃ/ badz+ra 103—108

gugya sid dhi hūm̐/ rtsu thabs mkhas byin brlabs ①chen po ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs yin te/ /byin brlabs ②chen po rnam bzhi podu/ /dbang bskur gnang duphyir gtad pas dun/ /rigs kyi bu mchog deng phan chad/ /sems can kun la snying brtse ⑤phyir/ /mu stegs rtag chad yan chad nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad spyod ⑦la/ /khyod kyis mi bya gcig kyang med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spyod pa yis/ /sems can kun gyi re ba skong ⑧/ /oṃ sa ma ya guphya e rba ⑫ma ya a/ slob dpon zhal chab kyi dbang ni khams gsum kun la dbang yid bzhin du sgyur 0te/ hūm̐ nga ni rgyal ba kun gyi bla/ /thig le byang chub sems chen po / /nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje/ /ye shes rol pa'i 'byung yiganas gter/ /nga ni spyi dpal bla na med/ /skyon bral thabs kyi rgyal po yin/ /sems kyi dkyil nas drangs pa'i chu/ /khyod ⑩kyi lce la phab pa 'di/ /snying gi dkyil du gzung bar byos/ /rigs kyi bu khyod deng 'phan chad/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs mchog zung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso bo yin/ /byang chub sems dang mnyam pa'i phyir/ /sems dpa' kun gyi mchod gnas yin/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ④deng ⑫phan chadabya/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi7/ /bstan pa phyi nang zab mo kun/ /sems kyi dkyil du bsdus nas kyang / /rdo rje lce yis 8sgo phye ste/ /bdud rtsi sman mchog dam pa 'dis/ /dad ldan skyes bu ngoms ⑩par byos/ /sems kyi thig le dkyil 'khor du/ /zhi khro 'byam sre )pa'i gter sgoms la/ /srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur 0cig /dbang can thams cad bkol bar byos/ /skye 'gro kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /gdul ba'i phyag rgya 'di yang spyod/ /dug phyogasum rtsa ba gcad par byos/ /phyi nang snod bcud rnam par dag /rnam dag chen po nyid 103—109

kyi lam/ /byed spyod thabs tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa/ /'gro don byang chub sems kyi dbyings/ /sems kyi chu 'di btung bar byos/ /rnal 'byor chen pos dam du zung 3no/ /hūm̐ de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /mnyam pa'i don la gzhol ba'i phyir/ /ye shes rgyal pos 'di skad gsungs/ /snying gi (midakyil du rnam sbyang ba( )/ /hūm̐ nyid ring pos mtshams sbyar te/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i dbyings / /dge sdig las kyis mi bcos shing / /sgom zhi)dang sgrub pas mi 'byangs pa'i/ /rnam dag sems nyid rin chen gter/ /rdo rje snying po ye shes kyis / /khro rgyal kun gyi gtsor (5)gyur cig /shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra bo dhi (6)rtsu ho/ oṃ i / mi 'gyur ba yi (sheye shes gnas/ /ma btsal 6)phyin pas bde ba'i mchog /ma bltas gsal bas ye shes spyan/ /gong na med pa'i 7kun gyi rje/ /ye shes rang gnas (stebadal ba la/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung sa thob 8shog /oṃ ma hā gubya phroṃ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la/ dz+nyā na gugya sid dhi swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta(3/ gzungs dang ting 'dzin stobs dang mi 'jigs pa/ /'gyur ba med pa'i sman mchog thig le lnga/ /mtshan mchog rdzogs pa chen pos lus brgyan cing / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga to gugya ād+ma 8a gi ṣiñca 8ho ha/ khyung gi gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdengs pa yis / /klu rnams zil gyis gnon par byed pa ltar/ /srid gsum yon tan mchog tu rdzogs pa yi7/ /sangs rgyas kun la mdzes pa'i cod pan mchog /mchog tu che bas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ma hā gurgya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca lha ho/ hūm̐ bde ba chen po'i yonyerang gnas la/ /ye shes rgyal po stangs dpyal 17du/ /'gyur ba med par longs spyod cing / /thabs dang shes rab 'phro 'du yis/ /skye 'gro sras su 'dzin par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga to gu 103—110

h+ya a nu stirāg ta badz+ra swa bhā ②ba ād+ma ko3lha / dbyings nas nyi shar mkha' la rdzogs sras 'gyur/ /rgyu ④'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las rdo rje bkod pa gsang ba dam tshig dang dbang sbyin pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes rgyal po des thugs rje chen po gdung ba'i dam tshig lu gu rgyud la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig sta na chen po'i phrin (snyelas mdzad do/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad ( )kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi rjo gsang ske/ /zhing bcur ldan pa'i longs spyod la/ /gsung gi 'phro 'du rnam sbyangs te/ /lnga yi tshom bu yang dag gsal/ /sgo lnga byin rlabs 'dren pa'i mchog /ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar pa'i lam/ /gtsug tu snang mdzad sems dpa' che/ /skur skyed byin rlabs rmad po che/ /pho nya mang po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /zhing bcu gnas nas blangs nas su/ /nyi zla zhu)steng du de bzhag ste/ /shes pa gsum po dbyings su bstim/ /rang rgyud 'khor ba'i sa bon las/ /ljang gu khyani ru 'phang bstod deyi/ /ni ljang r+ghaṃ du gnas bsgyur nas/ /yas 'dus mas 'dus hūṃ la 'dus/ /hūm̐ ni bde gshegs ye shes lnga/ /dkar la gsal bar skur (nyebaskyed de/ /bde chen 'od zer 'phro bas brjid/ /rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa//yab yum bcu yi byin rlabs 7nyid/ / le brgan 6)rtsu ni dbyings su sbyor/ /kun tu bzang mo 8bde ba'i mkha'/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyi ga'i byayum/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas gtsotso/ /sras su gyur pas bde ba'i mchog /zhing gyur mchog dang mchog phran rnams/ /gnas ni dzi —4kun bzang yum gyi mkha'//sa ni 8rdo rje sems dpa'i /smus/ /mi ldog nyi zla'i gdan stengs suzhu / /mkhas 103—111

pas sku yi phyag rgyar ①bskyod/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu sku mchog g.yung drung sbyin/ /ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig tu'o/ /de nas ye shes rgyal po des/ /gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rdul snyed na/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul phran snyed/ /de kun gsang mchog mnyes bya'i phyir/ /nyid kyi gsang ba'i rgyal mo de/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis ②dbyings su thim/ /'khril nas gsang ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ /bcwa ⑧brgyad phrag gnyis hūm̐ spros pas/ /klong du hūm̐ chen gcig tu 'khyil/ /kha dog rnam bzhi yang dag ldan/ /rigs bzhi lha mo rnam spros te/ /stong khams bkang nas mchod pa byed/ /la la gsang mchog dbyings su 'khril/ /la la 'dod lnga'i mchod pa byed/ /rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang / /bla re rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs dang / /rin chen do shal se mo do/ /dbyibs legs rin chen phung pos ④mdzes/ /bsam rdzogs rin chen sdong po yis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mchod/ /la la 'gro ba re ba skong / /la la bdud 'dul ngan song sbyong / /kun kyang gsang ba'i mchod 'bul byed/ /nyid kyi gsang ba'i rgyal mo dang / /gnyis su med par 'khril nas su/ /'khril nas ga na'i (snyemachod pa yibyed/ /stong khams nyungs ⑦'brur gzhug tshul du/ /ga na'i ⑧mchod pa chen po yis/ /thams cad mnyes 6)pa chen por gyur⑩/ /de nas ye shes rgyal po de nyid kyi (1gsang ba'i rgyal mo dang gnyis su med par 'khril nas ched du brjod pa 'di rka/rtebarjod do/ /e mtho bde gshegs spyod pa'i mchog /sna tshogs spyod la rang bzhin gsang / /ma chags pa yi ngo bo las/ /chags pa chen po'i spyod pa 'byung / /spyod pa chen po rnam gnyis la8/ /rtogs nas chags pas 103—112

su spyod pa/ /yang dag chags pa chen po ste/ /'di ni tshangs mchog rgyal po yin / /sems kyi spyod pa rnam pa gnyis/ /zhing ①bcu mnyes pa'i las bya'o / /zhes ched du gsungs so/ /de lta bus phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing khams kyis bsdus pa thams cad mnyes pa chen pos thim par gyur to/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las thugs rje gdung ba'i le'u ste ②bdun pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgyal po de mchod pa bla ma'i rgyan bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bla ma dgongs pa'i mchog /bro gar 'du 'phro'i phyag rgya yis/ /'dzul bulam nam mkhar 'gro bar nges/ /glu tshig sgra yi phyag rgya yis/ /chos kyi sems dpa'i dngos grub len/ /bza' dang btung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /yid bzhin sems dpa'i dngos grub len/ /rgyan dang bgo ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /'od 'bar bla ma'i dngos grub len/ /ā li kā li'i dhiphyag rgya yis/ /thams cad grub cing rdo rje nges/ /rgyu 'bras dbyings su sbyor shes shing ske/ /bla ma'i dgongs pa gang sbyor ba/ /rig ⑤'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du nges/ /skye ba rnam bzhi rgyud sbyangs nas/ /mtshan rdzogs sa la gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs pas (7tshogs chen po rnam pa gnyis rdzogs par gyur to/ /de nas nyid kyi bla ma'i mdzad spyod la dgyes pa chen pos 57klu 'di blangs so/ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che/ /bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs/ /snang stong thig le kun du rdzogs/ /ho/ oṃ rdo rje 103—113

bsod nams thig le che/ /rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan/ /rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa/ /rdo rje rgyal po thig le che/ /ho/ oṃ mi dmigs sgyu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' yas kun nas sna tshogs 'phro/ /mtha' yas kun nas lhun gyis thim/ /sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po/ /ho/ oṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che/ /yon tan phrin ①las kun tu rdzogs/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang / /'dus pa'i rdzogs chen thig le che/ /ho/ oṃ phyogs bcu 'jig rten rdul snyed du/ /rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed/ /sprul pa rdul phran bsam yas kyi/ /skad cig yud ②la lhun gyis grub/ /ho/ oṃ thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che/ /sku gsung thugs kyi du kun tu khyab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che/ /hosti/ oṃ thams cad thig le bla ma'i don/ /sgyu 'phrul bla ma thig le'i dbyings/ /dbyings nyid byang chub sems chen po/ /snying po bla ma nges pa'i don/ /thig le gnyis ⑤las g.yos pa med/ /ho/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las tshogs chen po rnam pa gnyis mnyes pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rgyal po de sgyu 'phrul bla ma chen po'i 'jigs pa chen po'i tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin mngon par 'du mdzad de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag tu lta ba dang / rmongs pa'i dbang gis gab pa'i gsang ba chen po ni ma rtogs/ sbas pa'i gsang ba la mngon par zhen ⑥pas chos mnyam pa nyid kyi don ni phyal bar bor/ bram ze'i ngan sngags mang po ni blo'i gdeng (pedu blangs nas snying rje chen po'i las dang ni bral gnas su ming btags (kyenas zhe 103—114

snang sgrol ba'i las ni rgyun ①du byed/ thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i don ni ma rtogs/ 'dod chags spyod pa'i las dang skad cig tsam yang ma bral/rang rig pa'i ye shes ni blo la nub/ don dam pa la kun du gti mug pas ni (mirgyun du khebs/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan ni ma rtogs/ nga rgyal khengs pa'i dregs pa'i las ni rgyun du byed/ tshad med pa bzhi'i las dang ②ni bral/phrag (gedog gi tshub mas ni rgyun du khrid de/ bdag tu rmongs pa dang rtog pa la zhen te/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang bral bas rgyu dang 'bras bu la ⑤mongs te/srid pa'i sa bon rtsub mos 'phangs nas mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba rdo rje yidamyal ba chen por bskal pa chen po stong phrag drug cur dzo)skyes so/ /de las thar nas nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba chen por bskal pa chen po drug tu skyes so/ /las kyi sgrib pa rtsub mo de las thar te sngon gyi srid pas mtshams sbyar nas yi dgas ⑨srin po chen po lus gcig mgo bo brgya pa kyi)mgo bo sna tshogs pa/lus brgya pa mgo tsogacig pa lus dang yan lag mang po 'dug pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs shing gdug pa'i rdzu 'phrul mang po ston pas klu'i ris nas 'bras bu che ba man chad dbang du bsdus nas sa bon rtsub mos mang po 'debs so/ /de nas sngon legs par spyad pa'i 'bras bus bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis sku'i dbyibs legs par brgyan pa ye shes phyin ci ma log pa'i spyan gyis gzigs te/ las ngan pa'i srin po de nyon mongs pa'i bag chags sbyangs pa /gedang / khams gsum gyi sems can bde ba la gzhag ༷ pa'i phyir thugs rje chen po'i ye shes skyes nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag po dgyes pa chen po ye shes kyi rgyal po de nyid 'jigs byed chen 103—115

po rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla ma chen po sprin rnam par spro ba sgyu 'phrul bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms ①par zhugs te/ de bzhin nyid kyi bla ma chen po'i dbyings ②nas nyid kyi gsang ba'i bdag mo khro mo'i rgyal mo chen mo mngon du phyung ste/ hi hi zhes dgyes pa'i gzi mdangs kyis pad+ma rgyas par mdzad de/ gnyis su med pa'i dgyes pa chen pos thim nas gsang ba bla ma'i sprin las/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+wa bi ṣa gro dha badz+ra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad dur khrod bdal ba chen po'i rang bzhin khrag gi rgya mtsho dba' rlabs du'akhrug pa'i dkyil na/ keng durus chen po ri rab kyi steng na rdo rje me dpung du 'khyil ba'i dbus na 'og rdo rje rgya gram mig mangs ris su dubris pa/phyogs bzhi ngos bzhi 'bar bar khyams dugasum rdo rje rin po che'i glo 'bur du mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs mu khyud du bcas pa/ rdo rje rin po che rgya gram mthing ga ⑦'bar ba'i rtsig pa dra ba ris su brtsigs pa/ steng yid bzhin gyi ⑧rin po che 'bar ba/ rdo rje rgya gram 'bar ba'i bla re mig mangs su bres ⑨pa/rtse mo dbyibs bla mas 'og min gyi gnas na 0srid pa'i rtse mo man chad bum pa'i tshul du dbyibs rdo rje rgya gram mig mangs yigacig tu 'khyil pa/ ye shes rdo rje rgya gram gyi cho 'phrul bla ma'i 'od 'bar bas phyogs bzhir 'phros shing 'khrugs pas khams gsum thams cad bdal ba/ rgyal mtshan bla ma chen po dang / ru mtshon bla ma chen pos phyogos bzhi grwa 8bzhi nas bsgreng ba/ gsang ba bla ma'i rtsig pas phyi rim bskor ba/ rdo rje rin po che'i phyi rol gyi shing ljon pa bla mas phyogs mtshams gtibs pa'osnye/ phyi dang nang med pa kun du yang bla ma chen po'i nang du gyur pa/ khams gsum thams cad rdo rje ra ba'i rtsig pa 'chor ba med pa'i 103—116

gzhal yas khang na khro bo dang khro mo'i rol pa'i phyag rgya stong gi 'jig rten rdul phra mo snyed 'thon ①par gyur to/ /de nas 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du 'ur 'ur dang chem chem dang / shig shig dang / thor thor dang /gtogs shig dang / choms ②shig dang / sod cig dang / drol zhig dang /sbyongs shig la sogs pas 'jig rten na dudabang che zhing dpa' brtul 8che zhing brtul zhugs can rnams ⑤brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas dgyes pa chen pos ye shes rgyal po de nyid dur khrod bla ma chen por dgyes nas khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dkyil keng rus chen po'i ri rab kyi steng na rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na rdo rje ye shes kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa la nyid kyi gsang ba'i rgyal mo dang mchod pa bla ma chen po mdzad de gnyis su med pa'i dbyings nas 'di phyung ngo / /rtsu badz+ra du tri nan srur+ya ⑥ tsan+da pad+ma ⑦maṇ+ḍal de ba tiṣ+ṭha ⑤rna zhes brjod pas ye shes rin po che'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa 'od 'bar ba'i steng du dur khrod gdug 6)pa'i tshogs seng ge la sogs pa bla ma chen po'i khri btsugs te/ gdan bla ma nyi zla dang pad+ma spel bar bting ⑩ba'o/ /de nas cho 'phrul bla ma chen pos btul ba/ bsam gtan bla ma chen po spags pa tshad med pa/ dmigs pa thams cad dang (nyubral ba'i ye shes bla ma chen pos dregs pa thams cad dus gcig tu btul ba'i snam rten bla ma chen po la mtshon pa dang / dmigs 8pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyag rgya bla ma 'od 'bar ba bzhugs pa ni bcom ldan 'das ye shes rgyal po chen po sku mthing nag cir yang 'gyur ba/ rdo rje ljags kyis 8gsung 'brug stong gi sgra sgrogs ④pas stong khams thams cad dus gcig tu 'jig pa/ ye shes me'i 8thugs kyis snang srid kyi bud shing dus gcig tu bsregs pa/ steng 'og med par 103—117

kun du skyi bung zhes byed pa/ dbu dgu phyag bcwa ①brgyad pa/ zhabs rnam pa brgyad du gtams pa/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyan 'bar ba nyi shu rtsa bdun mnga' zhing rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje mthing ga ②khung gi gshog ①pas 'jig rten gyi khams yog ④par bkab pa⑤/ khros pa'i rgyal mo mthing nag 'bar ba dang gnyis su med par bzhugs so/ /gnyis su med pa'i dbyings nas shar phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs la khri dang nyi zla'i steng du ma hā de ba dang / 'dod pa'i lha gan rkyal 0du brtul ba'i steng du nyid kyi gzugs kyi phung po de bcom ldan 'das bud+dha he ru ka /sku mdog ser nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur pa dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa'o/ /bder ⑦gshegs khros pa'i rgyal mo dang 'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /lho phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs la khri dang nyi zla'i gdan stengs su gshin rje gan rkyal 6)du bsgyel (9)ba'i gdan la nyid kyi tshor ba'i phung po las bcom ldan 'das rat+na he ru ka sku mdog sngo nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur pa/mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi 7rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che khros pa'i rgyal mo dang 'khril ba chen mo'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /nub phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs la khri dang nyi zla'i steng du chu bdag gi rgyal po dang 'khor lo nag po blang 67gi ri ti gan rkyal 7du bsgyel ba'i gdan la nyid kyi 'du shes kyi phung po de bocom ldan 'das pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir gyur pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis yi brgyan pa'o/ /pad+ma khros pa'i rgyal mo dang 'khril pa'i tshul du bzhugs 103—118

pa'o / /byang phyogs 6)'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs la khri dang nyi zla'i gdan stengs su gnod sbyin stobs bzangs ②gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la nyid kyi 'du byed kyi phung po de bcom ldan 'das kurma he ru ka sku mdog ljang nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad par ⑧gyur pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste④/ dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ las mchog khros pa'i rgyal mo dang 'khril ba chen po'i (9tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /de nas dreg ⑥pa chen po la sogs pas gdug ⑦ pa'i sems kyis gtum pa'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pas mgrin gcig tu 'dug (3 nyepa'i nga ros gtum pa'i brlang tshig tu smras pa/ thong thong snying rje'i bdag po ci 'di 6)ltar byed dam zhes zer zhing shin tu gtum pas rngam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen pos ye shes rgyal po de nyid 7sku gzi brjid chen po'i mdangs su gyur te/ thugs rje chen pos 'dul ba'i thabs kyis sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gsang sngags bla ma'i rngam pa'i gdangs 7skad chen po 'di dag phyung ngo / /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ / ha ha ha/ khā hi khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod pas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i gdug pa'i tshogs de dag gi snying dang dbang po kun phyung nas nang grol (nyekun drangs yan lag kun bcad btubs tunyete sha zos/ khrag 'thungs rus pa kun 'chos so/ /de nas 'jigs yibyed chen po de nyid kyis hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ bh+yo e a ra li dzā dzā zhes brjod pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha' dang bcas pa yungs 'bru gcig tsam du chud par bsdus so/ /de nas 'byung po ma rungs pa thams cad kyi rje bo'i yang rje bol/ dregs pa chen po la sogs pa'i chung ma 'byung mo thams cad kyi rje mo'i yang rje mo/ srin mo chen mo mi srun mo dang ske/ tshangs ma tsodang / khro mo dang / dbang mo dang / 'jug sred mo dang /103—119

gzhon nu mo dang / dmar po 0)dang / bdud rtsi mo dang / zhi ba mo dang /be chen (gyimo dang / srin mo dang / za ba mo dang / dga' ba mo dang / ra ro khrag 'thung zhumo dang / gcig pu spyod ma dang / yid 'phrog ma dang / grub mo dang ske/ rlung 54tshomo dang / gsod byed mo dang / me mo dang / phag ⑤mo dang /rgan byed ༅mo dang / sna chen mo dang / chu lha mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang /ra mgo dmar ser chen mo dang / bum sna sngo nag chen mo dang / gsus 'dzin sngo nag chen mo la sogs pa tso)dang / yang bran dang / g.yog dang / yang g.yog la sogs pa 'khor zhing gi rdul kyang bsdus so/ /de nas yang dgyes pa chen po ye shes rgyal po de nyid dgyes pa bla ma'i gsang ba chen po sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mngon par 'du mdzad de sku gsung thugs bla ma las 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ āḥ(7rgyu/ badz+ra pad+ma pra be sha pad+ma hūm̐ a la la ho zhes brjod pas 'byung po ma rungs pa thams cad shin tu chags pa'i yid g.yos nas gsang ba rgyas par byas nas khab len gyi rdo la lcags (9)'du ba'i tshul du bcom ldan 'das ye shes rgyal po'i sku la mi srun mo kyil sogs pa brgyad 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ser nag chen po'i sku la tshangs ma la sogs pa lnga 6nya'akhril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das sngo nag chen po'i sku la bdud rtsi mo la sogs pa lnga 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dmar nag chen po'i sku la khrag gis myos ma la sogs pa lnga 'khril lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ljang nag chen po'i sku la me mo la sogs pa lnga 'khril lo/ /de nas dgyes pa chen po de dag gis hūm̐ zhes brjod pas pad+ma'i tshogs bsdus te shin tu bcum 12par gyur to/ /de nas dgyes te yi ha ha zhes brjod pas nyid kyi shes pa'i tshogs rnam par shes pa brgyad las dkar po la 103—120

sogs pa brgyad rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas te 'thon 6)par gyur to/ /'thon ②nas kyang 'khor lo 'bar ba'i phyi rol shar phyogs nas 'khor bar khro bo'i gzugs kyis snying rje 'jigs tshul gyis stan la 6)gnas so/ /de nas dgyes te he zhes brjod pas nyid kyi shes pa'i yul brgyad las seng gdong chen mo la sogs pa brgyad rang gi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas te 'thon (genas yang 'khor lo 'bar ba'i bar khyams (5)su snying rje 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis stan la shin tu rngam pa'i stabs (7kyis gnas so/ /de nas dgyes te phaṭa ces phyogs bcu'i zhing ma lus par bsgrags pas ( )phyogs bcu'i zhing ma lus pa na (8)'gro ba rnams kyi don ma lus par mdzad pa thub pa chen po drug bcom ldan 'das drug 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad cing 'gro ba drug 'dul ba dang / yid chos dbyings nas rol te spor (9)byed nyi kyizer zhags pa can la sogs pa brgyad du gyur te/ 'bar ba'i bar khyams gsum pa la zhing skam gsher spel ba'i gdan stengs su rang gi lag cha dang shin tu rngam pa'i stabs kyis shar phyogs nas 'khor bar gnas so/ /de nas dgyes te phaṭa ces brjod pas nyid kyi phyin ci log bzhi las rdo rje srings hu1'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi rang rang yogi lag cha dang ngo mtshar du chas nas dkyil 'khor 'bar ba chen po'i sgo bzhir snying rje 'jigs tshul gyi nyunyestan la shin tu rngam pa'i gzugs kyis thabs dang shes rab kyi tshul du gnas so/ /de nas dgyes pa chen po'i sprin las/ bud+dha rol pa'i phyag rgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis dus gcig tu phaṭa ces brjod pas thams cad khros nas 'byung mo thams cad kyang rang gi gnas su yud tsam gyis phyin par dgye'ogs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khrag 'thung chen po de nyid thugs rje chen pos bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dgongs 103—121

pa cig (3)char zhugs te sku gsung thugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ (7ta ma hā kro dhi 0i i zhes brjod pas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das khrag 'thung chen po'i snam logs nas 'thon to/ /'dam ri khu blud de dran pa rnyed do/ /de nas khrag 'thung chen po de dag kun ya mtshan chen por gyur te cho 'phrul chen po mdzad pa mthong ngo phyi/ /de dag gi dus su 'jig rten drug na gnas pa'i dregs pa chen po rnams dus gcig tu btul 56)bar mthong ste/ shin tu zhum zhing bred nas mgrin gcig tu smras pa/'bangs su mchi (7)'bangs su mchi/ /'bangs su nan tan ma bgyis na/ /mgo dang lus kyang brgyar 'gas shing / /snying yang gas shing gtubs (nyagyur cig /rul myags tshig (9)nas rlag pa dang / /dmyal bar lhung yinas 'bod par shog /ces 'bangs su mchi bar rang rang gis dmod (1btsugs so/ /de nas de dag kun dkyil 'khor kyigyi gdan du bzhag go/ /de nas yang de thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ rang rang gi chung ma dang / bu mo dang / rang rang gi ma dang / sring mo rnams dkyil 'khor du phul te/ bdag cag rnams kyi mchis brang 1stodang / /ma dang sring mo bu mo rnams/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhes su gsol/ /dpa' bo lha rjes bzhes su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di/ /ming tsam 'dzin par su bgyid pa/ /nor bu rin chen 'bar ba ltar/ /de yi yidagos pa rdzogs par bgyid/ /ces dmod btsugs 7so/ /de nas de'i ma dang / sring mo dang / chung ma dang / bu mo rnams yud tsam gyis phyin par 'ongs nas las kyi dngos grub stsol ba las/ de nas khrag 'thung ye shes chen pos ming 7btags/103—122

lag tu rdo rje byin nas rdo rje bran dang pho nyar dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor 'bar 6)ba chen po'i don phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la gsal zhing 'bar bar bya ba'i phyir ye shes rgyal mo (nyade nyid kyi gsang ba'i rgyal mo dang gnyis su med par gyur nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje bla ma las 'di dag phyung ngo / /e ma'o ye nas gsang ba'i chos/ /mkha' dbyings gnyis su med pa las/ /mkha' la bla ma'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /khri btsugs nyi sridakyil gdan stengs su/ /de la lilha tshogs gdan du bting / /hūm̐ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte dbus su/ /khri bshams nyi dkyil ya bdud gdon/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba/ /byang chub sems las sku bskyed pa/ /dpal chen bla med he ru ka /dbu dgu phyag kyang bcwa (debargyad de/ /spyan yang 'bar ba nyi shu bdun/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan (5)gsol/ /zhabs kyang rnam pa brgyad du gtams/ /rdo rje mthing ga gakhyung gi gshog(nas /'jig rten khams kyang yog par bkabatsa)/ /sbrul nag 'jigs su rung ba dang / /dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dbu gsum dang la byung ba ni/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rnam par thar pa'i dbu gsum gyis/ /khams gsum mya ngan zlo ⑩ba'i zhal/ /dbu gsum bar nas rngam pa ni/ /g.yas sngo g.yon ljang dbus mthing zhal/ /thabs dang shes rab sems kyi dbu/ /srid gsum dbyings su rdzogs pa'i zhal/ /dbu gsum mtha' nas rngam pa ni/ /g.yas mthing g.yon mthing dbus mthing zhal / /khams gsum re ba skong ba yi/ /lung dang man ngag sems kyi dbu/ /'gyur ba med pa'i mthing nag zhal/ /skye shi rtsa ba gcod pa'i tshems/ /dbu dgu rol pa'i byin brlabs 4sprelas/ /g.yas gsum glog tsho stong lce tsho 'byin cing / /103—123

g.yon gsum 'brug stong sgra sgrogs 6)pa/ /dbu gsum rdo rje ser chen 'beb②/ /spyan dgu dang la gzigs pa ni/ /chos dbyings kun du bzang po dang / /kun du bzang mo'i mkha' dbyings la/ /'gyur ba med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs/ /spyan dgu bar nas gzigs pa ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes kyis/ /srid pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /byams mgon snyoms pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /spyan dgu mtha' nas gzigs pa ni/ /g.yas gsum zhe sdang khros pa'i spyan/ /gzigs pas bdud dang mu stegs sgrolazhi)/ /g.yon gsum byams mgon snyoms pa'i spyan/ /gzigs pas mtha' yas bde la 'jog /dbu gsum ye shes gi)rol pa'i spyan/ /gzigs pas skye 'gro gnas su stobs(5)/ / dbu dgu (6)rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dzo dgu/ /lnga dgu bzhi bcu rtsa lnga yang / /bud+dha bzhi bcu rtsa lngas brgyan / /stong pa chen po'i ye shes kyis/ /khyab bdal (8richen po'i rtags yi)su bsnamasal/ /bcwa 7brgyad phyag na rol pa yis/ /stong pa bcwa 11brgyad dbyings su sbyor/ /zhabs brgyad nga rgyal dregs pa 'joms/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis/ /rdo rje mthing ga yinagashog pa brkyang / /bcwa 12brgyad phyag na bsnams pa yis / /rdo rje glo snying zhing chung g.yas/ / bhan dha 7zhing chen ster chen g.yon/ /nang zhags nyi ma khyung chen g.yas/ /zhing chen zla ba 'ug pa g.yon/ /me dang rgya mtsho ga 'u g.yas/ /rlung dang rin chen ri rab g.yon/ /yon tan bcwa 'bargyad dbyings su rdzogs/ /dang po rdo rje dung chen ni/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /bdud dang mu stegs kun 'joms pa'o/ /gnyis pa stir chen glo snying ni/ /srid pa'i sems can thams cad kun/ /dam tshig sta na dbyings su sgrol/ /gsum pa stir chung ril mid ni/ /dug khogasum rnam par 103—124

sgrol ba'i rtags/ /bzhi pa ster chen nang zhags ni/ /rgyud lnga'i sems can dbyings su 'dren/ /lnga pa nyi zla zung du 'dzin/ /byang chub sems las g.yos pa med/ /drug pa khyung dang 'ug pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khol ba'i rtags / /bdun pa me dpung rlung gis 'thor/ /srid pa'i bag chags thal bar rlog6) /brgyad pa ri rab rgya mtsho rnams/ /thams cad ma lus g.yeng gnas shing ske/ /'byung ba lnga la mnga' brnyes (mipa'o/ /dgu pa rin chen ga 'u ni/ /dngos grub sprul pa 'byung ba'i rtags/ /dgu gnyis zung du ldan pa las/ /stong pa bco ( brgyad dbyings su rdzogs/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni/ /thod skam 'bar ba (sku)phreng ba yis/ /zhi ba phyogs gcig mya (gengan zlo/ /mngon par rdzogs pa'i sku brnyes (nyapa'o/ /thod rlon 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'dig/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdus ⑧nas su/ /sprul pa'i sku la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /thod pa phyed tshal phreng bas ni/ /dug lnga bdud rtsir sbyor ba (9ste/ /longs spyod sku la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /zhing chen rlon pa'i na bza' ni/ /chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po ste/ /chos kyi sku la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /stag lpags g.yang gzhi'i sham thabs ni/ /phrin palas rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje'i sku la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /sbrul nag chun 'phyang mang po ni/ /ye shes thams cad 'byung ba'i rtags/ /rtags /〉chen sku la mnga' brnyes pa'o/ /zhabs brgyad lha brgyad brdzis pa ni/ /nga rgyal can rnams tshar gcod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas khros mapa'i rgyal mo ni/ /kro dhi yi shwa ri yum gyi gtso/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i ral pa can / /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthunabla/ /'khril ba chen po'i tshul gyis su / /bhan dha rak+ta gtso la stobasal/ / 'khril ba tsochen po'i tshul du bsam/ /103—125

shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs na6)/ /khri dang nyi dkyil nyi zla'i gdan/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba/ /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa/ /khrag 'thung bud+dha he ru ka /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad(mi/ /g.yas ljang g.yon sngo dbus ser zhal/ /phyag drug mngon par rol pa las/ /'khor lo dgra sta (kyizhags pa g.yas/ /bhan dha rde'u chung kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon/ /ser nag dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bde gshegs khros pa'i rgyal mo dang / /'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bsam/ /lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs na/ /khri dang nyi dkyil gshin rje'i gdan/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba/ /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur pa/ /khrag 'thung rat+na he ru ka /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgradage/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar dbus sngo zhal/ /phyag drug mngon par rol pa las/ /rin chen gshol dang gtun shing g.yas/ /bhan dha dgra sta rde'u chung g.yon/ /sngo nag dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rin chen khros pa'i rgyal mo dang / /'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bsam/ /nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs su/ /khri dang nyi dkyil klu yi gdan/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba/ /'du shes phung po gnas gyur pa/ /khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ka /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad(5)/ /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal/ /phyag drug mngon par rol pa las/ /pad+ma rde'u chung spu gri g.yas/ /bhan dha kha ṭ+wāṃ so phreng g.yon/ /dmar nag dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /pad+ma khros pa'i rgyal mo dang ske/ /'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bsam/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs na/ /khri dang nyi dkyil gnod sbyin gdan/ /de yi steng du bsam bya ba /'du byed phung po gnas gyur pa/ /khrag 'thung kurma he ru ka /dbu gsum phyag 103—126

drug zhabs bzhir bgrad①/ /g.yas dmar g.yon ser dbus ljang zhal/ /phyag drug mngon par rol pa las/ /ral gri zhags pa rde'u chung g.yas/ /bhan dha thod dbyug kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon/ /ljang nag dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan/ /las mchog khros pa'i rgyal mo dang / /'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bzhugs/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i phyi rim na/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ /mkha' dbyings gnyis su med pa las/ /mkha' las skyes pa'i phra (7men ma/ /shar phyogs su ni bsam bya ba/ /sa bdag bsgyel ba'i gdan zhi)stengs su/ /kun gzhi stiganas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor sngo nag go'u (snyeri ma/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil / /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi 6)gsol/ /sgyugs ⑦par glu blangs ha has bzhadabu/ /sti ra dbyug po)pa g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /skye 7shi ma la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /lho phyogs ngos su bsam bya ba/ /gsod (1skyen bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /rnam shes gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor ser nag tso'u ri 7ma/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gsol/ /spyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad / /thabs kyi 3 mda' drangs g.yas pa na/ /shes rab bzhu bdungs tsogayon pa na/ /ya ma ye la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /nub kyi phyogs su bsam bya ba / /nyi ma bskyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /nyon mongs gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor dmar nag pra mo ha/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /sgyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /srur+ya ye la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /byang gi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /zla ba bskyel ba'i gdan 103—127

stengs su/ /reg bya gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor mthing nag pe ta lihunye/ /ral pa kham ( nag gyen du 'khyil/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon//spyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad/ /rdo rje rtse lnga g.yas pa na/ /ster chung mgo gcod g.yon pa na/ /tsan+t+ra ye la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /shar lho mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /me lha bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /lta byed phra men gnas gyur pal/ /rnal 'byor dmar nag puk+ka gsi/ /skra 'bar mche gtsigs rkan brdabs shing glu/ /dur khrod g.yang gzhi slag ④pa gyon/ /spyugs pas 5 glu blangs ha has bzhad / /sti ra chen po g.yas pa na/ /tshems par rgyu 6)'dren g.yon pa na/ /asne 7ye la brkyang bskum (8)bzhugs/ /lho nub mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /bden bral bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /nyan byed gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor mthing nag sma sha ni/ /skra 'bar mche gtsigs rkan brdabs shing / /srog chags chen po rtegayang gzhi gyon/ /spyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad/ /sti ra chung ngu g.yon pa na/ /tsit+ta phyung ba 7)g.yas pa na/ /ni ri ti la brkyang bskum 11bzhugs/ /nub byang mtshams tu su bsam bya ba/ /rlung lha bskyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /snom yo byed gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor ser nag tsaṇ+ḍa thuli/ /skra 'bar mche gtsigs rkan libardabs shing / /'jigs su rung ba'i slag tshapa gsol/ /spyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad/ /sti ra chung ngu g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha bcad pa g.yon pa na/ /ba ya be la brkyang bskum bzhugs / /byang shar mtshams yi tshosu bsam bya ba/ /dbang ldan bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /myong byed gnas gyur phra men ma/ /rnal 'byor ljang nag lhas ma 38ri/ /skra 'bar mche gtsigs rkan 19brdabs shing / /ste ra chen po'i 103—128

shun pa gsol/ /spyugs pas glu blangs ha has bzhad/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yas pa na / /rtse gsum 'khrug pa g.yon pa na/ /i shwa ra la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor de yi phyi rim du/ /smug nag 'bar ba'i bar khyams na/ /gsang ba'i mkha' las skur bskyed pa/ /shar gyi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /dri za bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /kun gzhi yul las gnas gyur pa/ /phra men thogs med seng ge'i gdong / /rnal 'byor ser nag seng ge ma/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /phyag gnyis bsnol nas 6)shin tu 'gying / /sti ra chen po sprug (2)cing gsol/ /in+d+ra ye la brkyang (8)bskum bzhugs/ /lho yi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /grul bum bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /rnam shes yul la buganas gyur pa/ /phra men dpa' bo stag gi gdong / /rnal 'byor dmar nag byā n+t+ra (5)ma/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /phyag gnyis gyad kyi 'dor tshul gyis/ /stir chung bsgyur (6)nas 'bru tshugs lta/ /ra tri'i gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /nub kyi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /yi dgas ri/bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /nyon mongs yul la (8)gnas gyur pa/ /phra men rtog 'dul wa yi gdong / /rnal 'byor dmar nag sri ka dzi)ma/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /phyag gnyis ster chen nang grol 'dru/ /hri 'di gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /byang gi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /gnod sbyin bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /reg bya yul la 7ciganas gyur pa/ /phra men btang snyoms spyang mo'i gdong / /rnal 'byor mthing nag shwa /nyan ma/ /mche gtsigs rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /phyag gnyis rol pa chen po yis/ /ste ra phyed mar btsal skonas gsol/ /yak+ṣa'i gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /103—129

shar lho mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /srin po bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /lta byed yul la 0)gnas gyur pa/ /phra men gzi brjid bya rgod gdong / /rnal 'byor dmar nag kri ta ②ma/ /mchu brdar garkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /zangs gri rnon po g.yas pa na/ /rgyu zhags drang ba rgyagayon pa na/ /rak+ṣa ⑤sa la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /lho nub mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /srin po bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /nyan byed yul la stiganas gyur pa/ /phra men gsal byed dur bya'i gdong / /rnal 'byor rnal ma gaṅka ma/ /mchu brdar ⑦yon brdabs g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stir chung stod smad g.yas g.yon na/ /rngam pa'i tshul gyis phrag la bkal/ /rak+ṣa (gus la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /nub byang mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /srin po bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su6)/ /snom byed yul la yiganas gyur pa / /phra men sa le bya jog gdong / /rnal 'byor dmar nag kha khu (nyam/ /mchu brdar 32rkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gyon/ /zangs gri dmar po g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /rak+ṣa (ges la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /byang shar mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /srin po bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su/ /myong byed yul la miganas gyur pa/ /phra men rdzogs byed 'ug pa'i gdong / /rnal 'byor ljang nag hu lu ma/ /mchu brdar kyirkan brdabs g.yang gzhi gsol/ /rdo rje lcags kyu g.yas pa na/ /ster chung spyi 'joms g.yon pa na/ /rak+ṣa yis la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /'bar ba'i bar khyams tha ma la/ /thod skam 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ /zhing chen bsnol ma'i yi gdan stengs su/ /shar gyi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /nyul byed yul la 6nyaganas gyur pa/ /spor byed chen mo mi zad (7ma / /sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i sku mdog ma/ /zhing chen rol pa'i slag ( )pa gsol/ /103—130

ral pa kham nag gyen 0)du 'bar/ /sgyugs pas glu blangs srid gsum 'bar/ /ha ha ②gad mos ye shes rol/ /nyi zer zhags pa g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /lho yi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /mi mgon thub pa gnas gyur pa/ /spor ①byed chen mo mdung thung 'phen / /rnal 'byor ser nag nyul chen ma/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil / /mi yi g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /spyugs pas glu blangs srid gsum sbyangs④ / /ha ha (gegad mos mi rnams spor(6)/ /rdo rje mdung thung g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /nub kyi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /chos kyi dbyings las gnas gyur pa/ /spor dzo)byed rdo rje dril 'khrol (nyam/ /rnal 'byor mtshon du med pa'i sku/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar/ /chos nyid dbyings kyi na bza' gsol/ /sgyugs pas glu blangs stong khams spor/ /ha ha'i gad mos dbyings su sbyor/ /gsung bsgrags dril bu g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs6)ske/ /byang gi phyogs su bsam bya ba/ /lha min thub pa gnas gyur pa/ /spor yibyed thod phreng skar mda'i gdong / /rnal 'byor sngo nag nyul chen ma/ /srog 41chags chen po'i g.yang gzhi gyon/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar/ /spyugs pas glu blangs khams gsum sbyangs/ /ha ha 8gad mos lha min spor/she/ /rdo rje skar mda' g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du mubarkyang bskum bzhugs/ /shar lho mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /lha 'dul thub pa gnas gyur pa/ /spor byed khyung thogs gnod sbyin ma/ /rnal 'byor mthing nag nyul chen ma/ /'jigs byed g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /ral pa kham nag gyen 103—131

du 'bar/ /sgyugs pas glu blangs stong 6)khams grags/ /ha ha ②gad mos lha rnams spor4kye/ /rdo rje khyung chen g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /lho nub mtshams su bsam bya ba yi dgas (gethub pa gnas gyur pa/ /spor byed me khyer glog phreng 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor dmar nag nyul 55)chen ma/ /yi dgas mgrin rings g.yang gzhi 6)gyon/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar/ /sgyugs pas glu blangs snang srid sbyangs/ /ha ha'i gad mos (7)yi dgas spor(she/ /rdo rje glog phreng yinagayas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /nub byang mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /byol song thub pa gnas gyur pa/ /spor byed 'jigs chen slog sha rdebs7/ /rnal 'byor smug nag nyul chen ma/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar / /slag (1chen brjid pa'i g.yang gzhi gyon/ /spyugs pas glu blangs stong khams grags/ /ha ha'i gad mos byol song spor/ /rdo rje slag besha g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng yo du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /byang shar mtshams su bsam bya ba/ /dmyal mgon thub pa gnas gyur pa/ /sgor byed gshin rje ral gri skra/ /rnal 'byor sngo nag nyul chen ma/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar/ /gshin rje 0)g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /spyugs pas glu blangs srid gsum sbyangs/ /ha ha'i gad mos bodamyal ba spor4/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas pa na / /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /ro rlon steng du brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi la/ /phyin ci log bzhi gnas gyur pa/ /shar gyi sgor ni bsam bya ba/ /phag chen po yi gdan stengs su/ /rta gdong srin mo'i g.yang gzhi tshogasol/ /rdo rje lcags kyu g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rak+ta g.yon pa na/ /103—132

phag chen po yi gdan stengs su/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po dang / /'khril ba chen po'i tshul du bzhugs/ /rngam pa'i tshul gyis phyir bltas 6)pa'o/ /lho yi sgor ni bsam bya ba/ /ra gdong chen mo'i gdan stengs su/ /phag gdong chen mo'i g.yang gzhi gyon/ /lcags kyi dril zhags g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rlon pa g.yon pa na/ /ra gdong chen mo'i gdan stengs su/ /khro chen gshin rje gshed po dang ske/ /'khril ba chen po'i tshul gyis su/ /rngam pa'i tshul gyis bltas pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor ni bsam bya ba/ /bum rna chen mo'i gdan stengs su/ /dred gdong chen mo 9kyegayang gzhi gyon/ /lcags sgrog me 'bar g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rlon pa g.yon pa na/ /srin po bum rna'i gdan stengs su/ /khro chen rta mgrin chen po dang ske/ /'khril ba chen po'i tshul gyis su/ /rngam pa'i tshul gyis phyir bltas pa'o//byang gi sgor ni bsam bya ba/ /gsus po che yi gdan stengs su/ /spyang gdong chen mo chagayang gzhi gyon/ /dril bu thal chen gi)g.yas pa na/ /bhan dha rlon pa g.yon pa na/ /gsus po che yi gdan stengs su/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang glu/ /'khril ba chen po'i tshul gyis su/ /rngam pa'i tshul gyis phyir bltas pa'o//ho badz+ra gurgya tshig tu'o/ /gsang ba'i snying po'i de kho na nyid nges pa sgyu 'phrul bla ma chen po las bdud btul ba dang nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan phyogs bcur gsal ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas dgyes pa chen po ye shes rgyal po de nyid gsung gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di yang dag par grags shing dam tshig rjes su 'dzin pa'i dgongs pa rtser chib nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje las 'di dag phyung ngo / /phroṃ (5)bi shwa kro dha badz+ra dz+wa 103—133

la maṇ+ḍal hu)tsakra hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ha la ha la du tri tsakra nān/ srur+ya tsan+d+ra pad+ma de ba tiṣ+ṭha nān/ hūm̐ hūṃ ha ha hūṃ hūm̐ badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ②ta ①ka ha na da ha pa tsa rtsu phaṭa/ hūm̐ badz+ra dha ra ma hā kro dhī ④shā ri dz+wa ⑤la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ⑥ma dzohā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ⑧ka ha na da ha pa tsa rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to bud+dha/ ma hā gro dhī 6)shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭ+wāṃ tshurat+na ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ⑩ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ ṭ+wāṃ srur+ya tsorat+na ma hā kro dhī tsosha ri dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥ8pad+ma ma hā shrī 7he ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ha yika ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hrīḥyishwa pad+ma ba mu ka ma hā kro dhī 4)shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ()ha kurma ma hā shrī te ru ka ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 0sarba duṣ+ṭan ta 0ka ha na da ha ( nyepa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ kurma du)ma hā kro dhī 6)shwa ri dz+wa la ni hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra ke'u ri ha/ badz+ra tse'u so)ri ha/ badz+ra pra mo hā ha/ badz+ra be tā buli ha/ badz+ra puk+ka phyisi ha/ badz+ra ghasma ri ha/(ste badz+ra sma sha ⑥ni ha/badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li ha/ badz+ra sing ha mu kha (nyahe/ badz+ra byā n+t+ra mu kha 0he/ badz+ra sri dul mu kha zhe te/ badz+ra shwa chan mu kha dunyahe/ badz+ra kṛ dha mu kha dunyahe/ badz+ra shaṅka mu kha 0he/badz+ra gā ka ()mu kha he/ badz+ra hu lu ka mu kha 6)te/ badz+ra ār+ya (nyete tsa te nga tsa/badz+ra a mo gha hūṃ/ badz+ra ā 0lo ka bam̐/ badz+ra bhasmi ri pā la ya ba to ho/ rtsebye ()gyi phri 7ta ār+ya ni tsa tur ba ya phaṭa/ badz+ra be yo gi pra ce ti ār+ya ni tsa tur thā (nyaya hūm̐ phaṭa / badz+ra mu 6 a ni a pra ti ār+ya ni pa shi ka ra phaṭa/ badz+ra mu ni a pra ti ār+ya pa ni shi ka ra phaṭa/ badz+ra mu ni a sum̐ (stob a ni ba shi ka ra phaṭa/ badz+ra mu ni a pra ti ār+ya ni traṃ su pa shi ka ra phaṭa/ badz+ra mu tri ni a pra ti ār+ya ni pa shi ka ra phaṭa/badz+ra mu ni a du pri ti a ni pa shi ka ra phaṭa/ e h+ye hi ā (men ya ho/ oṃ ru lu ru 103—134

lu rgyu bh+yo hūṃ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ0)/ badz+ra gro dha sa ma ya tsū phaṭa ces gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyis stong gsum gyi dkyil 'khor khyab par dus gcig khyab par grags pa dang ske/ dam nod pa bka' nyan gyi tshogs ma'i lasrin mo la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang so so'i srog gi snying po phul lo/ /badz+ra ma nu rāk+ṣa chasi/ badz+ra pra ma ni/badz+ra ro trili/ badz+ra be+et+ta ( be/ badz+ra ping ga 4)lo/ badz+ra ke ma ri/ badz+ra in+d+ra (7na / badz+ra su ra ya tra/ badz+ra so hu mya/ badz+ra a mṛ (nyata/ badz+ra da na ta/ badz+ra rāk+ṣa 6)si/ badz+ra bak+ṣa si/ badz+ra ra ti haṃ/ badz+ra ru ti haṃ/ badz+ra e ka tsa ro/badz+ra ma no ha ro/ badz+ra sa na dhi ⑩lha/ badz+ra ba ya bya/ badz+ra ma hā ma ram na/badz+ra asne (7ye/ badz+ra tsa murnyispyi/ badz+ra pu tran/ badz+ra ba ru ṇi4)/ badz+ra ma hā kā ④la / badz+ra tīk+ṣa yi / badz+ra lam̐ po dha ra/ ye shes rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa/ /thugs rjes yikhro dpal rngam pa'i tshogs/ /'bar ba'i byin brlabs /tsho rmad po che/ /de hu)nyid du ni bdag la stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sa4)/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ/ badz+ra sa ma ya phaṭa/ a li u li ta li ta ( )pa li rda s+t+waṃ (1kho na ro tri ()kha rlo yo ga ni kha raṃ hūm̐ ha he phaṭa ces brjod pas/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu kun/ /tshig cing 'bar bas thams cad khyab/ /gsung gi khro tshogs chen po yis/ /kun du khyab cing gang gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po ye shes rgyal po de nyid kyi de dag gi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir nges par brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa / /gru chad bzhis sa brgyan bar khyams ridang / /gru bzhi sgo khyud bzhe dang ldan / /'bar ba'i bar khyams gsum gyis mdzes/ /thod sbrul sna tshogs nyi mas brjid / /'bar ba'i phreng ba mang po 'khrug /khyu mchog ma he gzig dang stag /103wa 135

gtum pa dom gyi spar bas ni/ /dbang phyug lha chen la sogs pa/ /dregs pa chen po gtum tshogs mnan/ /gdan du byas te sku bzhugs pa/ /smug nag sngo nag ser nag dang / /dmar nag ljang nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu dgu phyag ni bcwa zhi)brgyad dang / /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad②/ /rngam pa'i sgra chen 'jigs par sgrogs(mi/ /stag lug sbrul dang nyi mar chasabya/ /sti ra che chung nang zhags dang / /khyung dang yid bzhin nor bu dang / /stong gi ⑤'jig rten khor yug bcas/ /rdo rje dung chen gang ba dang / /ral gri dgra sta gshol la 67sogs/ /rang gi lag cha sna tshogs dang / /btsun mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya dang / /spor byed chen mo brgyad rnams dang / /dbyug pa mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /sgo bzhi'i phyag rgyar mdzes pa dang / /lcags kyu la sogs thod pas mdzes/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /bcu gnyis dang ni brgyad kyis mdzes/ /rang gi stan dang lag char chas/ /ci bgyi zhes ni chas te gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu thams cad du/ sku gsung thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis gang zhing khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes rgyal po de nyid don yod pa'i 'bras bu chen po dam tshig chen pos gzung ba'i phyir 'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig rdo rje 'di gsungs so/ /bla med mi spong bla ma dzobakur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi gcad/ /yang dag lam du zhugs la byams/ /gsang ba'i don phyir smra mi bya/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig chen po ni/ /gdong 987chen bcu yi don rtogs kyang / /rtsa ba gsum po mi 'da'o9 / /yan lag dam tshig lnga gnyis ni/ /gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang 103—136

dang ske/ /nga rgyal phrag dog mi spong 0)ngo / /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chu/ /dag pa'i snod bcud mi dor ②ro/ /spyi dpal bcu yi mnga' brnyes kyang / /yan ①lag bcu po mi dor ro/ /gzhan yang yan lag dam tshig rnams/ /'da' bar mi mdzad rdo rje dam/ /sa ma ya ni rdo rje che/ /mi 'da' rgyal ba nyid kyi dam/ /bsam rdzogs lhun grub che mthar phyin/ /srid gsum dag pa dbang chen sgyur/ /mi 'jigs kun tu bzang por spyod/ /theg pa mtha' yas 'dul ba'i thabs/ /ji snyed sdom pa mtha' las ④pa/ /ma lus rnam dag lhun gyis rdzogs/ /nyams 'gyur nyes pa brjod mi lang / /tshe thung bsam pa log pa dang / /mya ngan sdug bsngal chen po dang / /dmyal ba nyid ni rdo rje byed/ /dgu rdzogs bcur 6)ldan gsum gyis sbyangs/ / bskang ba 4)la (7sogs mtha' yas mchog /ces gsungs pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis (kye'adul bar 'gyur ro6) / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las 'jigs byed chen po gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig rdo rje'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po ye shes rgyal po de nyid chos thams cad man ngag bla ma chen po'i snying po byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngang du snyigs ma med par byung bebatab pa'i phyir sku gsung thugs bla ma chen po'i thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas man ngag bla ma chen po'i snying po 'di phyung ngo / /byang chub sems kyi bde chen la/ /rgyu rkyen rten dang len bcas pa'i/ /skyon med thig le chen po las/ /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs/1)/ /phyogs rtogs yang dag nyid ma rtogs/ /'dul ba dgongs pa gsang ba dang / /rang bzhin 103—137

gsang ba'i don rnams ni/ /yi ge tshig la rab brten te/ /khong nas gab sbas don 'byin pa/ /ston pa rdo rje'i 6)thugs la gnas/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i thig le dbyings/ /'byung ba shes rab rigs kyi yum/ /byed pa rigs kyi gtso bo ste/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i tshogs/ /dbang po yul dus rig pa'i 90rnams/ /bdag nyid chen po lhag par rdzogs/ /thugs kyi ye shes lngas blta zhing / /snying po thig le mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes chen por rol/ /ye shes dgyes pa mchog tu 'bul(mi/ /zad med zag pa med pa yi74 / /bsod nams ye shes sgyu mar rol/ /rol mo'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas mchog /gsang ba'i thig le nyid kyi dbyings/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa'i dbyings/ /sku gsung yon tan phrin (5)las thugs/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun/ /ma lus bdag gis dbang sgyur (6)ro/ /dbang sgyur ye shes rol pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor la gnas dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub/ /rdzogs chen rtogs pa chen po yis/ /rgyan 7)du dkyil 'khor ma lus thogs/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyam sbyor bas / /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus 'byung / /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i mgon/ /sgyu (guma'i dkyil 'khor ma lus sgrol/ /bya ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor spyod/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thos bsam bsgom tsa)pa'i mnyam sbyor bas/ /rang 'byung 7kun nas lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni 6nyasangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /rgyu 103—138

rkyen rten dang ldan pa yi/ /thams cad byang chub sems kyi dbyings/ /byang chub sems kyi bde chen gyis/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad dbyings su thim/ /thig le chen po bla ma las/ /sgyu ma byang chub lam du bstan/ /skyon dang yon tan thams cad kyang / /byang chub thig le nyid kyi ngang / /spyod pa rnam pa nyid 67kyi yang / /thig le chen po'i lam du nges/ /sgyu ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor yang / /thig le chen po'i dbyings su sbyor/ /sdom pa rnam pa bcu gsum dang / /spyi yi dam tshig mtha' yas pa/ /thig le chen po'i ngang du gsal/ /snod bcud 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /thig le nyid kyi rol pa'i dbyings/ /tshogs chen rnam pa gnyis po yang / /byang chub sems kyi dbyings su nges/ /gzhal yas khang dang rgyan rnams dang / /cho (mi'aphrul byang chub sems su thim/ /khro tshogs bdud 'dul rol pa yang / /byang chub sems su nges pa yin/ /'gro drug sems can gsum po yang / /ye shes drug dang sku gsum du/ /nges pa'i thig le chen po yin / /lnga yi rten dang rkyen (5)bzhi yang / /dbyings kyi ma dang dus kyi sring / /thig le chen po'i ngang du 'dus/ /snga phyi gsum dang yod med khams/ /sku gsung thugs su nges bstan pa'i/ /thig le byang chub sems su nges/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyang / /phyag rgya bzhi bcu gnyis po yang / /thig le nyid las gzhan na med/ /bzhi yi las dang gcig po yang / /thig le sems kyi ngang du gsal/ /'gro ba'i don du 'byung ba yi/ /dgu dang stong phrag brgya bcu bzhi//byang chub sems las gzhan na med/ /bde skyid sdug bsngal mang po yang /rtogs pa bde chen dbyings kyi don/ /ye shes ye shes rol pa yang / /rdo rje snying po'i dbyings su nges/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /dus 103—139

gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams/ /nyag gcig ①yab tu nges par rdzogs/ /thar pa'i lam mchog dbyings kyi yum/ /kun du bzang mo la ②sogs kyang / /thig le ma yi ngang ①du gsal/ /gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor dang / /bzhugs gnas khyad par mang po yang / /ye shes chen po'i gnas su bsdu/ /mchod pa'i rgyan dang longs spyod kun/ /rigs pa'i byang chub sems chen po/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i ngang du 'dus/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi ngo bo dang / /chos so cog gi rang bzhin rnams/ /byang chub sems su nges pas na/ /dkar nag las kyis ma gsungs so/ /byang chub sems kyi bde chen ni/ /ci yang med las cir yang snang / /cis kyang ma bcos g.yung drung sku/ /cir mi mdzad la thams cad sgrol//dmigs pa med par kun la khyab/ /ma bskos rgyal po yang dag pa/ /ma sbyangs ye shes snying po che/ /ma bsgoms cig ④car don nyid ( rdzogs/ /ma bsgrubs rgyal ba kun gyi gtso/ /ma sbyangs skyon dang yon tan med/ /tshig dang yi ges mi mtshon te/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis rnyed par dka'/ /kun bzang ⑥rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /rnyed nas rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor spyod/ /spyod pas 'gro ba sgrol ba ste/ /de la nyes pa'i skyon mi mnga'/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dbyer med par dgyes nas stug pos brgyan 97)pa'i rgyan nyid du bzhugs so/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las man ngag snying po byang chub sems bde ba chen po'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas yang ye shes rgyal po de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dgongs pa yang dag pa'i phrin 98)las chen po 'di ma 99)byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 103—140

kyi ched du sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin ①las rdo rje las phyung ngo / /e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa la/ /khros pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /bkug nas rdo rje'i phur pas gdab/ /rdul du byas nas tshogs la 'bul/ /e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /bcings gyur bskyod nas phyogs bcur g.yos/ /myos ②'gyur gas te tshig par 'gyur/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba'i gzi brjid lhun chen la/ /chags pa'i yid kyis mchod sbyin ②bya/ /rdo rje gsum yang dbang du 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming du bcas par bya/ /rdo rje chags pa'i phur bas gdab/ /chags pa'i tshogs la thim par dbul/ /baṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sprel bsdams nas/ /ci 'dod de bzhin byed par 'gyur/ /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /'bar ba'i 'du 'phro'i gzi chen la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /yon tan yid bzhin gter du brtag /nga rgyal dga' 'phro'i phur bas gdab/ /rdo rje gzi brjid 'phel bar brtag /ma yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba'i 'phrul chen spro/ /yid bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' (4)dang mnyam/ /ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /gsal ba'i gzi brjid 'tsher ba la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis mchod sbyin bya/ /gtum chen rngam po'ang lha (gener 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga 'am zas lnga la/ /gtum chen 'khrug pa'i ngo bor brtan(phyin/ /lhan 103—141

der gsal ba'i phur bas gdab/ /'bar ba lha 6)de'i tshogs la 'bul②/ /ya yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lu gu rgyud du sbrel bsdams nas/ /'bar ba lha ①de'i byin gyis khyab/ /thams cad g.yo ba med par 'gyur/ /a/ thams cad rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /las su ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /las kyi khyad par rdzogs pa yi/ /srid pa gsum du bsdus pa rnams/ /byin gyis ma brlabs gcig kyang med/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i phrin ④las kyis/ /sbyangs pas bsam rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ /ho/ slas dang byi (5)mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /lhag ma kha chu 'dod pa sbyin/ /rang gi dam tshig rab bsgrubs te/ /gang 'dod las de byed par bsgo/ /khrag 'thung chen po la (6)sogs te/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa thams cad kun/ /thams cad ma lus byed pa yin/ /mdzod ldan chen mo la 97sogs te/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /'du bar 'dod na 'du bar byed/ /'phel bar 'dod na 'phel bar byed/ /sbos (8)mo chen mo la sogs te/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /rmongs par 'dod na rmongs par byed / /myos (9par 'dod na myos yipar byed/ /seng gdong chen mo la (7sogs te / /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /thams cad kun la za bar byed/ /rdul cha tsam yang med par byed/ / bzhad gdong tunyechen mo la 6)sogs te/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /thams cad kun la 'byin par byed/ /kun la rab tu nyams par byed/ /a/ spor byed chen mo la yisogs te/ /nyul byed chen mo brgyad rnams la/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /thams cad kun la nyul bar byed / /ma lus gnas nas spor 'obar byed/ /slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /bro gar glu tshig chen mos ni/ /sbad 7cing gtang bar 7bya ba ste/ /thams cad 103—142

ma lus byed pa yin/ /sngon shing dang ni lcug phran tshal/ /sdong gcig dang ni me reg tu/ /dang ba dga' ba chags pa dang / /khros pas ka li rab tu bya/ /zhes gsungs pas phrin ①las rnam pa bzhi sti ra'i rnga dang bcas par phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams 'dul bar gyur te(kyi/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ye shes rgyal po 'jigs byed chen po de nyid dam tshig sti ra'i rnga bla ma rdung zhing sti ra rngam pa'i mdangs 'di phyung ngo / /e yi ①tshogs chen 'byam gi)pa ru/ /ste ra'i (gernga chen sgra bsgrags pas/ /hūm̐ ha he phaṭa sgra 'byin cing / /yig 'bru brgyad kyi byin brlabs (7kyis/ /ru lu rdzu bh+yo'i gsung sgrogs 9)pa/ /khro bo rngam pa'i sgra skad kyis / /srid pa gsum char bshig nas kyang / /stong gsum bsgral ba'i sgra 'byin pa'o/ /sti ra rnga chen 'di brdungs (25pas/ /gnod sbyin srin po kun bsgral te/ /mu stegs kun gyi snying yang 'byin/ /sti ra'i 6)rnga chen 'di bsgrags pas / /stong gsum khro bo'i tshogs kyis bkang / /kun kyang rnga brdung di ri ri/ /rnga sgra chen pos stong gsum bshigasku /rnga sgra chen pos bdud dpung bsgral/ /rnga sgra chen pos srid gsum sbyangs/ /rnga sgra chen pos dgra /11bgegs 'dul/ /rnga sgra chen pos ngan song sbyangs/ /rnga sgra 'brug gi sgra bsgrags pas/ /na rag dmyal khams stongs 7par byed/ /rnga sgra tug chem ri rab rnyilan / /ste ra rnga chen sgra phyung bas/ /phyin ci log rnams snying yang 'byin/ /rnga chen 'brug gi sgra sgrogs shing ski/ /rnga thabs glog stong 'gyur ab bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs dam bskang 8/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig bskang 91na/ /rnal 'byor rnam lnga'i dam tshig bskul/ /sti ra rnga chen 'di brdungs zhu pas/ /nyan thos mdo sde gnas nas spar/ /rang rgyal lta ba dbyings su sgrol/ /sti ra'i rnga chen 'di 103—143

bsgrags pas/ /lha dang mi yi ②theg pa yang / /bla med theg pa'i dbyings su btsud / /ste ra rnga sgra 'di bsgrags ②pas/ /stong khams sti ra'i rnga sgras bkang / /kun kyang rnga brdung ①ni ri ri/ /rnga thabs glog stong lce 'byin cing / /rnga skad 'brug stong sgra sgrogs pas/ /byin brlabs ༷lcags kyi ser chen 'bebs/ /stong gsum 'khrug cing srid gsum 'thor/ /rnga thabs g.yab mor bor ba dang / /kha dang ka yi ru mtshon gyis/ /thams cad gnam lcags chen pos btab⑤/ /ka la chen po la ⑥sogs te/ /rdo rje chags ⑦'og ldegs pa'i rnams/ /dus gcig tu ni tsit+ta ⑧'byin/ /sti ra chen po'i stirnga sgra yis/ /srid pa khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyil / /dus gcig tu ni dbang chen rdzogs/ /rnga sgra rin chen khang pa brtsegs / /bsam rdzogs che la dbang thang thob/ /rnga sgras g.yo ba med par byed / /chos la 'dzud pa'i sgra yang 'byin/ /rnga sgras ci 'dod dgongs pa rdzogs / /byang chub sems ltar de ma thag /ces gsungs pas ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi sbyor bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa chen po ye shes rgyal po de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma chen po man ngag gi snying po dang bcas pa de la shin tu rngam pa'i mdangs tunyekyis dgyes pa chen po'i glu 'di blangs so/ /hūm̐ gtum chen dus tsomatha'i me ltar 'bar / /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'gyu 8ba bzhin/ri /mche ba zang skeyag za byed che/ /ho/ hūm̐ rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ /tug 7chem ri rab 'bum rnyil 7skad/ /a la la yi gad rgyangs che/ /spyugs pa'i 'thor rlung g.yeng ba che/ /ho/ hūm̐ khro bo'i shes rab 'od po che/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor kun du gsal/ /'bar ba'i ye shes kun du 'joms/ /sna tshogs 103—144

ye shes thig le che/ /ho/ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po sprin chen po/ /khros pa'i dkyil 'khor char chen 'bebs/ /dkyil 'khor yid bzhin 'byung ba'i 6)gter/ /sna tshogs khros pa'i thig le che/ /ho/ hūm̐ bdud rnams kun gyi ②bdud chen po/ /bdud kyi bdud ste ①bdud rnams 'joms/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs kyang 'jigs byed pa/ /'jigs byed chen po bdal ④ba che/ /hūm̐ rdo rje brag ①chen sra ba po/ /rdo rje chu bo sdud chen po/ /rdo rje me ste kun 'bar che/ /rdo rje rlung ste 'thor rlung che / /ho/ hūm̐ stong gsum khro bo'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /'jigs byed mtshon du med pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs gsung dang sna tshogs thugs/ /'jigs byed rngam pa'i ye shes gter/ /ho zhes blangs pas stong gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jigs byed chen po rnams dbyer med pas mnyes par gyur to/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bla ma chen po las lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin 5yelas dang yongs su mnyes pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa'i don/ /gsang ba kun gyi bla ma ste/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyal po yin/ /nges don chos kyi snying po las/ /'dul ba mdo sde chos mngon dang / /dam tshig sgrub dang grub pa dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'phros te/ /sde snod kun dang rgyud kun yang / /'byung nas (/gtan la 58ranges par 'bebs/ /'gro drug sems can gsum po yang / /sta na chen po'i dbyings su bstan/ /ling ga pad+mar bcas pa yang / /ga 59)na chen po'i dbyings su sbyor/ /snang srid kha dog mang po yang /ga yin chen po'i lam du bstan/ /rang bzhin gsang ba'i snying po 'di/ /rtogs 103—145
