sgo srung ①ma rnams bri/ /de yi yum dang bcas pa rnams/ /khro bo nyid dang sku mthun ②pa'o/ /sems dpa'i 'dug stangs gnas byas la/ /sgeg mo g.yon du bsten byas la/ /sngags g.yog mdzes par tshogs byas la/ /mgu ba'i phrin las brtsam par bya/ /ske tshe ①thal ba rus pa la/ /dzam+bha ④la yi gzugs lta bur/ /byas la snying gar ⑤byi ba ni/ /a ma pa la si ti 'am/ /gang 'dod pa yi ⑥yi ge de / /phaṭa dang rtsig hās dam ltar bya/ /ming byang gong ltar bri byas la/ /gang ltar 'tsham ⑧pa bzhin du bzhag⑨ /de la 'di yang rab tu brjod/ /oṃ a kro badz+ra shārnyi ⑩na ga badz+ra swā hā/ oṃ a gro te ka shārnyi 7pa la rbu zhes brjod la snying khar ⑫brgyab na/ thams cad mgu nas dang ba'i sems kyis zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas zhi ba'i las byas zin nas/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa zhi bar bya ste/ /bdag la mi dga' ba med na las 'grub pa yin no/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las/ thams cad zhi ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad rgyas par bya ba 'di ched du brjod do / /gser las grub pa'i yul dag la'ang / /dpal rgyas sems dang ldan byas te0/ /rgyase par bya ba'i sems kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad par bya / /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin byas la/ /ba yi chag chag btab byas tephya/ /rnal 'byor dam pa blo ldan pas/ /thig 'di tsogadab pa rab tu brtsam/ /gser las grub pa'i thig skud la/ /dpal ldan 'phel ba'i sems dang bcas/ /slob ma dam pa las grub par/ /bsams la thig 'di tsogadab par bya/ /pho brang gser la rtse mo g.yu/ /rdo rje rtsig 7pa gser las grub/ /gru chad sgo rnams 103—165

lcags las grub/ /rnal 'byor sngags pa blo ldan pas/ /thig bzhi re'u cha brgyad du 'gyur/ /mtha' nas thig gdab man ngag can/ /de la 0)sogs pa bsam par bya/ /rin chen skyil krung (5)'dug byas la/ /dbus su gsang sngags bdag bos te③/ /phyogs phyogs sgo ba dam pa rnams/ /snga ma bzhin du bsgoms ——nas kyang / /rang sngags skyes bu de bskyed do/ /oṃ a kro te ka puṣ+ṭi (geb la na hūm̐/oṃ a gro puṣ+ṭi (5)ti ba ta na sto(6)/ zhes brjod pas bdag po yab yum la/ /'khor rnams 'brur re 5ba las sam/ /rang rang bskyed pa dam pa ste/ /sngags dang ldan par ting 'dzin gsal/ /bzhugs dang brtan dang mchod pa dang / /phyag byed pa la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi bya ba ma lus par thams cad ma lus tshang bar bya/ /skyed dang grub pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /rgyal ba bsnyen te shethag mi ring / /rang grub 'bras bu de la sogs/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs pa yi/ /dngos grub dam pa rab 11ster zhes/ /'dren pa dpa' bos yang dag bshad/ /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin byas nas/ /sa zhag gser las grub pa la/ /gzugs ni dam pa rab tu bya / /phyi gan gan rkyal sna mnan byas la/ /nang hūṃ puṣ+ṭi 517a bu tse swā hā/ /snying gar 7bris nas brjod bya ba32/ /snying po sngags kyi dam pa ste/ /bla med dam pas rab tu bshad/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭi ā thuyu ba shang shrī puṣ+ṭi bo'i hā zhes brjod na thams cad rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las / thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bdag nyid dbang gis 'du ba zhes bya ba'i ting 1003—166

nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas ched du brjod pa 'di ①brjod do/ /zangs las 'brel ba'i yul dag la/ /rang dbang med de dbang bsdus nas/ /'du ba'i sems dang ldan byas te②/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bshad par bya/ /zangs sam dmar po'i sa dag la/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma dag dang 'dra/ /legs par khod snyoms ①zin pa dang / /thig ni rab tu gdab par bya/ /lte ba can la rtsibs brgyad pa/ /kun du zlum pas ④rgyas pa mtha'/ /lte dudabus gzhu bdungs dubris byas la/ /de steng stibadag po dam pa gzhag /thams cad ma lus mchog tu 'gugs/ /sa pa la yang thogs pa med/ /zhes ni yang dag bla med des/ /bshad par bya ste rab tu bsten/ /gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba//sems kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa ste/ /bla med yang dag nges pa'i lam sangs rgyas byang chub la sogs rnams/ /gzhung las 'byung ba'i tshig don rnams/ /ma nor gsungs pa'i ⑧bka' bzhin du/ /bsgrubs na 'grub par bshad pa'o/ /de dag 'gugs par gyur pa ⑨na/ /phal pa gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /bsdu dang 'dren pa byang chub lam/ /'di dag go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /yungs kur 0rkang rjes sa 'am gzhan/ /khrag gsum thal chen bsres ⑩byas la /ga'u'i nang du blugs byas la/ /ga 'u gnyis ni kha sbyar te/ /skud pa dmar po zangs la sogs/ / bcing ba bsdams 8te bkris (nyebyas la/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni 8thog tu gzhag /yungs kur 'azangs gnyis bsreg byas te/ /dud pas ga 'u ⑩de la bdug /de la bdugs par gyur pa dang / /bzlas pa'i snying po brjod bya zhing / /lan grangs khri tshad ⑩du ma ru/ /brjod na sangs rgyas la sogs rnams/ / 'gugs par gyur yin phal ba gzhan/ /smos ci dgos te 103—167

nges par 'gugs/ /oṃ badz+ra a gro mañju shrī ba shang ma hā sarba ti la r+bha/ lan grangs mang du brjod byas na/ / ci ltar bsams 6)pa thams cad 'gugasaphyi/ /rgya shug bskus ⑧pa'i khu ba dang / /ma yi lag pa'i khu ba gnyis/ /snga ma bzhin du bkug ④byas na/ /'gugs ⑤par 'gyur zhes dpa' bos bshad/ /yang na rang gi lag pa'ang yirung / /zhes gsungs pas ④thams cad ma lus par 'dus te / dper na phyogs thams cad nas mtsho la sbrang ma 'du ba bzhin du 'dus te bdag gi dbang du bya ba de dbang du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rjes gsungs so/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las / dbang gi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po gshin rje'i tshogs 'du mdzad dephyi/rang bzhin gyi mthu can po)'di gsungs so/ /'byung byed ye shes dkyil 'khor ni / /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin byas la/ /bdag nyid khro bo chen po ste/ /yum yang de bzhin de yi 'o/ /yab yum gnyis med byin brlabs las/ /7thig skud rgyus 31pa lcags las byas/ /de ni las kyi thig ces bya/ /thig bzhi btab pas ⑫dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /kun du gru bzhi sgo khyud can/ /gru chad ldan te dur khrod rgyan/ /mdzes par bris te gzhan na min / /sten 1nyapa'i lha ste snga ma bzhin/ /bskyed pa'i sngags 'di brjod byas pas / /bdag dang 'dra bar bskyed par bya/ /oṃ a kro te ka yis a/ hūṃ badz+ra be ta lili rak+ta 7me/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐ lhu hūm̐ hūṃ rtu rtsu lhu rtu/ dzaḥyo rtsu baṃ hoḥ18 / bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo zhes brjod pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams 103—168

cad g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun du rab tu g.yos so/ /'gul 'gul / rab tu 'gul/ kun du rab tu 'gul lo/ /ldeg ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg go/ /chem chem/ rab tu chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /dbus mtho na mtha' dma'/ mtha' mtho na dbus dma' ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i bdag nyid des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rab tu gsung gi gsang sngags gsungs pas ①bdag cag spro lags so/ /'jig rten du 'di lta bur mthu can la bdag zhu lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin gyis khro bar mdzad pa de la bdag mngon du sems can thams cad rab tu yang zhu bar 'tshal lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen por 'du mdzad pa des 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /oṃ shrī bar yak+ta (gyigu ya/ sarba ta chakhri badz+ra ka la rū ④pa ma ra na phaṭa ces gsungs pas/ 'jig rten na dbang che ba dang / mthu che ba la sogs pa thams cad btul nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gang nas kyang / /gsung du med pa'i chos nyid la/ /rang sems 'phro 'dur gyur pa las/ /phyogs bcur gsungs pa de dag yin/ /de bas nan tan bskyed byas te(na)/ /drag po'i tsham ngam bshad par bya/ /'jig rten bcud kyi gdug pa kun/ /tsham (6ringam glog ltar 'gyur ba las/ /ngo mtshar ya mtshan bsgrag par bya/ /e ma'o yab yum gnyis med rol pa'i mkha' dkyil nas / /phyogs bcur 'phro ba byang chub sems/ /rigs kyi yab dang de bzhin btsun mo ni/ /rtag par bsgoms te de bzhin gshegs par bya/ /rdzas dang 103—169

phyag rgya sngags dang bcas rnams ni/ /gzugs dang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu gang 'dod grub par ro/ /mi dge bcu dang ldan pa'i rnam par 'dren pa der byas te6)ne/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas rnams dang / / ga 'u ②pad+ma dam pa dang / /kham pa rdza yi 'ji ba yis①/ /khrag sna gsum dang gi duwang ngo / /de dag phrin las mchog yin te/ /grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /bla med dpa' bos yang dag gsungs/ /phyogs bcu'i gdug pa ma lus kun/ /'dul bar 'gyur te the tshom dumed/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las drag po'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang la longs spyod par bya ba'i phyir/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod dudo / /rang bzhin 'phags pa kun du shes rab ste/ /de bzhin rnam par mi rtog ⑦yin pas na/ /'di gnyis chos kyi sku zhes rab tu bshad/ /chos kyi longs spyod 'dul ba'i don la rgyas/ /'gro ba'i don rdzogs ma lus skur 'byung dang / /bdud dang mu stegs srin po gdul ba'i phyir/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gzugs su sprul nas ni/ /ma lus tshar gcod don du 'di gsungs so/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud zlum por bcas/ /sbrul gyis ⑧rgya gram dag gi ⑨mtha' bskor la/ /lte bar rdo rje rgya gram bri bar bya/ /de yi steng du ka pā kyil gnyis la/ /gcig la rigashin rje dbu drug pa yi gzugs/ /gcig la yum chen khro gnyer gzugs bris la / /nang du dgra bo rkang rjes sa dang ni/ /dri dang de bzhin khrag sna gsum/ /thal chen rgya shug bskus (1pa'i khu ba dang / /brdzis la dgra bo'i gzugs byas la//103—170

bcug la skud pa dkar pos bcing / /dkyil 'khor thog tu gzhag par bya/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka /hrīṣ+ṭi ①badz+ra gro dha ya mān+ta ②ka badz+ra gro dha ③phaṭa phaṭa a/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis ni/ /yab yum sku mdog mthing nag la/ /dbu skra kham nag ral pa gyen du brjes/ /dbu la thod pa rlon pas brgyan/ /sku la sbrul nag chun po dang / /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs④/ /phyag drug phyag mtshan bsnams pa ni/ /g.yas kyi dang po sdigs mdzub dul/ /rgyu zhags lcags kyu bar tha ma/ /dung chen tri shul dugasal shing g.yon/ /de ltar cha lugs gsal ba dang / /dbyangs 'di blang bar nan tan bya/ /hūm̐ rngam pa'i rgyal po khrag 'thung gshin rje gshed/ /khams gsum dbang sdud rtags su zhal gsum podu / /dbyings nas sprul pa'i yab yum lhun gyis grub/ /las byangan 'khrul ba'i sems can gdul dka' ba/ /gdug pa de dag 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas la/ dzaḥkyi bam̐ hoḥtshu/ sa ma ya /hu/ zhes pa lan grangs mang du brjod/ des ni brtan par bzhugs par 'gyur/ /khrag chen rgod khrag sha dang tshil/ /chen po la sogs gtor ma bsham8/ /de ni dkyil 'khor thog dag tu/ /bdag nyid ting 'dzin gsal ba las/ /sngags 'di 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra hasta ba ba he ha dā na hrīṣ+ṭi 8che ge mo mā ⑫ra ya rtu rtsu 8phaṭa phaṭa/ che ge mo hasta ba pri ti nir te sa rtsu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ nyin zhag gcig la lan ⑩'bum bzlas/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du bzlas/ /de dag bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang ⑩/ /gtor ma'i las dag brtsam (nyebya ste/ /bskyed dang bskul dang rdzogs pa dang / /phyogs bcu'i khro bo spyan drangs te4)/ /bzhugs dang brtan dang mi g.yo sogs/ /ma lus rdzogs pa'i phrin las bya/ /103—171

de ltar phrin las rdzogs pa dang / /yang nas yang du bstab pa bya/ /de ltar bstab pa byas pas tu)na/ /dgra bgegs dbang 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /de nas yang 'di ched du brjod de gsungs so/ /oṃ nga ni phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi/ /bder ②gshegs thugs kyi sras yin par/ /bdud dang srin po log 'dren rnams / /ma lus tshar gcod byin brlabs te / /mgon po gshin rje nyid kyi sras / /don rnams thams cad ma lus pa/ /de nyid du ni bsgrub par bya/ /dgra rnams thams cad 'dul niba'i phyir/ /phrin las rdo rje can gyis (snyemadzod/ /zhes ⑥brjod cing sngags kyis brdeg pa ni phrin las mchog gi rgyal po zhes gsungs so/ /dus dang dus 9)dang zhag grangs ni/ /nyi ma gcig la stong rtsa gcig /nam gyi gung la brgya rtsa gcig /tho rangs (0thun gcig brgya rtsa gcig /srod kyi gung la brgya rtsa gcig /de ltar nyin zhag gsum bar du/ /bzlas pa zhag grangs tshang bya zhing / /phyag rgya bca' zhing gzugs la brdeg /nya la byas na gdon mi za/ /oṃ mā (9)ra na kha da sarba hrīṣ+ṭi ya mnayi/ rtu rtu tre kha da bar na pa la rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya bcas la dgra bo'i gzugs la brdeg go/ /oṃ badz+ra r+ghaṃ khaṃ s+pha tunyer na phaṭa/ hūm̐ ā be sha yonyes/ lhu lhu phaṭa phaṭa a/ yang phyag rgya gong ma bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la tan+t+ra lhu rtsu/hrīṣ+ṭi kṛ ta nan/ rtu hrīṣ+ṭi bi kṛ ta nan nan 6)zhes brjod la/ /bdag gi lag pas dbang bskur kha7ro/ /yang phyag rgya bcas la/ sngags 'di la yang 7lan grangs mang du bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa hrīṣ+ṭi yibadz+ra sti 6 1ra baṃ/ kha hi rtsu rtsu che ge mo dbang du sdus 38shig /hri la hri la zhes lan grangs mang du brjod do/ /rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyag rgyas brdeg go/ /yang phyag rgya bcas la sngags 'dis brdeg go/ /103—172

oṃ badz+ra kung ka ma ka la ya na hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa a/ zhes 'bum bzlas ①la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas brdeg go/ /yang phyag rgya bcas la sngags 'dis brdeg go/ /oṃ badz+ra a gu sha tre tha ste ②ra rba lhu lhu phaṭa phaṭa che ge mo mā zhur ya dza hūm̐ ④zhes dbang du sdus 0shing / rtsu lhu phaṭa phaṭa zhes lan grangs mang du brjod do/ /rdo rje gdengs ⑥pa'i phyag rgya bcas la dbang du bsdu'o⑦/ /yang phyag rgya bcas la sngags 'dis brdeg go/ /oṃ rtu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa 'dus 'dus rang rang yo yaṃ raṃ raṃ hring hring du ⑧ba bh+yo hūṃ 6)phaṭa che ge mo dun bh+yo zhes bzlas la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gi ⑩phyag rgyas brdeg go/ /de ltar las de dag yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par byas la/ bzlas pa byas na las ci byas pa thams cad dbang du 'du bar nges zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs so/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las/ ngan sngags dbang sdud kyi ⑩le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i 8gshed/ bcom ldan 'das kun la khyab pa'i phrin las bsgrub (nyepa 'di/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /lnga phung yan lag gzhom pa dang / /dug gsum rtsad nas gcad pa dang / /'bras bu rgyal bar bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /nan tur phrin las bshad par bya/ /dang po'i las ni rgyas dang gsang ⑫/ /dgug dang gtad dang bcing dang dgrol8/ /sbyor ba'i gdug pa ma lus kun/ /phrin las 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /dang por btsal ba'i btsal thabs ni/ /rnam pa drug dang ldan pas btsal/ /stag mo gad la mchong stabs dang / /seng ge gangs la 'gying tshul dang / /khwa spyang gzan la rgyug tshul dang / /bya rgod gzan la 103—173

'babs ②tshul dang / /dom ②chen rmi lam rmi tshul dang / /khu skeg thang shing snyeg ②tshul gyis/ /ro yi phung po btsal bar bya/ /ri la 'dug na 'gying bas btsal / /sribs la 'dug na dumachong bas btsal/ /gdags la 'dug na 'dug pas btsal/ /'or na 'dug na 'babs ⑤pas btsal/ /brag la 'dug na rmi dubs btsal/ /nags la 'dug na snyeg ⑦pas btsal/ /rgyal rigs yin na seng ge stangasal/ /bram ze ⑨yin na stag mo stangasabya/ /rje'u rigs yin na bya rgod stangs/ /dmangs 7rigs yin na dom gyis bya/ /ma ning yin na spre'u yis ⑩bya/ /dog la yin na khu spyang stangs0/ /de ltar ro yi tshol stangs ni/ /rnam pa drug dang ldan pas btsal/ /brtags nas 'ongs pa ④gyur pa dang / /gshin rje rgyal po'i tsham ngam bya/ /khro bo bcu yis stang stabs ⑩kyis/ /ro la kun tu bskor byas la/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su gzhag /de ltar gzhag pa'i las byas nas/ /mgo ni lho nub mtshams tsos bstan/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams 7su bstan/ /lag pa g.yas pa lho yi phyogs/ /lag pa g.yon pa nub kyi phyogs/ /rkang pa g.yas pa shar gyi phyogs/ /rkang pa g.yon pa 8byang gi phyogs / /de ltar gan rgyal ()bzhag byas (gyel/ /da ni phur pa dgod bya ste/ /mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/ /lag gnyis rkang gnyis pho mtshan dang / /lkog ma de bzhin snying ga (nyadang / /lte ba pus mo dpung pa gnyis/ /gru mo de bzhin long bu gnyis/ /mtshog 6)ma de bzhin spyi bo dang / /dku (stedang de bzhin mchan khung gnyis / /dpral ba rnams su gdab byas la/ /phur pa de dag lha yi ④skur/ /rab tu brtags te tsho gagoms pa dang / /rang bzhin gnas nas gshegs pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin du bsgoms pa dang / /gzugs brnyan nang du bkod pa gsum/ /103—174

tshad pas gdungs pa'i bye ma la/ /mar zhu de bzhin thim pa bzhin/ /gnyis su med par shes bya la/ /gong du bstan pa'i lha rnams ni/ /rnam shes bzhi dang dbang po bzhi/ /de las gyur pa'i yul rnams ni/ /brgyad po ①ngang du shes par bya/ /sgo ma lus la grags pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa'i phyir/ /steng 'og khro bo de las gyur/ /de dag kun gyi sku gsung ②thugs/ /ma mo gsum gyis nga ①nyid de/ /yab ni kun la khyab pa la/ /yum ni kun la sdud pa ste/ /bya ba byed pa bdag nyid do/ /phung po kun la khyab pa la/ /mnyes pas phul phyin lha yi tshogasaX/ /'gro drug kun la ma lus snang / /de ltar las rnams zin pa dang / /zhag grangs du bya dam yang bca'/ /dngos grub thob par 'dod pa yi / /rnal 'byor chen pos ⑤ting 'dzin gsal/ /de ltar byas nas mi la ⑥ sogs / /thams cad dbang du 'du bar gsungs/ /dgra bgegs tshul lta smos ci dgos/ /drag po'i phrin dulas grub 'dod pas/ /dgra bo'i ming byang bris byas la/ /bam gyi kha yi nang du gzhug⑨ /rdo rje rgya gram rgya yis gdabaskye/ /he ru ka yi phyag rgyas mnan/ /yungs kur (7rgyal pos drag tu brdeg /rgya shug bkus ⑩pas drag tu blugs(nye/ /nyi ma bzhi la drag tu brdeg /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad8/ /dam rdzas mchod pa shin tu dgramatshu/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin drag tu bya/ /yengs na bar chad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /g.yeng bar mi mdzad khro bos gsungs/ /des ni las kyi 'bras bu yang / /shin tu zad pa med pa ste/ /mkha' la 'phur dang sa la 'dzul/ /chu la bying 8med mngon shes ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las bzhi tuna'akhor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las ro langs kyi sgrub (nyepa la/ ngan sngags kyi phur bus gdab pa'i le'u ste 103—175

bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje nyid rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /ye shes 'khyil pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed steng na/ /ye shes nyi ma gsal ba'i thig phran gdab/ /mu dhikhyud zlum po sbrul gyi zhags pa bri / /stegs bu phyogs mtshams ②phur bus bskor bar bya/ /de ltar bris pa'i dkyil du dgod pa ni/ /oṃ ni dbus kyi lte ba la/ /shar du hri la lho ru stol/ /nub phyogs lhu (shel byang du ha/ /byang shar mtshams ⑤su dza zhes pa/ /shar lho tri la lho nub me/ /nub byang a la rab tu rten/ /rten ⑥pa'i yi ge de bkod nas/ /dbus su bstan sgyu par bsgom pa ni/ /gshin rje ste sku dmar nag la/ /dbu gsum po la phyag kyang drug /dbu la thod pa tshal gyis brgyan/ /zhal g.yas smug nag g.yon ljang ba/ /dbus ni sku dang rab mthun ⑧pa/ /sku la thod pa brgyan gyi (9)tshal/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ /yab kyi sku la rab 'jug pa/ /g.yon phyogs gnas pa gong ma bzhin/ /oṃ a mṛ ⑩ta ta ka sarba a mṛ 17ta gro ta 'argyu phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ (/mnyata kro ṭa yi: phaṭa/ de ltar yab yum gsal bar bskyedami/ /pad+ma'i gdan la rab bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor la sogs pa'i rim pa ni/ /bskyed pa gong ma'i rim pa'o/ /rtag tu bzlas pa bsnyen pa'i sngags / /mi drag 7mi bul mi zhan par/ /ting 'dzin gsal bar bsgom ⑩byas te / /zhi la 'tsher ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /ri rab dbus kyi lte dbus la/ /rab brtan 18'og gi go go nas/ /rdo rje tshe yi dbang stsol te/ /phyogs bcu gdug pa'i tshe 'dren te/ /gdug pa ma lus 'gugs par 'gyur/ /tshe'i snying po 'di 103—176

rtag tu bzlas/ /oṃ sa ma ya mañju shrī mu tra a ko ā yu pha ①la si ti ni rbu a/des ni tshe yi dbang thob nas/ /sangs rgyas sku dang mnyam pa dang / /bskal pa ma zhig bar du ni/ /lo lnga lon pa bzhin du gnas/ /de nas bskul ba'i gnas 'di gsungs/ /e ma'o phyogs bcu kun nas 'dus pa yi/ /ye shes rgyal po'i thig le 'di/ /gsang chen rmad du byung ba ste/ /rgyu ②drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i bcud/ /thams cad ma lus chos so cogadu /chos kyi sku 'am chos kyi dbyings/ /don dam tshig dang mngon sum pa/ /dngos po mtshan ma thams cad las/ /khyab pa'i mya ngan thugs rje che/ /phra mo sems kyi rang bzhin teri rmo/ /gti mug mun pa sel ba ste/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun dang bral/ /shin tu sad (5)pa mya ngan 'das/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin gshin rje ste/ /rdo rje tshe'i rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'oyi/ /zhes gsungs pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad rngam pa'i zhal nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /e ma'o phyogs bcu'i ⑦'jig rten ye nas dben/ /bder (shegashegs thams cad ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i ye shes lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i stong khams 'jig rten rgyan du bcas/ /thabs dang shes rab kyis ni dbang bskur (9nan/ /bdud dang srin po log 'dren tshe bsdus te/ /dbang bskur gnang ba des kyang byin bskyed de/ /shar phyogs dri za'i gnas nas tshe drongs shigatso /oṃ badz+ra ku la e swa shwa 0ster na ha ha ho ho rtu rtsu(ge / zhes ni dbyangs dang bcas pa yis/ /rdo rje rigs las kyi ragrub pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /mgon po gshin rje tshe dbang bskur/ /de nas rin po che'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o rin 103—177

chen 'chang ba kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang byed pa/ /gtso mchog khyab par byin brlabs te/ /mi 'gyur rigs kyi tshe thob nas/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas nas tshe drongs shig /oṃ rat+na ku la ā ①yu he he ho ho rta / rin chen dgyes pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /khyad ⑧par byin brlabs ③thob gyur cig /de nas pad+ma rigs kyi che'i dbang 'di yang gsungs so/ /e ma'o khro gtum rngam pa'i tshogs/ /pad+ma'i ④rigs kyi dbang phyug ste/ /snang ba med las lhun gyis grub/ /rdo rje 'chang gis dbang bskur ⑤bas/ /klu 'dul tshe yi dbang thob shog /pad+ma ku la ā 0yu he he ho ho haṃ/ 4 lhun gyis grub pa tshe yi dbang ske/ /thogs med dam pa thob par shog /de nas las kyi rigs kyi che'i dbang bskur ba 'di brjod do/ /e ma'o rang bzhin mtshan ma med pa yi/ /ye shes lnga ldan phrin las gtso/ /gnyis su med pa las kyi rigs/ /las rnams thams cad dbang bskur rtsibs/ /gnod sbyin gdon las nitshe drongs te⑨/ /gnod sbyin bgegs 'dul dbang thob shog /oṃ kurma ku la ā kyiyu he he ho ho haṃ/zhes brjod pas thams cad tshe'i dbang nyid du gyur te/ ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /tshad med bzhi yi thugs rjes kyang / /nyon mongs dgra rnams zhi gyur cig /ces phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi ⑪tshe'i dbang bskur ro/ /'phags pa las bzhi'i tso'akhor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las/'jam dpal tshe sgrub 8pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i bdag nyid de/ mtha' 8byed 'byung ba de nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs las byung ngo / /gshin rje las kyi phrin 103—178

las 'di/ /myos dang mgo 'khor byed pa dang / /yid 'khrug khrag tu skyug par byed / /log 'dren rnam pa drug tu bstan①/ /log 'dren mthar ②byed dkyil 'khor ni/ /bcu ①gnyis 'khor lo rtsibs can de/ /yi dgas kyi duni gos la bri / /sum brtsegs dhildan pa'i mu ran la/ /dbyangs kyi duyi shes kun tu bskor//hrirtsi'i ⑦sngags kyis gnon ⑧byas la/ /tha la thod pa gtang bar bya/ /de nas sngags kyis dgang bar bya/ /ya ma na te ⑨ra tsa'i tshogs/ /sa ste 'byung byed ngo ⑩yi rten/ /me ste thams cad sreg pa'o/ /bdag nyid gshin rje mthar byed skur bskyed la/ /yum yang de ru bsgom byas la/ /phyogs bcu yigadug pa thams cad kun / /ma lus tsham rngam 'drag par bya/ /bzlas pa'i snying po ma nor bar/ /sgra dang 'du byed rab spangs te/ /bde zhing yid 'ong gnas dag tshulas/ /rab tu snang mig snang sems bcas/ /sgra dang bcas pa'i sems spangs te④/ /nyi ma shar nas nub kyi bar/ /rgyun dang dus su bstun 8pa'o/ /bar bar bskul ba'i las bya zhing / /bcol ba'i las dag rab tu brjod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad yum btsun mo dang gnyis su med par byas te/ bzlas pa'i sngags 'di sku dang gsung dang thugs las byung 8ngo / / oṃ trī sbyi 0bi kri tā nan/ hūm̐ rtsu 8pa na a nu da bha ba/ sarba dharma tsa tsār+ya a ti ba rtayi/ oṃ lo yo i/ badz+ra bo dhi ta thā ga ta kro dhi ( )shwa ri/ a byi ta badz+ra kro dhi ⑥shwa ri/ he he haṃ rta(ste/ sngags 'di rab tu brjod byas pas/ /kha dog che zhing lus po ( )che ba dang / /rgya dag yongs su ma chad thams cad nam ( stemakha' ste/ /gsal ba'i shes rab thams cad nam mkha' 'dra/ /mthar phyin sngags kyi lung la mkhas par bya/ /de yi sbyor ba thams cad dgyes skongs shing luge/ /dbang sdud 103—179

sngags ste 6)drag po'i las dang sbyar/ /mi dmigs gtso bo'i sngags dang phyag rgyar gnasal/ /sgrol dang mthar phyin phrin las gnas su bstan/ /ting 'dzin rim pa 'di dag ldan par bya/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /sgyu ma la dbang sgyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / go 'phang chen po la sbyar ba'i thabs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang ldan (7pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thugs rjes zhe sdang sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyis su'adod chags sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes kyis gti mug sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yon tan gyis nga rgyal 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'bad pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis phrag dog 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de dag 'joms pa'i sngags ni 'di dag go/ /pradz+nyā ku la/ dz+nyā na ku la/ dha ka 9ciku la/ gu na ku la/ bīr+ya (57ku la/ bhū (7ta ku la/ badz+ra ku la / pad+ma ku la/ kurma ku la/ rat+na ku la/ sarba ta thā ga ta ho(3)/ zhes brjod nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /dper na me dang 'od bzhin du/ /'od la sbrang ma 'du na yang / /me lce'i drod (8)ni 'od la yod/ /'od kyis sbrang 'tshig ci 9bzhin du/ /skyon gyis (7dri ma thams cad dang / /bdud dang mu stegs log 'dren dang / /mi mthun 17pa yi dgra dang bgegs/ /shes rab thabs kyis gzir gnon pa'i/ /me lce dang ni sbrang ma 'dra'o/ /tha dad pa yi mi mthun pa'ang / /'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje nyid/ /'khrigs 12pa med cing sgrol bar byed/ /mi skye ye shes ral gri yin/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dral byas nas/ /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa yi/ /rgyu kyi dang rgyu ma yin pa yi/ /nyon mongs sems can mtho ris gnas/ /bsgral ba'i zhing du smos pa de/ /de 103—180

la de bzhin drag tu bya/ /rigs dang lo grangs mthun yo)pa la/ /de bzhin byas na skyon pa ste/ /de dag yongs su shes par bya/ /las dang bya ba rtsol ba rnams/ /nyams kyi phyag rgya ②rang don sad/ /de rtags dka' ①ba mi 'gyur te/ /mi la ya yi 'og gos la/ /gi chawang dag gis bris (5)byas te(6)/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags dang / /gang bya spel la bris (7)byas la/ /rak+ta dag gi kha chus bran / /thub pa drug gi snying po bri/ /gsang ba'i sngags 'di drag tu brjod/ /oṃ hri: gro dha bi bī ta/ /hri: gro dhi ma (gur ta/ pra sang he te ba mu ka /he hang he hang / / kā la rū yonyepa rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa a/ de skad gsung gi sgra bsgrags pas//dgra dang bgegs dang mu stegs dang / /bdud dang srin po ma lus rnams/ /gzir cing gnon ⑩pa drag tu bya/ /mi mthun 47phyogs kyi 'byung po de/ /gdul bar bya ba'i don ched du/ /khro bo'i sku ru bsgom tunyebyas te/ /thams cad bsgral bar bya ba yi/ /rang bzhin grub pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pra mārta (snyen/ na mo badz+ra badz+ra ki ④mo na ta/ /a hang pra khum khum mo musti tsos hā/ de skad ces ni gsungs pa yis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dbang du 'gyur/ /bdud rnams dag ni khro zhing gtum/ /srin po dag ni 'jigs shing rngamatso/ /mu stegs log 'dren rgol bar byed/ /de dag gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /phrin las dam pa 'di brtsams so/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /dbus kyi pho brang lte ba la/ /bdud rnams 'dul ba'i snying po bri/ /shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs su/ —7/ /dri za dbang bsdu'i /shesnying po bri/ /lho yi phyogs kyi 'khor lo la/ /mu stegs sgrol ba'i snying po bri/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi 'khor lo la/ /klu rnams tshar gcod snying po bri / /byang gi phyogs kyi 'khor lo la/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams dbang sdud bri/ /103—181

rtu bi gha ①nan/ rtsu rak+ta ②nan/ oṃ tir ti ka nan/ oṃ mar na nan/mtshams ②kyi dkyil 'khor lte dbus surjo/ /mtshams ⑤kyi bgegs gnon snying po bril/ /rtsu dha rtu pāḥdurtu lāX/ rtu swā/ gru chad ⑧rnam pa bzhi po la/ /thod pa rlon pa bri bar bya/ /mu khyud thod pa'i 7phreng ba gtang / /phyi rol sbrul gyis yongs su dgang / /de ltar dkyil 'khor zin pa dang / /rnam par 'tshe ba'i gzugs rnams kun/ /kham pa rdza yi ga 'u tshul/ /gzugs su yongs su bri bya ste7 / /dbus su yongs su gzhag par bya/ /kha dog dmar pos bcings nas ni / /rtse gcig phyag rgya bcas byas la/ /gsang sngags 'di yang 'bum khri brjodam/ /oṃ pra marta na mo ha sra badz+ra dza ki mo na dhidha a hang pra khu ma mo tha tha swā hā/na mo do gi kha dha mu pra pa tha byi tsotha u ste ni nan sarba ta ta na phaṭa/ phyag rgya de dang bcas pas brdeg /zhag gsum bzlas pa byas na ni/ /bgegs dang log 'dren dbang du 'dus/ /gzhan yang de bzhin bzhugs pa'i khro/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba dang / /smug nag ljang nag kham pa dang / /so so'i cha lugs rngam pa'i gzugs/ /mgon po gshin rje nag po yis/ /bgegs chadang log 'dren gzir cing gnon/ /rngam pa'i zhal du 'di bstabs so/ /oṃ che ge mo kha ram khā hi/ oṃ hri: tsoche ge mo kha ram khā hi/ oṃ kā la rū ⑩pa che ge mo kha ram khā hita tsho/ rtu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa a/ /nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du bzlas/ /de nas phyag rgya gsum bcas te'u/ /yang nas yang du gzir 6)cing gnon gye/ /phyag rgya de dang gsang sngags 'dis/ /lan grangs stong rtsa gcig tu brdeg / oṃ hri: 37badz+ra ya ya na parna su put+ta 6nyertu rtu phaṭa phaṭa a/ las dang rdzas dang sngags dang ni/ /phyag rgya brtson 'grus ma yengs par/ /'bum mam grangs ni 103—182

ci mang du/ /yang nas yang du nan tan bya/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal 'jigs byed kyi rgyal pos rab tu gsungs so/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las log 'dren mthar byed kyis mnan ①pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i bdag nyid des mthar byed 'byung ba 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan phrin las las phyung ngo / /gnod sbyin mthar byed phrin las 'di/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bris la/ /bzlas pa'i snying po bri bar bya/ /ya ste skyed pa me ste sreg /tos la snying rje ru la chags//rdzo ni 'byung byed yab kyi gsang / /yo (mil kun 'byung ta la bsdu/ /bdag nyid las kyi mthar byed sku/ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa las②/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /'dzum dang bcas pas yul la 'bul/ /byang chub bla med sangs rgyas la/ /mchod cing ci ④ltar mdzad pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du/ /ting 'dzin 'du ba nam mkha' 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pas phyogs bcu'i gdug pa ⑤can thams cad spa gong ste bred nas myos par 0gyur gte/dper na mi ra ro ba bzhin no/ /de nas nan tan gyi phrin las 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan phrin las las phyung ngo / /gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ sgra can/ /las rnams mthar dubyed phrin las sku/ /gnod sbyin sdang sems ldan pa kun/ /bar chad bya bar sems pa ste//de dag zil gyis gnon 6)pa'i phyir/ /sku mdog nag po chen po ste/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /thod pa tshar gsum dbu rgyan 7can/ /phyag g.yas 103—183

zhing chen g.yon bhan hu)snya/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs zhabs kyang brkyang bskum ②ste / /mi mthun bgegs dang sdang ba'i dgra(mi/ /ma lus dbang sdud phrin las mchog gi sku/ /mi sdug tshul 'chang dregs pa'i khyo shug goldan/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi rgyan du byas/ /zhe sdang dbang sdud stag gi sham thabs can/ /nyon mongs dbang sdud glang chen ko rlon can/ /'dren pa'i khro rgyal gdug 'dul dam pa 'di / /dus ngan tha ma'i sems can 'dul dka' ba/ /nyon mongs dbang sdud dpal gyi zhal du stobs(nya/ /'gro ba ma lus thugs rjes dbyings la dgod/ /zhe sdang shugs 'chang khro bo'i gtso/ /gdug par gyur pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad pa/ /nga rgyal la sogs rtag tu dug gsum sku/ /ye shes ngang las thams cad rdzogs par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra hri: 6)bi kri tā na na/ ta thā ga ta ya tsom ra tsa hūm̐ phaṭa sa(8sna/ zhes pa'i sngags dang bcas la bdag nyid las mthar 6)byed kyi skur bsgoms la phrin las bcol zhing gnon 7pa drag tu bzlas pa'i snying po bzlas so/lha/ /de'i dus su sbyin sreg byed na phrin las brtsam yonapar bya ste/ me thab 1ge.e yi dbyibs tsha'adra la/ /bang rim sum brtsegs kha khyer can/ /ngos la me yi 7phreng ba gtang / /kha khyer rdo rje ra ba la/ /mu ran thod pa'i phreng ba ste/ /me ste bsreg bya 7'chang zhes pa/ /kha dog nag po shin tu rid1)/ /phyag na zhugs gling bgrang phreng dang / /be con ril ba thogs pa ste/ /tshul bzhin spyan drangs gdan bzhugs bstod/ /dbang dang phyag tshang gshegs pa rnams/ /gang ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du bya/ /gnyis 'og rang bzhin ya ma'i sku/ /gnyis med spyan drangs bzhugs la bcol/ /sbyin sreg phrin las zin pa dang / /bcol bskul dag kyang rab tu bya/ /rdzas ni dug dang lan tshwa 1snyedang / /ske tshe sbrang rtsi 103—184

yungs nag dang / /gu gul nag po la sogs pa'i/ /lcags 'dra'i rdzas la rab tu bsngags/ /bdag nyid lha yi skur bsgoms la/ /dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs 6)pa yi/ /sngags 'di rab tu rtse gcig bzlas②/ /oṃ hūm̐ ya khang me tra ha mu kha hri: (miya ma ra tsa phaṭa rtsugo/ phyag rgya zil gnon phyag rgya bca'/ /dkyil 'khor bskor zhing gsang sngags bzlas/ /bdag nyid nub kyi phyogs 'dug ste/ /las kyi mthar (5)byed skur bsgoms la/ /gsang sngags mi bul mi drag par/ /bzlas na (6)myur du 'grub pa ni/ /yid 'khrugs myos nas dbang med 'gyel ba dang / /rab tu brgyal nas thal bar 'jig pa dang (7)/ /de rnams mi 'grub pa ru ngas ma bshad/ /ces bcom ldan 'das don yod pa'i khro bos gsungs so/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gnod sbyin mthar byed kyis gnon (8༄pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed chen 59)pos mthar yibyed 'byung ba 'di sku dang gsung dang thugs las phyung ngo / /srin po mthar byed phrin las 'di / /dkyil 'khor bsgom pa tsho1bya bar bstan/ /ya ste rgyu yi la ta ste rkyen/ snye/ /yo ni kun du bskul ba la/ /ni ni sdud pa'i don yin te/ /ri zhes bya ba lhun stug pa/ /ya la 'dus te k+ṣe la thim/ /bdag nyid chings zhes bya ba'i sku/ /dbu gsum po ngal phyag drug ste/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser nagatso/phyag drug phyag mtshan bsnams pa ni/ /g.yas pa ba su ta yi zhagasazhu/ /g.yas par gsal shing tha ma lcags kyu'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po chu srin bar ma ka ta ri/ /tha ma rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa'o/ /sku stod glang chen ko rlon la/ /sku smad 4 stag 103—185

gi sham thabs te①/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhis ②sku la brgyan②/ /gzhan yang dur khrod rgyan mchog rnams/ /ma lus sku la rdzogs pa la/ /bskul ba'i dbyangs 'di blang bar bya/ /mi shigs rdo rje gar gyi bdag /rdo rje gsang ba'i gshin rje ste/ /phrin las rgyal dupo grub pa'i las/ /oṃ dang i dang hūm̐ zhes pa/ /oṃ ni dpral ba'i steng du dmigs/ /i ni lce yi ①steng du la/ /hūm̐ ni thugs ka rjonyid du'o/ /de las 'od zer rab spros ⑦te/ /bdag lus nam mkha' lta bur gyur / /phaṭa ces bya ba rab brjod pas/ /'jig rten khams rnams 'od kyis khebs(gyi / /de nyid sreg pa ma yin te/ /yid kyi ye shes me 'bar ba/ /gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /kun gyi stong pa de yin no/ /ji ltar mkha' la mtshon lhonyesnang ba/ /nam mkha' nyid las byung ba ltar/ /sngags kyi 'phro 'du btang ba yang / /sems las byung ba nam mkha' tshul/ /rnam shes stong pa'i ngang la 'du/ /bdag nyid chos kyi skur bsgoms la/ /zhe sdang 'phro 'du mang byas la/ /bskyed pa'i sngags ni 7drag tu bzlas/ /oṃ ma hā rdasata ka 7pe ra a ra ne 7tsa na ka ta khe che ge mo la dus zhes pa dang / sngags gong nas 'byung ba dang —/ spel te las byas na gdon mi za'o ④zhes gshin rje khro bo'i rgyal pos gsungs so/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las klu mthar byed kyis gnon 8pa'i thabs kyi ⑩le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas yang khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed kyis mthar 7byed 'byung ba 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las las phyung ngo / /ya ma mthar byed phrin las ni/ /dkyil 'khor snga ma 'dra bar dmigs/ /bzlas pa'i snying po 103—186

'di yang bril/ /ya ste 'byung byed lak+ṣi yis sreg /ya ni yang dag tsa ni skemasal / /ni zhes pa ni khug cig dupa'o/ /ra zhes bya ba bsgral ba la/ /ma las skyes ⑤byed slar sdud pa'o/ /bdag nyid ya ma mthar byed sku/ /sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig ①phyag gnyis pa/ /sku la thod pa phyed tshal brgyan/ /dbu yi skra ni kham nag la/ /ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba ste/ /phyag g.yas chu srin dbyug to ⑦'phyar/ /g.yon pa phyag na zhing chen za ba'o/ /sku stod glang chen ko rlon la/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs can/ /dur khrod me dbus bzhugs pa la//yum yang de dang 'dra bar bsgom/ /bzlas pa'i niting 'dzin me 'dra la/ /bzlas brjod rlung 'dra g.yo zhing bskyod⑨/ /lce la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /steng du bzlas pa'i snying po dgod/ /tha ma dbyangs dang bcas pa la/ /hri: ⑩sngags kyi phreng ba gdabatso/ /phar 'phros rnam shes 'gugs par bsam/ /tshur ⑫bsdus gshin rje nyid la thim/ /'phro 'du bzlas pa de dag kun/ /gong du bshad pa dag la yang / /de dag rab tu sbyar zhes bshad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i khro bos bskul ba 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ya ma las kun 'jigs par byed pa ni/ /thams cad dbang sdud ya ma mthar 8byed sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang / /zhabs gnyis dor thabs klu rgyal gnon/ /sku la sbrul nag stong gis brgyan pa ni/ /bgegs rnams 'dul zhing rtag tu 'chi bar mdzad/ /sku la thod pa'i phyed ④tshal brgyan pa ni/ /'gro ba thugs rje phyogs gcig dgongs pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba ni/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /phyag g.yas chu srin dbyug 8to bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'jigs pa che las sgrol ba'i rtags/ /g.yon pa 103—187

zhing dbyug phyag na bsnams pa ni/ /thugs rjes sems can mya ngan lam la 'jog /ko rlon g.yang gzhis sku la brgyan pa ni/ /dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i rtags/ /stag gi g.yang gzhis sku la brgyan pa ni/ /dug gsum gnas su bsgral nas chos kyi sku/ /skye med ngang las 6)g.yo bskyod mi mnga' yang //zhe sdang phrin (gyilas bya ba'i dus la bab/ /oṃ hri: (0ya ma 4)ra tsa sarba mā ra ⑤ya nan dza sa ma ya/ zhes brjod cing zhe sdang dang ldan par ting nge 'dzin gyis bzlas pa dang sbyar te las byas na gdon mi za'o/ /de dag ni 'di zhina'os pa tsam gyis ma yin te yang dang yang du 'dris (7par byas la (9nan tan gyis po)ma byas na 'phral du phra mo tsam gyis 'grub pa ma yin no/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i lho )rgyud las ya ma mthar byed kyis gnon yinyapa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang las phran tshegs bsgrub 1 pa 'di nyid kyi 1 sku dang gsung dang ( )thugs yon tan phrin las las phyung 7ngo / /zla ba 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma'am 'khor lo gang yang rung / /yang na rin chen dra ba la/ /dra mig rnams ni 'dug par gnas/ /rin chen phur bu nang du bltas/ /de ru bri 'am gzugs par bya/ /tha ma sbrul gyi zhags pas bskor/ /dkyil 'khor de yi dbus su ni/ /khru gang thur tshadu brkos 4 tshobyas la/ /ga 'u 1nyakha sbyar nang du ni/ / yungs kur 1 blugs la bzlas pa bya/ /rtags la ma yengs 'phro 'du yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra kā la da du kha la/ pra ma rtan hūm̐ phaṭa / sle kha sle kha phaṭa phaṭa ces bzlas la/ bdag nyid ya mān ( 7ta kur 1003—188

bsgoms la/ sngags ni ①nus tshad du bzlas na 'grub nges so/ /yungs kur ②rgyal po bsgrub ①pa'o/ /de nas 'khor khro bo la sogs pas/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma'o dbyings las byung ba dang /mkha' la rgyu dang sa la dbang ba (shegasum gyis bskul ba'i dbyangs 'di bdag cag len lags so/ /ye shes mkha' ldan ma mo'i dpal/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba'i phrin las can/ /dpal gyi phyag brnyan rak+ta'i dri snom (5)ma/ /ma mo khyod ni kun gyi gtso mo dpag tshad brgyad khrir rgyug /bud med lus la 'jigs byed tshul 'chang ba/ /kha nas me 'bar rgya mtsho'i gting 6)nas skemasal/ /mig nas zhag 'dzag ri rab thal bar rlog(8) /skad cig tsam la stong khams dbang du sdud/ /'jig rten lha chen brgyad kyang 'dar yid yid/ /che ge mo zhig dbang du sdud par byed/ /bud med gzugs can dus la bab/ /che ge mo oṃ trag ragyu /hri: kyi)ya ma ma ma yinan zhes bskul ba ni dbyings kyi ma mo'o/ /nam mkha'i gting dpag yangs (nyul gnas bcas shing / /bar snang khams la rgyu ba'i tshogs / /khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud/ /lcags kyi bya khra lta bu ni/ /ma mo rnams kyi mchog kyang yin/ /kha 'bar stong gi gtso mo ste/ /'jigs byed ⑫rnams kyi dbang byed ma/ /srid gsum dbang du sdud pa mo/ /gzigs pa'i go 'phang nam mkha' 'dra/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa glog pas mgyogs/ /g.yas kyi gshog pa brdabs pa yis/ /bdud dang srin po rdul du rlog3na /g.yon gyi gshog pa brdabs pa yis/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po dbang du sdud/ /dam tshig can gyi dus la bab/ /oṃ ma ra trag ragasari/ tri yo ya ma ra tsa ka ka 8ru ba hri: dza (7zhes bskul ba ni mkha' lding gi tshogs so/ /ya ma na ste grub pa mo/ /la la 103—189

lag na rgyu zhags 'chang / /la la lag na thod phreng 'dzin/ /la la zhing chung ba su 'dren/ /la la me khyer rgya mtsho skems①/ /la la 'gugs byed nyams pa 'dzin / /la la sbrul nag zhags pa 'dzin/ /la la pho nya 'gugs shing 'dren/ /sngags pas bos shing gdungs pa'i tshe/ /dam tshig dus la bab po sa ma ya /snang bar sems pa'i snying nas drongs/ /brtse ba'i tshogs kyi ②dus la bab/ /oṃ ka ha trag rab②/ rat+na ka la hri: ④su hā/ zhes spyan drangs ⑤zhing bskul ba ni gter bdag gi tshogs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed kyis 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po las bzhi 'khor lo 'di/ dus phyi ma la rnal 'byor pa gang zhig bsgrub ⑥pa'i las byed na/ nga yang thugs dam las mi g.yel la/ 'khor khro bo dang / khro mo la sogs pas kyang / nga'i thugs dam rjes su bsgrub (7par mdzad pas/ dus tha ma la dam pa'i chos 'di rnal 'byor pa'i sku la bsngo ba la sogs pa la dam tshig 'byung bar zhal gyis bzhes so / /de nas 'khor rnams bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rjes/ dus tha ma la 'byung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa la dga' nas/ yi ⑧rangs te mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud las/ mjug yonyebaskul ba dang gnang ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //'phags pa las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba chen po rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs sgo7// //de nas 'khor khro bo dang khro mo la sogs pa rnams kyis/ ngag mthun (1pas bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma'o bcom ldan khro rgyal gtso/ /las bzhi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'di la/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung 103—190

bstan pa la/ /bdag cag the tshom ①'tshal ba rnams/ /bder (migashegs gsung gi ngo bo yis/ /zhu ba'i dmigs rnams bshad du gsol/ /'phags pa zhes bgyi ji ltar lags/ /las bzhi zhes bgyi ji ltar lags/ /'khor lo zhes bgyi ji ltar lags/ /gsang ba zhes bgyi ji ltar lags/ /rgyud ces bgyi ba ji ltar lags / /rnam dag dbyings las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhu ba'i dmigs rnams bshad par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khro bo gzhan la gdug ①par mdzad pa yis/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis gsung 0phyung ste/ 'di skad 'khor la bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi 'khor rnams zhu ba yi/ /dmigs rnams zhu ba rab tu legs/ /'phags pa zhes su bstan pa ni/ /gdug pa ma lus kun las 'phags / /ye shes sems dpa' 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dpe yis de la bskrun ⑤du med / /las bzhi zhes su grags pa yang / /de la las ni rnam pa gnyis/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dul dbang dang / /sku gsum phrin las 'dul ba ste/ /thabs dang thabs su 'brel pa la/ /shes rab 'brel pas yum zhes bya/ /chos dang longs spyod pa yi sku/ /'dul dbang las zhes bya bar grags/ /de la bzhi zhes bya ba yang / /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang mngon no/ /zhi ba bya ba'i ⑥nges tshig kyang glu/ /ting 'dzin rim pa byams pa la/ /'phro 'du dkar la 'tsher ⑦ba ste/ /thams cad mgu bar byed pa dang / /mi mthun (8)pa rnams zhi bya'i phyir/ /de phyir zhi ba zhes bya'o/ /rgyas pa gser ltar ser ba la/ /ting 'dzin sprul pa mang por khyab/ /phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i don byas te/ /bskul ba'i sa la gzhes pa yi / /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ /bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /kun du zhugs te rgyas pa la/ /tshe dang dbang thang dpal la sogs/ /thams 103—191

cad rgyas pas rgyas zhes bya/ /de la dbang gi nges tshig kyang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas/ /bdag gi yid la bsams 6)pa kun/ /yab yum sprul pa'i khyad par las/ /ci 'dod thams cad dbang du sdud/ /las dang bya ba ma lus dang / /bdag nyid lha layi skur ①bsgoms pas/ /'du bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /de la drag po'i phrin las kyang / /gshin rje gshed dang gshed bdag mo/ /yab yum khyad par sprin lta bu/ /nam mkha' khebs pa byed pa ltar(ge/ /gnyis med byang chub khyad 6)par las/ /'phro 'du 'od zer sprin lta bu / /nam mkha' gang bar khyab pa la/ /khro bo'i sprul pas khebs gyur te/ /'jig rten rdul du bshig nas ni/ /gdug pa ma lus kun btul te(6)/ /slar bsdus yab yum sku la bsduru sku/ /de ltar nas dang yungs 'bru tsam/ /ma lus kun du 'gengs byed cing / /dmigs pa gang na gnas pa dag /btsal te slar yang 'gugs la sogs/ /'di dang 'di zhes bya med par/ /'khor ba tshang nas sprugs bsams te/ /drag po'i phrin las grub par bsam/ /'khor lo zhes su bstan pa yang / /mi 'khor 'khor phyir rtse mo 'phro/ /lte ba 'khor la (8)rtse mos gcod/ /de phyir 'khor lo zhes su grags/ /gsang ba zhes su grags pa yang / /kun la mi bstan (97rtsa ba ste/ /thun mong kun gyi ma yin pas/ /de phyir gsang ba zhes bya'o/ /de la rgyud ces bya ba yang / /tshang zhing 'brel pas btags pa dang / /breng chags dgos pa sgrub pa yi/ /de phyir rgyud ces bya bar bshad/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /nyi ma bzhi la las bzhi zhig /gsungs shing nges par bstan 7pa ste/ /dngos po ci la bsgom par bgyi/ /zhi ba la ni ji ltar bgyi/ /sngags rnams ji ltar bzlas 10 2—192

par 0)bgyi/ /phrin las nges par bstan pa ste/ /rgyas pa dag la ji ltar bstan / /sngags rnams brjod pa ji lta bu/ /dbang la ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ /sngags rnams ②brjod pa ji (7lta bu/ /drag po'i las su bstan pa la/ /lha ni ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ /bzlas pa'i sngags rnams ji ltar lags/ /phrin las rnam bzhir bstan pa des/ /las ni ji lta bu zhig 'grub/ /gzhi 'am gnas ni ji lta bu/ /de dag ji lta bu yis (7bri/ /nges par bstan pa'i man ngag la/ /bdag cag rnams la bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan khro 'dul des/ /gsung ni 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /gang bsgom lha rnams sku mdog dkar/ /yum yang de dang 'dra ba la/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor rnams rigs dang sbyar/ /bdag nyid ya mān (5)ta ka ru/ /sku mdog gsal bar bsgoms nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i sngags 'di mgu bas bzlas/ /ya ma ra tsa (phyiras to me ya/ che ge mo ba lu ka shārnyi ( dku ru swā hā/ ya me to ru na yo ta ya/ che ge mo k+ṣa ra tsa shān+ti 6)ku ru swā hā/ya ta yo ni ra (9)yak+ṣe ya/ che ge mo pa la musti shārnyi 7ku ru swā hā/ yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ che ge mo mā sna ra ya shārnyingaku ru swā hā/ mi drag mi bul mi zhan /nyepar/ /ting 'dzin sbyor ba ldan byas te / /nyi ma re la rim bzhin sbyar/ /grub 8par 'gyur bar gegadon mi za'o/ /phrin las nges par grub pa ste/ /bsgom par bya ba sku mdog ser/ /yum yang de dang 'dra ba la/ /phyi ma rim 4 bzhin sbyar bar bya / /gser lta bu yi ting 'dzin la/ /'phro 'du byang chub sems lta bu/ /phyogs bcu ma lus don byas te/ /bdag gi phung po ma lus dang / /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel bar bsam/ /de tshe sngags 'di bzlas par 1 bya/ /ya ma ra tsa 19sa to me ya/ che ge mo pra ma ya/ puṣ+ṭi 2 ku ru swā hā/ ya me to ru na yo ta ya/103—193

pa'i bdag nyid/ dpal bde byed pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug chags pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa med pa'i chos nyid kyis thams cad la dbang bskur 0)ba de nyid lha thams cad 'du ba'i gnas gzhal yas khang par 90du gyur pa/ 'og min rdo rje lhun po'i gnas ye shes kyi snang ba rin po che sna tshogs ni 'od 'bar ba'i khang bzangasal/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gzugs sdug pa sna tshogs dang /dri zhim pa sna tshogs dang / ro bro ba sna tshogs dang / reg bya 'jam pa sna tshogs dang /④ chos kyi bde ba bskyed pa sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phro zhing 'khrigs ⑤pa rtse mo mtho zhing khyams kyi rnam par phye bar sgo bzhi tsherasgo khang dang bcas par bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i rol pa chen po kun du snang ba dang / 'od kyi dpal dang / dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang / cho 'phrul bkod pa dang / rnam par gzigs dang / mi bskyod (7)rdo rje dang / mngon par snang ba dang / brtan pa'i dbang phyug dang / 'brug sgra dang / dri ma med pa dang / rin chen phung po dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / rin chen dra ba dang / dkon mchog mtshan dang / rin chen tog (gedang / 'od zer snang ba dang / tshe mtha' yas dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang / chags pa med pa'i 'od dang / dga' ba'i spyan dang / don thams cad yod pa dang /brtson 'grus shugs can lhoradang / las chen 'phrul las dang / gnod sbyin 'dul ba dang / sna tshogs dbang phyug go/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bde ba'i blo gros dang / rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs dang /gzi brjid bkod pa dang / 'khor lo rnon po dang / shes snang ba dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / 'od zer 'phro ba dang / drag shul can dang / dri ma 10(3—209
