zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs ①te/ thugs ma'i ②dpal be'u la sogs pa'i gnas rnams nas/ 'od zer gyi ③dkyil 'khor gsal bar byed pa bkye dubs/ des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byas pa dang / ya mtshan gyi ltas chen po bco (nyebargyad 'byung ⑥bar gyur to/ /de nas snod rgyadang bcud du bcas pa'i ⑧gsal zhing 'bar bar gyur nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs dam bskul te/de dag gis kyang cho 'phrul rnam par 'khod pa ⑨zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen pos rang gis 'khor lo'i khyams dag tu spro bar byed mdzad do/ /de yang zhing khams rnam par sbyong zhing slar 'khor gyi ⑩'khor dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phro ba'i gnas su 'dus so/ /de ltar 'chad pa'i rgya chen po'i rnam par rol 'phrul pas rol zhing zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas par gyur nas bzhugs pa las 'khor thams cad kyis the tshom skyes par gyur to/ /de'i dus na mthun ⑩par gleng ba ni/ kye ma ho ya mtshan sna tshogs chos/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ya mtshan che7/ /cho 'phrul dpag med gyur pa yi/ /dgos 8pa'i don nyid ji lta bu/ /rgyu rkyen med par sangs rgyas ni/ /gsang gsum dam tshig spro mi mdzad/ /de yi mtshan nyid yang snang ba//gsang ba'i dbang po bskul tsobar mdzod/ /khyod 'di rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /dgongs don rgya mtsho don mnga' ba/ /bka' yi bdag po dgongs mdzod dag /legs par zhu zhing gsol gdab mdzod/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes lnga brgya dang bcas pas gzhan dag gi the tshom rnam par gcod pa dang rang nyid kyi sgo gsal bar bya ba'i phyir mdun rol nas langs te/ phyogs bcu nas 'khod nas mchod pa'i tshogs rgya chen po bkod cing rgyal ba kun la mchod de/103—211

lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bskor ba byas shing rtse gcig tu gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/dga' ba'i bzhin gyis gsol ba btab pa/ e ma rgyal ba nyid kyi sku/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor dag /ting 'dzin ye shes gnas las byung / /dga' mdzad dkyil 'khor 'dus pa dang / /byang chub sems sprin char chen gyis / /nyon mongs la sogs sbyong mdzad cing / /thugs rje chen po ye shes kyis//tshogs pa'i 'bras bu legs smin mdzad/ /sku mdangs dga' ba'i bzhin bcas pas / /gsang 17ba'i theg pa bstan du gsol/ /khyod kyi dgongs don gting ②dpag dka'/ /zab cing phra la rgya che bas/ /'khor rnams the tshom ri bos gnon / /thugs rje che mnga' gsal (gebar mdzod/ /'di dag thams cad bstan pa'i snod/ /mgon po btang snyoms lhun mnga' mdzad(45)/ /dus 'dir rtsom pa don che ste/ /smon lam 'bras bu mthar phyin mdzod/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i brtan g.yo'i dkyil 'khor thams cad thugs mnyam pa nyid rtse gcig gi sgo nas gzigs so/ /rnam par gzigs kun du gzigs/ de ltar dgongs nas dkyil 'khor 'di dag thams cad smra bsam las 'das par sna tshogs rnam par smros shig /de nyid dngos po dang bar gzigs nas/ gzigs pa'i mtha' dang / dgongs pa'i mtha' dang / mdzad pa'i mtha' kun la snyoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs 67te/ bkod pa dang / rnam par bkod pa dang / rnam par bshad pa dang / dgongs pa dang / rnam par dgongs pa dang / rol 7pa dang / rol pa chen po dang / mdzad pa dang /sna tshogs mdzad pas kun du spro bar 8mi byed de/ 'jig rten drug gi rnam pas (9na1003—212

bsdus pa'i stong gsum gyi dngos po 'di dag /sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor 'di las gzhan du snang bar mi dgongs so/ /de'i dus dang sa dang sa'i khyad par dang ske/ dkyil 'khor bkod pa dag kyang rnam par mi gzigs/ kun du mi gzigs shing dgongs pa yang mi 'gog go/ /de dag ni mthar yang mi gnas shing nam mkha' lta bur bzhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de la zhugs hu)ma thag tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag kyang chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bur rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje ngo mtshar gyi sgo nas bskul zhing gzhan dag gi (gyidon thugs g.yo bar mdzad pa'i glus g.yo slong bar mdzad de/ tshul ban gdon gyi rgyal po che / /'dren pa kun gyi rgyud nyid pas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyud nyid pas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i ya mtshan ston/ /kye ma'o mgon po don kun gnasabu/ /zhi ba'i las dam 'jug byed pa/ /byang sems thugs rje'i rlan bral lam/ /rdos can chos dang 'grang 'gyur cing 55) /zhes gsol ba btab pa las kyang ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas yang yum gzi ldan pad+mo zhes bya bas rnam par mi rtog 56)pa'i ting nge 'dzin las 57slong ba'i glus skul bar mdzad de/ mi dmigs ting 'dzin bsam 'das brjod dang bral/ /bde ba chen po ye shes byang chub sems/ /mi dmigs thugs rje mi 'da' dam tshig gis/ /rol pa'i cho 'phrul rgya chen bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces yang 50bskul ba'i rjes/ /mgon po'i gnas rnams la dgongs nas/ /'od zer rnams bkod 'dzum mdzad de/ /'khor ba legs sbyin skabs dbye mdzad / /legs so legs so rdo rje can/ /pad+mo 'dzin pa'i grogs bcas pas/ /103—213

yang yang bskul bar mdzad pas na/ /gnang ①zhing bstan par mdzad pa la/ /dga' ba'i spyan rjes dang bar gyis/ /gang 'dod rtogs pa zhi bar mdzod/ /ma 'ongs rtogs pa mtha' dag rnams/ /thugs rje shugs kyis bzung mdzad de/ /don kun khyab pa'i snang ba yis/ /gzung bar bya ba'i skabs dbye mdzad/ /zhes zhugasungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba'i rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las rnam par sprul pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas dga' zhing 'khor 'dus pas/ /dga' ba'i bzhin bzangs ③rgyas mdzad de/ /gtso bos ji ④ltar bka' stsal bzhin/ /thugs rjes 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gzungs/ /de nas gzigs (geldan pad+mo can/ /'dzum mdangs rjorgyas pas bskul mdzad de/ /'o byed 'khyud pa la sogs pa/ /dga' bzhin ⑦chags par rnam par 'gyur/ /e ma rig pa'i rgyal po khyod/ /thugs rje chen po nyi (kyi'od bzhin/ /thugs rje 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gzungs/ /phyogs ris ⑨med pas go 'byed pas/ /yul du gyur pa kun rgyud dgongs/ /mi dmigs cho 'phrul nam mkha' las/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho sprin phung bzhin/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i char chen pos/ /sna tshogs las brgyad dag par mdzod/ /de nas gtso bo rdo rje 'chang / /ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs mdzad de/ /rang gi mtshan mos ⑩rab mdzes pas/ /rgyal po zil gnon gzi brjid can/ /phyag gi 'khor lo rab bskor cing / /phyogs rnams kun du gzigs mdzad de/ /mi dmigs tīnam mkha'i dbyings dag na/ /rdo rje sprul tunyasku mngon phyung nas/ /gzi ldan pad+mo 103—214

chen mo dang / /rol pa'i tshul du bzhugs mdzad de/ /'dzum mig chags pa'i bzhin dag gis/ /'khor rnams slong ba'i sngags brjod ①do/ /oṃ āḥlartsu ma hā bhasmi sha sku niru bi na hro rjod ya i bha ba hi a la la ho/ /gnyis su med pa'i byang sems kyis/ /dkyil 'khor sbyor zhing bsdu bar mdzod/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs sku/ /rdo rje gar gyi ⑧rol mdzad cing / /dga' mchog rdo rje byang chub sems/ /'dzum zhing 'khyil ba'i pad+mo'i gnas/ /dkar 'tsher yidag pa'i rang bzhin te/ /dmar po dbang dang gnyis med par/ /gsal khyab kun du spros pa las/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa mtha' yas 'thonartsi/ /zhi 'gog mya ngan 'das pa dang / /byang chub mgon gnas lam zhes dag /gnyis med gnyis su sbyor mdzad cing / /rang gi dkyil 'khor gnas la bkod/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa rnam par rol/ /brjid dang bcas pas gar mdzad cing / /'dzum par (gyimadzad dang rol pa dang / /kun du 'gying dang spyan mdzes bltam6)/ /smin ring bskyod cing bsgyur ba dang / /rdo rje phur pas g.ya' bas slong / /'dor zhing skum ⑩dang 'jog ldeg dang / /rnam par rol pa'i gar gyis kyang / /rigs kyi phrin 7las sna tshogs sprul/ /nam mkha' kun tu khyab par mdzad/ /rnam par rol pa'i bde tso'abyung bar/ /byang chub sems sogs zhi zhing gsal/ /rol pa'i char nyid mngon babs 8pas/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /brtan dang g.yo ba ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams dag byas nas/ /byang chub sems tshogs rol pa la④/ /brdeg dang 'khyud dang sdom pa las/ /sbyor dang bstim dang mnyes pa dang / /kun du rab dgyes ye shes thigatso /sna tshogs snang ba nyi ma'i tso'od/ /yang dag bde la rab gnas mdzod/ /de 'dus 103—215

pa'i che ①tshogs pa'o/ /phyogs bcu kun nas bzhes ②mdzad de/ /thabs dang shes rab byin brlabs ②pa'i/ /byang sems rnam dag rgyun gyis mchod/ /rnga dang sil snyan sgra sgrogs ④shing / /dbang po tshim pa'i rol ⑤rtsod dang / /gar dbyangs glu drug sna tshogs kun/ /stong gsum gang bar gsung (7byas te/ /bcom ldan pad+mo bde yang ⑦bde/ /gzi ldan yum dang bcas par mchod/ /e ma 'dus pa'i tshogs dbus nasani/ /thugs rje che mnga' nyi stidakyil bzhin/ /'khor lo kun sgyur sgrol mdzad pas/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor rgyas par mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i gsol 'debs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor dag la lhun grub rdzogs/ /pad+ma'i dpal ldan sems pa che/ /phrin kyilas ye shes gnas kun sbyong ⑪/ /khyod zhabs bskyed pa thugs rje'i stobs/ /khams gsum ma lus dag pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes mchog /mgon po bka' drin mdzad pas legs/ /de skad gsol btab dgyes par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas la bzhugs/ /de nas dga' ba'i byang chub sems/ /sngon gyi rgyud dang lam bzhi las/ /sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngon gyi rgyud dang lam grogs rnams/ /dgongs shing thugs rje'i ye shes thugs/ /rang bzhin gnas nas kun dgongs te / /phyogs bzhi nas ni bskul bar mdzad/ /kye kye mchog gsum bde ba'i sku/ /byams pa'i thugs mnga' sku gsal mdzad/ /rdo rje rgyal po byang chub sems/ /bdag dgongs 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad/ /kye kye yon tan rin chen tshogs/ /thugs rje mnyam nyid ye shes che/ /rgyal po 'khor lo byang chub nyid/ /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs sprul pa'i mdzod/ /kye kye rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /dga' ba (snyergya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas/ /so so'i ye shes sna tshogs 'byed/ /chos rnams 103—216

kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /kye kye 'gro ba'i don chen bdag /btang snyoms mi 'dor sna tshogs dor/ /bya ba grub pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag ston/ /rang dga'i bskum 6)pas g.yo mdzad de/ /phyogs bzhi byang chub dga' gnas (mi'ajug /kye ma'i ③'gro rnams de bzhin nyid / /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /nyon mongs gzung 'dzin sgrib pa yis / /rang gi mtha' lam 'ges ④par byed/ /'di dag thugs rje'i gnas su rung / /ye shes gsal ba'i thabs mang pos/ /thams (5)cad dus gcig bsgral byas nas/ /rang gi bde chen don ston mchog /zhes gsungs pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin / /sangs rgyas sras bcas dga' bar mdzad6)/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las thugs rje sprul pa'i rol pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'chang ba stan las langs /bde gshegs bsngags pa rjod (7)byed cing / /bskum pas dbyangs kyis (gugasol ba btab/ /kye ma ho mchog gsum dam tshig sku/ /ye shes bla na med pa'i bdag /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rnam 'phrul thugs rje'i dus nyid pas/ /rigs kyi 'khor lo dpag med sku/ /di 59)ring bkra shis phun sum tshogs / /thugs rje chen po yal 'dor na/ /ci phyir theg chen mchog tu sngagasate/ / /yang dag zhus pa'i tshig gsan nas/ /thugs rje'i (nyadakyil 'khor gzigs par mdzad/ /mgon po'i pad+ma'i sku de nyid/ /gzi ldan yum dang rol mdzad cing / /dri med ye shes phyogs gzigs shing / /gnyis med byang chub 103—217

sems kyi dkyil 'khor gsal/ theg pa gsang chen cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam 'di dpal ldan rol mo'i mchog /sangs rgyas sras bcas sdud ①mdzad de/ /gzhan 'phrul gnas tshogs g.yo mdzad cing / /stong gsum 'di dag spyod ②mdzad cing / /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 'jug ste/ /sku las la'od zer spro bar mdzad / /des khyab rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal/ /ye shes 'od mdangs ༷sems dpa'i sku/ /gnas lngar gsang ⑤ba'i sngags kyis gzhug /phyag rgya chen po yongs rdzogs sku/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dga' ba'i mdangs/ /dmar gsal pad+ma rā (5)ga'i mdangs/ /g.yas g.yon zhal gnyis sngo dang ser/ /rigs rgyan mtshan ma kun gyis mdzes/ /phyag na pad sdong bum pa dang / /rdo rje rtse lnga dpal be'u dang / /mtha' mas mda' gsor gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rin chen sna tshogs na bza' dang / /phyag rgya'i yum ⑦bcas rol pa mdzad/ /gzhal yas khang pa sgo bzhi dang / /rin chen sna tshogs rta babs bcas/ /dra ba dra phyed mu tig phreng / / bhan dha dril bu (kyesogs kyis spras/ /dbus ①kyi dkyil 'khor cher 'phags pa'i/ /pho brang ka ba gdung rnams la/ /pad+mo rdo rje sogs pas spras/ /'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gnas rnams kun du rin chen khri/ /pad+ma 'khor lo nyi zlas mtshan/ /phyi rol bar khyams 'khor ba dang / /snod rnams kun du pad+ma la/ /thabs dang shes rab bye brag gis/ /nyi ma zla ba rkyang pa'o/ /de nas pad+mo rnam ⑩dag kun/ /dbus kyi gdan la bzhugs mdzad de / /dgyes pa'i gar dbyangs bskyod pa'i mthus/ /thabs dang shes rab rdzogs par mdzad/ /de tshe thugs mchog byang chub sems/ /mkha' klong rnam par dag pas na11/ /rig pa bde ba chen po'i sku/ /sna tshogs sna tshogs shar ba 103—218

de / /gsung nyid ①yi ge 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /'bar ba 'od zer rtse lnga pa/ /cho ga'i yan lag rim bzhin du/ /thugs kyi mtshan ma dam tshig bya/ /sngags bcas 'phro zhing 'du ba'i tshul/ /rgyal po bder ②gshegs yab yum dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems ma dang / /las mdzad khro bo yab yum dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i skur gyur nas/ /rigs kyi rgyal phreng mtshan mas mdzes/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor gnas bzhugs shing / /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'khod/ /de tshe mgon po bde chen po/ /rigs kun bdag 'gyur zhes bya bas/ /pad+mo rnam par 'phrul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'byin par mdzad/ /byang sems kum las rnam 'phrul pa'i/ / bder gshegs (mi'od zer snang ba'i sku/ /zhal dang phyag la sogs pa'i rgyanani/ /gtso bo'i cha lugs ci lta 6)bar/ /rang 'od yum dang 'khril bar mdzod/ /bkra shis mtshan ldan bde ba la/ /rā ga pad+mo hūm̐ zhes pas/ /sngags mchog yi ge 'bru brgyad de/ /las kun grub par mdzad pa yin / /gang gi pad+ma sha ri dang / /bhu dha hūṃ gis (7bsnan byas na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun dang / /grub chen brgyad kyi tshogs sog (/tshornams/ /sbyor ba tsam gyis grub 'gyur zhing (kye/ /yun rings dzi༄gnas pa gnas pa yin/ /'byin pa'i dus su gsang sngags la/ /yi ge dza yis gdags byas nas/ /rnam 'phro rigs kyi dkyil 'khor sbyor/ /rigs bdag sku gnas dgyes par rtebazhugs / /thugs rje skul ba'i glu dang sngags/ /'od zer tshogs kyis skul ba mdzod / /dam tshig gsum ston sngags kyi mthus/ /dgyes chags brtan pas gzi dang ldan/ /oṃ rnam dag pad+mo bde ba'i dbyings/ /ye shes byin las gsal ba'i mchog /dkyil 'khor gsang gsum dam tshig che/ /mnyam nyid 103—219

rigs bdag thub pa che/ /byin brlabs 'dor 6)bar mi mdzad pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /gsal mdzad gnyis su med pa'i sku/ /rang gi ngo bos gnas pa yin/ /gtso bo sngags kyis bskul byas te/ /'od zer rgyan bcas thugs kur bsdus/ /yi ge ā nas aḥ'i ②bar/ /bcu drug 'od zer 'phro byas pas/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas skur bkod gcing / /rigs mthun stidakyil 'khor kun gsal 'gyur/ /sngags kyi (nya'od zer sgrar bcas pas/ /chos rnams bcu drug dag pa'i dbyings/ /rang gi gnas su bkod ⑥byas pas/ /mtshan mchog sum cu phyirtsa gnyis rdzogs/ /de bzhin kā nas k+ṣa yi (kyebar/ /sum cu yidam bzhi'i rim bzhin gsal0/ /brnyan pa'i yi ge drug dang bcas/ /'od 'phros thams cad sangs rgyas sku/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor gsal byas nas(me/ /sngags kyi 'od zer sgrar bcas (stenas/ /chos mang ye shes zag pa med/ /slar nyid sku yi gnas zhugs 8pas/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 8rdzogs/ /gzhan yang rin chen sna bdun dang / /bkra shis brgyad sogs kun gyis spras/ ci /khaṃ las rnam 'phrul tshe mtha' yas/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dkar dmar mdangs / /pad+ma sogs dang ral gri 'dzin/ /chos kyi snang ba'i rgyan gyis bsgrubs / /pad+ma rgyan 'bring rang bzhin mchog /shar gyi tsodakyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /gi las sprul pa'i chos dbang phyug /dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /pad+ma'i phreng ba bum 7pa 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su bzhugs pa'o / /r+ghaṃ las sprul pa'i chags med 'os(1 7/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis byu ru'i 'od / /pad gnas glegs bam me long 'dzin/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gnas bzhugs pa'o/ /ngo las sprul pa'i spyan dag ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis btsod /she103—220

kyi mdog /rin chen phreng bas 6)bsil yab 'dzin/ /byang gi dkyil 'khor gnas bzhugs pa'o/ /rtsa las sprul pa'i mi bskyod pa/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi chu shel mdog /rdo rje dril 'dzin 'khril pa'i tshul/ /dpal be'u bum sogs 'od phreng ②rgyan/ /tshi las sprul pa'i rta dbang phyug /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bai ḍūr+ya glu/ /rin chen snye ma dung phor 'dzin/ /lho yi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs / /rdza ④las sprul pa'i 'brug sgra ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gur gum ⑤mdog /rin chen chag ⑥shing 'gu dhe 9)'dzin/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /nyi ⑧las sprul pa'i dri med dpal/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mar gad mdog /rin chen pad srungs za ma tog /byang gi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs / /rta las sprul pa'i rin chen dbyangs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gser gyi mdog /rin chen dril bu yum dang 'khril/ /rin chen mdzod spungs 'khor lo sogs/ /tho las sprul pa'i nam mkha'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sngo skya'i mdangs / /rin chen gling bu pad+mo 'dzin/ /shar gyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs / /rda las sprul pa'i dra ba can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mthing ga'i 6)mdog /rin chen phreng dang pad+mo 'dzin/ /lho yi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs / /r+ghaṃ ⑩las sprul pa'i dkon mchog rgyan/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dmar skya'i mdangs/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyud mangs (nya'adzin/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /rna las sprul pa'i rin chen tog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma ra ta/ /dgos 'dod bum pa dpag bsam shing / /byang gi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /ṭaṃ las sprul pa yonakun du snang / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gser gyi mdog /'khor lo dril 'dzin yum dang bum pa 'dzin/ /103—221

gtsug tor dri med rdo rje 'dzin/ /the 6)las sprul pa'i 'od kyi dpal/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi shel gyi mdog /'khor lo dra ba ral gri 'dzin/ /shar gyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /rda ②las sprul pa'i dga' dbang phyug /zhal gcig phyag bzhi nyi ma'i mdangs/ /'khor lo rgyal mtshan dga' ba'i mdzod/ /lho yi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /rta dulas sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bkodabya/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dmar skya'i mdangs/ /nyi ma'i 'od phreng rdo rjes spras/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /rna rgyalas sprul pa'i rnam par gzigs//zhal gcig phyag gnyis ljang skya'i mdangs/ /ku ⑥sha'i chun po'i a mra'i mdangs//byang gi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /paṃ las sprul pa'i don yod pa/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang sngo'i mdog⑦ /rgya gram dril bcas yum dang 'khril/ /rdo rje gdengs pos ral gri 'dzin/ /pho (nyalas sprul pa'i brtson 'grus 'khyugs0/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi kur ti ka /rgya gram phreng ba rtse gsum 'dzin/ /shar gyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /baṃ las sprul pa'i las chen po/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ser skya'i mdog /pad+ma'i phreng ba nor bu 'dzin/ /lho yi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /r+ghaṃ 7las sprul pa'i gnod sbyin 'dul(me/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pad+ma'i mdangs/ /phyag na rdo rje mche ba 'dzin/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /mo las sprul pa'i sna tshogs dam/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang ser mdangs/ /zla ba rin chen dbyug pa 'dzin/ /byang gi dkyil 'khor gnas la bzhugs/ /bder (stegashegs rgyal ba de dag kyang / / tsakra sgyur yo rgyal ma lus dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad sna tshogs rgyan8/ /rigs btsun btsun mo mdzes par bya/ /yang sprul byams pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /103—222

zhal gcig phyag bzhi gangs ri ①mdog /rdo rje gdengs dbyug ral gri dang / / tri shul ②thod bcas pad+ma'i lcugani /rngam brjid 'khor bcas yum dang 'khril/ /drag po'i rgyan cha shar gyi sgo/ /khu ④las sprul pa rtse ⑤ba'i dbang / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gser gyi mdog /rin chen dbyug pa pad+mo dang / /thod rnga ⑥rdo rje myu gu'o / /ro las sprul pa'i rnam grol dbang 9)/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dmar mdangs gsal/ /pad+ma dang ni dril bu dang / /thod sprul ras sngon ba dan 'dzin / /lam̐ las sprul pa'i 'gro dbang phyug /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang gu'i ⑧mdog /rdo rje rgya gram pad+mo dang / /gri gug gtun shing phreng ba can/ /rin chen phreng bas mdzes byas nas/ /'khor bcas rngam pa'i mdangs bcas pas/ /lho la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ru/ /gzhan 'jigs ri9)drag po'i las kyis 'khod/ /shaṃ ོlas sprul pa'i byin dbang phyug /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dkar dmar 'od/ /rtse gsum bhan dha yirin chen 'khril/ /mi ()yi thod pa ri mos mtshan/ /ṣi tu)las smra tsoba'i dbang phyug ste/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ser skya'i mdangs/ /rin chen rtse dgu bgrang phreng dang / /pad+ma'i lhug ma sdigs mdzub 8mdzad/ /sa tshulas sprul pa'i spyod dbang phyug /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dmar skya'i mdangs/ /dbyug pa rtse gcig pad+ma dang / /dgra sta zhags pa phyag na 'dzin/ /haṃ las sprul pa'i dbang phyug ste/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang gu'i lco tshosku/ /ral gri lcags kyu dgra sta dang / /me yi phreng ba 'khor lo 'dzin/ /gzhan 'joms 'jigs 5)pa'i khro bo'i mchog /rang 'od rigs mthun yor+shayum dang rol/ /drag po'i rgyan tshogs ma lus 'gengs/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhin du 'khod/ /ka las bde ba'i blo gros dang / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi nam mkha'i mdangs/ /yum bcas rdo rje 103—223

dril bu dang / /nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /kha las khang pa rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pu sha ra/ /rin chen pi bang 0)phreng ba dang / /rnga yab rdo rje cod pan thogs/ /ga las gzi brjid bkod pa ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgya skegs ②mdog /pad+ma'i lcug ma zla ba dang / /'khor lo yid bzhin bum pa dang / /gha las sprul pa'i 'khor lo gnon pa ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma ra dang / /'khor lo dbyug pa ma mo shing / /rgya gram rin chen lcug ma 'dzin/ /tsa las shes rab snang ba ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang skya'i mdangs/ /rin chen phung po pad+ma dang / /rtse gsum dril thabs 'od dkyil 'khor/ /tsha las rdo rje rgyal mtshan te/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gser gyi mdog /rin chen gdugs mdzes nyi ma dang / /dpa' bo longs spyod pad+ma'i spyan/ /dza las 'od zer 'phro ba can(kye/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mdangs dmar 3)gsal/ /pad+ma 'khor lo mchod sdong bu/ /mu tig chun po za ma tog /dzha 557las sprul pa'i drag shul can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang ⑥ser mdog /'od kyi me phung me (7'od dang / /ral gri 'bar ba g.yas dang g.yon/ /ta las sprul pa'i dri ma sel9su/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar skya'i mdangs/ /nyi ma'i phreng ba gaṇa ḍi rdeg(9) /chos kyi tsakra rdzogs byed pa'o/ /tha las sgyu ma'i 'phrul pa ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la sha /seng ge rgya mtsho rin chen phreng / /rin chen bum pa de bcud bcas/ / las kyi 7rin chen rgyal po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rā ga'i mdangs/ /ri bo pad+ma chu dri snyostedang / /gser nya 'phyo ba'i rdzing bu yin/ /dha las 'phros pa'i dra ba can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang gu'i 12mdog /rgya gram dril bu 'phro ba dang / / bhan dha yi sbrang yab 'dzag snyipa'i 103—224

rgyun / /ta 6)las sprul pa'i lag bzangs ④ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ka ra ta'i 'od / /pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan dkar dmar mdangs/ /dri yi gzhong pa ku (5)sha'i tshul / / tha las gser ④'od 'phro ba 'dzin/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mthing ga'i phyimadog /glegs bam mdzes pa'i sku gzugs dang / /rin chen mdzod dang zla ba'i 'od/ /ḍa las rin chen snye ma ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pad rā ⑥ga /pad+ma'i sdong bu dpag bsam shing / / bhan dha 7rtse gsum zla tshes gzugs/ /dha (shelas chos kyi 6)mthong ba ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sna tshogs sku/ /go cha ye shes sgron ma dang / /dpal be'u zur 7brgyad nor bu tog /sna tshogs sprin phung ser gra bcas/ /mche ba dril bu ngang pa 'dzin/ /bha las gzhon nu rin chen ni / /zhal gcig phyag bzhi ljang ser mdog /rgya gram 'khor lo'i phreng ba dang / /'od zer rtse gsum sngags pa'i bum/ /sems dpa' yonachen po de dag rnams/ /rgyan phreng cha lugs 'od zer dang / /yum gnas 'khril zhing rang gnas kyi/ /gtso la 'khril ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ /nya yi ma na las 4ge'aphrul pa yi/ /rdo rje rnam par gnon la sogs/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma ci yibazhin du/ /pad+ma rā ga rak+ta mdangs/ /be'u gser mdog yin dra tshebazhin/ /pad+ma rdo rje rims yisogs mtshan/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi yum dang 'khril/ /'og ma'i phyag mtshan mthun tu pa yi/ /rang rtags mtshan ma sna tshogs dang / /pad+ma'i lcug mas mtshan byas pa'i/ /me tog 'bras bu rnams kyis mdzes/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi ru/ /byang chub sems dpa'i cha lugs kyis/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor gnas su 'khod/ / ya wa tshosher las sprul pa yi517/ /pad+ma 'phro ba la sogs bzhi/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar dang ser/ /dmar ljang pad+mo me long dang / /rin 103—225

chen phreng ba pi bang 6)gar/ /mchod pa ②las mdzad nang gi mtshams ①/ /ṣa sha sa ha las 'phrul pa'i/ /pad+mo tshim byed la sogs bzhidu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rigs gnyis gzugs/ /bdug rgyaspos me tog dung dang dri/ /'gying ⑥tshul tri shul ⑦las kyi tshul/ /mchod pas phyi yi dumatshams na gnas/ /de dag gi gsang sngags ni/ oṃ dhe 0nyi rā ga pad+ma shi ri bu ta rdzu hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā dha ba ra bu na si ta ma hā dha ma hre 7da yā hūṃ hūm̐/ prad ⑩tang ya dza swā hā/ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi'o/ /oṃ tsakra a lo 8ka na ma rak+ṣa si ⑩bha rad na hri ti ba ya ba ti 8dza swā hā/ nub phyogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /oṃ badz+ra da ra ba kṛ 8ta ya ni shaṃ tshur ti ba shaṃ ⑩ni dza swā hā/ shar phyogs kyi dkyil tso'akhor la'o(7 ma rat+na ku ti du man ta bhan dha bhan dha ru du na du na (1bi dza swā hā/ lho phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor pa'o/ /oṃ pi sha tsin dha ma ma du ru ha ha ha ha sarba gurba ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/byang gi dkyil 'khor pa'o/ /oṃ ma ma a ba lo ka na ru ru yu ru si de bh+yo de satwa ⑫ma ma hūm̐ dza swā hā/ rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ bi lo ka nā 9 nyam si ta na ma ku ru ku ru bo dhi satwa bha ra bu na dza hūm̐ dza swā hā/ rigs las sprul pa'i byang chub sems kyi'o/ /oṃ bin dha bin dha sarba kurma si de de bi ku ru bu ta saṃ bo ha hūm̐ oṃ i dza swā hā/ lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ a pasma ra kro dha sni/yak+ta 8ste: hūm̐ hūm̐ bi rta pa ka phaṭa swā hā/ khro bo rnams kyi'o/ /gsang sngags rgyal po mi bzad 69pas/ /rnam par sprul pa sku 0yis ni/ /stong gsum gnas nas g.yo mdzad de/ /rang gi lha la gsal bar mdzod/ /de nas mgon po rdo rje 'dzin / /bde chen gar gyi dbang phyug gis/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum gsal byed pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /dkyil 'khor byin brlabs 103—226

dbang bskur zhing / /rigs kyi bdag pos gsal bar mdzod/ /gnas kun mtshan ma yongs dag nas/ /rnam gsum snang ba gnyis med 'gyur/ /oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bā ka ②tsit+ta ma hā bo dhi h+ya su traṃ tri sha shu dhe ②so nā dukhya hūṃ rdzu rgyu / oṃ rin chen dbu rgyan ④gyi sngags sarba phu geta ku ru rat+na ma ma ku ta/ a a bīr+ya dusad ma ma ku a gi ṣiñca oṃ āḥlas swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma a mo ka sa ma ya shrī ha ha ha tshin dha ma ni a smi sha bi ma ma ya hūṃ hūṃ/ sngags gsum gyi dugasal bar ⑨byed pa'o/ /oṃ bi sha tsin dha ma ni a ba saṃ bo da ⑩ma ma ku ru si la la ta si na bi ⑪bud pa paṃ da hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rnam par spro ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma ta la ni bi sha tsakra ku ma ta bu ta na ma si la du tri si hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i sngags sol/ /oṃ i a a min du she ma la shan dun dhe ta thā ga te ⑩skyod ti pad+ma ku ru āḥhūṃ swā hā/ rbad pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma mu khaṃ pad+ma pa ba sa bo ti de ra tsoyi gu ru rtsu r+ghaṃ hūm̐ haṃ haṃ dar sha swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ na ma su traṃ bho ga ga na gu ma le si sā tsor hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rig 8pa mchog gi sngags so/ /oṃ ⑩ba ga ga ba si kyipo pad+ma dha a h+ye gyi ma hā kā (nyeru ma da a (7ma dhu na dza dza/ spyan drang pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+mo si ga ga su ra ta ra ga sa ma ( )ye sti( nya/ gdan gyi sngags so/ /oṃ a mu ka si na ma shurnyesarba bh+yo ga ga ta pū sanyetsa me da na da hūṃ tri swā hā/ mchod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma bi lo ku ma cen la su rna tu ṭ+wāṃ ( nyes hā pa si hi hi/ dgyes par bya ba'i sngags so/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po mchog /rdo rje gsang ba rmad 'byung duba'i/ /sku dang gsung thugs gsang sngags che/ /byin gyis brlabs pa don bshad mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes mchog /de dag dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul mchog /dri ma med pa'i byang chub sems/ /de ni dkyil 103—227

'khor snying po mchog /rdo rje gsang ba'i gnas chen po/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pa'i tshul/ /rang bzhin byang chub sems nyid las/ /rang bzhin lhun grub rdzogs chen po/ /'gro ba'i snang ba dam pa'i mchog /rang bzhin dag pa dri med chos/ /dkyil 'khor gnas mchog gnyis med pa'o/ /phung po khams ①sogs rnam dag sku/ /e ma'o ( chos sku ②mya ngan 'das/ /e ma'o chos rnams ye shes sku/ /e ma'o chos kun (7rnam par 'phrul/ /rgya che sngags kyi tshul ldan pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gsang gsum ngo mtshar che/ /thabs lnga mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sngon dang da lta 55'brel don 'byung / /thabs mkhas pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes dag pa'i shugs/ /sa dang sa 'das don chen po/ /ta thā ga ta'i byin brlabs (67dbyings/ /la la sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /zab pa de nyid rang gi mthus/ /gsang gsum gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ya mtshan chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam 'phrul sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams/ /dga' ba chen po ngo mtshar gyis/ /rgyud gsum rnam dag tshim gyur nas/ / dgyes pa'i dbyangs ( kyis gsol ba btab / /e ma'o ngo mtshar ya mtshan che/ /gnyis med rol pa ya mtshan che/ /dri med dag pa 8ya mtshan che/ /'od 'phro 'du ba ya mtshan che/ /byang chub sprin phung ya mtshan che/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ya mtshan che/ /'phrul pa 'byung ba ya 103—228

mtshan che/ /khro bo 'byung ba ya mtshan che/ /byin brlabs ①cho ②'phrul ya mtshan che / /tha ba rlan nimadzad ya mtshan che/ /'gog pa rlung mdzad ya mtshan che/ /bdag cag 'khor tshogs 'dus pa rnams/ /dam tshig can du byin brlabs mdzad / /za 'og rim pa ci ④bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral du 'god/ /de nas bcom ldan bde zhu)chen pos/ /chags pa chen po rdo rje'i sku/ /sku dang gsung thugs gnyis med pa'i/ /'khor rnams rab tu sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje rgyan gyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor gsal bar mdzodayi/ /de tshe byang chub sems chen po/ /'od zer kun du khyab pa des/ /dga' ba chen po'i mchod pa yis/ /gnas kyi mtshan ma gsal bar mdzodaspyi/ /'du shes med dang 'gog gnas sogs/ /rang gi rtog pa'i mtha' zhes rnams/ /dri ma med pa'i byang chub sems/ /rin chen chu des dbang bskur (8)nas/ /rang gi ye shes dbang thob ste/ /'gro ba'i don byed nus dang ldan/ /las la spyod pa'i gnas rnams dang / /rang skyob pa yi sems dag gis/ /thugs rje chen po'i byang chub sems / /sangs rgyas bstan 59)pa 'di gnyer ro/ /byang chub sems kyi mtshan ma yis / /'dus pa'i gnas lnga rig par bya/ /oṃ gu h+ya badz+ra sa ma snyikyi/ a la la ho / rdo rje ro langs bsdus pa yis/spe/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig chen po rnams/ /rigs kyi dgongs pa ji tsho lta bar/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i las la gnas/ /skal bzang 4snyedam tshig chen po ste/ /de las 'das na rlag cipar 'gyur/ / bka' yi bsgo skiba'i don chen pos/ /'das pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam yas pas /dam tshig thob pas gral 'khod do/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po nyid/ /dbang thob las mdzad chen po des/ /bcom ldan 'das la gtsug yigi phyag /103—229

rnal 'byor lugs su byas nas ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ /mnyam 'gyur gsol ba rab tu gdab①/ /'di ltar ma byung ngo mtshar khyod/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang phyug che/ /mngon spyod ya mtshan ston par spyod/ /bka' yi 'khor lo dam pa nyid/ /smra bsam yul las rab 'das kyang / /dpes mtshon snang ba la brten ②nas/ /yi ge ming tshogs la sogs kyis/ /gsal bar mtshon te go bar mdzod/ /ston pa dbang phyug dam pa des/ /gsol ba btab pa'i don dgongs nas/ /brjod bsam 'das pa'i ting 'dzin las / /mnyam par bzhugs dunas mi gsung bzhugs/ /de nas ④'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs kyis/ /stobs mchog seng ge chen po la/ /logs su btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ /rmad 'byung (snyemachod pa sna tshogs byas/ /gsol btab blo mchog seng ge khyod/ /bdag cag zhu ba'i gnas skabs phye/ /stobs mchog seng ge gsang bdag gis/ /gsol ba btab pa'i don dgongs nas/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs khyod nyon cig /bdag la zhus shig nyaspobs par byos/ /slar nyid gsol ba btab pa'i don/ /kun gyis mthun ⑦pa'i tshig smras pa/ /mgon po rgyal ba kun gyi (bemadzod/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras kyi mchog6) /byang chub sems dpa' rje btsan 7la/ /chos rnams ston pa'i gnas lags na/ /bcom ldan gsang mchog dam pa des/ /gsang sngags lam rnams mi ston cing / /dgongs mdzad 'brel pas mi mdzad pa(nya/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis gang lags pa/ /'khor ni tshogs la bstan du gsol/ /gsal zhing dbye bar mdzad par rigasayi//zhus pa'i don nyid slar gsungs pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yo gsang ba'i mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dngos/ /sna tshogs snang zhing gsal bar mdzod/ /de 103—230

nyid rdzogs pa'i gsang sngags can/ /bshad las 'das pa'i don de ni/ /dgongs don rgyal bas gsung mi mdzad/ /de ltar ston pa rgyal mchog gis/ /rnam par brjod pa mi mdzad pas/ /yang dag don gyi snying po nyid/ /rgya cher bka' ni gsal ba yin/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams nyon cig /byang chub dam pa'i snying po ni/ /smra bsam ①las 'das brjod med pas/ /tshig tu brjod pa legs ma yin/ /gnyis mtha'i rtog pa las gzhan dag /tshig gi snang bas the tshom ②skyed/ /grol ⑧ba nyid kyis 'ching 'gyur zhes/ /'das dang ma byon thams cad dang / /da ltar byung ba'i ④dgongs pa'i don/ /ma gsungs ⑤mi gsung gsung du med/ /de nas sems dpa'i yisnying po ni/ /spros dang bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i tshig dbang du/ /mtshan ma'i tshig gis rnal 'byor rnams/ /don dam rtogs dka' ⑦'gro ba'i phyir/ /rgyal bas tshig skor ⑧bstan pa yis/ /'dus tshogs 'khor gyis 6)yang zhus pa/ /stobs mchog seng ge de ltar na/ /bdag sogs ma 'ongs rnal 'byor pas/ /tshig gi rjes 'brangs ⑩don dag tu/ /gsang ba'i las brjod gsal byed pa/ /ji lta bu yis mtshon par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /dbang bskur thob par zhu ba spobs/ /bcom ldan dbang mchog dam pa la/ /zhus shing stobs mchog seng ge khyod/ /des kyang 'khor gyis zhus pa bzhin/nya/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /phyag 'tshal rmad 'byung rme mchod rdzas nas/ /rdo rje tshig tu 'di skad gsol/ /kye ma ston pa thugs chen po/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba kun 'dus pa//byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid de/ /tshig tu brjod pa ma mdzad na/ /ma 'ongs sgra la brten 8pa dag /don la reg 8par mi 'gyur phyir/ /mtshon bya mtshon 103—231

par byas nas ni①/ /snying po byang chub don 'di la/ /dpes mtshon ②'thad par grub byed pa/ /gsang ba de nyid bstan ①du gsol/ /de nas mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /ye shes lnga dang rtags ldan pa'i/ /phyag gi mtshan ma gsor mdzad cing ske/ /rmad 'byung ④ya mtshan ston par mdzad/ /thams cad pad+mor 'gyur ba yi / /rmad 'byung (7chos kyi sgra yang sgrogs/ /oṃ āḥ6)rgyu swā hā/ bo dhi ༷tsit+ta gu gyal/ sa ma ya a sa/ a nu bo (midhi tsit+ta a nan ta gar bha()/ ma hā sa twa pra ⑩ta a hūm̐/ 'di ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /sangs rgyas grags (nyechen thams cad dag /rab tu drag cing brgyal 'gyur nas(9/ /gzhan lta ma lus smos ci dgos / /bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag bka'(nye/ /bshad kyis yirigs kyi bu rnams nyon/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med par/ /yang dag bden pa'i don bstan pa/ /de ni dngos po mtshan nyid de/ /mkha' ldan chen po rnams kyi gdeng ski/ /ji srid blo yi chos dag tu/ /gnyis su snang ba'i mtshan ma la/ /bsam brjod kun rdzob zhes 7bya ste/ /de las 'das pa don dam yin/ /sku gsum gnyis su med pa yi/ /snang ba'i dngos po ma 'gags pa/ /dus gsum bstan pa chen por gnas/ /yid bzhin pa yi don nyid do/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul/ /thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes ni/ /de nyid bla med mchog dam pa/ /de skad ces ni bka' stsal nas/ /a la la yi sgra brjod do/ /stobs mchog seng ge dri ba dris/ /de ltar lags dzinaso bcom ldan 'das/ /sngags kyi lha la blo gnas gang / /spyod la gnas pa gang dzin/dag gis/ /phan tshun 'brel 'gyur ci lta bur/ /blo yi rim pa 'jug bya 'am/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i bdag po khyod nyon cig /103—232

sangs rgyas rnams kyis 6)bstan pa'i don/ /mtshan nyid rnam dag dus lags ⑤pa / /bgrang dang bgrang ba las 'das pa'i/ /dngos po mtshan nyid de bzhin no / /legs spyod bden pa'i lam 'jug cing / /rnam gsum sngags kyi don spyad na/ /'brel pa shugs kyis lngasgrub byed na/ /lta spyod gnyis ldan bden pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor sa la legs gnas shing / /bden gnyis 'brel pa'i don bsgrubs nas/ /yang dag rtag pa'i don gsal 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor sa spyod sa thob goshog /ma skyes thabs kyi ye shes ldan/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings / /bden gnyis dbye ba med pa yis/ /yang dag don mchog sgyu ma'i skul/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma thabs kyi gsung / /phyag rgya sgyu ma'i tshul nyid de/ /med pa ma yin mtshan med de/ /rnal 'byor gnyis dang ldan phyir ro/ /slob pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis brten (5)nas/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sa goms nas/ /bden 'gyur bden pa gnyis la gnas/ /che chung mthu yis grub pa yin/ /sgra yi rjes 'brangs yirnal 'byor pas/ /don med spyod la gnas par 'gyur/ /yang dag kun rdzob bden gsal bas/ /gnyis med don dam bden par gnas/ /sna tshogs chos kyi g.yul ngo zlog57) /rig pa'i skyes bu rnam par grags(nya/ /zhes pas dgyes par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yodadagongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ de kho na nyid bstan tsopa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas rig pa'i skyes bu mchog /gsang tshogeba'i bdag pos yang zhus pa/ /bcom ldan snying po byang chub sems/ /dgongs pa'i don ni ci lta bu/ /las 103—233

dang nyon mongs dag byed pa'i/ /ye shes sgron ①ma ci ltar lags/ /rgyal bas dgongs pa'i byang chub sems/ /rdo rje lta bur mnyam bzhag ②nas/ / mi rtog ③ye shes gsal mdzad de/ /sna tshogs rnams kyang byang chub sems/ /bde ba che las gzhan med do/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam pa'i tshogs/ /chos rnams kun gyi rgyu yin te/ /rnam gsum rdo rje lta bu nyid/ /sku gsum gsal ba rnam par snang —/ /dngos po gsal ba'i chos med de/ /gcig las rnam 'phrul sna tshogs nyidam/ /phyag rgya gar thabs dbang bsgyur ④bas/ /'ching ba'i tshogs las rnam par grol/ /dngos po thams cad bral ba yi/ /phung khams skye mched rnam par dben / /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i yul bral bas/ /dpag med pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam gsum mchog gi don las byung / /'od gsal chen po'i rang bzhin no/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i don/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i thugs/ /skye dang skye med sna tshogs dngos/ /phyogs 'dzin mtha' yis bcing bar byed/ /de dag chos las rnam grol ba'o/ /bden pa chen po'i ting 'dzin rgya/ /ngo mtshar ya mtshan rmad kyi chos/ /me long gsal ba'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /'gag pa med pa'i chos rnams la/ /byang chub sems nyid skye bar 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /ya mtshan rmad du byung (5)ba'i chos/ /sna tshogs snang byed gnas grol ba/ /rang bzhin zhi ba'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis kyi mtha' las grol ba'o/ /gnas dang gnas med byang chub sems/ /ya mtshan rmad kyi don byung ba'o/ /rgya cher so sor gsal ba'i ngang / /kun rtogs (61byang chub sems chen po/ /dmigs med gsang ba las byung ba'i/ /dmigs dang mi dmigs sna tshogs ni/ /bde ba'i ye shes gsal 103—234

ba'o / /ma 'gags pa yi chos nyid do/ /bya ba grub pa'i tshul can du/ /spros med spros pa sna tshogs snang / /spro bsdu 'dun dang spros bral ba'i/ /mdzad pa'i byang sems brtan pa las/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul bla na med/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rmad du byung / /rang gi de nyid gsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyal bas bshad pa'i dgos ①don la/ /'khor rnams ya mtshan (gyengoms par 'gyur/ /mchod dang zhal dag nisgra 'byin cing / /rang gi de nyid gsal 'gyur ④nas/ /byang sems de nyid bstod par bya/ /e ma'o stong nyid byang chub sems/ /e ma'o dag pa dri ma med/ /e ma ⑤mi sgrib gsal ba che/ /e ma'o mnyam nyid dbyer med chos/ /e ma'o so so rang rig ⑥sems/ /e ma'o bya byed lhun gyis grub/ /de bzhin nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems nyid thugs kyi mchog /bdag cag rig 'dzin tshogs pa rnams/ /byang chub sems nyid smon pa dang / /'jug dang ldang rtsidang gnyis med deni/ /rang gi byang sems g.yo bar gyisasti/ /reg par bgyi zhing nye bar bgyi/ /nyams su myong bar 'tshal lags na/ /thugs rje che 7dgongs byin gyis rlobs/ /bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis rlobs/ /de skad tshig tu gsol btab pas/ /bcom ldan snying po 'di skad gsung / /sna tshogs tsho1rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams 'phro ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /rang bzhin brjod bral rtog pa med/ /rang gsang rtogs pa'i dka' ba'i don/ /srid gsum ye nas rnam dag chos/ /bdag rtog 'khrul pa'i nyes dmigs kyis/ /dus ring 'khyams 'gyur 'gro ba rnams / /rang rtog dngos po'i las la spyod/ /log pa'i sems kyis kun brtags kyang / /rang bzhin nyid la 'gyur ba med/ /ye nas don gyi tsosangs 103—235

rgyas la/ /'khrul pa'i bde sdug 'khor los 'khyams/ /log rtog dngos med byang chub sems/ /'khrul rtog mi gnas rgyan gyi 6)mchog /tha ba'i gnas nyid byang chub zhing / /srid dngos sangs rgyas mngon rdzogs sku/ /'dzin rtog byang chub snying por gsal/ /brtan g.yo dngos po thams cad dang / /bde chen sku las gzhan med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (snyedagongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las de bzhin nyid kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //bcom ldan rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa'i don/ /de nas gsang ba'i bdag po yis/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phro ba'i don/ /mtshan nyid 'phro zhing rtogs pa dag /rgyal bas bshad phyir bskul (mi'adebs mdzad / /bcom ldan rgyal ba thams cad kyis( )/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa'i don/ /rgya che mdzad pa'i mthu ldan pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum gyi gnas/ /rab rgyas mtshan bzhin cho ga'o/ /yan lag bdag (5)la bstan du gsol/ /de nas mgon po gsang ba'i bdag /gnyis med ye shes la 'gro ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs gnas/ /rgya cher sprul pa'i don bstan mdzad/ /stong nyid ye shes las byung ba'i/ /ri bo rgyud 'dzin rigs mtshan can/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge'i tshul 'jug pa'i/ /rta bdun 'od sogs gsal byed ldan/ /skar ma'i tshogs dang 'dra ba las/ /mnyam nyid 'od kyi gong (6dbu'i gzugs/ /snang ba'i 'od zer lnga yi tshul/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma sngags dang bcas/ /rnam 'phros rang rig zhing khams sbyong nya77/ /de dag gong bu'i gzugs mtshungs par/ /gtso 103—236

bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /stong nyid snying rje chen po yis/ /ma lus rgyud rnams gsal mdzad nas/ /nam mkha' dang ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /thugs rje chen po skyon skyong mdzad/ /sa bon gsang ba'i las byung ba'i/ /mkha' snang gsal ba kun khyab las/ /sna tshogs kun nas so so nyid/ /'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rim bzhin bkod6)/ /kun 'phrul sa bon las bskyed pa'i/ /ye shes rin chen sna tshogs gzugs/ /shar du do shal phreng ba dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan (mirnga yab sogs/ /me long rol mo'i tshogs bsam yas/ /'khor lo rin chen rdo rje pad/ /twa ra na bzhi rgyan mdzes pa/ /sgra dbyangs sna tshogs nyi zla'i tshogs/ /tsakra bar khyams phreng ba dang / /dam pa'i 'dod yon lha mo 'khrigs(kyi/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i khri brtsegs liganas/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i rin chen rgyan/ /gnas rnams khyab par ci (5)bzhin par/ /dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /a sto/zhe/ i lhi(pe/ u u/ e i/ o au/ i aḥ/ ṛ rī / bla lī/kye/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na /〈rwa pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de bzhin nyid dbyings rmad 'byung yiba'i/ /bder (nyagashegs kun gyi thugs gsal ba/ /byin brlabs ⑫ya mtshan sprul pa'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kun gyi gnas/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /phung po chos rnams sangs rgyas te/rte/ /'byung lnga dbyings phyug yum gyi mkha'/ /khams dang skye mched sems dpa' dang / /sems ma'i tshogs dang khro mo'i yisku/ /phyi nang srid gsum dngos snang ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag nyid che/ /gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad che/ /tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /'du shes 103—237

snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /'du byed don yod grub pa yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /thams cad bder 0)gshegs lnga yi sku/ /sa khams sangs rgyas spyan yin te/ /chu khams lha mo mā ma tī/ /me khams na bza' dkar mo ste / /rlung khams dam tshig sgrol ma'o/ /nam mkha' kun du bzang mo'i sku/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam dag pa'o/ /dbang po'i spyod yul ma lus kun/ /thams cad bder ②gshegs rigs kyi sku/ /mig la rnam par snang mdzad de/ /rna ba rin chen 'byung ldan che/ /sna la snang ba mtha' yas nyid/ /lce la don yod grub pa'i sku/ /lus nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /de ltar snang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ye nas lhun grub gnas pas na/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba don shes bya/ /phyi rol don shes yul drug 'di/ /yum chen lnga yi phyag rgya'i dbyibs / /gzugs khams sangs rgyas spyan ma ste/ /sgra tshogs lha mo mā ma tī/ /dri tshogs na bza' dkar mo'i dbyings/ /ro drug lha mo sgrol ma yin/ /reg tshogs lha mo kun du bzang mo'i sku/ /dus gsum mnyam sbyor 'du 'bral med/ /rdo rje pad+mo mnyam sbyor bas/ /rang rig chadakyil 'khor gsal bar mdzod/ /thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin na)las rol pa'i rgyan/ /nga (5)nyid 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pa'i mchog /sa yi khyad par ma lus pa'ang / /rdo rje chos kyis sbyor mdzad dang / /yon tan phrin 6)las mthar 97phyin pas/ /tshe 'di nyid kyi go 'phang mchog /rdo rje gsang gsum dam tshig rdo che/ /rang gi mthu yi sbyor byed pa/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag 6)sbyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas bzhugs te⑩/ /dri med byang chub sems kyi tshul/ /'gro rnams tshogs bcas dag par byas/ /rtag tu gsang 103—238

sngags brjod byas shing / /rdo rje mgon po'i sgo gsal brtan/ /rtag tu gtor sbyin gtang yo)byas te②/ /khams kyi 'dzin pa med par grol/ /rtag tu lha la mchod byas te/ /rang gi bdud rtsis mchod cing rol/ /rtag tu mi gnyis bstod bya ba/ /rnam grol thams cad brag ca'i nisgra/ /pha rol phyin bcu dus gcig byatu/ /pad+ma cho ga rtogs par 'gyur/ /zag pa zad pas sku lnga dang / /pad+ma'i rigs kun mnyam par sbyor/ /pad+ma'i dam tshig (gel gnas pa/ /gnas kun dkyil 'khor gsal bar 'gyur/ /pad+ma rang gi gnas su bsgom(6)/ /'dod chags chos kun spyod pa yi( )/ /mgon po rang rang gnas na (8)gsal/ /dri med dag pa'i thig le las/ /'od zer lnga yi snang ba bcas/ /rang gi gnas nas 'phro mdzad cing / /de nyid mgon po'i sku 'dod gzugs/ /kun tu pad+ma chags med pas/ /gnas kun dkyil 'khor gsal bar 'gyur/ /thub pa chen po'i mtshan rnams dang / /dpe byad rdzogs par gyur nas ni/ /yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /kun du dregs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje'i dam tshig la gnas pas/ /rdo rje rang gi gnas su bsgom(9)/ /'od 'phros 'dus pa'i lco tshoganas phyag rgya'i4nye/ /ye shes mnyam nyid kun don mdzad/ /thugs rjes rnam mang yul bral zhing / /'joms par mdzad pa'i tsho khro bo'i sku/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor dri bral ba/ /mngon sum gsang ba'i ye shes sku/ /'khor lo'i dam tshig la gnas pas/ /'khor lo rang gi tunyeganas su bsgom/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rin po chel/ /'phro 'du nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshogs/ /phung tshogs yikhams rnams rnam dag cing ske/ /phrin tshulas ye shes bla na med/ /byang chub dag pa'i cha lugs gnas/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i byin brlabs tshusku/ /dga' ba'i thabs dang shes rab 103—239

sbyoral/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 0)'dzin gnas②/ /rnal 'byor dad brtson ting 'dzin ldan/ /'grub 'gyur ring por thogs med spyod/ /ces rtsigasungs pas 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams mnyes par gyur to④/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje stan las langs (5)te/ dga' ba'i mchod pa dang gar thabs kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad mnyes par byas nas/bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te gsol ba btab bo/ /kye ma rgyal ba kun gyi gtso / /sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bskyed (6)pa'i yab/ /khyed kyis dkyil 'khor sprul mdzad nas/ /gdul bya'i lam 'di grol byas na/ /phyi yi 'gro ba ci ltar gzung / /gang dag dbang po ma smin pa'i/ /dkar po chos rnams mthong mi 'gyur / /de dag thugs rje chen po yis/ /bzung dzo zhing las la gzhug (nyapar snang —/ /ma 'ongs 'gro ba la la dag /'di ltar dkyil 'khor mthong ba rnams/ /ji ltar dkyil 'khor brtan par 'dul/ /zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba theg pa gsang sngags kyi lam du 'jug par 'dod pa dag gis ni/ rdo rje slob dpon la brten te gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug dzo9)par bya'o/ /rdo rje slob yidapon blo gros mchog /dad brtson shes rab stobs dang ldan/ /bdag chos ma lus shes 'gyur 1 nas/ /skyob pa byang sems sdom pa blangs1nya/ /byang sems snying rje chen po dang / /dga' ba btang snyoms bzhi 1 bzhag nas/ /sems can thams cad 1043—240

mgron 0)du gnyer/ /slar nyid byang chub lam la dgod/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams dang / /bsdu ba bzhi la legs gnas pas/ /theg pa chen po'i lam gnyer zhing / /nyan thos la sogs blos pa med pa'i blos/ /gsang ba'i theg pa don gnyer tsho zhing / /dkyil 'khor dbang thob dam tshig ldan/ /gsang ba'i rgyud rnams don shes shing / /de nyid bcu las kyigoms gyur pas/ /rang gi ye shes rnam grol zhing / /dngos po de nyid brtan ༄par gnas/ /mu stegs la sogs mi bskyod (gecing / /theg dman la sogs 'gyur ba med/ /rtag tu 'gro ba bzung (6)ba'i blos/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs las la brtson/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /grong khyer chen por 'gro byed dpon/ /'jig rten drag (7tshobartson chos brgyad dag /btang snyoms spong len med pa nyid/ /dmus long tshogs kyi mig chodabu bas/ /bla ma'i gtso bor gzung bar bya/ /'jug pa'i gang zag phun sum tshogs/ /zhi des gsong por smra ba dang / /'jam zhing 'gro ba'i yid 'ong ba/ /rtse gcig (9ri dang ba 'ibartson 'gyur byed/ /blo gros yon tan kun la 'jug /lha dang bla ma la sogs gus/ /theg pa chen po'i lam dag pas//ngan pa'i tshogs spangs gzhan du gnas/ /de ni blo gros bzang po yon tan ldan//theg chen gsang ba 'dzin pa'i snod/ /sa mchog shin tu dben pa'i gnas/ /ri bo nags tshal 'bras bu dang / /me tog chu rgyun phun sum tshogs/ /gnod byed skye bo tshogs bral ba/ /rnal 'byor grogs bcas dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /bdag dbang bar chad med pa'i mchog / bsnyen pa ji bzhin rdzogs nyu15pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor bri sogs las rnams bya/ /phun sum tshogs pa bdun ldan pas/mi/ /bdag gnas sa gzhi'i grogs bcas dang / /mchod rdzas yo byad ma lus pa/ /103wa 241

bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab ①par bya/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /gur dang bla re bcas pa yis/ /khro bo me 'od mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /bsrung zhing 'khor lo rim bzhin bsgom/ /sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i blos/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis dag par bya/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa dbul ba dang / /sdig bshags bsod nams rjes ②yi rang / /sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor skyob dang / /lus dbul byang sems bskyed pa dang / /lam gnas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ /rgya cher yongs su bsngo byas shing / /sems can don du smon lam gdab/ /dmigs med pa yi rang bzhin gyis/ /de dag brtson bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /rnam thar gsum las 'das pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes che/ /thams cad nam mkha'i stimatshan nyid deX/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' 'dra skyob rnal 'byor pas/ /don kun mnyam pa nyid la gsal/ /de la rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sprul byas pas/ /rigs kyi zhing khams spyod ⑦byed cing / /rnal 'byo ra chen po las kun 'grub/ /sa phyogs dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /grong ngam grong khyer dgon pa 'am/ /ri phugs (minags tshal gang rung bar/ /nyams dga' yan lag brtag 6)par bya/ /gang du bzang ni 'bras bu bcas/ /ne'u gsing ⑩chu 'gram me tog bcas/ /dpal rdzogs yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /de ni rab gus brtag par bya(nya/ /nam mkha' 'khor lo dra ba dang / /sa gzhi pad+ma dra ba dang / /bkra shis phun sum sna tshogs gzhi/ /bar chad med pa'i mtshan nyid yin / /sa gzhi zhom rdib med pa yi/ /dbus su mtho ba phyag rgya che/ /shar dang byang du gzhol ba ni/ /phrin (snyelas rnam yo bzhi'i chadangos grub 'gyur/ /lho dang 103—242

nub tu gzhol bas ni/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'gyur/ /nub dang byang du gzhol ba ni/ /ting 'dzin phra mo'i las gzhan 'gyur/ /gang zhig shar phyogs mtho ①ba dang / /dbus su dma' ba ⑧spang bar bya/ /sa de pus mo nub tsam du/ /brkos te slar yang dgang bar bya/ /mang ni'aphel gyur na dngos grub mchog /gang bar gyur pa shis pa yin/ /dma' zhing ma legs gyur pa yin / /sol dum ④dus sogs byung na yang / /yang na chu yis dgang ⑤byas te/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril 'dzin pas/ /mnyam bzhag lha yi sngags brjod cing / /shar du mi drag gom pa brgyad/ /song ste slar ldog ⑥blta bar bya/ /'grib pa med na dngos grub 'gyur/ /snang dang mi snang sa yi ⑦bdag /mgu byas rin ⑧gyis nyo ba dang / /blangs te bar chad med pa'i phyir/ /bgegs gzhan phra mo bskrad par bya/ /bar chad med pa'i sa dbus supo)/ /rigs kyi bdag po 'byor ldan pas/ /chos gos la sogs rgyan thogs shing / /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor legs bzhugs te/ /'khor los 7sgyur rgyal cha lugs kyis/ /mchod sogs sbyang zhing byin brlabs te/ /rdo rje bsrung ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor rig par bcas/ /sa yi lha mo sung (nyam rnams/ /spyan drangs mchod pas ⑫mnyes par bya/ /khyad par sa yi bdag po dang / /'gro drug bgegs rnams ma lus kun/ /dgug cing bu lon mchod sbyin gtang / /dri zhim chu yis kun gtor zhing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas (ste sbyang bar yibya/ /gang zhig dngos grub la sogs 'dod/ /rab 'bring tha ma grub don du/ /lto 'phye brtag pa'i cho ga bzhin / /yan lag kun dbang rgya yang byayi/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyar mnyam tsopa'i / /sa gzhi khru la sogs tshad du/ /brkos te sa yi skyon bsal 9)zhing / /sa 103—243

zhag mdog bzang (1)'jam phyin pas/ /gang zhig dri zhim chur bcas pa'i/ /sngags btab (gegang zhig 'thas par bcag(kye /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor khru dor bstod 0 / /rgyar ni khru drug pa yi (getshad/ /tshogs bsag zhi)khru gang 'phang du bstod / /mtha' skor khru gang pa yi tshad/ /dbang bskur (7sor bzhi'i tshad bstod de/ /ji ltar gru bzhi rgyar bskyed cing / /dbyibs legs me long bzhin du gnas/ /tshad mnyam grog sbur la sogs pa/ /rin chen lnga dang sman lnga dang / /snying po lnga dang 'bru lnga dag /dri chu sngags kyis (kyebatab byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor snying por gzhag (9)par bya/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs te//stong pa nyid kyi sngags kyis sbyang / /dri zhim sngags kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /chu rgyun phyogs bcur gtor byas shing / /sna tshogs gtor mas mnyes byas te/ /lha 7tshogs mgron 11rnams tshim par bya/ /slob dpon rigs kyi gtsor gnas pa'i / /rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs byas nas/ /sgrub pa'i grogs mchog blo gros ldan / /tshul bzhin du ni gsol ba btab/ /dbus kyi sa yi char gnas pa/ /kun 'byung nam mkha' dag pa'i sngags/ /brjod cing 'byung ba'i sa bon las/ /dkyil 'khor ri brtsegs 32bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje bsdams pa sar gzhag yo cing //byams pa'i rdo rje rnam dag cing / /rdo rje dkyil 'khor thugs dang bcas/ /phyag mtshan dran pa thog mthar rgyan/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /gur sogs khro bo me 'od bcas/ /gtso bo gar gyi midabang phyug skus/ /pad bcas thal mo lan gsum brdab/ /'od 'phros sloganas kun g.yos pa la/ /lha mo gser mdog rgyan gyis mdzes/ /me tog phreng ba bum thogs pa'i/ /lus phyed sa las 'thon sabyas te/ /mthun 1 na bka' nyan tshul du gnas/ /mchod bstod zhal 103—244

bsil sogs 'bul 6)zhing / /dri zhim (milas rnams ma rdzogs par/ /de srid mi 'gyur brtan bzhugs nas/ /bdud sogs bsgo ba'i ngag bcas mdzad/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa las/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du shog /ji ltar rgyal ba thams cad kyis la/ /bdud kyi sde rnams 'joms mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud las kyang / /rgyal bar byas pa'i dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /de nas slob dpon rgyan rdzogs pa'i/ /rdo rje dril 'gying bcas pa la/ /dam tshig ④nye bar bskul ba yi/ /glu dag phyogs bzhi'i gnas nas gdon/ /rgyal bas 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi me long gsal ba ston/ /bder (5)gshegs rnams kyi gsang ba pa/ /rdo rje gsang gsum dam tshig mchog /ye shes dri ma med pa'i tshul/ /sgrib sogs ma lus bral byed pa'i/ /rdo rje pad+mo mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /dkyil 'khor chen po drug cu'i (6)bdag /theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /gsang gsum pad+mo dag pa'i dbyings/ /so sor gsal (7)ba'i don bstan pa/ /rdo rje lta bus gnas kun sbyor/ /zab cing rgya chen sgra sna tshogs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bshad pa'i dus/ /rgyal po yon tan dpe dang bral/ /rin chen lhun po'i mdzod mnga' ba/ /nyams dga' thugs rje'i zhing rnams dgongs/ /bdag med mnyam pa'i ye shes can/ /phrin 8rilas dag pas zad par mdzod/ /gsang gsum sna tshogs rdo rje'i bdag /rigs mchog nyushes rab brtson byed cing / /spyan bzang dag pas 'gro la gzigs/ /slar nyid khro bo chen po'i sku/ /zhal lnga phyag cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /'jigs byed 'bar ba'i skur gnas te/ /mgur nas hūm̐ bsgoms sgra sgrogs shing bo/ /rdo rje pad+ma lta ba yis/ /lha rnams bdag la 103—245
