chen po/ /thugs rje ye shes rnam 'phrul tshogs/ /khyab mdzad byin brlabs ①ston pa'i gtso/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin ②las rmad du 'byung ①/ /ma lus sems can don gyi phyir/ /pho brang dag par byin gyis brlabs④ / /phyogs mtshams ma lus rnam dag pas/ /byang chub ye shes gnas gsal 'gyur/ /nyon mongs nyes tshogs kun bcom pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po dri med shugs/ /ye shes byin brlabs las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba grub par mdzod/ /rin chen rnam (gelnga'i phye zhi)ma dang / /sa tshon la sogs gang 'byor pa/ /rin po che yi snod blugs te/ /dkyil 'khor gnas kyi phyogs lngar bzhag⑦ / sbyang zhing (nyabyin gyis brlabs byas na/ /rigs lnga'i skud tshogs yum bcas la/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor dbus sogs dang / /mchod bstod sngags kyis mnyes par bya/ /o badz+ra tsi ta po)ma ti sa ma ya hūm̐/ dkar mthing ser po ljang gu yidang / /dmar po'i tshon rnams rim bzhin du/ /dbang ldan mtshams nas brtsam (nyubyas te/ /pañca rā ga drang bar bya/ /g.yas pas pad+ma rdo rje bzung 8/ /g.yon pas 'dren pa'i las bya'o/ /de la mchod 'bul sngags brjod cing / /bden pa bdar te dgab par zhustebya/ /'di ni chos dbyings rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rang 7sgrol byed/ /dpal ldan pad+ma gar dbang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /yang dag bden pa'i byin brlabs 'akyis/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams shis par mdzadayi/ /dbus kyi lte ba nas brtsams te/ /dang po slob dpon gyis bri yonazhing / /phyis ni ci dgar shes par bri/ /mtho dman med snyoms drang por bya/ /de nas mtshan ma rtags (shebastan te/ /chad cing smra bas mi 'grub ste/ /yon pos /smugadung pa'i las rnams 103—253

skyedzoske/ /chad pas slob dpon slob ma dag /shi tham ngan par 'gyur ba yin/ /lhag dang bcas pas g.yul 'khrugs shing / /phyogs 'khrul pa yis smyo bar 'gyur / /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gnas dag tu/ /re'u mig nyi shu rtsa lnga las/ /bder ②gshegs gtso bo'i rigs su bcas/ /phyag rgya'i yi ge mtshan ma ③bri/ /phyi rol pad+ma'i 'dab gnas la④/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi tshogs rnams la/ /byang sems khro bo bcas pa dag /shar nas rim bzhin bri bar bya/ /phyi dang nang gi mtshams ⑤rnams su/ /mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams bzhag⑥ /bar khyams ⑦bskal bzangs (kyesems dpa' rnams/ /sgo bzhir khro bo'i tshogs gzhag go/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dbus song ste/ /bder cigashegs 'od zer snang ba yi/ /pad+mo rdo rje dril bcas pas/ /rang gi kha dog tshon bcas bzhagati /de yi shar phyogs re'u mig la/ /tshe mtha' yas dang chos dbang phyug /chags med 'od dang spyan dga' ba'i/ /pad brtsegs ⑩pad+ma'i phreng ma tsodang / /pad gnas rin chen 7glegs bam rin chen phreng / /rang mdog sngags kyis brgyan pa bzhagatso /shar kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /bde bar gshegs pa mi bskyod pa/ /rdo rje dril bu'i sngags bcas pas/ /rang gi 'od bcas gdan la bzhaga'i /de yi shar phyogs re'u mig la/ /'brug sgra dri ma med pa'i rigs/ /mngon par snang mdzad bstan dbang phyug /chags shing rin chen pad spungs pa//rin po che yi dra ba ste/ /rim bzhin rang mdog sngags kyis brgyanatso/ /lho yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /bder chagashegs rin po che sbyangs kyis/ /rin chen brtsegs dang dril bu la/ /rang mdog sngags kyis mtshan byas pa'o/ /de yi shar phyogs re'u yo mig la/ /nam mkha'i mdzod dang dra ba can/ /dkon 103—254

mchog rgyal mtshan rin chen tog① /rin chen gling ①bu rin chen phreng / /rin chen rgyal mtshan rin chen bum/ /rang gi 'od bcas sngags kyis brgyan/ /nub kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /bder chagashegs kun du snang ba'i 'od/ /'khor lo dril bu mtshan ma la/ /rang 'od sngags kyis mtshan pa ④byi/ /pad+mo rigs kyi ⑤'khor lo'i tshad/ /byang gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /bder ⑥gshegs don yod grub pa yi/ /rdo rje sna tshogs dril bu bsnams/ /rang gi sngags dang kha dog gsal/ /de yi shar phyogs re'u mig la/ /brtson 'grus dang ni shugs chen po/ /gnod sbyin 'dul ba sna tshogs dbang / /rgya gram phreng dang pad+ma phreng / /rdo rje gdengs po zla kham gcan/ /'od 'phros sngags kyis mtshan byas pa'i/ / mtshams kyi re'u (kyemig bzhi rnams la/ /'od 'phros 6)pad+ma 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma gnon dang pad skyong dang / /me long rin chen phreng ba dang ske/ /pi wang tigar gyi phyag rgya la/ /rang 'od sngags kyis mdzes par bya/ /phyi rol pad+ma'i shar brtsams te(1/ /rigs kyi byang sems bzhi bzhir gnas/ /bde ba'i blo gros rgya mtsho'i sgra/ /gzi mdangs dang ni 'khor lo yi/ /nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad lcug 'khor lo dbyug pa rnams/ /rang 'od sngags kyi mtshan mar gnas/ /shes rab snang ba rdo rje rgyal/ /'od zer 'phro ba drag shul gyi/ /rin chen phung po rin chen gdugs/ /pad+ma'i sdong po 'od phung bri/ /dri ma'i tshogs dang sgyu /nem 'phrul(3/ /rin chen rgyal po dra ba can / /rin chen ri bo rgya gram bri/ /lag bzangs tsogaser 'od 'phro ba dang / /rin chen snyi tsom chos mthong dang / /pad+ma'i rgya gram glegs yibam dang / /pad+ma'i sdong po'i go cha bri/ /dri med mun pa sel ba dang / /dga' ba dbyangs dang 103wa 255

gzhon nu yi/ /chu shel nor bu'i phreng ba dang / /sprin phung rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /de ni rigs lnga'i sems dpa' ste/ /rang 'od sngags kyis mtshan byas pa'i/ /de mthar khro bo ①bzhi rnams kyi②/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma bri byas te/ /sbyin bdag smra ba'i dbang phyug dang / /rtse gsum rin chen rtse dgu dang / /dbyig pa rtse gcig ral gri'o/ /gru chad ③mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /bdug ④sgos me tog mar (5)me dri/ /phyi rol bar khyams ⑥gnas dag la/ /57)phyogs re (kyisems dpa' bzhi bzhi ste/ /rdo rje rnam snang gar mkhan dang / /blo yi rgya mtsho thogs med bkod/ /rdo rje mtshan ma gsang sngags bcas/ /rang 'od gnas gdan dag la bri/ /pad+mo dga' ba'i sa la dbang / /rin chen spungs pa sprin gyi phreng / /rin chen mtshan ma sngags dang bcas/ /rang 'od gdan la gnas pa bri/ / yid 'ong zhi)me tog sgron ma dang / /spos brtsegs kha lo sgyur 7ba dang / /pad+ma'i mtshan ma sngags dang bcas/ /rang 'od gdan la gnas par bri/ /dran dbang pad+ma'i blo gros dang / /las byed snying po'i blo gros dang / /rgya gram mtshan ma sngags dang bcas / /rang 'od gdan la gnas par bri/ /shar sogs pa yi sgo rnams su/ /khro bo'i 'jigs pa'i rgyal po yi/lha/ /rdo rje rgya gram rdo rje gdengs(nya/ /rin chen dbyug pa pad+ma phreng 1ste/ /rang gi yi ge gdan gnas pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma bri bar bya/ /phyogs bzhi rgyan dang phreng ba dang / /'dod yon lha mo la sogs pa'i te/ /rgyan rnams pad+ma rdo rje dang / /rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram bri/ /'phro skibs mtshan ma kha dog lnga/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i 'od bcas pa'o/ /phyi rol rta babs dra ba sogs/ / bhan dha 'dril bu nyi shu bzhi/ /gdugs yinadang bum pa bya yi phreng / /dpag bsam rdzing bu dang ba (1 dang / /nyi zla me long rgyal mtshan lnga/ /103—256

chos kyi 'khor lo ri dgas 6)rnams/ /mdzes byas phyi mtha' pad+ma dang / /rdo rje me ②'od mtshon gyis bskor/ /dbus mig kha dog nyi shu lnga/ /pad phreng dmar po bar khyams dkar/ /sgo bzhi'i (7rin chen sna bzhi pa④/ /gru chad gser gyi kha dog can/ /mchod pa lnga dang bum dgram zhing (57/ /bla rgyan na bza' phyogs rgyan bri(5)/ /me tog tshom bu sngags bcas pa/ /so so'i gnas su dgram par bya/ /gtor ma'i tshogs mang sbyar byas nas/ /phyi rol phyogs dang mtshams ⑨su dgod//lha yi ting 'dzin gsal byas pas/ /dkyil 'khor shis pa'i las 'grub 'gyur/ /de nas lha rnams bstod byas te/ /rdo rje 8pad+mo dam tshig gzhug5) /thugs ku'i ⑩sngags kyis dgug byas pa'i/ /mgron rnams /nyatshim par 'gyur ba dang / /dam tshig sngags kyis bskul byas shing / /rang gi phrin tsho las bcol bar bya zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tsho2dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las gzugs brnyan brtsam 7pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs mgu 'gyur tsonas / /rgyal ba sar layang bskul ba mdzad/ /kun don thugs rje chen po'i shugs / /ma 'ongs gsang sngags spyod rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por gang 'jug pa/ /dbang bskur sna tshul bzhin ji lta bur/ /de bzhin rab tu gnas pa gang / /bdag gzhan don gyi yan lag bsrung 518/ /sbyin sreg rim pa ji ltar lags/rte/ /gtso bo thugs rje cher ldan pas/ /ma lus gdul bya kun gyi phyir / /dus 'di snang bar mdzad nas kyang / /cho ga'i yan lag rgyas pa 103—257

gsungs / /de nas byang chub sems tshogs kyis/ /gus par gzung ①ste spyad par bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi dbang / /phyag rgya shes rab rab bskyod ②cing / /rab tu dga' ba'i bzhin rgyas pa/ /rigs rnams kun la gzigs mdzad de/ /mchog gsum sbyin pa'i ②zhes bya ba'i/ /don 'di rab tu gnas par mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan pa'i/ /ma 'ongs gdul bya gang dag gis/ /gnyis med gsang ba'i theg ①pa 'dir/ /smin pa'i lam la 'jug 'dod pas/ /gang gis mnyes ⑤pa'i las rnams kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon mgu byas nas/ /yang dang yang du gsol btab stedu/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i don du gnyer/ /ma lus sdug bsngal las bsgral phyir/ /byang chub sems mchog rgya chen blos/ /phyi nang 'byor ba'i yo byad dag /thams cad byang chub don du bsngos/ /'dod chags rnam dag pad+mo'i dbyings/ /chos kun gyis ⑦ni de bzhin nyid/ /ye shes sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /de ring yid 'ong don chen gnyer/ /oṃ u ta ka lita sa ma ya snyiṇi/ pad+ma dga' ba'i sku mchog mnyes/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mtshan dpe phun sum tshogs pa yibya/ /bder yigashegs sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje chen pos gzhan rnams 'joms/ /mi shes dri ma kun sel ba'i/ /thugs mchog gsang ba'i chos mthar phyinati/ /rdo rje thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags snying po gsang ba'i chos/ /rab snang pad+ma'i dbyings nas 'phrula'/ /byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rin chen char 'bebs shing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal 'gyur ba/ /dpal mchog bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du gnas 103—258

'gyur khyab pa po/ /las mdzad rdo rje dam tshig ①mchog /mi mthun gnas rnams rab 'joms mdzad/ /rdo rje 'joms ②la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas nyid du/ /dbang bskur dugasang ba las byung ba/ /dam tshig ye shes rab grub mdzod/ /shes rab chos nyid las 'phrul ba'i/ /rjes su 'jug ༷pas snying rje'i tshogs/ /yang dag bden pa las byung ba'i/ /byin brlabs du'adod pa thams cad rdzogs/ /bder dugashegs sprul pa'i tshig tshogs ni/ /dbang bskur rdzogs mdzad pa yi rigasal/ /me tog phreng ba la sogs pas/ /slob ma brgyan ⑦par byas nas ni/ /phyir phyogs stegs bu la bzhag ste/ /gtor ma phyogs kun las byin ⑧nas/ /kun la gsol 'debs bsgo bya yo)zhing / /slob ma gzhug ⑩pa nyid du bya/ /ras gtsang dmar po'i rgyu las byung / /gnas gzhan ma spyad ma nyams par/ /rang gi sngags kyis ⑩byin brlabs tsonas/ /legs par gdong ni g.yog 8par bya/ /pad+mo'i ④thal sbyar rin chen phreng / /sngags brjod gzungs 'dzin rtse gcig tu/ /brtan por byang chub don gnyer bas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su mos pa bskyed/ /de nas slob tidapon blo ldan pas/ /theg chen lam la zhugs pa'i phyir/ /slob ma dag la slar smras pa/ /gsang sngags lam mchog zab pa 'di/ /shin tu bzung ba tsodaka' ba yin/ /khyod kyis bzung tshubar 'dod pa rnams/ /mi snyems 8pa yi blo bskyed nas/ /lta spyod mchog la gnas dgongs so/ /kye ma rdo rje gsang ba'i don/ /theg yichen snying po bla na so )med/ /tshe 'dis byang chub 'grub byed kyang / /rmongs rnams the tshom skye bar 'gyur/ /ngang tshul bzang po 'di rtogs pas/ /dus gsum rusprebazhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /byin 103—259

brlabs (1)ngo mtshar mchog brnyes tephyi/ /sems can don phyir tshul dang ldan/ /khyod kyis sgro skur dang bral gzhing / /dad brtson the tshom med par zung ④/ /de nas slob mas slar gsol pa/ /yang dag thugs rje cher (snyemanga' ba'i/ /mgon mchog rnams kyis bdag la gnong ⑥/ /'di dag bdag la gtol ⑨med pas/ /khyod kyis gsungs bzhin gsol bar 'tshal/ /slar yang rab gus dang ba'i ⑧yid / /tshul chen mi nyan dam tshig mchog /slob dpon che (9)la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor sras bcas tshogs/ /thugs mchog dri med bdag la dgongs / /bdag gis byang chub don gnyer bas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su mos pa bskyed/ /gar gyi dbang phyug bde chen mchog /mgon 'gyur rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /mya ngan las 'das pho brang 'dir/ /bdag nyid zhugs par mdzad pa legs/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /gsang ba'i mthe bo nas bzung ⑩ste / /yol ba'i nang du gzhug (1par bya/ /oṃ pad+mo sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya yo ga tsit+ta uta pā ta yā 12mi hūm̐ swā hā/ de nas gsang ba'i gnas zhugs (nyapas/ /tshamachod brnyes rgyun bshags tshal sogs kyis/ /snod du rung bar gyur pa dang / /dam tshig gsum sgrogs 7chu blud cing / /rdo rje gsang ba'i dam sgrogs shing / /phyag rgyas sngags kyi gnas gsum sbyang / /oṃ rgyal ba kun gyi 3 7khyod nyid ni/ /byin gyis brlab lho cing brtan mdzad pas/ /pad+ma gar dbang dkyil 'khor 'dir / /bdag med dam tshig spangs pa dang / /dad med brtson 'grus nyams pa dang / / blo dman shes rab chung ba dang / /yi blo dman rtog )'dzin la gnas la/ /srog gi phyir yang brjod mi bya/ /bde chen mgon po pad 'chang sku//khyod kyi snying la zhugs pa na/ /gsang ba'i ye shes gzhan brjod dus/ /snying 103—260

khrag 'thung zhing gzhan du shes/ /bdag ni gar gyi dbang phyug sku/ /khyod la thugs rjes bzung 6)byed pas/ /nga yis bsgo ba'i tshig 'di dag② /'da' bar rung ba ma yin no/ /bdag la brnyas shing 'khu byed na/ /rab gtum (0khro bo chen po'i sku/ /glad ④pa tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /lus sems dal ⑤sogs rdul du byed/ /gnas bzhi yi'abyung ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang sngags sa bon 'od zer bcas/ / dbab pa'i ⑦gsang sngags lan stong du/ /dri zhim bdug spos dril dkrol (kyezhing / /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug 6)par bya/ /des ni mtshan ma'i rtags mthong 'gyur/ /sku yi ye shes phyogs bcur g.yos/ /gsung gi ye shes gsang ba brjod/ /thugs kyi ye shes mngon shes gsal/ /sngags gsum phyag rgyas brtan par gnas/ /bden pa'i ye shes byin brlabs ⑩kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rigs kyi lha gang yin/ /bdag gis bskal pa ci 4stelta bar/ /dus 'dir dbab par mdzad par rigs/ /nor bu phreng ba gar 8bab pa/ /rigs de rang gi dam tshig 8nyid/ /sngags dang phreng ba ma lus pa/ /slar nyid de la sbyin par bya/ /gser gyi thur ma byin brlabs pas/ /ma rigs 'aldongs pa'i ling tog tshebasal/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /khyod kyi mig 'byed brtson par mdzad/ /ma rig bsgribs g.yogs bsal tsomadzad nas/ /pad+mo spyan bzang yidri ma med/ /oṃ pad+ma tsak+ṣu dz+nyā 1nyen pra be sha phaṭa/ rdo rjes gdong g.yogs bsal yi byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor gsal ba ( )bstan par bya/ /legs par ltos cig (7blo gros che/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba la sogs rnams/ /gsang sngags snying po dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /legs par zhugs te grub pa bzhin/ /me tog gang la bab pa yi/ /lha de rigs kyi dam tshig yin/ /shar gyi sgo srung sa nas 103—261

brtsams te/ /gtso bo'i bar du dkyil 'khor bstan/ /zhal zas na bza' la sogs pas/ /bla ma blo ldan mnyes par bya/ /yi dam lha sku phyag rgya sogs/ /gsang ba'i ming dang bcas par bstan/ /de ①ring dus nas bzung byas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob par/ /rab rib tha ma'i blo ldan pas/ /dus kun du ni gzung chabar bya/ /kye ma ho blo gros rgya mtsho'i gnas/ /'gro la bskyab ⑧pa'i don brtson la/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma la btud de/ /pho brang grong mchog nyams dga' 'dir/ /dbang bskur ba yi rin chen mdzod/ /snang mdzad lus la bab pa lags/ /rigs bzhin thugs rje brtse ④dgongs pas/ /dri ma'i skyon sol byin brlabs mdzod/ /gnang bar mdzad ⑤pa'i dus lags pas/ /skyob pa'i sku mchog thob par mdzod/ /shar gyi sgo phyogs khru do'i rgyab/ /dbang bsten (zhedakyil 'khor dbus kyi tshad/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas/ /dmar po'i tshon ⑦gyis legs byugs te/ /seng ge'i khri bshams pad+mor bcas/ /'khor los 98)sgyur rgyal tshul gyis gzhag⑨ /spyi bor gdugs ⑩mdzes rgyal mtshan g.yas / /dung dang zangs tunyedung sil snyan rnams/ /rol cha mchod 'cha phyogs mtshams 3 dgod/ /rgyan phreng gos kyis legs bklubs 8pa/ /dri chu sngags bcas yungs kur 7dang / /ku sha'i chu yis dag par bya/ /oṃ ma hā bin ta ha na ha na 0rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rigs kyi lhar bskyed de/ /bkra shis dag ⑩pa'i glu (3blangs shing / /rol mo rgyan phreng bkod byas te/ /bum pa'i chu yis dbang bskur bya/ / de yi 67phyir na 1sgrib tshogs dang / /bag chags nyon mongs gnas dag nas/ /lha yi chu rgyun dag pa'i mthus/ /ye shes phung po dbang phyug mchog /oṃ lha yi chu ni dag pa'i chu/ /rdo rje gsang gsum gnas ( spelas byung / /103—262

byang sems chu yis tshogs rnams dag /dbang bskur ba yis ①don thob mdzod/ /yon tan rin chen rnam dag mchog /rigs lnga'i ②sku rgyan byas pa yi/ /dbu rgyan bzang po'i cod pan bcas/ /kun 'byung rin chen phung po mchog /traṃ yon tan ma bcas pa yi rgyanadu/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar byed/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po che/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kun rdzob kun/ /ye nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /'od phreng sngags kyis brgyan byas pa'i/ /rtogs bcas tshogs rnams kun las rgyal/ /bder ④gshegs thugs rje rtse gcig pas/ /khams gsum gnas rnams dor mi mdzad/ /byang sems rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /rang rig ye shes gnas gsal byed/ /chos rnams skye ba med pa'i don/ /sgra brjod dngos po brag ca ⑤bzhin/ /stong pa'i dril bu gsung rang bzhin/ /de las sna tshogs rgya chen tshogs/ /lha chos kun rgyu yilas rnam grol zhing / /de bzhin rkyen med 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /rang bzhin pad+ma dag pa'i dbyings/ /nges pa'i theg ⑦pa ston byed gsung / /kye ho rdo rje che ge mo/ /rigs kyi mtshan gyis dbang bskur teni/ /chos sku 'od gsal bde ba che/ /pad+ma'i sgra dbyangs ming dang bcas / /oṃ phyag rgya chen po gsang ba'i gnas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis//mi mthun la sogs bcom byas te/ /rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs/oṃ badz+ra pad+mo a bhi ṣiñca lami/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a gi ṣiñca ti / oṃ a ti pa ti traṃ a bhi ṣiñca 7rta/ oṃ na ma che ge mo a bhi ṣiñca tsomi/ slob dpon lha la rab gus pas/ /tshogs bcas yon tan bzung 8byed cing / /rdo rje dam tshig skipa yi spun / /mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bskyang e/ /'di dag la gus smod 0byed pa/ /tshe srog rdo rje gtum pos 'phrog /sngags rnams dus su brjod bya zhing ⑩/ /phyag 103—263

rgya rgyun ①du bcing bar bya/ /gsang ba'i tshig dang mtshan ma'i tshogs/ /dus kun dag tu sba byas te/ /bdud rtsi lnga po sha sogs rnams/ /mnyam par shes pas rgyun du spyad②/ /bro drug glu drug stabs pa yi/ /brtul zhugs niganas skabs dag tu bya/ /nyon mongs chos lnga 'dod yon lnga/ /dam tshig nyams pas shes par spyad④/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya che/ /gnas gsum brtul zhugs la gnas shing / /lung bstan rjes gnang dbugs 'don pa'i/ /cho ga bzang po spyad 57par bya/ /de 97ni rdo rje slob dpon mchog /yon tan bza' ba'i gnas ⑦thob 'gyur/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya sku/ /yang dag sngags kyis byin brlabs te / /ma 'ongs bzung ⑧ba'i blo gnas pas/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig 6)rjes su zung ⑩/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta swa ra pad+ma sa ma ya snyi0/ oṃ da du shrī tunyepad+mo māṃ tsodha a / oṃ ma hā skyapad+mo swā hā tsosarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta skyes phaṭa/ mchod pa bkra shis bzang la klags7/ /brtul zhugs (nyemachog tu gyur pa yin/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don spyod pa'i/ /dngos grub thun mong cho ga'i las/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /dbye rmongs bskrad pa'i cho ga dang / /gsad pa la sogs las rnams kun/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di yi tshul/ /khyod kyis gang 'dod grub par gyis/ /de nas rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor rab sbyor bas/ /'khor ba'i chos rnams zil gnon cing / /phyogs bcur dam chos gsung sgrogs shing / /pha rol phyin drug gnas 'phags te / /sgro 'dogs the tshom khrirtogacod par byed/ /lung bstan bder ( 3gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /rigs mchog mdzad pa bla na med/ /rgyal ba kun gyis lung bstan mdzad/ /khams gsum 'dzin bcas kun las grol/ /'dod chags bral 103—264

ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum kun na gzhan med de/ /des na 'dod la ①chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /oṃ ma hā sa ma ya rtsu phaṭa/ /gsang sngags rgyun (mirnams 'dzin bya dang / /lha dang slob dpon gzung ①bar bya//'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gsung gcig sgo nas gsungs pa yin/ /'gro rnams kun la phan pa'i blos/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs brtson par gyis/ /dad brtson shes rab blo ldan pas/ /gang 'dod 'bras bu'i tshul la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i grong khyer 'dir/ /gang gis 'dod don gang gnyer ba/ /des ni sgrib sogs kun spangs shing / /mchog gnas ye shes gsal bar sbyor/ /bde chen gsang ba'i theg pa che/ /tshe 'di ( )byang chub 'grub par byed/ /nyon mongs dgra sogs las grol ba'i/ /bde ba chen po'i gnas thob pa'o/ /de nas lha dang bzhugs gnas pa'i/ /rnam (5)dag de nyid bstan bya ste/ /mchod sbyin gtor tshogs mgron gnyer cing / /bkra shis 'gro ba'i tshogs bsags (6)bya//slar stiyang slob ma blo ldan pas/ /yon mchog bla ma la phul te/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /mnyes byas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /shes rab yan lag phun sum tshogs/ /bcu drug yang 58na nyi shu bzhi/ /rdo rje bla ma la phul tetshor//byin gyis brlabs 7pa'i cho ga bya/ /khrus byas dri zhim rgyan gyis bklubs57/ /sna tshogs sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang tshogi/ /rigs kyi lha dang ldan byas pas/ /dam tshig yi bskul ba'i brdas mtshon tebla/ /gnyis med ye shes snyoms 'jug bya/ /byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor mchod byas pas/ /slob dpon tshogs la dbang yang bskur/ /ji ltar rgyal ba sras mchog gis/ /'jug pa po rnams tshim mdzad pa'i/ /gnyis med ye shes gsang ba'i don/ /103—265

dbab pa'i phyag rgya las ①byung ba'i/ /a la la ho/ oṃ āḥdus/ a ho su ka rang gi gnas/ /a ho ra geti tshim par mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /shes rab mchog ldan byin brlabs pa/ /slob ma'i lag tu gtad par bya/ /rang bzhin bde ba'i ye shes nyid/ /zag pa med pa'i don gsal 'gyur/ /rnam rtog med ④pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang gi dngos nyid mthong bar 'gyur/ /e ma ho 'gro ba'i gnas 'di dag⑤ /de bzhin nyid las gzhan du 'khrul/ /de dag bde chen ye shes pas/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba ci yang medam/ /ye shes 'di ni shin tu poyi/ /rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra zhing / /rdul bral thar ba zhi ba'i chos/ /rang gi rang bzhin de nyid do/ /de ⑦ni sbyin sreg ⑧gsang ba'i don/ /khyed rnams kun la phyir bshad de/ /dkyil 'khor chen po phyogs bzhi 'am/ /gzhan yang gnas gzhan gang 'thad ⑨par/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod dang / /las kun pa yi thab khung brtsam/ /zlum po khru gang zla kham kyidang / /gru gsum sna tshogs dbyibs can no/ /de dag dkar ser dmar dang nag /sna bzhi kun gyis mtshan (7pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma'i rgyan / /sna tshogs rdo rje mtshon kyicha can/ /khru gang bzhi dang gnyis med dang / /khru gsum de yi zhabs snyesu phyed/ /bud shing yam shing so so yi/ /mtshan nyid lo ⑫'bras kha dog ro/ /rtse mo cha las sor bzhi dang / /sor brgyad 'bacu drug nyi shu'i tshad/ /sbams pa'i so so'i mar gyis byug /rim bzhin rtsa ba bud khang ni/ /skum dang gru bzhi zla tigam dang / /gru gsum tshul du brtsig yipar bya/ /lha rnams kun gyi 'khang pa nyid/ /me yi gnas su gzhag 6)byas te/ /so so'i las dang mthun 67pa ste/ /ag ne rā tsa bod ( kyepar bya/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs phyag 103—266

rgyas g.yab①/ /g.yon pa bgrang phreng gzung ②bar bya/ /oṃ e h+ye ⑧nyi dusag ne ⑤ye ma hā ba ba hi swā hā/ khro bo ⑥rgyal pos gsung ④bya ste/ /me lha'i gdan mchod pad+ma dbul/ /de rjes mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /sreg nirdzas ma lus dbul byas nas / /lha rnams mchod pa'i phyag tshang 6)du/ /bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya / /g.yas g.yon dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis/ /khu bcud 'dzag pa'i rnam grangs dbul/ /oṃ ma hā a na la ma hā bhu tā badz+ra la basmi ku ru rtsu sasba duṣ+ṭan ⑩/ phaṭa/ /me lha mchod pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā ku ru pañca hūṃ/ dgang blugs ⑪dbul tiba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ba dha ha na badz+ra swā hā/ til gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra pudhe hūṃ/ me tog 8gi'o/ /oṃ sarba asna ④ye rtsu 8swā hā/ yam shing ngo / /oṃ badz+ra pū dza me gha ga lo ke shwa tsor hūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bya ba'i mchod pa'o / /oṃ dhu pe ti ⑩ba bu sha lhan dhe (nye sbyar ba'i mchod pa rnams so/ /oṃ a pra ti badzā ya yis hā/ ku sha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe ( )swā hā/ drur 0ba'i 'o/ /gzhan yang rdzas rnams gang tshogs pa/ /rang ming yi ge gsum sngags dbul 3/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kun mchod cing / /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab(nye/ /sdig bshags bag chags kun byas pas/ /lha yi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /tha ma me lha mchod byas nas/ /phrin tsolas so so'i sngags brjod cing / /oṃ badz+ra na ma sarba ta thā ga ta skṛ da (nyeyam ku ru hūm̐/ lha rnams gshegs su gsol zhing /dam tshig lha la tsobasdu bar bya/ /de nas rab gnas bzang po ni/ /'gro la phan phyir chabashad par bya/ /sa phyogs nyams dga' zhunyemadzes pa ru/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor legs byas te/ /mchod rdzas rdzas kyis mnyes byas nas/ /slob dpon chas ⑥su gzhug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgrubs byas nas/ /103—267

rten tshogs sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan gnas nas gshegs mdzad de/ /lha mo sgyu ①ma'i lhums zhugs phyinas/ /de bzhin 'dir yang bzhugs su gsol/ /dkon mchog gnas 'dir bzhugs ②nas kyang / /me tog la sogs mchod bzhes la/ /'di don gzung ④bar bya ba dang / /byang chub sems mchog spel bar mdzod/ /nang par rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ⑤ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni grub pa la/ /bka' drin cho ga mdzad par 'os / /de nas gnas rnams kun sbyangs nas/ /'gro drug gnas kun sgrol byed pa / /thams cad dus 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang / /gsang ba'i sngags ldan lha rnams kun/ /'jig rten mchod pa'i don phyir ro/ /rab gnas bzang por 'os pa lags/ /de nas gnas rnams kun sbyangs nas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa rdzogs byas te/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor ji lta bar/ /dbang bskur cho ga rdzogs byas nas/ /sbyin sreg gtor ma la sogs gtang / /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las lam khyad par du 'phags pa'i le'u ste (6)brgyad pa'o// //de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus thams cad 'dul bar mdzad pa de'i tshe / bdud kyi rgyal po shin tu mya ngan skyes te/ kye ma'o ho sangs rgyas 'dir ni bdag gi gnas la sogs pa bcom zhing rlag par skyed (7)na thabs ji lta bur (gugadul bar bya/ 'on kyang 'di nyid la ni bdag ci yang bya ba'i gnas med/103—268

shin tu dman par gyur pa 'byedag dang mtshungs par 'gran nam/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gsum pa ②'di dag ni/ srid pa mi sreg ①brlag par bya ba'i phrin ④las yin pas/ thams cad la bka' ⑤bsgo zhing / las ngan pa 'di dag la bzlog par bya'o zhes bsam mo/ /de nas 'jig rten gsum gyi gnas na mthu che ba dang / dbang dang gzi brjid thams cad 'dus nas/ kye khyed rnams bdag la nyon cig /'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag ni/ rgyal po gcig gi dbang du ma gnas na/ thams cad srid pa 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /des na phyogs thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa 'dus la/ bdag gi bka' nyan par mdzod cig ces bsgrags so/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi drag (7byed chen po'i tshogs kyis rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul bstan cing smras pa/ khyed ji lta bu'i nga rgyal can cig ⑦yin / nged rnams re res kyang (khu'akhor dpag tu med pa skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po yin pas/ yul 'khor grangs med pa la dbang byed cing / gzhan gyi re gnas dam par gyur pa lags pas khyod rang zhi ba la posteganas na legs so zhes mthun ⑩par brjod pas(nya/ bdud kyi rgyal po yang shin tu nyon mongs pas rgyas te gzhan dag la smras pa/ lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di dag kun/ /nga yi bka' las gnas pa yin/ /skye 'gro ma lus gang dag kun/ /rgyal po'i bka' gsang nyan par gyis/ /khams gsum bdag po lha yi nyugelha/ /sa rnams kun gyi sa steng pa/ /bdag tu ni mthu dang rdzu 'phrul tshad/ /kun gyis 'gran rdzipar nus ma 8yin/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na/ /srog srid brlag cing gnas kyang 'thor / /zhes brjod do/ /de nas tshangs pa'i rgyal posatso/ rang gi 'khor dpag tu med pa bsdus te/ de dag gi dbus nas srin po chen po'i gzugs 103—269

'dzin pa'i khro bor ①gnas nas/ rang gi mthu las sprul pa'i khro bo dang /mtshon cha'i tshogs spro ②bar mdzad do/ /de bzhin du khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang / blang ①gi ri ti dang / gzhon nu gdong drug pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi 'khor dang dudapag tu med pa bsdus te/ de dag gi dbus na 'gying zhing sprul pa bsam gyis rjomi khyab par spros te/ dbang dang rdzu 'phrul ston to/ /ri rab kyi kha khyer la gnas pa'i rgyal po chen po bzhis kyang rang rang gi 'khor gyi yidabus na 'gying zhing mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ston par mdzad do/ /gser gyi ri la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgya byin dang / dbang ldan dang / gshin rje dang / bden bral dang /chu lha dang / gnod sbyin dang / nyi ma dang / sa'i lha rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi gnas dang bcas par 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha dang bcas par 'khod do/ /nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / phur bu dang / pa ⑦ba sangs dang / spen pa dang / gza' chen po rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pas 'jigs pa'i khro bo'i tshogs dang / mtshon char bcas pas 'khod do//mtha' yas dang / 'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang / rigs ldan dang /nor rgyas dang / dung skyong dang / pad+ma dang / chu lha ⑧rnams kyis rang rang gi g.yog 'khor rnams dang / 'jigs pa'i sprul pas 'khod do/ /de bzhin du khams gsum gyi dregs byed kyi tshogs gnas pa'i gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /grul bum dang / 'gro ba drug gtso bo dbang che zhing mthu yod pa rnams dang /ma mo rnams dang / gshin rje dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / 'dab bzangs po)dang —/ srin po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / rgyu skar gyi tshogs su bcas pa 103—270

rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 6)dbus na 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyi ②mtshon cha dang nga ro dang bcas pas rnam par 'phrul zhing 'khod do/ /de nas bdud kyi rgyal po yang nyon mongs pa skyes te/ rang gi 'khor rnams 'du bar mdzad cing rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa ci yod pa dus 'di dag gcig gtu ston ④nas / mtshon cha sna tshogs 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang nas drag po 'bar bar (9'jigs pa'i skur ston to/ /khro mo'i tshogs dang rol pa mdzad pa lags/ 'khor ba'i tshogs mtshon cha me 'od bcas pa phyogs bcur spros te nam mkha' thams cad gang bar byas nas thog ser nad dang tshub ma thams cad skyes so/ /des 'jig rten gyi lha kun myos shing rmongs par gyur pa ⑥dang / 'jigs (7pa'i tshogs kyis phyogs thams cad nas/ 'khor ba'i me 'od 'bar ba'i mtshon chas bsad cing gtubs ⑧pa las/ so so'i tshogs bred par gyur te/ rang gi snying po phul zhing skyabs su gsol lo/ /de nas lha thams cad 'du bar byed pa'i bdud kyi sde de dag la mnas dor 6)zhing dam tshig byin te/ so so'i snying po blangs te/ 'khor tshogs thams cad rje dpon dang bral te/ lha chen po brgyad ni rang gi rtse la 'khod ⑩do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi ni shar gyi gling la 'khod tunyedo/ /gnod sbyin dang / phyogs skyong dag ni shar gyi gling phran ciganyis su 'khod 4)do/ /'gro ba ris 8drug gi sems can rnams ni lhor dgod tsodo/ /dri za dang ma mo rnams ni lho'i gling phran la dgod do/ /lha ma yin rnams ni nub tu dgod ⑩do/ /gshin rje dang 'dab bzangs yodang srin po rnams ni nub kyi gling gi gling phran gnyis la dgod (nyedo/ /gza' dang rgyu skar rnams ni byang du dgod 4)do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa gsang ba bla na med pa las/ bdud ru 103—271

kyi sprul pa bstan pa'o/ /de nas bdud kyi rgyal po de nyid shin tu dga' zhing 'khor thams cad la bka' bsgo bsti/ rgyal po gcig gi 'khor du gnas pas ni/yid dang mthun du par spyod pas gnas pa yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang ngas ci ③ltar bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin nyon la/ thar pa'i lam 'di chod la/ ston pa gzhan la gus par ma byed cig /kho ④po'i ⑤'jig rten stongs par 'ong ngo /bsam pa rgya chen po ⑥med pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag ni/ gti mug can gyi rang bzhin te / byol song lta bu yin pas/ bde legs kyi gnas thob pa'i don med pa yin no/ /yang tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ kye 'du shes med pa'i 'gro ba dag /rang gi bde ba spong byed cing / /thar pa'i lam gzhan sgrub ⑤byed pa/ /de dag 'khrul pas rang rgyud brlag /nyes 'dod bde legs spong byed pa/ /rmongs pas 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /re zhig (9)thugs rje skal ldan pas/ /bdag gi 'khor du 'dus pa yin/ /gnas gzhan gong ma thob ⑩'dod pas/ /bdag (nyal dad sems gus par gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de dag gis kyang de ltar nyan te0she / rang rang gi gnas shor zhing mya ngan gyi sems skyes kyang ci tu ltar bya ba'i thabs med de/ de ltar 'khod cing gnas so/ /de nas bdud kyi rgyal po rang gi gnas su song ste/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dga' ba'i longs yispyod 'dod pa'i yon tan la spyod cing / dgyes pa'i glu gar dang rol mo la spyod do/ /ji ltar khams gsum kun gyi bdag po ni bdag 7yin pas 'di las lhag pa'i bsgrub bya ni gzhan dag yod par bdag gis ma mthong ngo / /da (7sangs rgyas yonakyi tshogs dang byang chub sems dpa' dag kyang bdag 32gi dbang du bsdu na thabs ci 17ltar brtsam zhing / rang gi 'khor dag la yang 'dri bar byed do/ /de nas 103—272

bdud kyi ①gong khyer kun la bsgo ste/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rnams la mi dge ba'i ltas (midang mtshan ma ngan pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi bsgrub (snyepa thams cad du rab tu 'chad cing / ci 'dod pa rnams la grub par bya na bdag cag la mos pa byed do/ /de'i rjes la de dag gi gtso bo rnams bdag gi 'khor du 'dus pa'i tshe thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gdul bar bya'o/ /gal te 'ongs par ma nus pa bdag ④ni kho rang gi gnas de nyid dang bcas pa gzhom par bya'o zhes brjod do//de'i stong gsum g.yo bar byed pa'i tshogs kyi khro bo'i mtshon cha'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprul nas/ dkar po'i rigs (5)la dga' ba'i 'gro ba rnams ma lus bcom zhing / sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang brlag par bshams pa las/ bden pa'i mthu gang la gnod par ma gyur to/ /de nas rab tu khros te/ bdag gi khams gsum 'di dus gcig tu gdul bar bya spyod pa la/ ngan pa'i tshul can g.yo sgyu dang bcas pa 'di dag mi 'dul lam/ de rang gi sde tshan 'og ma la gnas pa kun bskul te/ thar pa'i lam la gnas pa 'di dag rigs kyis gdul (6)bar bya'o zhes brjod do/ /de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa bsgo bar mdzad pa dang / de dag gis kyang rang rang gi sprul pa dang /mtshon cha rnams phyogs kun du spro zhing / rang gi gsang sngags drag po'i tshogs dag kyang rjod (7par byed do/ /des 'jig rten 'khrugs shing g.yos nas thams cad bred par gyur to/ /bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud rinalas / bdud kyi sde dang bcas pa shugs 'byung ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan bde chen mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid kyis/ /103—273

stong gsum so sor 'dul mdzad phyir/ /rnam 'phrul ting 'dzin gnas la bzhugasal/ /de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje che dang smon lam mthus / /so so'i las rtog ①mthun ②bzhin du/ /sna tshogs rtog pa'i tshul ma ston / /'dod chags la zhen smon pa dag /chags pa chen pos 'dul bar mdzad / /de bzhin zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag nidog 'dul don du/ /mthun ④byas snang ba sna tshogs dang / /mi mthun sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad/ /pad+mo bder ⑤gshegs rdo rje don/ /rin chen rin chen las sna tshogs/ /phyag rgya che sogs 'khor lo sgyur⑥/ /ji lta ba bzhin dag par mdzad④/ /thabs chen rnam dag pad+mo'i don/ /shes rab sprul pa'i mchog 'gyur bsani/ /gar gyi dbang phyug bde ba che/ /rdo rje lta nyid sprul par mdzad/ /gzhan yang mdzad pa rgya chen po/ /sna tshogs mthu yis 'dul mdzad de/ /dag pa'i 'gro ba mthun ⑨byas sku/ /gser 'od mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /go byed theg pa bla na med/ /zab mo gsang sngags ji bzhin par/ /rgyal ba bder ⑩gshegs phyag rgya'i sku/ /rab sprul dkyil 'khor sna tshogs pa'i/ /la las byang sems rgya chen mchog /la lar lam lnga dag par sbyorayi/ /la lar pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs/ /la lar 'bras bu'i don la sbyor/ /la lar dga' ldan lha yul 'phags/ /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa ⑩dang / /'jig rten spyod mthun 8rol rtsed sogs/ /gzhan gyi skur spang tsobya ba rnams7/ /bcas ku'i can gyi bsam 'phrul pa/ /mthun nya)'jug thabs kyi bya ba mchog /dka' thub mdzad dang dka' ⑩ba spyod/ /rdo rje gdan la yang sangs rgyas/ /bdud 'dul mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shing / /rtse gcig ting 'dzin bskul nas bzhugs/ /cho 'phrul mdzad pa kun 'dul 103—274

zhing —/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rim ①bzhin bskor/ /mya ngan 'da' tshul ring bsrel ⑧ston / /zhi tshogs khro bor 'khyil pa dang / /rang byung dud 'gro'i gzugs sna tshogs / /snod kyi 'jig rten kun mthu sku/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug 'jig rten skyong ske/ /bdud dang srin po gzugs sogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i las rtog dag mdzad cing / /rang gi ye shes don bkod bya/ /de tshe 'gro ba'i gnas mtshon tshogasal/ /las kyi stobs tshogs mthus brdabs rnams/ /de bzhin nyid mthus tshogs chen pos/ /yang dag lam las rab grol zhing / /nga rgyal chen po'i dregs tshogs skyes/ /rang gi mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ston/ /nyon mongs las kyi lam la zhen/ /rang gi rigs tshogs bsdu bar byed/ /'jig rten gsum 'jig a la la/ /khams gsum gtso bo ①bdag cag rnams/ /su zhig sprul pa a la la /'jig ④par mdzad pa'i 'os ma lags/ /rang gi dka' ⑤thub bde gnas pas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam mchog ste/ /gzhan gyi bstan pa ci zhig bya/ /bde tshogs 'jigs pa'i yan lag go/ /su zhig rang gi bde spong zhing / /gzhan nas sdug bsngal don gnyer ba/ /gzugs mang sprul pa bsam yas kyang / /rang gi sku mdzes bsgyur ba dka'ayi/ /sgra mang sprul pa bsam yas pas rang gi gsung nyan 'phro byed dam/ /sems rtog phyibya ba'i 'od bcas kyis/ /ting 'dzin rtse gcig 'gyur ba med/ /drag po'i stobs mchog gzi ldan rnams/ /rang gis rang spyod bde bar sdod/ /de nas bdud dpung dang po dang / /dbang phyug tshangs pa khyab 'jug che/ /rgya byed glu dang dregs byed rnams/ /rab tu khros te rang gi mthus/ /ston zhing drag po'i gsang sngags dang / /gtum tshig nga ro 'bod sgrogs (nyebyed/ /de tshe rgyal po'i byin brlabs 6)mthus/ /103—275

mthun 6)'jug thabs kyis 'dul mdzad de/ /theg pa gsang ba bla med mchog /khyad par sgo gsum gyigasang byed cing / /yang dag don la bde bkod ①phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos mthun limadzad de/ /'jug pa'i lam ring bde bstan zhing / /dga' ba'i sgo nas bde mdzad kyang / /rang gi nyon mongs dregs pa'i mthus/ /don 'jug mthun 5)pa'i 6)spyod sgo 'jig /gti mug chen po mun gtibs ⑦nas//nga rgyal ri bo kun du bkod(nya/ /zhe sdang me lce 'bar bsregs shing dzi)/ /phrag dog rlung 7gis bskyod byas nas/ /'dod chags chu bos 'byin par 'gyur/ /dregs pa'i mthu yis rab khros (1te/ /tshogs rnams gcig la gcig bsgo ⑩zhing //gsang sngags rdzu 'phrul stobs phyung nas/ /rab tu bsgrags pa'i mthu yis ni/ /'jig rten gsum dag 'khrug par byed/ /mi nad mu ge 'khrug pa dang / /mtshon cha lo tog 'bras bu 'phrog /'byung po'i 'jigs gzugs nyes tshogs rnams / /rgyun mi 'chad du 'khor bar 'byung / /sa gzhi me 'bar chu bdag byed / /dug dang dbyig dug rlung bzhin g.yos/ /bde lam mtho ris thar lam gcod / /mi dag sems kyis non 'gyur zhing / /'gro rnams sdug bsngal bskyed byas 1 pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs khral bskyed/ /de nas byang chub sems bcas pa'i/ /'khor rnams dus gcig bstan par bzhengs/ /gtso bo'i phyogs su 'dud byed cing / /lan grangs bskor zhing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mgon po bde ba mnyes byed cing / /mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /thugs rje che mnga' salha yi lha/ /byams sogs dga' ba'i bdud rtsi chus/ /gdos bcas thal bar brlag mdzad pas/ /thim 'gyur rdo rje ye shes tshogs/ /cho 'phrul dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol/ /mdzad pa'i byin brlabs 7bstan du gsol/ /103—276

de dag nyon mongs rlabs 'khrugs 6)pas/ /rang gzhan ②thar lam bde bar 'joms / /byang chub sems nyid rlan bral lam/ /srid gsum yal bar dor byed na/ /thugs rje chen po gang la gdagasani/ /e ma ho 'bras bu mya ngan 'das / /e ma ho byang sems pad+ma'i rdzing ④/ /e ma ho brjod bral ku mu daphyi/ /e ma ho me tog 'bras bcas shing / /'di dag dkyil 'khor rnam dag pas/ /rigs mchog mtshan nyid yon tan gnas/ /dus 'dir dag par ga la mdzad/ /thugs rje chen po ga la gdags/ /'di dag skal ldan gsung ba'i snod/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /da ltar rnam rtog ri bos non/ /thabs kyis 'dul bar mi 'gyur bsayi/ /shugs kyis bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor sna tshogs bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ( )dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog ⑧rol pa'i rgyud chen po las mdzad pa chen po'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha chen po rnams 'dul bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te(9)/ rdo rje bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings nas phyung ste 0)sprul pa mdzad do/ / gru bzhi pa yinyal sgo bzhi pa'i/ /rta babs rgyan tshogs kun gyis spras/ /rin chen nor bu'i phreng sogs dang / / bhan dha sna dril bu 'dod pa lnga yi (stetshogs/ /mchod pa bla re rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /kha dog nyi shu rtsa lngas spras/ /'khor lo re'u mig dgu pa las/ /seng ge la sogs gdan khri spras/ /ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha tenya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa mnye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba ⑩bha ma/ ya ra la 103—277

wa / sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ye shes ma 'dres bde chen gsal/ /rnam 'phrul rigs mchog gzungs kyi dam tshig dang / /khro zhing 'dren pa'i mdangs kyis gnas/ /rigs gnyis lung gis rgyud pa'i sku/ /dmar nas zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal ①gnyis dag /bzhin mdangs tshangs pa'i tshul gyis ②gnas / /dbus ma khro 'dzum brjid bag dang / /pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /dril bu rin chen rtse gsum 'dzin/ /rin chen phreng ba'i chun 'phyang ①dang / /mu tig do shal dpung rgyan spras/ /stod g.yogs smad dkyis na bza' bklubasaskyi//dbu rgyan snyan cha sor gdub ④tshogs/ /mtshan bzang dpe byad mdzes par brgyan / /rigs kyis (nyamachod pas dbu skra sil/ /rang 'od btsun mo'i sku bcas pa/ /phyung phyinas phyogs bcu'i sngags kyis spros/ /hūm̐ phaṭa pad+mo skṛ ga ⑤dza swā hā/ oṃ phroṃ rdu gin dha dza pra mo haṃ/ mdzad pa'i phrin ⑨las rdzogs byas nas/ /slar 'dus 7bdag po'i sku la thim/ /shar du rnam snang phyag rgya che/ /gser mdog zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rtse gsum be 9)rtson pad+mo ral gri bhan dha tunye'adzin / /lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan nyid/ /mthing ga 8zhal gsum phyag drug pa / /rin chen pad+ma gri gug dang / /shu chal bum pa rtse gsum 'dzin/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /thod dbyug rtse gsum pad+mo dang / /dgra sta 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin/ /byang du don yod grub pa nyid / /ljang gu 8zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /ral gri rdo rje dbyug pa mdung / /pad+mo tshartse gsum gshin rje'i rkang / /kun gyi g.yas dkar g.yon pa ni/ /dmar ljang ser dang le brgan 3 7mdog /rang gi btsun mo'i mgul (nyanas 'khyud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis bdag po lhar/ /sku mdog gsang ba'i mdangs dang ldan//103—278

phyag dang cha lugs kun gyis brgyan/ /oṃ dzi na dzi ga lo/ dwo ṣa ①ra ti/ swa rat+na dzog② /mi mo ha ra ti/ oṃ ā ①jo lika /paṃ rā ④ga ra ti/ ha pradz+nyā sgrig /ṭ+wāṃ ⑤badz+ra ra ti/du sa phaṭa swā hā/ 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs bcas pas / /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar mdzadagye/ /'khor lo sgyur ⑧rgyal cha lugs dang / /dgyes pa'i skyil krung yo)tshul gyis bzhugs/ /khyams kyi phyogs dang mtshams rnams su/ /sems dpa' brgyad dang sems ma brgyad/ /thugs kyi ye shes yi ge las/ /rang gi gsang sngags dag gis gdon/ /sa snying dkar ser rin chen 'dzin/ /nam snying mthing ga ⑩ral gri 'dzin/ /spyan ras ⑩dmar skya pad+ma 'dzin/ /gsang bdag ljang skya rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon pa pad+mo yu ba can/ /bsnyems 8pa'i tshul gyis phyogs su 'dud/ /sgeg mo phreng ba dbyangs dang gar/ /dkar ser dmar ljang 'od 'phro mdog /me long rin chen phreng ba dang la/ /dbyangs snyan gar thabs mdzes pa'i tshul/ /oṃ k+shi ra dza tiya/ hūm̐ ⑫ lā gye sa byam ya lti/ ṭ+wāṃ mā ⑩le sa ma ya ()ho/ hrīḥpad+ma bhan dha ༷hri/ girti ⑪ra ho haṃ/ a dz+ra ()ti ra ga yā 0mi hūm̐ phaṭa/ byams pa dkar ser klu shing 'dzin//sgrib sel 'khor lo mthing ga duste/ /'jam dpal dmar skya ut+pal/ /kun bzang 'aljang ser rin chen snyetso/ /g.yon pa pad+mo lcug ma 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i stabs kyis gdan dul bzhugs/ /bdug spos me tog 'thor ba dang / /mar me dri chab lha mo rnams/ /ser dkar dmar ljang go rims tsobazhin/ /mtshan dang mthun ()pa'i rdzas kyis mdzes/ /oṃ me ra ni/ dza dhū pa (shepra be sha /thi ling swa ra ma pa ⑥ya/ hūṃ bus pa ā ṭaṃ )be sha hūṃ swa ra tsa ya/ baṃ dī pa (7bu gi ni / māṃ shi ra tsa duya/ ho gan dhe zhi tsi ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar sgor gshin rje 103—279

gshed po che/ /mthing nag be con rtse gsum phreng 6)/ /lho sgor stobs chen ser skya'i mdangs②/ /rdo rje zhags pa rin chen phreng / /nub sgor rta mchog 'jigs byed rgyal/ /thod sprul dril bu lu gu rgyud/ /byang sgor rdo rje 'khyil pa ste/ /ljang skya ①rdo rje rtse gsum mthu/ /khro bo cha lugs rngam brjid dang / /dur khrod rim pa'i chas kyis brgyan/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog khyidril/ /spyan dmar 'jigs byed 'od dpung dang / /rdo rje mche ⑤sogs khro gnyer can/ /yab yum 'khyil pa brkyang ⑥bskum sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa ru lu'i gsung 'don cing / /las kyi 'khor lo gnon pa'i tshul/ /oṃ ru lu pad+mān ta yod gartsu phaṭa/ dza badz+ra kro dhī ⑧shwa ri hūm̐ pra dz+nyān+ta yod po)phaṭa/ hūm̐ rat+na kro dhi 0shwa ri/ hūm̐ pad+mān ta yod yiphaṭa/baṃ pad+ma kro dhi snyishwa ri hūm̐ bi ga nān ta yod/ ho kurma kro dhi ⑩sha ri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/phyi nang med par dkyil 'khor chen po ste/ /thugs yirje ye shes che las sprul/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi 7rgyas btab ⑩cing / /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /'od dpung sprul pa'i lha 'khor gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po snang byed cing / /tshangs pa la sogs lha chen brgyad rnams 'gugs/ /rdo rje brjid gnon sngags kyi mthus / /de dag dran pa med par 'gyur/ /mtshon cha'i tshogs kyis (1sgrol byas te / /dug gsum phung po gsol bar mdzad/ /phrin (shelas khro bo brjid glu yis/ /lha chen 'khor rnams dbang du sdud(/)/ /dkyil 'khor chen por gzhag ( )byas nas / /snga ma'i sha rus gnas ( nyanas ston/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lha chen rnams kyis slar lus gsol/ /'khor bcas pa yi dbang bskur zhing / /rdo rje 'chang gi gral 8nyal dgod/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i brdas bsgos (nyeshing / /phrin ( )las bka' ( nyanyan gnyer gtad de/ /gzhal yas khang gi rgyan 6nyadu bzhagazhunya /103—280

kun kyang tshig dbyangs mthun pa bsgos1)/ /dam tshig mna' srog thal myong 'gyur zhes brjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las rdo rje bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas pad+mo (michags pa'i skus/ /gsung gi gzi mdangs rgyas mdzad do/ /phyag rgya rdzu 'phrul gnas sbyor bas/ /gser mig 'dab bzangs ⑧grong khyer dang / /lang ku'i gnas tshogs srin po'i sde/ /klu rgyal dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir//rdzu 'phrul kun stobs 'khor lo yis/ /lha chen la sogs gdul bar dgongs/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /pad+mo zhung)rta mchog sprul pa mdzad/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings snyoms 'jug las/ /sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /rdo rje 'dzin thub 4)dbang nyid dang / /rigs (6)nyid sprul pa'i lung las grub/ /sku mdog dmar po rā tsoga'i mdog /zhal gsum rta mgo ljang gu 47can/ /phyag ni ⑨gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ gti /thod pa khrag me dpung sprul lnga/ /gnas brgyad klu bdag thod phreng dang / /glang chen stag gi pags 5nyepa gyon/ /sgra skad drag po phyogs bcur sgrogazhurta /bgegs la sogs pa'i cha lugs can/ /drang /nyesrong khros pa'i cha lugs kyis8/ /klu yi 'gro ba rmongs mdzad pa/ /pad+ma'i gdan la brkyang bskum gyis / /yum chen dpal ldan ma dang sbyor/ /oṃ pad+mo gu ru he he ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/'khor lo 'bar ba phyogs mtshams su/ /ye shes khro bo chen po brgyad/ /trī blalas grub pa'i 'jigs gzugs can/ /rta mgo ljang gu 8brjid pa yi/ /shar du pad+ma'i dbang phyug ni/ /dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /rdo rje pad+ma klu 103—281

phrin (7las mdzad pa'i phyag /zhal dang sku ni so so'i mdog /oṃ ru khu ⑤si ta gu na ṭī eta sa mo ra ga hūṃ phaṭa snying po'i sngags so/ /o badz+ra ḍā ④kyi dzā ⑤la shaṃ pa ra ku ma yir t+t+waṃ phaṭa nye ba'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki ①rgyu saṃ ba ra dzā ⑧bla mu kha ma me hūm̐ phaṭa rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi ⑨dkyil 'khor spro ba'i mthus/ /de dag dran 7pa med par brgyal/ /slar nyid rang gi 'khor du bsdus/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor chen por bkod/ /de nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gdul bya rnams kyi gnas dor nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung 7byed cing / /rdo rje theg pa 7sbyor bar mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las mkha' 'gro ma sprul pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan dgyes pa'i gtso/ /gar gyi dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs / /gzi ldan yum dang zhal sbyor zhing / /phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'o/ /ting nge 6nya'adzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /phyogs kyi bgegs 'dul byed pa'o/ /khams gsum gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gnas/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i khang bzangs nali/ /rin chen pad+ma seng ge'i gdan/ /dri med nyi zla spras pa la/ /dbus kyi lha mchog chen po ni/ /zhabs brgyad phyag ni bcu drug dang / /dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /bgegs la sogs pa'i tshul dang ldan/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo gri'i/ /thod pa rin chen dgra sta ras/ /yum chen dbang phyug sgeg mo dang / /rgyan tshogs rin chen phreng ba can/ /dri med pad+mas bklubs ⑩pa'o/ /oṃ ba ga tunyeb te ru (ste kai saṃ 6)10(2—288

po ga ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdun du rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /dkar ser rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yas su rin chen sems dpa' ste/ /ser po rin chen 'khor lo thogs / /rgyab tu pad+mo'i sems dpa' nyid/ /dmar ser rtse gsum bum 6)pa thogasal/ /g.yon du las kyi sems dpa' ste/ /ljang ser dril bu tri shu ②la/ /oṃ badz+ra swat+ta hūṃ ①phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na susta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma swat+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kurma swat+ta tsū phaṭa/ 'khor lo pad+ma'i rtse mo la/ /yum dang 'khril ba'i tshul gyis 'khod / /phyi rol pad+ma'i rigs bdun la/ /bder ④gshegs yab yum nyis ⑤stong tshogs/ /bder yigashegs rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma rgya gram sna tshogs mkha' / /sku mdog pad+ma rā phyag dang / /in+d+ra la sogs rim bdun la/ /ral pa rtse mdzod bum pa la/ /lcug ma dril bu glegs bam dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan phreng ⑧ba 'dzin/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rin chen rgyan phreng 'od mdangs 6)can/ /phyag mtshan gri gug thod pa dang / /pad+ma'i phreng ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /lhag pa'i phyag bzhi 'dzin par mdzad/ /dang por yirang rtags phyag rgya bsnams/ /oṃ badz+ra du ki bi shi (steka du rku di kai (nyamo hri si ga ta r+ghaṃ sra mo ta phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mo yo ga ta tuges ra la 8su hūṃ phaṭa/ rin po che rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ pad+ma rbu si nyi haṃ skote he mo baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma'i rigs rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ kurma bh+yo hūm̐ yi: rak+ṣa mur+ya 9/ sa hūm̐ phaṭa/las kyi rigs kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra rbu si ti yo gī tu shwa ri rtsu phaṭa/ 'khor lo'i rigs kyi'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs rnams kun du spros byas pas(ste/ /rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya yinas ni/ /phyogs kyi rgyal po'i gdon rnams 'gugs/ / skrag shing byed (spenas dgra (na 'gugs shing / /so so'i rigs 103—289

dbyer 'khrug pa dag /rdo rje gsang ba'i sngags kyis gzer/ /rang gi dam tshig rjes su dran/ /srog gi snying po dbul ①bar bya/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig gis / /dbang bskur byin brlabs rdzogs byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gnas su 'khod/ /gsang ba 'dzin pa'i gnas 'dor ②nas②/ /rang gi lus su gnas byas te/ /gzhal yas khang gi rgyan ༷du gzhag /de dag gi snying po ni/oṃ sa mu da ra dzin na ga su tra bha ba si tri sdi sha hūm̐ rbu phaṭa zhes pa'o/ /slar dugaso ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ su mu ge ḍi du myag ⑦te he ru tu pa la si rta dza rgyu phaṭa/ lha rnams kyi snying po bsdus pa ni/ /oṃ sarba sa ka ra rbu bag sha si me baṃ mu rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las khams gsum gnon pa'i le'u ste bcwa 9kyelnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan gar dbang sku/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus mdzad nas / /khro bo'i dkyil 'khor sprul byas te/ /gnod sbyin grul bum 'dul bar mdzad / /gzhal yas gru gsum mthing nag la/ /dbus su 'khor lo nyi ma'i gdan / /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /dur khrod chen po'i rgyan gyis brjid/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug ste/ /sku mdog pad+ma rā yo)ga'i mdangs/ /rtse gsum gtun shing ral gri 7dang / /pad+ma zhags pa thod rnga (nya'adzin/ /glang chen ko 8ba thod rlon sprul/ /yum dang zhal sbyor 'khril ba'i tshul/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las/ /yi ge las sprul khro bo'i rgyan/ /shar du rnam rgyal mdog dkar sngo / /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje dung / /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral 103—290

gri me 'od kyis ①mtshan pa/ /lho ru gshin rje gshed po ni/ /sngo nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /thod dbyug rin chen ne'u le dang / /rtse gsum me dpung thod rnga ②'dzin / /nub tu rta mchog khro bo'i ③sku/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dmar skya'i mdog /'khor lo sdigs mdzub 0rtse gsum dang / /ral gri thod pa ḍa ⑤ma ru/ /byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ /ljang sngon duzhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rgya gram gri gug pad+ma dang / /be con rtse gsum seng ge 'dzin/ /shar lhor dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /sngo skya zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /dbyug pa tsakra pad+ma dang / /rnga yab bhan dha rgyadril bu 'dzin/ /lho nub mi g.yo mgon po ni/ /zhal gsum ser skya phyag drug pa/ /rin chen ral gri gtun shing 'dzin/ /pad+ma thod khrag mdung rtse gsum / /nub byang 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /dmar skya zhal gsum phyag drug pa / /rdo rje dbyug pa durin chen bum/ /thod pa bdud rtsi snying 'dzin pa'o/ /byang shar stobs chen dud ku'i 6)mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mdangs / /rdo rje rtse gsum bam chen khog /sna tshogs rdo rje bam chen khrag /'jigs pa'i cha lugs khro phreng dang / /gyad kyi dor thabs rol pa'i stabs/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi 0dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān (nyeta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha kyiha ya spyi tib hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇa ḍa ⑩li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa 8rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya ⑩a tsa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha ṭak+ki rā dza tsos phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha 4)ma hā ba la hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyogs skyong (stergyal po yiganod sbyin dang / /grul bum tshogs rnams dbang bsdus te/ /gsang sngags drag pos bsgral byas na/ /slar gsol ()ye shes lhums su gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhing / /dam tshig la gzhan (gyedakyil 103—291

'khor tshul/ /kun gyi srog snying phul ba ni/ /dam tshig chen pos byin brlabs mdzad / /slar yang dam tshig 'dzin pa'i sngags/ /'khor rnams kun la sbyin par mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra kra kur murda si na ba mu ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥphyirgyu badz+ra su ka ②ta bha mo (5)rta a la la r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ lha rnams kun gyi ④dam tshig ni/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung / /rdo rje gnod sbyin drag po'i sku/ /khams gsum dus kyis ⑤dbang bskur nas/ /'khor ba'i chos las rgyal byed cing / /byang chub sems kyis de nyid gsal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las khro bo phrin skyolas rol pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan gar dbang skus/ /gzi brjid dgod pa'i rgyan (pebakod cing / /lha min grong khyer 'dul ba'i phyir/ /yum gyi dkyil (nya'akhor 'phrul ⑫bar mdzad/ /chos dbyings sprul pa'i gnas bzang mchog /rgyal ba'i rang bzhin rin chen spros/ /gru bzhi khang pa sgo dang bcas/ /rta babs ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /gnyis med rol pa'i yum ⑩gyi sku/ /mdog dmar rgyan du zangs chen gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi mdzes pa'i mdangs/ /'khor lo dung khrag pad+mo dang / /rin chen 'bar ba rtse (medagu 'dzin/ /rin chen pad+ma'i phreng ba can/ /stod bzang tshonyan bza' dkyil bzang 1/bzhugs/ /oṃ pad+ma mu sha ra sa ma ka ta hūṃ phaṭa/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /pad+ma dbyings phyug thugasal ba mo/ /rin chen phreng ba glu kyim che / /dkar dmar ser dang ljang gu'i nyamadog /rdo rje gsum pa pad+mo dra ba 103—292

dang ske/ /na ra si la'i ①snod rin tshogs/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor ma spros shing / /sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /oṃ tsun dhe ②shu ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṇi sha badz+ra saṃ rbu ga hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byi gtsu swa te hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma ④la /de bzhin bde ba skyed ⑤byed yum chen bzhi/ /dra ba mo dang glog ⑥'gyur rgyan/ /gshog pa can dang 'dod pa'o/ /dkar ser dmar skya sngo bsangs ⑦dang / /ljang gu ⑧mdog legs la bzhugs nas/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+mo ⑨dang / / ut+pal ljang gu ⑩legs mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ nu te no 7tsa kru rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ saṃ tunyepo ga ta su he bya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ma kri phroṃ he he rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ta re ga ga na a (nyam la rtsu phaṭa / phyogs rnams kun du mkha' khyab pa/ /til gang bzhin du gnas gyur pal/ /ma mo gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kun/ /'khrug rngam rod rod por gyur nas / /thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /srog gi snying po dbul tsobar byed/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdus byas te/ /rang gi gnas su tsodabang bskur zhing / /dam tshig ⑩dga' ba'i sdom pa rnyed/ /bder yonagashegs ye shes gsal bar 'gyur / /kun gyis mthun (shepar khas blangs te/ /dam tshig bsrung 4)zhing rnal 'byor skyong / /oṃ ma ma rak+ta sa pra ti yid rda du sa bu ta phaṭa/ oṃ trak+ta ra la si bad ṭa ta phaṭa/ ma mo dang 'byung po rnams kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ yu me si dha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ āḥrgyu yo ga bri gu me/ ha sa ha sa / ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ slar gso zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las rin chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'phrul 4 nyepa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //103—293

sku gsung ①thugs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /sa 'og sa bla sa stengs ②rnams/ /'joms byed gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /bdud dang de yi rigs 'khor kun/ /'du bar bya ba'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms zhugs 'khor lo sprul pa mdzad/ /thabs dang shes rab bsgrub byas pa'i①/ /'od zer gsal bas stong gsum gang ske/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /sgo bzhi rta babs phreng bas brgyan / /'khor lo rim gsum gdan dang bcas/ /rdo rje pad+ma rin chen gyis/ /khor yug seng ge glang chen mchog /nyi mas mdzes pa'i pad+mo ④yi/ /dbus kyi dpa' bo yum dang bcas/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdo rje rin/ /pad+ma ral gri 'dzin par mdzad/ /dmar ser kun du rgyu ba ni/ /ljang ser pad+ma dril bus 'khyud / /mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan phreng bklubs⑤/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis mdzes byas pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rtsibs rnams la/ /rigs kyi sems dpa' nyi shu bzhi/ /dkar dang dmar dang ser ba'i mdangs/ /rdo rje dril bu pad+ma bsgom/ /'khor lo rin chen snye ma bsnams/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis mtshan byas shing / /lhag ma gri gug thod pa thogs/ /khro zhing sems dpa'i cha lugs kyis/ /rgyan phreng rigs kyi dbang po gsum/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis bklubs6)/ /oṃ badz+ra swa ta ⑦ko dha (kyete he ru lu hūṃ phaṭa/rdo rje (9)rigs rnams kyi'o/ /pad+ma he 7sbyo swā da na ma ku ru ku ru rtsu phaṭa/ pad+ma ⑪rigs kyi sems dpa' rnams kyi'o/ /oṃ i ku ri tsag ban dha si dhi 4)phaṭa phaṭa/kro dhi shwa 1nyari hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyirigs kyi'o/ /sgo bzhi mdzes 103—294

gzugs khro mo ni/ / mi mthun ①blo gros dpa' chen mo/ /ye shes mkha' dbyings bzhi rnams te/ / dkar ser ②dmar dang rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje ①lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu mtshan ma'i phyag /oṃ badz+ra i gu sha dzaḥpā dusha hūṃ/ sbo ṭa baṃ/ sterje hoḥdu/ phaṭa/ dgug gzhug ⑥bcing ba'i las dag dang / /⑦dbab pa'i cho ga mnyes par byed/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dus/ /rigs gsum sems dpa' khro bor bstan/ /'jigs byed cha lugs rngam pa'i stabasani/ /rdo rje gcod byed 'jigs pa che/ /rdo rje 'joms pa'i yid 'phrog byed/ /rdo rje rab bzang blo gros mchog /rdo rje'i bstan pa g.yul las rgyal/ /pad+ma'i sprin chen 'brug sgra'i dbyangs/ /pad+ma'i blo gsal mya ngan 'joms/ /pad+ma'i sdong po nga ro myos/ /pad+ma'i 'od zer bdud rtsi'i 6)'od/ /'khor ba brtsegs pa myur du bzlog⑩ /'khor lo dga' ba sbrang rtsi'i mchogatunye /'khor lo sgrol tsodang rtse gsum 'ching / /'khor lo rol pa dga' byed (nyestobs/ /'di dag sprul pa 'khor tshogs skus/ /gnas gsum po dag 'dul bar mdzad/ /de nas gza' dang rgyu skar rnams/ /gdug pa'i nga ro chu ma shums/ /sgra chen sgrogs shing ④sprul nas kyang / /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen po skyabs gsol zhing / /bstan pa bzung 8bar dam bcas so/ /de dag so so'i srog snying dag /lus sems dad pas ⑩phul byas pas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po ⑩dbang bskur zhing / /rab gnas gdan la gzhag par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las rang sangs rgyas thams cad khro bor byung ba'i le'u ste 103—295

bcwa ①brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan dbang gi lha/ /pad+ma bde chen yum bcas la 'gro drug rgyu 'bras bya ba'i phyir/ /bde chen byang sems dkyil 'khor sprul/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas 'bar ba②/ /rin chen phreng sogs 'jigs byed brgyad(kye / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas bzhin brgyan/ /dbus kyi du'akhor lo gdan bcas la/ /rigs lnga'i he ru ka bzhugs mdzad/ /yum chen lnga dang 'khril bar sbyor/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /dmar nag dkar ser ljang gu'i (9mdangs/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ yiral gri dang / / tri shul gzhing dbyug tho ba bsnams / /g.yas par dung por g.yon thod khrag /bar ma gri gug pad+ma ste/ /tha ma yum dang 'khril ba'i tshul/ /spyan dgu sdang mig dmar po bzlog /khro gnyer (8)ral pa gyen du brjes6)/ /thod sprul khrag dang thal bas brgyadakyi/ /g.yang gzhi (7ri sha'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī 7he ru ka 6)badz+ra gro dhī shwa yiri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byudha shrī 8te ru ka bhud+dha kro dhī shwa yiri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na shrī 0he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ rat+na kro dhī 6)shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ (7pad+ma shrī ( )te ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ 0pad+ma gro dhī 8)shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kurma shrī ( —3he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ kurma kro dhī ( )shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/bde chen byang chub sems kyi rgyan/ /rol pa kun tu khyab mdzad de/ /khams gsum ma 'dres rnam par dbyings/ /bde ba chen po gnyis med 'gyur/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs rigs kyis bskur/ / bskyed de ( nyadabu la rang gi bdag pos brgyan / /smon 'jug g.yo ldang 6)bskyod pa yi/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med 103wa 296

pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las bde ba chen po'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs pa nyid 'a bzhag ste bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bdud kyi rgyal 6)po ma tra ru atras/ rang gi rdzu 'phrul chen po bstan ③zhing / 'khor dang bcas pas phyogs bcur ④rgyug cing rig pa 'dzin pa dang / rnal 'byor mtha' dag gi bar gcod byed cing bde 'gro'i bde ba thams cad rgyun gcod pa dang / rang nyid kyi nyon mongs pa bskyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 6)'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rigs kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa ⑥zhes bya bas ⑦stong gsum gyi 'jig rten thams cad skad cig gis (kyegasal bar mdzad do/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po stong gsum 'dir/ /khang bzangs ponyemadzes par byin brlabs te/ /rin chen ka ba gdan phreng dang / /gzugs mdzes la sogs kun gyis spras/ /nyi ma zla ba rin chen khri/ /pad+ma seng ge la sogs gnon⑩/ /sgo bzang yinyakhyams su bcas pa yitsho / /rnam dag gzhal yas khang bzangs ⑩sprul/ /de nas bcom ldan bde chen pos/ /dpal ldan gar gyi yidabang phyug skus/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rigs tshogs rnams/ /dga' ba'i sprin gyis bskul bar mdzad/ /bde ba chen po gnyis med mthus/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gcig 6tu gyur/ /yongs rdzogs gsal ba rgya chen pos/ /dkyil 'khor rgya chen sprul par mdzad/ /dbus su pad+ma'i rigs rgyal po/ /gtso bo pad+ma rdo rje'i mdangs / /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed sku/ /rdo rje dga' ba'i spyan 103—297

'dril zhing / /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs kun du/ /bder ①gshegs rdo rje sems dpa'i ②mchog /rnam snang rin chen ①don grub rnams/ /rin chen phyogs kyi mtshon ④mdangs gsal/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen dang / /ral gri pad+ma sna tshogs dang / /gtso bo pad+ma'i drug mtshan can/ /stong pa'i sgra snyan ⑤dril bu g.yon/ /sangs rgyas spyan rjo mdzes mā ma khrig/ /dkar mo dam tshig sgrol ma dag /mdog bzang niphyag mtshan gtso bo bzhi/ /sangs rgyas ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul stobs/ /thabs dang shes rab nyis stong tshogs/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtse mo la/ /rang gi mtshan ma so so'i tshul/ /dmar mdangs dkar dang gser 6)gyi mdog / ni ra 0ka ta'i mdog 'tsher ⑩zhing / /pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo rin/ /pad+ma tri shul 8bcas pa 'dzin/ /g.yas na 'khor lo go rims tibazhin/ /rdo rje skyil krung 8legs brgyan brjid/ /gzhan yang khro bo'i tshogs 'bar ba/ /phyi rol 'khor lo'i bar khyams tidang / /sgo la sogs pa'i 'jigs gzugs kyis/ /rngam pa'i mdangs bcas 'khod pa ni/ /khri tshogs yang sprul mtshon cha dang / /rigs kyi sprul pa'i don byed pa'i/ /khams gsum 'jigs byed khro bo dang / /mkha' 'gro'i dag pa'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dur khrod rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing / /rigs kyi kha dog mtshon cha dang / /'od zer 'phro ba 'khrigs pa'i tshul/ /gsang sngags drag po brjod mdzad pa'o⑩/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor khro zhi yitshogs/ / skad cig 6nyagasal bar rdzogs byas nas/ /phyi yi gnas su spro zhing bya4)/ /gsang sngags rgyun gyi skal ( )bar byed/ /r+ghaṃ a la la ho/ ma hā pad+ma skṛ 8med ya/ a ā oṃ āḥ(gyes/ ma hā pad+ma ku ru/ ha la ha la bhi sha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong khams sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /rab 103—298

'khrug bred rgyas ①mongs pa dag /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyis bder byas shing / /rang gi sangs rgyas zhing la bkod/ /dkyil 'khor gnas su bsdus byas nas/ /rang gi 'khor lo mdzes byas te/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs rdzogs 'gyur ②nas/ /dbu la rigs kyi bdag pos brgyan/ /oṃ pad+ma kun dhā li skṛ dud ya na bi mu ku ru ha na da ha ④rgyu phaṭa/ gsang sngags kun gyis brjod byas na/ /'jig ①rten gsum po sdud ⑥pa yi/ /pho nya rdo rje tī la ya/ /dregs ⑦byed gtso bo dag rengs ⑧bya/ /de nas bcom ldan bde chen ①skus/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskul ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje se gol lan tsogasum brdab/ /dam tshig chen po'i sngags chen brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs tshogs rnams / /ting 'dzin bsdu ba'i rdo rje las/ /gcig tu gnas nas 'gro ba gzigs / /dregs 7byed gtso bo ma rungs rnams/ /rgyu tsodang 'bras bu log 'khrul zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa log mi 'gyur/ /log pa'i lam la mngon zhen cing / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal mthus bsnyems tunyenas/ /'jig rten gsum dag phung byed na/ /zhi bas 'dul bar mi 'gyur na/ /khro bo'i rol pa mdzad mod kyi/ /'dul bar gzigs nas bka' gros tsomadzad/ /kye ma 'dul ba'i tshogs chen dag /'das pa'i dus na sngon byung 8ltar/ /da lta'i dus 'dir byung ba stebya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/ /log pa'i lam du 'khrul pa ste/ /khro bo'i tshul du byung ⑩gyur pa/ /de tunyetshe sems can thams cad kun / /shin tu khro zhing gtum par 'gyur/ /de ltar gyur pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /mnar med la sogs gnas ngan len/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal mtha' la brten/ /ji lta bu yi thabs kyis smyo/'dul/ /shin tu gti mug mdongs pa'i tshogs/ /de 103—299

bzhin bag chags ngan pa yis/ / rig 'dzin 6)bdun rgyud gcod byed cing / /bstan pa'i gsung rab 'jig par 'gyur/ /las kyi mun pas 'gro ba ②'khyams//dus ngan rigs ngan phra ②men ma/ /gnod byed gdon dang log 'dren dang / /srid gsum 'jig cing dam tshig 'dral④/ /'di lta bu phyiyi thabs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje rnam nya'aphrul bstan/ /nga rgyal chen po mdongs pa yi lta ba ri bo mthu brnyes ༅tshogs/ /da nilta'i tshe ni 'di byung 'gyur6nye/ /rgyal ba 'das dus sbyor byed cing / /ji bzhin las la 'khrul par byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid mdzod/ /mngon spyod rol pa'i thabs chen gyis/ /'di dag bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /srid gsum gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te⑩/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun 1nyamadzad/ /khro bo'i tshul can khros pa yikyi/ /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje khros pa yis/ /khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos / /rang bzhin dag pa'i ngo bo las/ /phrag dog 'khrul pa'i rlung dag gis / /'jig rten phyin ci log tu 'khyams/ /ji bzhin gnas pa lam bral bas / /khams gsum brlag yi pa'i lam la zhugs/ /'jig rten 'di dag snying rje zhing / /mngon shes gdul dka'i 0rmongs tshogs rnams/ /khro bo'i tshogs kyis sbyor bar mdzad/ / zhes bsgrags 7so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las rnam par 'phrul pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgral 7bya'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan dgyes chen pos/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug skus/ /ma 103—300

tang ru tra la sogs pas①/ /bdud kyi tshogs bcas 'dul ba'i phyir/ /yum chen sku gcig ②rol mdzad de/ /byang chub sems sprin phyogs bcur spro/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum ①dkyil 'khor gsal/ /dkyil 'khor 'dus tshogs dkyil 'khor chedhi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bdag nyid che/ /dgyes bcas gar bcas gdan la bzhugs/ /zhal gsum gangs ⑤ri ⑥mdangs ldan pa/ /pad+ma gtun shing 7rtse gsum thogs/ /rin chen ⑧rgyan sogs dbu rgyan bcas/ /dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /snod gcig dus gcig 0sprul pa mdzad / /mtha' dang dbus med 'jig rten gnas rnams kun/ /drag po 'thing yinag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /'khor lo rtsibs drug bar khyams nyi rim 7ldan/ /kun du zla kham 8sgo khyud gru bzhir yonyebacas/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i thod dbyug rgyan dang bcas/ /tshad med ye shes 'khor lo la bsten ④cing / /'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyan tshogs mang po bklubasatso/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ⑩lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ /smon lam dbang (medang thugs rje'i byin brlabs ⑫kyis / /'jig rten drug dang dus bzhi phyogs bcu na/ /gzugs khams ma lus dbang du bsdu ba na/ /drag po lha tu)brgyad nga rgyal gzhom pa'i phyir/ /lha chen phyogs skyong tshogs kyis rtsig 4 )pa byas/ /sku bzhi dpal brgyad tshang bar bya ba'i phyir / /rgyal chen rigs bzhi bzung nas ka ba byas/ /theg pa gzhan las 'phags pa'i don/ /glang chen ka la ling gis ka gtan ( tebyas/ /gling bzhi'i mi rnams dgos 'dod bskang khri ba'i phyir/ /gza' skar mig tshags byas pas 'gyur ldog med/ /'jig rten zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /seng ge ka la sha yis ka zhu ( nyebyas/ /'khor ba'i gcong rnying gtan nas sbyang ba'i phyir/ /seng 103—301

ge'i kha nas bdud rtsi'i la'o ma 'dzag /thod rus bar khyams rdo rje'i gzer gyis brgyan② / /zhing chen rnga yab bla re 'phan phyigadugs dang / /thugs rje byang sems kun du khyab pa'i phyir/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i rgyan chas gsal bar ldan/ /sprul pa'i me rlung 'brug gis dus bzhir phye/ /khro bo'i 'byung gnas thugs rje'i sgra dang bcas/ /rin chen khri dang pad+ma nyi zla gdan④/ /gser gyi seng ge spyan gsum pa/ /drug bzhi rtsal 'phags nyi shu brgyad/ /khri rkang brgyad kyis bar khyams phyidag la gnas/ /thugs rje che bas yinyi ma nyi shu brgyad/ /'jigs pa spangs pa'i seng ge nyi shu brgyad/ /sprul sku thob pas ⑦dbang mo nyi shu brgyad/ /kun du 'od kyi sa la rab gnas pa/ /rin chen khri rkang 'degs pa'i stobs dang ldan / /mgon gnas (nyadaben par gzhan dag gis/ /mthong rkang sbas pa'i chos nyid lung / /phrin po)las rnam par rdzogs pa'i gnas/ /rigs bzhi khrag 'thung he ru ka /bzhugs gnas mi 'gyur chos kyi sku/ /de nyid kun du 'od kyi lung ske/ /pad+ma le brgan kyiphyogs bcu'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed ⑩ pa'i tshul/ /chags par 7gyur pa 7pad+ma ste/ /che ba'am yon tan lung du ston/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag dri med pas/ /ma chags pad+ma can gyi lung / /stong zhing gsal bas gzhan gang 'phags/ /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs tsog yin/ /seng ge 'khor lo tshogs chen pos/ /thabs dang shes rab ya 8bral bas/ /spros med rang gis bzlums pa ni/ /ma skyes pa yi chos nyid lung / /'od zer gsal ⑩bas 'tsher bas na/ / yang gab 7sbas pa ()ye shes lung / /'phro 'du khyab par gyur pa'i tshogs/ /shes rab rigs kyi gsang ba'i yum/ /thabs dang shes rab dgyes pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /tshogs chen yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor chen po 103—302

ni / /bdag po khro bo chen po'i sku nyid du/ /gsang sngags 'di yis yongs rdzogs bya/ /oṃ pad+ma shrī ①te ru ka pad+ma gro dhī ②sha ri hūm̐/ ma hā tsaṇa ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan niphaṭa/ dkyil 'khor bdag po rngam ④brjid cha lugs dang / /'bar ba'i me 'od dmar gsal 'phro ba'i mdangs/ /dbu lnga phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i tshul du bzhugs/ /dbu ma mnyam nyid bde ba dbyings su gzigs/ /ral pa'i srid rtse me 'od bzhin du 'bar/ /smin ma ①khro gnyer sma ra sogs myur ba/ /lus thung sku rgyan rgyad kyi cha byad la/ /bcwa 0lnga'i spyan ( )gyis rang gi yul rnams gzigs / /rdo rje rin chen khyung gi gshog pas gtamasal/ /bcu drug rol pa'i spyan dang phyag mtshan dang / /sgeg po'i zhabs brgyad chas dang 'chas par gnasal/ /'jig rten gsum po zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /khro bo'i tshogs bcas 'gying bag yum bcas gnon/ /'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i rtse mo la/ /bder 6)gshegs rigs lnga'i snang ba sna tshogs ston/ /rang gi zhing sbyong drag po'i gnas 'dul zhing / /thams cad rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tsoche la dgod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kyis/ /yab yum gnyis kyi dga' ba bskyed (nyapar mdzad/ /gnas su nyi zla pad dkyil zla ba la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi tsos bon yongs rdzogs gsal/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā tunyeya badz+ra swa bhā ba āta ma ko3rta/ oṃ sarba lita thā ga ta bāka libadz+ra swa bhā ba āta ma ko3rta/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta7/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtse mo drug rnams la / /mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo kham yirgya chen mo drug /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i (nyecha lugs can/ /rigs drug mtshan ma cha lugs ci lta bu/ /bud+dha /rjebadz+ra oṃ/ satwa (nyebadz+ra hūm̐/ rat+na badz+ra tsā0/ pad+ma badz+ra ci( nya/ kurma badz+ra ha/103—303

ghu 0)na badz+ra phaṭa/ phyi rol dkyil 'khor khyab par spros ②byas te/ /'gro ⑧rnams dud sogs khams rnams dag byas nas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+mo dang / /ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑨rtse gsum dril bu bcas/ /g.yon pa bdud rtsi thod pa gang ba thogs/ /mkha' 'gro rab gtum rigs kyi dbu rgyan can/ /rang gi phreng ba dur khrod rgyan gyis bklubs(snye/ /las kyi kham 6)rgya sna tshogs gzugs kyis bzhugs / /dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /long ⑦ba rgyab 'brel rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /sku mdog ⑧mtshan ma sna (9)tshogs la/ /phyag sbrel zangs kyi thod pa thogs/ /oṃ shrī khā'i oṃ ⑩sha ri khā'i traṃ/ shrī khā'i ayi/ dmus long 'khor ba bcu drug dag byung ste/ /thod rus bar khyams smyo gnas su bkod 0par bya / /oṃ shrī khā'i hūṃ/ shrī khā'i yi:/ lcags kyi spyang mo brgyad rnams yang sprul bcas / /ye shes sprul pa'i khyi bcu rngam par 'khod/ /me ri sprin ltar gtibs ⑫pa ril zhing 'khrugs/ /bar khyams 7phyi ma'i gnas la kun du 'khod/ /oṃ ti (rteb ta tsakra shwa 3nyan mu mor khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ku ku ra yag 4) hūm̐ phaṭa/ /dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dzaḥ( )rtsu baṃ hoḥ( nyaphyag rgya las/ /mgo dgu brtsegs pa'i rkang gcig po/ /mgo brgyad lag brgyad rol pa dang / /mgo drug lag drug rkang drug dang / /mgo gsum rkang gsum lag gsum po/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sgo bzhi ru/ /tshad med sprul pa'i phyag rgyas rol/ /de dag rol pa'i byin brlabs ( 2las/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus pa'i(nya/ /thabs dang shes rab byang chub sems/ /me 'brug rlung 'brug phyag rgyas gsal/ /rab tu rdzogs pa'i tshul du byung / /oṃ dzi na la to tsa ro yag ( steku ru ban ts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa / gzhan yang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /bse yi byan lag dmar po 103—304

dang rka/ /dung bya khrung khrung la sogs rnams/ /'jig rten tsam pa'i tshogs kyis bskor① / /oṃ ha ha ru ru ma hā tsan+de shwa ri bi ②sha na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kun gyi rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma bi ta gsi to he he tsakra labh+yo phaṭa/ snying po'i sngags so//oṃ hu lu hu lu rtsu phaṭa/ e a ma ra li hūm̐ dza/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ bh+yo e ā ⑤ra li dza zhes brjod pas 6)khro bo 'khor lo ma lus par byon zhing / /rang gi dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par gyur nas/ /he ru ka chen po nyid kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyu'i dkyil 'khor du gnas shing / /rang gi dkyil 'khor rnams dam tshig bkod par mdzad do/ /de nas sprul pa'i 'khor lo tshogasag/ /ma lus rol (nyepar byin brlabs shing / /bdud dang grags 6)byed rmongs byed cing / /rang gi gnas su 'du bar mdzad/ /oṃ hu lu hu lu ro dza la e a yir li dzaḥyi baṃ hoḥhunye/ a la la ho/ 4)i ma tra ru tra ha la ha yil hūṃ phaṭa/ dug gsum dngos po sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rngam pa'i khro tshogs phyogs bcur spro/ /khro 'dzum phyag rgya bstan mdzad cing / /he he ru ru'i gsang sngags brjod/ /ha la rdo rje'i gad rgyangs kyis/ /bdud dang srin po 7la sogs brgyal yibar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba pa pa ka ra he lha 7ta pa byi sha ma ta /sheru tra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pa pa he ta ba 5)byi sha kha ( )tang ru tra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pa pa ka ra he ta pa byi sha kha tang ru tra hūm̐ phaṭa/dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor pho nya'i tshogs/ /dpal chen rdo rje thog ( 1)thog ser chen 'bebs/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi ( 2byin brlabs bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung ( gekhrag gi rgya mtsho skemasari ) / /rdo rje mtshon cha gnam lcags thu lum tsuna'adril/ /gsang sngags log par lta ba'i bdud rnams 'joms/ /rdo rje ser chen thog bcas 'bar zhing 103—305

'khrugs / /nyams pa'i snying dang dbang po thal bar rlog① /ye shes thugs rje a la la/ /oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka bharnya bharnya/ gardza gardza/ ha la ha la rtsu phaṭa/de nas bdud dang ru tra bcas/ /rdo rje mtshon chas bsgral bsgral nas/ /'khor gyi longs spyod rol mdzad cing / /sha khrag nang grol ②bdud rtsi dang / /rus rkang dbang por dubacas pa la/ /tshogs kyi longs spyod ston mor mdzad/ /kun gyi dgyes pa rdo rje'i glusaX/ /mthun ༷par sgra dbyangs gcig gis bstod/ /thugs rje rnam dag pad+ma'i rang bzhin las/ /thugs kur ⑥ las sprul pa'i byang chub sems/ /phyogs bzhi ⑦dbus lngar brjid pa'i sku mchog ni/ /grub pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga/ /dpal lus khyad nipar 'phags pa zhal gyi dbyingasal / /dbang mchog lhun gyis grub pa'i rta skad can/ /thar lam thugs rje kyithabs mkhas sprul pa yi/ /ye shes byin brlabs khro rgyal 'bum du sprul/ /smin mdzad smon lam yun rings (7grub pa yi8/ /dmigs pa'i mtha' bral pad+ma yum gyi tshul/ /chos rnams ma lus gsal bar gzigs pa'o/ /chags med thugs rje pad+ma'i tshul/ /sgra skad thams cad mtha' las grol/ /zab dang rgyang ring mchos kyi don rnams mtshan nyid las/ /shangs kyi rlung sgrom tsodug gsum rtsad 7nas chod⑩/ /zhal gyi ho ⑩la 'brel pas rgyud lnga gcod/ /rno dbal mche ba yo)skye shi rtsad nas gcod/ / le brgan ༷ljags kyi gsung sgra rgya mtshor 'chad/ /rol pa'i phyag gis 'gro ba 'dul ( nyal mkhas/ /gshog bzhi bskyod (7pas phrin dulas rnam bzhi mdzad/ /zhabs rol pas ni zi'/ gnon mdzad pa'i tshulas/ /sku che yan lag rags pa ri bo sostebazhin/ /thugs mchog ye shes stong nyid nyi ma bdal(snye / /ye shes lha mchog byin brlabs 69'byung ba'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar rol 103wa 306

khrag rlon pa za ba'i srin po 'joms/ /'tsher ①can yid la gdung ba'i rta skad ni / /mun mthu'i 'gro ba ma lus gsal bar mdzad/ /rgyu dbyings grangs dang gzigs thabs rtog ②pa'i don/ /hūṃ las dpal chen khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed / /gnas ni sna yi dbugs rings dro ①ba lags/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'phrul pa 'byung / /shangs kyi rlung sgrom yangs pas ye shes srog /gsang ba'i tshub ④mas sdug bsngal snying nas 'byin/ /rgya chen sprul pas bag chags tshar gcod de/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 0lugs las bzlogs ⑥pa yi/ /rigs kyi rlung gis dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /zlum dkar gzangs rings ⑦rdo dbal tshems/ /zhal du bdar ba'i byang chub sems/ /ma skyes chos nyid kun la rol/ /zhi rgyas dbang sdud ②drag po yi/ /cir yang 'gyur ba'i hom khung ste / /las lnga 'brel 6)pa'i zhal zhes bya/ /'khor ba yongs su smin pa dang / /las mangs ⑩nyon mongs dbang btsan dang / /skye ba mi skye lung ma bstan/ /de ⑨smin mdzad pa chen po yi/ /'jog dhisdog cir yang gyur pa dang / /rjod 8byed gnyis ku'i bstan gyur nas/ /'byar zhing bskyod pas ljags nyid do/ /yig 'bru'i rgyu nyid bder snyigashegs thugs/ /rdo rje myu gu ting 'dzin thugs/ /'od nyid nyon mongs rnam dag 'joms/ /rig byed ye shes phyag rgya dang / /yig 'bru sa bon phyag rgya tsodang / /yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /srid pa gsum ste lta ba dang / /rgyud yidang las kyi rim pa'o/ /de phyir ye shes rol pa'i dbyings / /snying po phyag mtshan phya mo dgatu /bstan par gyur nas mkha' yi dbyings / /chos sku chu yi spyi zla ba bzhin/ /sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin med/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas kun du/ /gar gyi dbang phyug rnam par rol/ /shar 103—309

gnyis med 'bar bas thams cad sreg /las dang bag chags sgrib sogs kun//gnas nas gshegs mdzad ye shes tshogs/ /lhun gyis ① dang bas ②kun du 'joms / /snyigs ②ma lnga brgya 0dus kyi mtha'/ /srid gsum sems can 'dul ⑤dka' ba/ /'phro 'du 'khyil pa'i 'od mdangs mdzad/ /'jig rten mkhyen dang mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis med thugs kyis sa le mkhyen/ /de ltar dgongs pa'i khyad par de/ /'gro ba mtha' dag 'dul don du/ /rnam par thar pa dbu gsum bstan/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing gakhyi /ye shes drug gi phyag mtshan ni/ /g.yas pas rdo rje rde'u chung dang / /mdung rtse gsum pa ⑦'dzin pas rol/ /dril bu rgyu zhags thod rlon g.yon/ /bskal pa'i me ri sbrul zhags dang / /thod rlon phreng ba rgyan ⑧du byas/ /sgeg pa ⑨dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ske/ /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed/ /snying rje rngam ⑩dang zhi ba'i skul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gar thabs can/ /'jigs byed khro bo rnam par rgyal/ /skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings su/ /mtshan ma med pa'i chos bshad pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyal/ /longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis/ /mi 'jigs stobs mchog gdan stengs (nyan/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad du / /zab mo rgya chen chos ma bstan(9/ /dngos dang dngos med gsal byed pas / /me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / /sprul pa 'gro mang don gyi 8phyir/ /phal mang bkod spyopa'i sa rnams su/ /dngos po mtshan ma rnam 'phrul gyis/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes tshogs/ /thams cad mtshan ma nam mkha'i dngos/ /de nyid sgro btags chos dang bral/ /kun ldan 7byams sems de kho na/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /he ru ka yi bde chen dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi rgyu 103—312
