yan lag ma nyams par/ /gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa/ /sum 'bum dag tu brjod byas nas/ /rol pa mtshan ma bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mchog chen mtshan ma ma nyams pa/ /rab brtags ①dur khrod gnas nas blangs/ /khro bo chen po'i tsham ngam ②gyis/ /yungs kur ①thal ba la sogs pas/ /sum bha ni yi ④sngags brjod cing / /yi dgas ⑤gshin rje bskrad par bya/ /de nas dri zhim sbyar ba yi / /dag (7byed chu yis legs bkrus ⑦te/ /me tog phreng sogs rgyan gyis brgyan⑧ / /gsung gi phyag rgya byin brlabs shing yo)/ /dpa' bos rang gi khyim du blang ske/ /glu ⑩drug dbyangs ⑩drug bcas pa yis/ /khro rgyal rol ba'i bro yis sbyangs / /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams dga'i mchog /rgya khyon 'dom gang khru yis bstod/ /ci bzhin la sogs cho ga bzhin/ /rdzas dang sa gzhi dag bya zhing ske/ /sa bon gnas pa'i las rdzogs nas/ /bsrung zhing dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /yab yum bsgrub 7pa'i grogs bcas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir gnas bzung ste/ /mchog chen dkyil 'khor kha ru bzhag /bsrung tu ba'i 'khor lo legs ldan pas/ /stong nyid ting 'dzin nas brtsams te/ /dkyil 'khor mnyes sogs 7rdzogs byas nas/ /ro langs dgug cing gzhug bya ste/ /bar chad med par bzlas brjod bya/ /oṃ bi tshur na trag sha ta ha ⑩la ta'i lo ma ta ya man ta tsan tra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ting 'dzin 'od zer gsal ba'i rgyun/ /zur ma chag par brjod byas te/ /'bum tsho gcig gis g.yo 'gyur zhing / /gnyis kyis 'od dang bcas par snang / /'bum phrag gsum gyis sgra bstan zhing / /langs te kun du lta (1 bar byed/ /de tshe rnal 'byor dbang po yis/ /skra (nyenas bzung nas bskyel 37byas la/ /rta mchog sngags kyis 8 )dbang du bya/ /rdo rje khyung 103—316

gshog phyag rgya yis①/ /don gyi gsung gis go bar spyod pas bro yang brdung ②/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang yan lag rnams/ /ma ③bral rang gi gnas 'ongs te/ /dkyil 'khor mtha' ma dubaskor byas nas/ /mchod pa bro glu dang bcas pas/ /lha rnams mnyes pa'i cho ga bya/ /de nas brtul ⑧zhugs chen po yis/ /go la lang gha gnon pa yis⑥/ /bro ⑦la sogs pa rdzogs byas nas/ /ro de gser du gyur pa yin/ /de ni mchod dang sbyin pa dang / /rang la dgos pa'i yo byad ⑧bya / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ ro langs bsgrub ⑨pa bstan pa'i le'u ste ⑫nyi shu bzhi pa'o// //de nas gar gyi dbang phyug gis/ /gzi (1ldan yum dang rol mdzad cing / /'khor gyis zhus pa'i tshig gsan nas/ /thun mong 8dngos grub bzang po nyid/ /ma 'ongs 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /rim pa bzhin du phan gdags mdzad/ /dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pas/ /yid mthun (steganas mchog bzang po ru/ /mig sman sbyor ba bsgrub 8byas te⑩/ /byin brlabs tsoldan pas 'gro don byas/ /rang gi ting 'dzin la gnas pas/ /rang gi gsang sngags 'bum rdzogs nas/ /mtshan ma yonyephra mo mthong ba dang / /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba yi/ /phyag rgya gsang sngags ting 'dzin ldan/ /rin chen sngags kyi bzlas brjod ni/ /'bum phrag gsum du gsung bar bya/ /oṃ pad+ma ma tsa ga hru (shes la sa ma ra si spre)ti yo na hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor gnas kyi rtags mthong nas( )/ /grong mtha'i gnas su 'gro byas te/ /sus (1kyang ma 103—317

mthong mtshan mo rung ①/ /lha 'dre gtum po'i grong du bsdad/ /rang gi 'khor gyi ④tshogs rnams kyis/ /mi rgod btsan 'brang bsrung bar bya/ /der ni bhan ①dha mtshan ldan du/ /gzi chen mar ni bltas nas su/ /mtshan gcig yal bar sngags dubazlas shing / /ting 'dzin ma nyams sbyor ba byas0/ /skya rengs dang po 'char dus su/ /dud pas bdugs te bcang bar 0bya/ /glu dang bro yi brtul ⑦zhugs dang / /lha rnams kun gyi stang stabs nikyis/ /gnas de'i bdag po dbang du sdud/ /rig ⑨pa 'dzin pa'i sngags ldan pas/ /slar nyid mig sman shas gcig tibyug /de nas 'khor gyi tshogs bsgo 0zhing / /skye 'gro kun la gsang bar bya/ /pad+ma bsgrub pa'i an rdza ⑩lis/ /ci 'dod dngos po tsomathong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang ril bu'i sgrub ④thabs ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga las 'byung ba yi/ /rdzas dag sha lnga dang bsres 8te/ /thod pa mtshan ldan nang bzhag nas/ /dkyil 'khor rgyan dang ldan gnas su/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan gnas tsos/ /gar gyi dbang phyug sku bsgoms shing ⑩/ /yi ge bcu bzhi 8gsang sngags kyis/ /'bum phrag gsum du bzlas byas te/ /mtshan ma phra mo mthong ba dang / /bdud rtsi gong bu bsgril byas te/ /rgya shug ⑩'bras bu'i tshad tsam du/ /rin chen za ma tog tu gzhug6) /dkyil 'khor de yi 0dbus bzhag (nyepas/ /bsrung duba'i tsakras bsrung bya zhing / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag lnga ru brjod par bya/ /'od zer lcags kyu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /oṃ ma hā pad+ma so tsobo ta hu lu hu lu ( mi phaṭa swā hā/ de nas ril bu 69de blangs te/ /kha 'am lag tu bzung 6)byas nas/ /gang 'dod gnas su 'gro byed cing / /ci 'dod pa dag grub par byed/ / lha yi ( )gnas mchog nyams dga' bas/ /snga dro ⑥103—318

gcig ①gis 'khor bar nus/ /gzhan yang bcud len bzang po nyid/ /skyes bu gang gis bsgrub 'dod pas/ /bdud rtsi rgyal po ②a ru ra/ /gser gyi mdog tu 'dug pas mchog /nyi shu rtsa gcig ra ①bor sba/ /sul rangs rgyas par gyur pa dang / /ba gcin ①phur mo thal ba dang / /ser 0skya'i ⑥ba mar btso ⑦bar bya/ /de nyid sbrang rtsi dang sbyar bas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig zhag gi bar/ /zho re'i tshad du bskyed cing bza'/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba la brten dunas/ /gar gyi dbang phyug skur bsgoms shing / /rig ⑨'dzin pa yi sngags brjod cing //mtshan rtags gsal bar ma mthong bar/ /yan lag ma nyams brtson 'grus bskyed / /oṃ pad+mo bi ha ra ha ra ta sa ⑩ni tsū phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags sum 'bum ma rdzogs par/ /a ru ra yi ⑩'bras bzang 8stong gi tsotshad/ /tsolegs par sbyar te zos pa'i mthus/ /nad dang zug rngu'i tshogs 'joms shing / /tshe ring bde ba phun sum tshogs/ /rgas la sogs pa'i skyon sel cing / /rig ⑫'dzin gnas su 'gro bar 8byed/ /de bzhin dbang po'i lag pa dang / /kha ra bu ram nye shing dang / /zur rngul mu zi la sogs las0/ /rang gi cho ga shes pa yis / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sngags kyis 'grubatunye/ /gar dbang dkyil 'khor la ni brten tsobyas te/ /so sor ma nyams sbyangs pa'i sa/ /ba yi 'o ma dang sbyar so )zhing ske/ /ba yi mar gyis gzungs btab nas/ /mtshan ma ma byung bar 0du gzhagadu /de ni rig 'dzin dngos grub thob/ /oṃ pad+mo i dra dra a he de bi na hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ pad+mar 3rgya a gar ta dar sha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+mo sa ④mon bi sha le (nyes phaṭa / oṃ ghu li tsos bo tam go ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+mo me sha a nan da ta ya ka ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de dag las rnams 'grub pa dang / /rtag tu rang gis ( )'char byas 103—319

shing / /gsang ba'i sngags lam la brten nas/ /tshe 'di grub par gyur pa ①yin / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i ②gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'og// //de nas gar gyi dbang phyug nyid/ /phyag rgya rol pa'i skur bcas kyis/ /snod ldan byang chub sems dpa' dag /mchog gi dngos grub skyed ⑤byed pa'i/ /rig 'dzin phyiganas kyi mtshan nyid bshad/ /dmar po dbang gi dkyil 'khor du//bhan rinadha mtshan dang ldan pa brgyad/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma la bkram nas/ /tshe 'das sngags kyis brgyan par bya/ /de ni bza' btung longs spyod tshogs/ /ma nyams phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /gar dbang lha la mos pa yis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjod (7byed cing / /sum 'bum bzlas pa'i grangs tshad phyinas/ /mtha' sngags gzhan gyis brgyan byas te/ /rtags mthong bar du bzlas brjod brtsam(91 / /oṃ a su sha oṃ a yu sha so ta rbu/ 'od zer du ba lta bu dang / /phyag rgya'i dbyings dang 'byung (7ba'i dus/ /bro drug glu dang gar bcas pas/ /brtul zhugs (nyachen po bdud rtsi spyad(gye/ /sku gsung thugs mchog phyag rgya che/ /gsang ba'i yum bskyed snying po mchog /oṃ e ka te bi ga te ma tang ka te swā hā/ma nyams nyams pa'i phyag rgyar (nyagasal/ /gnyis su med par sbyor ba yis rdo rje pad+mor ldan byas pas/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul la/ /gzi ldan gsang ba e gru gsum/ /nyi ma pad+ma shes rab ldan/ /so so gsal ba'i brdas mtshon teng7 / /oṃ phroṃ pad+ma ā yu sheg/ byin brlabs rnam 7par 'phro ba yis(rte/ /103—320

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs bskul ①zhing / /byang chub sems mchog tshe yi rgyun / /sgrub ②pa po la gsal bar mdzad/ /pad 'dab brgyad pa nyi mar bcas / /dbus su gsang ba'i rdo rje che/ /rtsu gis gsor zhing a yis bskyod/ /yang dang yang du bskul ba ni/ /sku gsung dbyings su gyur pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems mchog rgyun/ /bhan gadha mtshan ldan nang du bcug /rnal 'byor gar dang legs bcas pas/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad 0glu blang zhing / /bkra shis gar dang dbyangs su bcas/ /longs spyod ston mo (9kun gsol zhing / /dngos grub don phyir gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud chen po las tshe bsgrub (7pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o// //de nas gar gyi lha mchog gis/ /thams cad bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ /phyi nang snod bcud ma lus kun/ /rigs lnga'i sku ru bsgrub pa'i ⑦phyir/ /rang las byung ba'i rang bzhin dang / /dngos grub snying po kun bsdus bshad/ /chos rnams ma lus rnams brtags 5kyenas/ /rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor tshul du gnas / /de las ⑨'byung ba'i dngos rnams kyis/ /de nyid yilta bur sbyor ba bya//dang skrer bsod nams tshogs bsags shing tshokā/ /rdo rje bla ma mnyes byas pas/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /lha nyid nye bar bsgoms byas pas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po brtsam par bya/ /rigs kyi lha yi /gyedakyil 'khor gyis/ /rigs kyi phyag rgya bsgrub par bya/ /dri dbyibs kha dog ro la sogs/ /sha lnga bdud rtsir bcas pa dag /bhan dha yinamatshan ldan lnga ru ni/ /dkyil 'khor 103—321

'khor dang phyogs bzhir dgramacha/ /rdo rje bkod ②pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /so sor spang ba sbyang ②byas te/ /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin mthus/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor mngon par bsgrub/ /mchod cing mnyes par 0byas nas ni/ /las kun grub (nyapa'i ⑥gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ pad+mo badz+ra hri ghu na sidhi sarba pañca a sri ta/ oṃ āḥni/ swā hā/ de la du'od dang du ba dang / /dri dang lha mo rtags dag ni/ /bzlas brjod thun mong khyad par dag /'bum tsho gsum gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas grub pa'i rtags mthong nas/ /de dag btag ⑨tsam sbyang bya zhing / /mkha' 'gro rol pa'i brtul zhugs ⑩kyis/ /bsod nams sbyang zhing byin gyis brlabasayi/ /dkyil 'khor bkod 8pa rgyan dang bcas/ /khro bo 'bar bar zhal sgyur ⑩zhing / /yab yum gdung ba'i glu dbyangs dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 8'phro 'du yis/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gnas bzhugs par/ /bdud kyi gar gyi dbang phyug bskyed/ /slar nyid khro bo byadakyil 'khor gyis/ /gzugs 'dul gtso bo'i thugs kur tsozhugs/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor kun bkug nas/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi gnyis med 'gyur/ /slar ⑩'byung pad+mo'i 8rgyal po'i sku/ /dbus ⑩kyi dkyil 'khor gdan la bzhugs/ /mchod bstod dudaga' bas mnyes (7byas nas/ /bro gar glu yis duthugs dam bskang ⑫/ /khyad par gsang sngags rgyal po'i mthus/ /ye shes lngar duldan 'od zer can/ /oṃ ma hā sarba ta thā 6)ga ta pañca ⑩a mṛ ()ta ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ji srid mtshan ma ma byung bar(ste/ /sngags kyi rgyal po brjod par bya/ /de nas rta mgrin phyag rgya yis/ /sgrub ( )pa chen po gsang ba'i don/ /rdo rje rta mchog phyag rgya che/ /bdud rtsi rdzas kyis 6gyedabang bskur zhing / /rnal 'byor grogs bcas 103—322

spag /dpal he ru ka snying rje rol pa'i rgyud gsang ba zab mo'i mchog ces bya ba/①༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī he ru ka kā ru ṇa ②ṅgā ḍi gta tan tra gugya gi rtsir uta ta ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal he ru ka snying rje rol pa'i rgyud gsang ④ba zab mo'i mchog ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba chen po dam tshig gi sdom pa gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po dbang (5)brnyes (5)pa/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ khams gsum thams cad kyi bdag po chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba chen po nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du mnyam par 'jug pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i skabs dang ldan pa/ che mchog he ru ku'i shes rab dang ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams 103—355

cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rin po che gsang ba rdo rje mchog tu gsang ba'i bcom ldan 'das bud med kyi dkyil na gsung brjod pa med par bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rdul phran dang mnyam pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dang / rdo rje nam ①mkha' la 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba chen mo ②dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang / 'jib ②par byed pa'i gsang ba chen mo'i g.yog dang / 'byung ba chen po lnga dang / 'byung ba las gyur pa'i lha'i tshogs 'bum phrag brgya stong gis khyab pa 'di lta ste/ snying po ye shes rdo rje dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rdo rje dang me long ye shes rdo rje ④dang / so sor ⑤kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang / mnyam pa nyid ye shes rdo rje dang / bya ba nan tan ye shes rdo rje dang / nam mkha' ye shes rdo rje dang /rlung ye shes rdo rje dang / me ye shes rdo rje dang / chu ye shes rdo rje dang / sa ye shes rdo rje dang / thabs dang shes rab ye shes rdo rje dang / gzugs ye shes rdo rje dang / sgra ye shes rdo rje dang / dri ye shes rdo rje dang / ro ye shes rdo rje dang / reg ye shes rdo rje dang / sku ye shes rdo rje dang / gsung ye shes rdo rje dang —/ thugs ye shes rdo rje dang / bde ba chen po ye shes rdo rje dang / kun du bzang po ye shes rdo rje dang / gsung gi dbang po ye shes rdo rje dang /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang / zhi yiba'i ye shes rdo rje dang / gdul dka' 'dul ba'i ye shes rdo rje dang / rgyal ba'i ye shes rdo rje dang / me tog gi /ye shes rdo rje dang / rab tu dga' ba'i ye shes rdo rje dang / dbang gi ye shes rdo rje dang / nyi ma'i khro bo ye shes rdo rje dang / rgyal mtshan ye shes rdo rje dang / rdo rje sgra ye shes (53rdo rje dang / 'gro ba 'dul ba 5)ye shes rdo rje dang /103—356

gzhon nu ye shes rdo rje dang / rgyu ye shes rdo rje dang / gsung med pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang / sna tshogs kyi ye shes rdo rje dang / go cha ye shes rdo rje dang / yang dag par zab par ①byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang / 'dus pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes rdo rje dang / byang chub sems ye shes rdo rje dang / rin chen dbang bskur ba ②ye shes rdo rje dang / pad+mo ①dmar po ye shes rdo rje dang / dam tshig ye shes rdo rje dang / mchod pa'i ye shes rdo rje dang /rnal 'byor ma chen mo g.yog dang bcas pa rnams la 'di lta ste/ shin tu dga' ba'i dbang mo zhes bya ba'i ye shes rdo rje dang / rmongs par byed pa'i dbang mo ye shes rdo rje dang / gsod ces bya ba'i dbang mo ④ye shes rdo rje dang / rdo rje dbyings phyug ma ye shes rdo rje dang / ye shes dbyings phyug ma ye shes rdo rje dang /rin chen dbyings phyug ma ye shes rdo rje dang / pad+ma'i dbyings phyug ma ye shes rdo rje dang / las kyi dbyings phyug ma ye shes rdo rje dang / gnon par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / 'jums ⑤par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / rmongs par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / rgyas 'debs par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / 'dren par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / gsod (5)par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang /'bigs (7par byed ma ( ye shes rdo rje dang / gcod par byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang glu/ sdigs 5)byed ces bya ba ye shes rdo rje dang / tshig byed ces bya ba ye shes rdo rje dang / yan lag thams cad 'phrog byed ye shes rdo rje dang / 'jig ⑩byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / khrag la dga' ma ye shes rdo rje dang / gcod byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / pham tu)byed ma ye shes rdo rje dang / nam mkha' la hunye'agro ma ye shes rdo rje dang / ngag 'phrog ma ye shes rdo rje dang / zas sha rlon za ba ye 103—357

shes rdo rje dang / srin mo ye shes rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin ma ye shes rdo rje dang /gnod byed ces bya ba ye shes rdo rje dang / sbrul ye shes rdo rje dang / seng ge ye shes rdo rje dang / stag ye shes rdo rje dang / ri dgas ①ye shes rdo rje dang /phag ye shes rdo rje dang / spre'u ye shes rdo rje dang / khyi ye shes rdo rje dang / byi la ye shes rdo rje dang / ra ye shes rdo rje dang / bya rog ye shes rdo rje dang / wa ye shes rdo rje dang / bya rgod ye shes rdo rje dang / sre mo ye shes rdo rje dang /mi'i keng rus dang / 'bu chen po'i ro dang / yi dgas ②dang / sha za dang —/ gzig dang / bong bu dang / rta dang / ma he dang / ba lang ①dang / 'ug pa dang / rdo rje 'phrog par byed ma ①chen mo dang / rdo rje zas 'dren ma chen mo dang / de la sogs te mtha' yas mchog mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa dang bcas pa/ chos kyi dbyings rdo rje nam mkha' la 'gro ma'i tshogs g.yog dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i rigs ye shes rdo rje dang / ye shes kyi khro bo ye shes rdo rje dang / ye shes kyi khro mo ye shes rdo rje dang / sprul pa'i ye shes rdo rje ⑤dang ske/ sprul pa'i phra ⑥men ma ⑦ye shes rdo rje dang / yang sprul ma chen mo ye shes rdo rje dang / bdud rtsi lha mo ye shes rdo rje dang / de dag la sogs te bye ba phrag brgya stong po rnams sgra ca co 'byin cing nam mkha' (gyidabyings rab 'byam 6)chen po'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod par byed cing / bud med kyi dkyil na gsung brjod pa med par bzhugs kyiso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal che mchog he ru ka kun du bzang po dpal rdo rje sems dpa' shin tu dgyes pa gdon mi za ba'i tshogs rdo rje gtong ba dbang mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te1nya/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rol pa yi chen pos rnam par rol pa/ sprul pa 103—358

chen po'i gar dang / glu dang / sil snyan dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang /dri dang / ro dang / reg pa'i bde ba chen po dang 'phags par 'gyur ba dang /rol pa la sogs pa'i reg pa bde ba la ①spyod pa'i gar nye bar ston cing / rnam pa sna tshogs kyi tshogs kyi tshul chen po 'phags par 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ②gnon pa dang / rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spros ①pa dang / gar byed pa dang / za bar byed pa dang / 'jib par byed pa dang /④ pas ⑤par byed pa ⑥dang / zlog par byed pa dang / myong ⑦bar byed pa dang / 'gyur bar byed pa dang / 'phrog par byed pa dang / com par byed pa dang / kun du 'debs ⑧par byed pa dang / bde ba nye bar stobs shing reg pa ro'i bye brag dzi)mang po bye ba phrag brgya stong tshad med par ⑩nam mkha'i dbyings rdul phran las 'das par mnyam par 'jog pas nye bar gnas shing 'tsho ⑩skyong ste/ 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mi gzigs/ dgongs pa nye bar mi 'jog /thabs dang shes rab ston par mi mdzad/ shin tu 'gal ba 8phyin ci log pa la 'jog par mi mdzad/ nye bar 'jog par mi mdzad/ ma dad pa rnams dad par yang mi mdzad/ ma dul ba rnam tunyedul bar yang mi mdzad/ nye bar gtses 8pa rnams 'tshe 8ba zhi bar yang mi mdzad/ ma 'gags pa rnams 'gog ⑩par yang mi mdzad/ ma bskul ba rnams bskul bar yang mi mdzad/ ma rgyas pa rnams rgyas par yang tsomi mdzad/rnam par rmongs pa rnams sel bar yang mi mdzad/ dga' bar 'gyur ba rnams mi dga' bar yang nyunyemi mdzad/ dga' bar ma gyur pa rnams dga' bar yang mi mdzad / ma khros pa rnams khros par yang mi mdzad/ mi gdug pa /smugadug par 103—359

yang mi mdzad/ 'jigs byed chen po dang / drag po ma rungs pa chen po dang /gtum 0)po chen po dang / lha dang lha ma yin dang / log 'dren dang / gdug pa chen po dang / yi dgas ②dang / sha za dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po ③dang ske/ shin tu gdug pa'i gdug pa chen po dang / tsha ba'i don rjodang / nad dang ske/ sbrul dang / sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar byed pa rnams nye bar zhi bar yang mi mdzad/ rnam par dul bar yang mi mdzad/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus nas dgongs pa nye bar bzhag ste/ spyan gnyis mi 'dzums 6)par gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po la bskor zhing sku gsung thugs kyi ⑥rdo rje'i phyag gis phyag byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje chen po'i dbyangs kyis bskul zhing gsol ba btab bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun / /rnam ⑦dag sras bcas byang chub rnams/ /yun rings (nyabasgoms nas shin tu gdungs/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis dgyes par mdzod/ /kye 6)'dod chags dri med kun du bzang po'i spyod pa ste/ /'dod chags dam tshig la ni phye mdzad nas/ /dka' 7ba drug spyad shin tu gsungs pa yis/ /'dod pa bde ba nyid kyis 'jig (1par mdzod/ /rnam dag rdo rje las byung ye shes chu/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i byang chub sems ni rab phyung nas/ /rgyal ba thams cad rnams kyi dbu ni skams 7pa la/ /dri med rin chen char tu gyis spyi bor dbang bskur mdzod / /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pa/ /pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje mdzod gtod pas/ /sna tshogs sems dpa' sems brlan brlag 'gyur pas/ /sbyor ba gzhan min ma rtogs bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje sems khyod dbang mchog 103—360

bde ba byed pa'i mchog /rdo rje pad+mo dbye ba'i tshul gyis sbyor mdzod ①de/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab btud nas②/ /thams cad bde ba'i sgrub pa nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbyangs kyis ninges par bskul stib thugs su chud nas bzhengs te/ brjid pa rjodang bcas pas gar mdzad yicing / zhal 'dzum pa dang 'dor ba dang /bskum pa dang / 'gying ba dang ⑦/ spyan mdzes pas smin ring nibaskyod cing bsgyur ba dang / pad+mo phyag gis g.yas g.yon gar gyi phreng ba'i tshul gyis sa'i ngos la zhabs 'phen cing bsgyur ba dang / 'dor zhing bskum pa dang / 'jog cing 'degs pa'i rnam par gnon pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du khyab par mdzad de/ rlung gi khams dang / me'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang /sa'i khams kun khyab par mdzad de/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems la kun du khyab par mdzad de/ sna tshogs dang / phra ba dang / sbom pa dang /bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / rgan pa dang/ skyes pa dang / skyes pa ma yin pa dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / skar ma dang /gshin rje dang / chu bdag dang / brgya byin dang / 'byung ba dang / 'byung ba las gyur pa thams cad la bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos rgyas par byas te yang dag par gnas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te/ yang 'dus nas phyag gar dang bcas nas thal mo sbyar ponyenas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po la spyi bos btud nas gsol ba btab pa'i/ bcom ldan 'das kun gyi gsang ba'i te ru ka yinachen po 103—361

rol pa'i thig le 'di/ gnyis med ye shes yang dag 'byung / /bcom ldan khyod kyis ①bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi ma skyes pa/ /skyes dang ma skyes rnam spangs pa'i/ /'byung ②dang 'byung 'gyur rab sbyor ba'i/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /thams cad rin chen 'byung gnas dag /nam mkha' ①dri med 'dra ba yi(ge/ /rgyal mtshan chen po bsgreng bya ste/ /rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba'o/ /longs spyod chos ni yang dag 'byung / /pad+mo'i mchog ni dmar po mdog /'dod chags de nyid gsang ba che/ /bde byed thams cad bdud rtsi'i mchog /la la ar ni don dang ldan/ /yang dag mdzes pa 'gying ba'i 'gros / / sa phyogs (3)ye shes bde ba che/ /byang chub sems thig mchog phyinyid do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa kun du bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i bdag pos gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas 'gog pa chen po ye shes rdo rje zhes ④bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs tshogaso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ngo mtshar du gyur te/ yang 'dus nas bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po kun du bzang po chen po la de kho na nyid kyi (97dbyangs kyis bskul te bzhengs par mdzad do / /oṃ āḥ rtsu/ mi skye ye shes bde mchog ro la mnams/ /sems dpa'i mchog nyid 'gog pa rnams las 31bslang / /chags med kun du mya ngan 'das mdzad bzhengs shing mnams/ /mchog tu gsang tshuba'i dam bcas 'jig rten sgrolam/ /byang chub skye gnas dbyings las gar mdzod cig /sngon gyi nyon mongs rdo skams 12gzir ba yi/ /bde mchog rgyan dang ldan pa'i thabs kyis bskul te go bar mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po chen pos de 103—362

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po chen po he ru ka rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rang gis 6)gsang ba'i thig le shin tu dgyes pa chen po zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs phyung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ②ba'i snying po'i thig le'i dbus su rgyas par byas te/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du snang bar byas te/ steng dang 'og tu yang bzhugs ①te/ma lus lus pa med pa'i ril dang / sems can thams cad la gsal ④bar byas nas shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i ro ⑤bde ma mnyes par byas nas slar ༅de nyid du slar log nas/ bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i snying po gsang ba mchog gi stithig le'i dbus na bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi tshogs kyi phreng du ba mchog tu bde bar gyur pa 6)snying po des bskul ba ni gar mdzad cing rang rang gi ting nge rkyu )'dzin du dmigs nas yinabacom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po'i thugs kyi dbus su mchog tu gsang ba shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde bar bsgrubs te/ sku rang gi bud med kyi tshul du bskyed nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas mngon par 'byung bar gyur to7 / /de la la la ni spyan pad+ma lta bur bsgyur cing smin dkyus ring tunye sangs rgyas tshul gyis cigar mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor du/ /rab 7dgyes rdo rje gdon mi za/ /rdo rje sems la dgyes mdzad cing / /bde ba'i sangs rgyas bde ba yis/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas bzhugs par 'gyur/ /zhal bsgyur smin ma bsgyur 7ba yis/ /spyan yang bsgyur zhing shin tu gnon/ /sor mo rnams kyang rab bsgyur dang / /rdo rje tshul gyis gar mdzad cing / /sems dpa' che la mnyes par mdzad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkyil du/ /sku ni 103—363

skad cig bskul ba yis①/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gnas par 'gyur/ /zhal ni brjid cing rin chen ②dbu/ /dri med spyi ②bor gar mdzad cing / /dkyil 'khor zhal gyis rnam bsgyur ba/ /byang chub sems ni med par mdzad/ /dur khrod yon tan tshogs dag gis/ /pad+ma'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzad cing / /bde ba'i bdag po chen po la/ /rin chen tshul gyis mnyes par mdzad/ /rab tu dgyes gsal bde ba yi/ /pad+ma dmar la che mdzad de/ /'dod chags bral zhi ④ rab tu bsgyur/ /pad+ma'i dra bas 'brel ba yidu/ /pad+ma'i rnal 'byor ma dkyil du / /brjid pa'i spyan gyis kun gzigs pa'i/ /bde ba che la mnyes par mdzad / /bcom ldan pad+mo gnas par 'gyurayi/ /phyag gi sor mo rtse mo mtha'/ /rnam par bsgyur bar gar mdzad cing / /phyag sbyar khong stong pad+ma yis/ / glog bzhin dpral ⑦nas spyi gtsug (8)tu/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis longs spyod pas/ /sna tshogs bde byed gtso 6)nyid la/ /las kyi 'tshul gyis mnyes mdzad cing / /bcom ldan sna tshogs gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ⑩ba thig le byang chub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po shin tu dgyes pa bde ba chen po nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung 8ngo / /dkyil 'khor nyid kyi tshul gyis su/ /cho ga sbyor ba (stespros byas te/ /de dang mthun 7pa'i dkyil 'khor gdon8/ /sbyor ba'i gar gyis gar byas shing / /ci ⑫ltar yang dag brtag par bya/ /ci ( ltar dkyil 'khor de kho na/ /he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpa' bos kyang / /brtag tunyepar 103—364

nus pa ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes kyis brtags ①pas/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig gis②/ / lha yi ⑧sbyor ba rgyas btab pas/ /cho ga shes pas bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /thig gis yongs su 'khor bar btab/ /dbus su ④'khor lo rtsibs bzhir ldan/ /kun du yongs su mu khyud bcas/ /phyi rol rdo rje ra bas (snyebaskor/ /de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das che mchog ho ru ka rigs bzhi he ru mas ni bskor/ /grwa ⑥bzhi shwa ri yum dang bcas/ /de'i phyi ④rim 'khor lo rtsibs nini bcu drug la ye shes khro mo bcu drug /de'i phyi rim pad+ma bcu drug la sprul pa'i khro bo pha ⑨bcu drug /de'i phyi rim pad+ma bcu drug la sprul pa'i phra men ⑩ma bcu drug de'i phyi rim snam bu gcig la yang sprul bcu drug /de'i phyi rim snam bu gcig yil yang ⑩zhe sprul bcu drug /de'i phyi rol tsosnam bu gcig skyil sman gyi lha mo sum cu 8rtsa gnyis / /de'i phyi rim snam bu la bcom ldan 'das de kho na nyid kyi sku bsil dpag bsam gyi shing bzhin/ de'i rtsa ba na sman bdud rtsi lhag ma re re/ gser gyi me tog gzhon nu re re/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod cing bdud rtsi bum pa thogs nas sku khrus mdzad pa re re/ de'i phyi rim snam bu la dbang phyug ma las las grub pa/ mgo brnyan ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad dgod/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dgod pa'i don bzung zhing bka' stsal yipa/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni ()dbus nyid du/ /bcom ldan (nyeche mchog he ru ka /dbu ni nyi shu rtsa gcig la / /phyag ni bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhabs brgyad lha chen pho mo mnan/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi (6ya ba skoraso na/ /sbrul nag chun pos dbu la brgyan/ /thod pa rlon pas se ral kha/ /stag lpags 103—365

mgo chen sham thabs can/ /khrag dang zhag gi ①tshom bur bcas/ /bder ②gshegs rigs bzhi he ru ka /khyu dumachog ma he gzig dudang stag /mi 'jigs sems can bzhi yi khri/ /smug nag sngo nag ser nag dang / /dmar nag ljang rjonag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / dbu gsum ①phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad/ /cha lugs mgo bo yab dang mthun⑦/ /dbus kyi dbu gyen du lta ba'i zhal gyi ⑧nang du rdo rje bcug ⑨nas gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba tshul bzhin du mdzad cing bzhugs so/ /rigs kyi yum kun gtso bo ⑩yab dang mthun0/ ye shes las grub pa'i khro bo rdo rje thogs med dang / khro bo rdo rje mdung chadang / khro bo rdo rje me dbal dang / khro bo rdo rje mda' bsnyag (3dang / khro bo rdo rje phur bu dang /khro bo rdo rje tho ba dang / khro bo rdo rje bya ④gri dang / khro bo rdo rje rnon po dang /khro bo rdo rje ral gri dang / khro bo rdo rje zhags pa dang / khro bo rdo rje gtun khung 'dzin 7dang / khro bo rdo rje gzhu 'dzin dang / khro bo rdo rje ral pa gcig pa ⑩dang / khro bo rdo rje ye shes dang / khro bo rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / khro bo rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin dang / khro mo rdo rje pad+ma ṣ+ṭṛ ku ṭi ⑩dang / khro mo rdo rje ral gcig ⑫ma dang / khro mo rdo rje rtse mo dang / khro mo 'jigs su rung ma dang / khro mo mi thub rdo rjes 'dul ba dang / khro mo bkra 4)shis ma dang / khro mo dpal ldan ma dang / khro mo pad+ma'i phreng 9 ste thogs ma dang / khro mo nor bdag ma dang / khro mo grags ma dang / khro mo grags chen mo dang / khro mo rin 'od ldan ma dang / khro mo pad+ma'i spyan mnga' ma dang / khro mo zas sbyin ma dang / khro mo bdud rtsi 'khyil ma dang / khro mo rdo rje dur khrod ma dang / sku mdog gcig tu ma nges te/ sna tshogs cir yang 'gyur ba'o/ /sprul pa'i khro bo 'di dag kyang sku mdog sna tshogs 103—366

su 'gyur ba'o/ /khro bo hūm̐ ka ra dang / khro bo rnam par rgyal ba dang / khro bo nī la daṇ+ḍa ①dang / khro bo ya mān ta ②ka dang / khro bo mi g.yo mgon sridang / khro bo ha ya gri ④ba dang / khro bo ṭa ki durā dza dang / khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang /khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dang / khro bo ma hā ba la dang / khro bo bsnyud kyi rgyal po dang / khro bo zla ba'i gtso bo dang / khro bo rdo rje khu tshur dang /khro bo gom pa 'dor ba dang / khro bo gnod sbyin rdo rje dang / khro bo las thams cad pa yidang / khro mo 0sprul pa'i phra men ma dang / rdo rje go'u niri dang / rdo rje tso'u ri dang /khya rdo rje pra mo ha dang / rdo rje be tā ⑩li dang / rdo rje puk+ka si dang / rdo rje ghasma 7ri dang / rdo rje sma sha ni dang / rdo rje tsaṇ+ḍa ⑩li dang ske/ rdo rje sing ha mu kha tsodang / rdo rje byā skṛ mu kha yidang / rdo rje sri la mu kha 8dang / rdo rje pra tson mu kha ⑩dang / rdo rje kri ta mu kha phyedang / rdo rje rka ka mu kha yidang / rdo rje khā ka mu kha dudang / rdo rje u 0lu ka mu kha 'dang 'di rnams sku mdog gcig tu ma nges so/ /'di kun zhing bsnol 'ama'i khri la bzhugs so/ /bdud rtsi lha mo de rnams kyang / phyag mtshan rdo rje bum pa 'dzin/sku mdog dmar po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la sku lus glang po che'i cha byad du sprul nas mdzad/yang sprul chen mo seng ge lcam dral dang / stag lcam dral dang / wa ()lcam dral dang —/ spyang mo lcam dudral dang / bya rgod lcam dral dang / kung ka lcam dral tsodang ske/ bya rog lcam dral dang / zhug pa lcam dral dang / 'di dag kun gyi ye shes sprul pa'o/ /pha bang rngo )lcam dral dang / zer mo lcam dral dang / pho rog lcam dral dang / skra ka lcam dral dang / khu ta (3lcam dral dang / byi la lcam 103—367

dral dang / spre'u lcam dral dang / khyi lcam dral dang / sprul pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /las grub pa dbang phyug ma/ byo mi'i srin mo dmar ser shing ①chen tri shu ②g.yag mgo mdu/ /tshangs pa'i dmar skya bhan dudamar rtse lnga sbrul mgo ma/ /khro bo khyab 'jug 'byung sdig ②snying 'dren gzig gi mgo/ /khyab 'jug dkar dmar dung dmar byi zhags ⑥sri mo mgo/ /gzhon nu ser mo rdo rje pha bang ⑦mgo/ /dbang mo dmar skya bam chen khro chen dred kyi mgo/ /dmar mo (nyedung dmar rgyu zhags dmar mo dom gyi mgo/ /bdud rtsi sngon mo rin chen chu srin mgo/ /zhi ba sngo skya bam chen snying 'byin stag gi mgo/ /be con nag mo bam chen thod rlon khra yi mgo/ / srin mo nag yo)mo bam chen rgyu zhags wa yi mgo / /za byed nag mo bam chen snying ⑩'byin stag gi mgo/ /dga' byed nag mo khong chen bgegs rgyal bya rgod mgo/ /khrag 'thung dmar mo 7rdo rje dbyug dung dmar rta'i mgo/ /gcig pu dkar dmar nam mkha' lding gi mgo/ /yid 'phrog dmar ser bzhis 8bsdus byi za khyi yi ⑩mgo/ /grub ma dkar dmar sad ma byi za pu ④shud mgo/ /rlung mo dmar ser ro za rdo rje 7sha pa'i mgo/ / gsod byed skya 8ljang bam chen rde'u chung skye dhika'i mgo/ /me mo dmar ser mo srag rgyu 'dren skyin hunyegyi mgo/ /phag mo ljang nag rtse lho)sbyin rlon dmar phag gi mgo/ /dmar mo ljang sngon bdud rtsi'i khrag 'thung ( )khra yi mgo/ /sna chen ljang nag bam chen longs spyod ba lang mgo/ /grub mo ljang ser bdud rtsi bhan 63dmar sbrul gyi mgo / /phag mo lcags kyu phu 9 mitra rdo rje khu byug mgo/ /ra ni ser mo rgyu zhags ra yi mgo/ /bum sna dmar mo lcags sgrog 8nyekun 'joms seng ge'i mgo/ /gsus 'dzin ser mo bdud rtsi dril chen gzig gi mgo/ /sems can thams cad mchog 103—368

dag dang / /dgyes pa thams cad rab bsgrub ①phyir/ /nga ②yi de nyid gsung gis ni/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid bstan pa yin①/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bde chen po/ /gang gis chud pas ༷rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sems can mchog gi rjoston byed na/ /de nyid sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan gcig du'adus nasal/ /rab tu spro ba'i spyan gdangs nas/ /zhabs dang zhabs kyis ⑧gnon pa yis/ /sdud cing 'dor ba 'jug par mdzad/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi ①phyag gnyis kyis0/ /brjid pa'i rtse mo mtha' nas dgrol7/ /cung zad zur gyis gnon pa yis/ /mdzes pa'i spyi gtsug rnam bsgyur ⑩ba'i/ /spyan gyi phyag rgyas phyag mdzad pa'i/ /'gro la phyag rgyas btab par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /bskul ba'i dbyangs kyis rab tu bskul/ /gsang ba dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /shin tu dgyes tshe rdo rje dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen po/ /mchog tu dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /rnam pa 8kun du skye med rol cing chud mdzad pa/ /bdag cag gzugs dang bcas te rnam spyod 'gyur med pa'i/ /bde mchog byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /rnam pa kun du sdug bsngal yongs bral te/ /che ba'i ye shes lhun grub mchog dang ldan/ /bde spyod de la rol pas tshul bzhin mdzad/ /rdo rje glu ④ni blangs pa yis/ /shin tu srid pa'i mya ngan 'das/ /dag tsochen de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis brlabs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑩'dzum pa dang bcas pas spyan ut+pal kha bye ba bzhin/ smin ma dang sku rnam par sgyur ⑩ba/ glog dang chu rlabs su gyur pa nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las de kho na nyid 'di gsungs so zhes/ dkyil 'khor 103—369

zhes ni rab tu bya/ /ye shes rdo rje thugs la gnas/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje mchog nyid do/ /nyid kyi sbyor ba btags pa yin/ /rdo rje dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du//'od zer dkar po phreng ①bas mdzes/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'dra ba'o/ /rdo rje dpa' bo dkyil 'khor du/ /zla ba kham pa ②mdzes pa ma/ /mthing ga ③'bar ba kun rgyas pa/ /me la rlung gis bus pa bzhin/ /dgyes pa'i mchog ni rab bsgrub 6)pa'i/ /rin chen rdo rje dkyil 'khor ni/ /dga' bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /rab tu dga' ba nyi dum bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor dgyes mchog 'byung byed pa/ /dam pa'i dbang po pad+ma 'dra/ /'dab ma brgyad po dgyes pa yi/ /ge sar yize bas mdzes bya ba'og/ /las ni thams cad 'grub byed pa(she/ /rdo rje las kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /dga' byed dkyil 'khor ⑨gru gsum ste/ /'bar ba chen po me dang 'dra/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni brtag bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chen po yis/ /ci ⑩ltar de nyid sprul pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas rdo rje brjid pa'i gar mdzad cing glu dang / sil snyan dang /gling bu dang / pi wang dang / rdzo rnga dang / du na wa dang / ba na wa dang /pa la ki dang / zhi ba'i thal mos tunyesogs pa kun du gdungs 6)pa dang / sil snyan la sogs pa 62rol pas lha'i ro dang / ro'i zas dang / bza' ba dang /bca' ba dang / btung ba dang / theg pa dang / stan 'dang / gos dang /bldag 7pa dang / 'jib pa dang / 'jam pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos bstabs yinas gus pa dang bcas yonanas yonya'adzum pa dang bcas pa'i spyan gdangs te/ dbyangs 'dis bstod pa mdzad do/ /byams pas 103—370

kun du ①gzigs pas thugs rje'i spyan/ /grol bar mthun ②pa'i lam niston dug lngas ④'brel/ /gzungs kyi rang bzhin bder ⑤gshegs kun la stobs/ /bde chen kun du rgyas pas che ba'i ye shes 'dren/ /sku nyid stong pas tshogs pa'i rgyal po bzhin/ /chos nyid bde ba reg pas sku nyid ston/ /byang chub bgrod phyir chos kyi sgo mo bstan/ /gzungs ⑥bstan rigs lnga'i gtso bo rnams mdzad do / /dgyes pa drongs la bsnams gshing rol mo mdzad/ /bde ba bsnams ⑧shing dbyings nas bslang ba'i 0phyir/ /skye 'gag med pa'i tshul du rnam par ldan / /snying rjer 0rgyun bcas bde ba chen po ston/ /chos nyid bde ba chen pos nam mkha' yibazhin/ /bde ba mchog gi tingang las sprul pa'i lha mo kye/ /rol pas 'dus pa'i 8tshogs la stsal bar mdzod/ /bde la bsnams ④shing bde la ma nos hūṃ/ /bde mchog char pa rab tu dbab par gsol/ /dbyings las bder tsogashegs slob ma gzung du gsol/ /ci ⑩ltar bzhugs pa'i gnas su bzhugs su gsol/ /ngo mtshar byang chub tshe 'di bde ba thob/ /pha rol phyin drug gang la mi rten ⑩par/ /mi skye mya ngan 'das pa'i gzugs dang rnam par ldan / /bde ba chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa yi(nye/ /rmongs pa'i bde bas 'gro la snying rje cheyi/ /byang chub sems kyi dgyes mchog mi chags pa'i/ /glu 'di dag ni blangs pa yis/ /yid dang 'thad pa'i bde chen po/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa/ pad+ma dang 'dra ba'i spyan gnyis kyis kun du gzigs shing / 'dzum 6 )pa dang bcas pas zhal rgyas par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phran gyi tshogs zhunya'ajig rten gyi 103—371

khams mang po bskal par rgyas pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho chen po snyed ma lus lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / rin po che dang —/ pad+mo dang/ las kyi rigs las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang /rdo rje 'dzin ①dang / rin chen 'dzin pa ②dang / chos 'dzin pa rgyadang / sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs dang /thugs las byung ba dang / mtshon rjodang / dga' ba dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa rnal 'byor g.yog gi tshogs tshad med par byed par 'dren pa dang / 'gugs (snyepar byed pa dang / 'jigs ⑥par byed pa la sogs pa'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshogs dang / grags pa med pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje 'phrog par byed pa'i tshogs dang / gzhan yang phyi rol gyi rdo rje dang / rin chen pad+ma dang /las kyi rigs las byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la rnam par gyur pa dang bcas pa kun du gzigs pa'i spyan gyis gar mdzad ma dang / kun du gnon pa dang glu/ tshogs ⑦kyis 'debs pa dang / phyag na gar mdzad ma dang / 'gying —ba dang / kun du rnam par 'dor (nyaba'i gnon pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la byin gyis brlabs nas dgyes pa'i gdon mi za ba zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las gsungs pa/ de nyid bdag ni 99mnyam bzhag 7dang / /de bzhin lha'i de bzhin nyid dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya de bzhin nyid(nyu/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mchog tu 'gyur/ /yan lag thams cad bsam las 'das/ /yod med gnyis las mi gnas pa/ /'dren dang tshig 7las yang dag 'das/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor mchog ces bya'o/ /103—372

chos min chos ni rnam dpyod hu)pas/ /chos rnams thams cad brtag ⑧par bya/ /rnam dag nam mkha' 'dra ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /'dod chags mi chags 'dod chags mnyam/ /chu yi pad+mo dmar ba ①'dra/ /rang sems 'dod chags shin tu chags/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ /gzugs med gzugs ni dri med pa'i/ /khams gsum las ni 'jug byed pa'i/ /sems ni chu nyid dang ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad g.yog dang bcas/ pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshogs dang / yang bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po bzhengs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma rab dgyes ④dpa' ba ⑤mchog /kye ma rab bgegs ༅phyogs bsgyur ba/ /rnal 'byor chen po tshogs mchog ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid kyis gsungs/ /sangs rgyas sbyor ba rab tu zab/ /rdo rje spyod pa bla na med/ /'jig rten gsum po bde thob pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /pad+mo rin chen sna tshogs che/ /thabs kyis sbyor ba gar (7mdzad pa/ /rnam grangs sems kyi 'jig rten du/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor nyid kyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ thams cad gar dang bcas pa'i phyag /sor mo 'dab ma kun du 'brel/ /rdo rje thal mo gar rnams bsgyur/ /brjid bag rigedag tu rab tu bcas/ /grol zhing ma kyi)mchu tshems kyis mnan/ /chu skyes ⑩'dab ma bzhin du gzigs pas bshad/ /dbyangs len pa dang gcig la gcig bskul dang / /snang zhing kun du ma chags par / /chags med bde ba mchog gis ni/ /bde ba'i rnal 'byor gzungs kyis rnams / /stobs zhing (7bde ba sbyin mdzad pa/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin bsam 103—373

gyis mi khyab ste/ /stobs shing bzhengs te grub par mdzod/ /chags pas rab tu mi gos pa'i/ /bde ba reg cing dgongs su gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po chen po dgyes pa chen pos bskul bas thugs sad par gyur te/ shin tu dgyes nas rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas shin tu dgyes pa chen po rnal 'byor gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du shin tu dgyes pa'i rdo rje dbyangs kyis mgur len cing / rdo rje rnam par rol pa yis / bcom ldan 'das dgyes bzhad pas bzhad cing / nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gsang ba'i thugs ka nas ma hā su kha ①rgyu zhes brjod/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag mo ye shes kyi dbyings dbang phyug ma 'di phyung ngo / /zla gam steng du ldan pa yi/ /ye shes gnyis po ma lta ③bu//thig le mtshan du ldan byas nas/ /gsal ba ye shes rnal 'byor ma/ /ā li kā ③li 'dren byas ma/ /ri mo dbus su brtag 0byas te/ /de yi mgo dang mjug nyid du/ /khro bo gnyis po mchog pos bya/ /'di ni btsun mo rab gsang ba'i/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ma'i/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'di dag kyang / /bsod nams kun gyis (nyabyin brlabs 'gyur/ /ā li gnyis dbus ri mo bri/ /'dren pa yang dag ldan pa ste/ /steng du zla gam thig ler dga'/ /mgo ⑥mjug tu yang gzhan yang bri(7/ /'di ni gsal ba'i don dam ste/ /rnal 'byor rin chen dbang bskur sbyin/ /bstan pas (nyabasod nams thob 'gyur te/ /sdig pa rnams kyang 'jig par byed/ /ā yo)li gnyis dang kyildan bya ste/ /tsheg drag yi ge gnyis su bshad/ /'di ni rab 'gal kun du chags/ /chu srin ma zhes bstan pa yin/ /dang po bskal pa chen po yi/ /tsheg drag po dang bcas 103—374

par bzhag① /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sbyin byed/ /bdag nyid la ma bzhag yang ⑤rung / /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab ste/ /bsgrub bya dkyil 'khor sgrub ①byed na/ /dngos grub myur du thob ④par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa rnams kyi mchog /ye shes phyag rgya mngon gnas pa'i/ /'dzin pa'i bsod nams ci 'dra ba'i/ /bris pa yis kyang khyab (nyepar 'gyur/ /e ma'o bde ba ye shes che/ /'di ni ye shes sku 'di layi/ /gnod byed pa ni bsten byed cing / /'di yi tshul gyis thob par 'gyur/ /khams gsum mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'di las rgya chen gzhan med do/ /sgrub dupa po dang sems can kun/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ /che mchog he ru ka gsang ba 'di bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa mchog tu gsang ba las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyi gsang ba chen po ⑧rnal 'byor ma dbang phyug 0chen mo rnams kyis ⑩mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste dang po'o/ / //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ngo mtshar du gyur te/ dgyes pa'i yid ches pa dang / mgu ba dang / yid dga' ba skyes nas shin tu dgyes (1pa chen po rdo rje bzhad 8pas mdzad cing / yang he ru ku'i sku mdog ni sna tshogs pa'ol/ /bcom ldan 'das che mchog he ru ka zhabs brgyad phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa'o / /de las spros nas phyag stong spyan stong gis/ stong gsum gyi tu stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa na/ shin tu mi srun pas gdug pa rlung rgyal che zhing dregs pa can thams cad la badz+ra dza li'i sgra sna tshogs 'od zer 103—375

du gyur te/ de las spros pas rigs bzhi he ru ka dregs pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ rak+ṣa ①te ru ka nyon mongs pa'i dug gsum dbang du sdud cing 'joms pa'i phyir rak+ṣa ②te ru ka /ye shes kyi ③don dang ldan pa'i phyir byi sha he ru ka /dam tshig las mi 'da' ba'i phyir sa ma ya he ru ka /de las 'phros rjopas he ru ka stong rtsa brgyad/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan cir yang sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /kro dhi(nyeshā ri sku mdog sna tshogs pa'o/ /dbu dgu phyag bcwa ⑥brgyad/ zhabs bzhi phyag cha ⑦sna tshogs pa'o/ /zhabs brgyad rdo rje 'bar ba me dpung gi nang na/ te ru ka bzhi zhabs bzhis mnan pa/ badz+ra te ru ka /pad+ma'i sbubs su dpral ba'i spyan phyed tsam nub par bzhugs pa/ shin tu rngam pa'i khro mo dbu'i steng na he ru ka zhabs brgyad kyis khro mo dbu brgyad ⑧mnan pa yang dbus kyi gyen du bltas pa'i zhal ni nang du rdo rje bcug nas gnyis su med par sbyor lazhing byang chub kyi sems yum gyi sku la bstims/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rigs kyi te ru ka zhabs 'og tu mnan pa yang gnyis su med par sbyar zhing byang chub kyi sems 'bebs/ badz+ra dza li'i ⑩sgra sna tshogs pas rab tu g.yos par gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi lha chen po rnam par rab tu skrag yinas skyabs su gsol lo / /mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol te/ rdo rje 'bar ba me dpung gis/ /bskal pa bas kyang bsreg tsomadzad cing / /'jigs chen rngam pa'i khyad par can / /dbu mang bsgrub tu pa'i tshig sgrogs shing / /phyag mang 8'jigs pa'i mtshon cha bsnams7/ /zhi ba'i phyag stong spyan stong yang / /'jig rten rab tu spa bkong min/ /khro gnyer phyag stong spyan stong yang / /rgod dang gshe zhing za byed pa/ /'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs can/ /'jig rten thal bar rlog 103—376

mdzad pa/ /khro chen khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /ma dang sring mo bu mo dang / /chung ma slas 'di rnams phul nas skyabs su gsol lo/ /chags pa med pa'i dbang gi ①thabs kyi sbyor bas dbang (mibasdus te/ dam tshig dang ming btags lag tu rdo rje byin nas rdo rje 'chang gi gral du dgod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po he ru ka rol pa chen po'i don gyi gsang ba rab tu ①rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyal po sku dang gsung dang lithugs kyi rol pa 'di phyung dungo / /dkyil 'khor 'di dag thams cad ni/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi mu khyud bcas/ /thig gis yongs su 'khor bar khyabatab/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad brig/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i snying po la/ /bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka /shar du badz+ra he ru ka /lho ru rata na he ru ka /nub tu pad+ma ④te ru ka /byang du kur ma he ru ka /shar lhor raka 7he ru ka /lho nub yak+ṣa he ru ka /nub byang byi sha he ru ka /byang shar sa ma ya he ru ka /bder tigashegs yum dang bcas pa dgod/ /de'i phyi 7rim snam bu la ye shes las grub pa'i phra men ma bcu drug dgod/ de yi phyi rim sgo 'bazhi thod pas bskor/ /gshin rje 'joms dang stobs po che/ /rta mgrin (nyadang ni bdud rtsi cha'akhyil/ /sgo bzhi dag tu rim bzhin no7/ /sku dang phyag mtshan cir yang 'gyur te gcig tu ma nges pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po de kho na nyid sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das dpal pad+ma he ru ka dbu lnga phyag bcu drug pa/gshog ⑩pa rdo rjes gtams 7pa/ zhabs brgyad chas dang brgyan cing / phra men ma bcu drug gi 'khor dang / dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi 'khor gyis 8bskor nas bzhugs te sprul pa las bcom ldan 'das rta mchog chags pa chen po spre)103—377
