ge mgo/ /ro mchog za ba'i phra men ma/ / byā skṛ 6)mgo gcod stag gi mgo/ /thod rlon za ②ba'i phra men ma/ /sri ga dur rkun chawa yi mgo/ /dur sri ma yi phra men ma/ /shwa ④na sha 'drad spyang gemo mgo/ /sha chen za ba'i phra men ma/ / gro dha (nyakhrag 'thung bya rgod mgo/ /khrag tshil za ba'i phra men ma/ /gang ka mu stika dur bya'i mgo/ /dug gsum 'joms pa'i phra men ma/ /khā (nyakha rgyu 'dren pho rog mgo/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phra men ma/ /hu lu tshe 'phrog 'ug 6)pa'i mgo / /glo snying za ba'i phra men ma/ /stag g.yag sha ba seng ge'i mgo/ /byi la spyang ki yiwa yi mgo/ /dom dred phag gi mgo can rnams/ /thugs dam bzhin du las byos shig /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / chags pa med pa'i sbyor bas sku la yinya'akhril cing ⑫/ las mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sgo ba rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dzaḥdzaḥlcags tunyegyu glo snying 'dren / /a mo sngon mo 8thod sprul zhags/ /a 4geli dmar mo yilcags sgrog sdom//bas ni ljang gu 7dril 'khrol dgyes/ /bka' stsal pa bzhin du nyan par mdzad do / /bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka rol pa las ye shes kyi yinakhro bo dkyil 'khor gyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal lha mo sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sku dang gsung dang thugs yinardo rje las phyung 'i )ngo / /rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di phyung ngo / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs rnam pa bzhis ni brgyan/ /dar dang dril bu chun po dang / /nyi ma zla bas rnam par brgyan / /rin chen mu tig ( 7'bras bus spras rte/ /do shal rkang gdub rnams 103—395

kyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni rnam bres pa/ /sna tshogs phreng ba gos kyis ①brgyan / /srad (2bu bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ /ka ba mchog brgyad yang dag ldan/ /dbus su dga' byed stan la ni/ /dngul la sogs pas rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i dar gyis g.yogs/ /thams cad stan la de dag ces/ /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /stan de la ②ni gzhag ④par bya/ /tshad med pad+mo dmar 'dra ba/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs⑤/ /yid bzhin nor bu dbu rgyan ldan/ /rin chen gtsug ni rnam par mdzes/ /tshad med dang ni sbyang ba ⑥yi / /dbu la chun pos mdzes par byas/ /sna tshogs ye shes rab tu gnas/ /chu skyes spyan ni rab tu rgyas/ /dga' byed yid tsam g.yon du 'dud/ /g.yas kyi phyag gis rdo rje che/ /snying gar (7gsor la rab tu brtson⑧/ / bde la ⑨sogs pa yon tan ngoldan/ /thog ma nyid du rnam par gzhag /slob ma'am yang na gzhan yang rung 17/ /mtshan kun yinagyis ni rnam brgyan la/ /tshul bzhin byin nyi gyis brlabs ñca)bya ste/ /dbus kyi dkyil du gzhag par bya/ /bdag nyid kyang ni mnyam bzhag ste/ /de la 7sogs pa yon tan gtso/ /dbus kyi stan la 'dug pa ni/ /bdag ni rab dgyes rjes su smra/ /der ni slob ma byin brlabs te/ /thams cad las byed phun sum tshogs/ /rdo rje pad+ma las byung ba'i / /gsang ba yis kyang dbang bskur ro/ /rab dgyes la 7sogs yon tan ldan / /yid 'ong bu mo btsal bya ste/ /snying ga mtshog (nyam mgrin spyi bor/ /lha tsornams la 17sogs 'bru bsgoms te/ /mtshan ma phyag rgya ṭaṃ )rab 'bar ba'i rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /rang la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /tshul bzhin thams cad gzhag par bya/ /mdun du lha mo myos byed ma/ /ma sgonyamachu 'dzin 103wa 396

pa'i ro la dgyes/ /dkar dmar kha dog 'dres pa yis①/ /thams cad rgyan ②dang yang dag ldan/ /lo ni bcu drug lon pa mchog /shes rab can gyis ①mdun du gzhag④/ /g.yas su lha mo gsod (༅byed ma/ /mtshon cha'i mda' ni 'dren par brtson/ /do shal rkang gdub dag stigis brgyan/ /lo grangs nyi shu lon pa ste/ /gser gyi ri bo zhu ba 'dra/ /chu skyes spyan ni yid tsam sngo/ /sems dpa' che la mnyes mdzad cing / /de yi tshul bzhin gzhag par bya/ /rgyab tu lha mo rmongs byed ma/ /pad+ma dmar po mdog gi 'od/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'o/ /sku yi ( )tshad ni nyi shu gcig /dga' byed 'dod pa'i ro la dgyes / /sna tshogs na bza' yang dag gsol/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs(kye / /sna tshogs pad+mo sbyor la 5)sogs/ /gar gyi bya ba rab rlag gzhag /g.yon du sna tshogs chen mo ⑩ste/ /sna tshogs dgos pa rjes brlabs pa/ /sku yi tshad ni bcu gnyis ldan/ /rnal 'byor la ni shin tu brtson/ /lha dang lha min mi yi rnams/ /'gro ba thams cad myos tunyemadzad ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan 8gyis rnam par bklubs6ste/ /sna tshogs dar ni na bza' gsol/ /grwa rnams yidag ni thams cad du/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg rnams dang / /bdug pa me tog bsung ⑫ ldang ba/ /gzi brjid chen po'i 'od dang ldan/ /ci rigs par ni gzhag par bya / /sgo yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rang gi las kyi phyag rgyar ldan/ /skal tsoldan 'ga' la rnams yonamos pa/ /sgo srung yinyebazhi ni gzhag par bya/ /gzhan yang rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /pi wang gling bu brdab pa dang / /rdza rnga rnga chen ku mu da(tshe/ /mu ra tsa dang da ra (3 )dang / /gar dang dbyangs dang bzhad zhugepa che/ /rol mo yo byad sna tshogs rnams/ /dga' byed dkyil 'khor gzhag 103—397

par bya/ /6)phyi yi dkyil 'khor thams cad do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni phyi rol du/ /rdo rje nam mkhar 'gro ma gzhag /yi dgas (0phyag rgya yang dag zhon/ /dpa' bo 'jigs byed gzugs 'dzin te/ /skal ldan rang gi lag char ldan/ /gdug pa'i sems kyis bsdigs byed cing / /sha khrag dang ni rgyu ma dang / /rkang dang tshil bu ⑧za spyod pa/ /dkyil 'khor byas te bdug pa ni/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gzhag par ④bya/ /dga' bar byed dang 'dren par byed/ /gsod ⑤par byed dang 'phrog par byed/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi rnams/ /shar gyi phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /gzi brjid che dang 'bar byed ma/ /'joms byed bong bu lho ru ste/ /gtsug lag mthong ba'i zhi)rgyu yis ni/ /mkhas pas tshul bzhin gzhag par bya/ /chags chen po dang chags bral dang / /'khor lo ma dang rgyas 'debs ma/ /rab ⑦tu 'byor bas 'byor byas te/ /ci rigs nub tu gzhag par bya/ /sna tshogs lus dang srung ba dang / /gnod sbyin mo dang yang dag 'phrog /sngags dang phyag rgya byin brlabs nas/ /sngags mkhan ci rigs byang du bzhag /shar gyi grwa 9nyaru gzhag pa ni/ /bya rog gdong ni mig ⑨'bru ste / /'jigs pa'i mig dang 'jigs pa'i gdong / /ci 7ltar rjes (mesu mthun ྅snyebyas te/ /yi dgas yi ston la yang dag 'dugatso /sna tshogs mchog gi gdong 'dzin te/ /lag par gri dang khar yigazhong thogs/ /mchog tu sha dang khrag za ba'o / /nub dang lho yi tshematshams gzhag pa/ /bzhad dang 'ug pa'i gdong ring ma/ /khros pa'i khri dang phag gi gdong / /gsus po tu che la lto 'phyangs tunyernams / /nub dang byang gi mtshams dag tu/ /rnga mo (7bong bu gdong 'dzin ma/ /khros pa ra dang khyi yi gdong / /rgyu ma'i mgo nas sha bar byed/ /shar dang byang 103—398

gi mtshams dag tu/ /keng rus dkar po 'dzin pa ste/ /khros pa rus pa'i phreng bas bklubs①/ /lto 'phyangs lapo la bum ①pa 'dzin/ /phan tshun 'thab par brtson pa yi/ /ce ⑤sbyang gi ni 'khor gyi ⑤rnams/ /'jigs byed gdong ni mche ba 'dzin/ /rnam par bsgyur ba'i gzugs 'dzin ma/ /sgo rnams kyi ⑥ni phyogs rnams kun/ /sgo bzhi rnams ni gzhag par bya/ /byang gi nyaphyogs su (nye'abod 'grogs te/ /bum pa rnams ni shar nyid du/ /nub tu rnam par 'jigs yi)pa'o / /lho ru gshin rje rgyal po bzhag /de dang gzhan yang rgyal po mchog /nam mkhar 'gro bas kun du bskor/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' yum gyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /dgyes shing spyan ni rgyas pa yis/ /bzhengs yinas dgyes pa chen po yi/ /brjid pa'i phyag gis gar mdzad cing / /thal mo sbyor nas tunyegatsug nyid du/ /gzhag pa yis ni 'dud par byed/ /bskul ba yis ni dbyangs 'di yis/ /de dag gtso la mnyes par byed/ / kye ma chos ni ngo mtshar che/ /tu kye ma spyod pa ngo mtshar che / /tu kye ma sbas pa ngo mtshar che/ /kye ma bde byed yang dag 'byung / /kye ma kun du bzang po ④don/ /kye ma rab dgyes yang dag 'grogs/ /kye ma bde ba dga' ba che/ /kye ma bde ba bde mchog ste/ /kye ma sngags kyi yang dag sbyor/ /kye ma snying po yang dag sbyor/ /kye ma phyag rgya yang dag bzhugs/ /kye 7ma bsgrub ⑩pa rmad 'byung ba'iyon/ /kye ma pha rol phyin pa yis/ /kye ma ci hunyeltar mthur rigs pa/ /kye ma dgos pa sna tshogs che/ /kye ma dag pa gsum sbyar ba/ /kye ma rdo rje mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /kye ma pad+ma rnam phye ba/ /kye ma dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'i/ /kye ma mchog dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /kye ma gar ni dga' ba che/ /103—399

kye ma glu ①rab dri ma med/ /kye ma sil snyan rnam par ②'khrol/ /kye ma gda' ⑧dang mun sel ba/ /kye ma dga' byed me tog phreng / /kye ④ma mar me mun pa sel / /kye ma dri ni shin tu bsil/ /kye ma rnal 'byor mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /kye ma sgyu ⑤ma nam mkha' 'dra/ /kye ma sangs rgyas nam mkha' 'dra/ /kye ma rin chen bde mchog skyed/ /kye ma sna tshogs sgyu (phyinam mdzad/ /kye ma ngo mtshar sangs rgyas dang —/ /kye ma ngo mtshar dbang po rnams/ /kye ma ngo mtshar sems dpa' che/ /kye ma ngo mtshar lha yi rnams/ /shin tu dgyes che rdo rje la/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bstod byas te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'gying ba ⑦yis/ /dga' dang bde byed skyes par 'gyur67/ /chu skyes zhal ni 'dzum bcas pa/ /yangs pa'i spyan gyis gar mdzad de/ /spyan dang zhabs ni bsgyur ba yis/ /rab tu dgyes ldan smin ma bsgyur/ /yangs pa'i (9)spyan gyis gar mdzad de/ /spyan dang zhabs ni bsgyur ba yis/ /yid tsam mdzes pa'i spyan zur gzigs/ /sha rgyas brla ni nu mar 'dud / /rked pa'i dbyes ni rnam par yangs/ /rnams kyi gos kyang che la mdzes / /chags pa cung zad tshems kyi tshaganon/ /tshems kyi phreng ba kun da zla / /mi drag zlos pa'i dbugs 'byin cing / /rab tu dga' chen dgyes pas bstod /tsho1spyo/ /bud med gzugs ldan mdangs bzang ba/ /lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis gnas gsum gyis/ /dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo mchog /spyan la 7sogs pa bsgom par bya/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'od zer sna lngas khyab pa yis/ /pad+mo rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /'bar bcas zla 'od bzhin du dkar3ste/ /yid du 'ong ba bsgom par bya/ /103wa 400

bzhin bzangs ①phan par 'dod pa yis/ /bud med rnyed na cho ga bzhin/ /bde bar mchod par brtsam par bya/ /ye shes sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dbus su gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /sngags shes pas ni gnas bzhin du/ /bud med rtag tu gzhag par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /bu mo lo grangs bcu gnyis pa/ /dben pa'i gnas su khyad par du/ /sgrub pa pos ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /mtshan nyid dag ni yongs su dag /rab tu bzang la bzhin yang mdzes/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ / pang par (gebazhag nas rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bu mo ut+pal mthing ga'i ①mdog /'dra ba dag ni rtag tu bsgrub/ /sbyor ba'i cho ga de nyid ni / /byas na rgyalas rnams brtsam par bya/ /bud med sems ni rab brtan pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon pa la/ /rigs kyi sbyor ba rab bsgoms te/ /bdag gi khu bas mchod par bya/ /'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /na chung gzhon nu mig bzang (gebatsal/ /gzugs bzang gzhon ⑥pas brgyan pa yi/ /lo grangs nyi shu lnga lon pa'i/ /bzung 4)nas byol song skyes (khuganas brtag /bzhin bzangs kyi)shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /na chung mtshan ldan skal 7ba mchog /mig bzang 6glebartan pa'i blo ldan pas/ /khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /dben zhing rab tu nyams dga' bar/ /sbyor ba mchod pa kun brtsams na/ /rdo rje sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /zla ba phyed kyis nges par grubazhu)/ /smin dkyus ring zhing skra lo 'jam/ /lus ldem dbyibs sgu tsho)blo dag cing / /brtan wipa chags shing bcos su btub/ /lus nyan ci la thogs pa med/ /rked pa phra la ro smad zlum/ /stod ni drang la shin tu rgyas/ /tshems dkar mgul ring 8phyag 103—401

sor ring / /dkar la tu)dmar chags ②rnar bu'i mdogadu /gzungs ma mtshan ldan spyad par bya/ /mnyen lilhug 'khril ldem rab tu mdzes/ /yid 'ong 'dzum phran spyan zur gzigs/ /mkhur ①tshos dkar pos gdab par bya/ /dkar 'dzin phyir ni mnye bya ste/ /pad+ma'i ze ba yichen pos gdab/ /pad+ma lan gsum mnyes ④bya ste/ /mchan (3khung mngon sum rna ba gnyis/ /zangs kyi mdog gis gzung (9༄bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi btsun mo dang bcas par gyur to/ /de nas 'di brjod par mdzad do/ /zhi ba kha dog dkar la 'tsher/ /btang snyoms kun 7gyi spro bsdu yis/ /gsum pa rdzogs par ldan ⑩pa dang / /phyag rgya tshogs mchog (gede dag la/ /rgyal mo dag dang mnyam du skyes/ /phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /bcu gsum pa yi cha lugs tu)'dzin/ /che chung med par ⑩gsal bar bsgom/ /dbu la gnyis pa'i yi ger 8ldan/ /gsal ba nyid kyis dus dag tu/ /cod pan lnga yi rin chen las/ /rgyan gyi rigs ni gsal ba yin / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ / mthing ga mi'abar ba'i yi ge che/ /rigs kyi rin chen spro bsdu las/ /phyag rgya gsal ba'i skur gsal ba'i/ /rgyal mo dag dang mnyam du skyes(rte/ /sgrib pa kun spang sdig byed stobs/ /gnyis pa yi ni yi ge las/ /thams cad blo dbyangs yi ge gter/ /mnyam par 'khril ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rin chen rigs kyi phyag rgyar 1 tshogasal/ /las 'di thams cad kun gyi mchog /rgyal po rnam par rol pa'o / /pad+ma rā ga 'dra ba'i mdog /chos sku zla tshes rab ldan pa/ /gsal ba'i kha dog mdzes pa na/ /thams cad ma lus dbang du mdzad/ /sbyor dang skye dang bsdu ba yis/ /phyag rgya gsal bar dbang gis bskur/ /btsun yo )mo dag 103—402

dang mnyam du skyes/ /gnyis su med par 'khril ba yin①/ /dbu ru yi ge gnyis par ldan/ /rin chen rigs kyi spro bsdu las/ /cod pan rigs lnga'i kha dog ste/ /ci bzhin pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyag rgya bzhugs tshul pad+mo'i tshul/ /mnyam par gsal bas dkyil 'khor yin/ /mi phyed pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor kun 'dus mchog /pad+ma (mirigs kyi phyag rgyar chagasal//rigs kun gyi ④ni phyag rgyar gsal/ /mun pa sel ba'i mar me bzhin/ /gsal dag yid gnyis med par bsgom/ /chu skyes 'jam pa 'og tu ldan/ /steng dang sprod pa'i rol mo yis/ /dgyes shing mnyam pa'i mchod pa bsham/ /'di ltar gsal ba dbang yang rdzogs/ /thams cad bsdu ba zhes bya ba/ /de bzhin dbang ste las thams cad/ /dus gsum pa yi mdzad pa che/ /rigs ⑤kun 'dus par bde bar gshegs/ /mnyam pa ci bzhin ting 'dzin te/ /yi ge 'bru gcig (7kun gyi mchog /bshad par khyad par las kun rdzogs/ /chu skyes gsal bar 'dab ma'i steng / /gnyis su med par gsal bas na/ /rnam pa gnyis kyi bye brag gis/ /'dus par gsal bar skur gyur pa/ /'dod cing chags pa ma yin zhing / /blo la yid gnyis med pas na/ /phyag rgya gsal bar rgyal ba'i sku/ /rgyal mo dang ni mnyam du skyes/ /dbu la gnyis pa'i yi ger ldan / /sbyin pa rgya chen khebs pas na/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i gnas su bsdu/ /bong tshod (7lo grangs khyad par med/ /gnyis su med par 'khril bar gsal/ /dus kun du ni mnyam ldan pa/ /gsang (kyeb mchod pa rab tu rdzogs/ /zla rgyas 5nilta bu 7gtso bo bsgom11 / /chags pa med par 'dod bsdu / yi/ /yum dang lhan cig sgom tsho pa ni/ /ā li kā slar 'byed pa'i don/ /phyag rgya las kyi bye brag gis//103—403

bde ba chen po ②tshul gnas pa/ /rgyal ba kun kyang de dang mthun②/ /phyag rgya bsnol bar gnas pa yi③/ /kun kyang sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /phyag rgya rdo rje thal mo ni/ /kun kyang yum gyi rgyab tu bsnol/ /zhal gnyis mdzes par rab sbyar ba/ /zla gam pa yi ljags gnyis mdzesabya/ /dung gi phur bus mkhur tshos phyil/ /'debs shing rdeg pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /bsnyen pa nye bsnyen dbang rdzogs pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi mchog / bzhad dang du'adzum pa'i gtso gzugs bsgomatshu/ /rnal 'byor dka' thub chen po'i don/ /gsang ba spyod pa shin tu dgyes/ /gsang ba nyid du sems can 'dren⑧/ /thams cad kun gyi 0rmongs pa sel0/ /yum gyi las ⑩kyis khyad par ni/ /sa yi rim pa kun sbyor zhing / /zas dang mgo dbang med pa yi/ /nyan thos 'gog pa la ⑫sogs pa/ /byang chub sems kyi char chen gyis/ /pad+mor bcings pa tshar gcod mdzad / /dam tshig chen po sdom pa ste/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /phyag rgya chen po tshogs 6nyamachog ste/ /dga' ba don du rigs mchog yin/ /myur bar rtag tu ma yengs na/ /gdon mi za bar grub pa ni/ /'dod khams lha yi snyinyin phyed kyis/ /gsang ba kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsang ba'i don dang mnyam pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /kun du bzang po 8rnal 'byor mchog /gsang ba nyid kyis ⑩mkha' dbyings so/ /yi ge oṃ ldan tsheg drag bcas/ /rnal 'byor bde chen nyid kyi lho 7sras/ /gzugs khams lha tshogs byin brlabs te/ /phyag mtshan 'khor lo gsal ba dang / /bde ba rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs/ /gtso bo gser gyi kha dog gsal/ /nyi ma gser gyi 'od bzhin du/ /gsal ba 'tsher yo ba bcom ldan 'das/ /dbu ru yi ge gnyis pa 103—404

la / /rin chen myu gu khang pa 'bar/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan gyis/ /legs par brgyan pa mtshan rnams rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa chen po bzhugs tshul dang glu/ /ting 'dzin mthun pa ①'gro la gzigs/ /pad+ma ge sar dbus gnas pa'i / /thig ler ②gsang ba bzhin dang ldan/ /mdun du lha mo chags pa modu/ /lo grangs nyi shu mdzes dang ldan/ /ma hā ④su khe gnas la dgyes/ /mdzes pa'i lag pa gar dang bcas/ /gnyis su med pa'i bzhugs tshul ni/ /gtso la rten zhupa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /rgyab (5)tu lha mo dgyes chen mo/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen par mdzes tshul gyis/ /thal sbyar 'dzin pa sku brten pa/ /sku tshe bcu drug brtsan ( )dmar sku/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'dzin tshangs par sbyor/ /'dod chags can la mthun ⑧par mdzad/ /g.yas su zhe sdang 'dul ba mo/ /rdo rje pad+mo sbyor la dgyes / /ma dad pa rnams dbang med par/ /drag po sbyor mdzad zhe sdang sel/ /chags pa chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /gnyis su med par 5)sbyor ba yis/ /gtong ba 7med par bstan pa'i tshul/ /sngo bsangs mdog ldan khyad par che/ /sku tshad bcwa lnga chags pa can/ /dus mtha' med par sbyor la dgyes/ /steg tsodang sgeg pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal 'khutso/ /rab tu spras yinyepa'i 'gog pa rnams/ /bslangs nas rgyal ba'i sras su mdzad/ /arta tsom li phrin 7las kyis/ /thams cad byang chub chen po mdzad/ /mig gnyis 'dzums yidang sbom po yis/ /dbang mor ldan par byas pa na/ /gnyis su med par sbyor 'dod yin/ / sna yi 7rtse mor mthe'u chung 'dzin/ /ma ta bzhugs par brtson byas pa'o/ /so so rnams bsdams kha phye ba/ /dus la bab ces bya ba ste / /ting 'dzin gsal bar gyur pa na/ /dus la bab ces bya ba yin/ /'di 103—405

ltar brda ①ldan ting 'dzin la/ /dam can bud med rnams ②mi 'dud/ /dngos grub mi thob dam tshig nyams/ /tshe rabs ①kun du brlag par 'gyur/ /'di ltar brtson par byed pa na/ /g.yon pa skyed ④pa rnam ⑤bzhi yis/ /skyes pa na chung tshul bzhin du/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i 6)mtshams nyid du/ /dbyings phyug ༷lnga yi sbyor ba yis/ /dal bus dal bus gzhug (nyapa dang / /dal bus dal bus rab bskul te/ /drag po tshig gis 6)spro ba dang / /byang chub sems kyis pad+ma ⑩dgang ske/ /sbom po dbang ngam lnga rnams kyis/ /yum gyis blangs la gtso la mchod / /nye ba'i bsnyen pa la sogs te/ /bsnyen pa che chung rdzogs par bsgom47 / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /mchod pa brgyad kyis mchod par ston/ /de ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /gnyis su med par lugs bzhin du/ /mnyam par 'khril ba'i tshul du bstanatso/ /dus gsum kun gyi gdung 'dzin la/ /g.yon phyogs bsten (nyapa'i skal dang ldan/ /na tshod lo ni bcu drug pa/ /sdong po rul pa dag la dgyes/ /g.yas pa zur gyi spyan gyis gzigs / /dril bu sgra snyan 'khrol chal brtson/ /rdo rje rab tu sgrogs 7byed ma/ /sangs rgyas lnga 7yi dbu rgyan 6 7can/ /mngon du sbyor la rab brtson pa/ /brda (nyedang bcas pa 17gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la slong mdzad ma/ /byang chub sems kyi sprin tsho chen gyis/ /mchod pa chen po rab mchod mnyes/ /sprul pa bsam yas mtha' klas pa/ /dus gsum 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /so sor rumechags pa'i mdangs kyis ni/ /mnyen (snyedang bcas pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /de nas gsang ba chen mo 2lhadang gnyis su med par 'khril ba chen por gyur te/g.yon pa skyed pa mang pos 2 )mnyes pa dang pad+ma spang ( geb la sogs pa 'byung ba 103wa 406

mnyes par ①mdzad nas rab tu dgyes te glu 'di blangs so/ /chos kun dngos po med par rab gsal ba/ /'byung gnas chen po ya mtshan 'byung bar mkhyen/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar che'o zhes blangs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs pa(mi/ mdangs bzang mig gi dkyus kyang ring / /sku ni ldem la tsan dan dri/ /yan lag lcug ma ①bzhin du mnyen/ /tshems dkar sum cu stirnga rngo med/ /mgul (7ba zlum rings 4)rab tu legs/ /gser la g.yu spras g.yas su 'khyil/ /gzungs ma 'di dag bsten ⑦par bya/ /skad gdangs mi snyan ra ra (gupo/ /yang 6nyen rmongs bag sub sub po/ /sbrang bus gtses yipa'i sna sgra bzhin/ /sems can dag la khro zhing 'tshog /dam can dag la g.yel (nyabar mdzod / /phyi nang sra zhing 'bras bu can/ /de bsten (nyan ni dngos grub nyams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma la/ /rab tu 'phrul 4)te 'char ba yin/ /bden gnyis so sor snang ba yis/ /yum gyi mkha' zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /ma nor lam chen yikun bsgoms nas/ /kun du bzang mo bsgoms pas grub/ /bud med la ni mchod bsten na/ /ye shes chen po grub par gsungs/ /dpal kun du bzang po thams cad shes rab kyi longs spyod 'di gsungs so/ /mngon 8spyod las kyi 'jug pa 'di/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyod yin/ /rnal 'byor sdom thi pa gnas pa yin/ /de la mchod pa dam pa ni / /sbyor ba rab tu sbyor ba ste/ /kun du khyab pa (shekun du sbyor/ /rjes su chags pa dam tshig mchog /de byi dkar sham yinamadog dang ldan/ /bcu drug bong tshod ring ba dang / /lugs su blugs zhi )pa lta bu ste/ /lus legs mdzes dang ldan pa dang / /dpral ba dbyes che kos ko zhistephra/ /nu ma chung zhing sor mo 103—407

ring / /yid tsam mig dkyus hunyering ba dang / /so dkar thags bzangs ②mtshams thung zhing / /skad ②bzang mdangs dang ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas mchog ste/ /'di la brtson 6)par byed pa ni/ /rigs kyi rdo rje gdon mi za/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub ⑤par 'gyur/ /gnas rab bden par rab brtags (7te/ /sha dkar mdangs bzang mdog dang ldan/ /lus 'bring zlum pa cha byad gcan/ /so dkar thags bzangs (8)mig dkyus ring / /skad phra mdog dgod 6)spro ring ba/ /dpral dbyes la yisogs bzang gnas pa/ /rma ⑪nag la 7sogs gnas pa ni/ /rtag tu chos la 'dud pa yin/ /tshangs pa dbyangs kyi rin chen las/ /'di las brtson byas bsgrubs pa yi/ /de bzhin rigs kyi ting 'dzin las/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyod na/ /tshangs pa'i snga dro gcig tsam gyis/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa dga' ba ni/ /sbyor ba brtson pas 'grub par gsungs/ /bud med cha lugs legs pa ni/ /bong tshod mi ring lus phra zhing / /rkang lag chung zhing skad gsal ba / /mig legs ngo rlum brtsan (/snyedamar che/ /blun du chags pa mi shes med/ /lus la mtshan gyi rtarmad 'dras brgyan/ /tshig gsal rmi lam nyung ba dang / /so dkar mchu legs dad par ldan/ /chog shes pa yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /gsang ba'i mkha' la nyi zla'i 'od/ /rdo rje pad+mor ldan byas te/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyad na/ /'dod pa'i khams lha'i skad cig gis/ /'grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /lus zlum gtum pa nga 7rgyal can/ /khong na sems rnog sems la 'dzin / /bya ba 'dra la mi gtong ldan/ /bslab pa'i blo rtul sha rus che'i/ /mdangs bkrag brtags na phyi phyir gsal/ /sbyin la dga' zhing chos la dad/ /10(3—408

rin chen rigs kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /bag chags yi ge tshar gcod ①cing / /ting 'dzin blo la gsal ba na/ /bsgrub ②pa'i dus la bab pa ste/ /de tshe rab tu rtsen ⑧pa yis/ /yum gyi pad+ma kha phye zhing / /bde ba thugs kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /phan tshun du ni dga' spyad na④/ /rigs kyi rin chen grub pa ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /thugs rjes ⑤mdzad spyod bye brag gis/ /'jig rten dag na dman pa'i rigs/ /rab tu bkug ste dga' spyad na/ /snying rje mchog dang thabs ldan pa'i/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa chen po gsungs/ /shan pa'i rigs ngan smad ⑥'tshong ma'i/ /na ba'i rigs dang 'dod spyod rnams/ /'joms pa chen po'i ting ⑦'dzin gyis/ /myur du spyad na 'grub par gsungs/ /yi dgas ⑧gnod sbyin byol song dang / /khyi dang rus 7sbal spre'u la 0sogs/ /mi dang lha yi gnas mchog kun/ /so so 'tsham pa yidaga' spyad na/ /las mchog dam pa 'grub par tsogasungs/ /rab tu chags la chags pa'i mchog /rab tu rmugs pa rmugs pa sel/ /zhe snang can la 'tsham yo par ston/ /grags pa can la zhi ba che / /rtsen 8pa dag la rtsen 8par mdzad/ /thabs kyi yimadzad pa kun gyi mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /phyin ci log tu gang spyod rnams/ /gdul (zhebar mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mi mdzad pa ni ci yang med/ /shin tu gtum pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /gtum po thams cad dbang du mdzad/ /shin tu zhi ba'i cha lugs kyis/ /grags pa can rnams dbang du mdzad/ /shin tu mdangs ldan cha lugs kyis/ /chags pa'i yid rnams dbang du mdzad/ /e ma'o shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor chen pos rab tu brtson par mdzad pa/ yid kyi (nya'aphro ba dang / zla gam med pa dang / gyad 'gyed pa 103—409

dang / khur 6)ba bla na med pas phan tshun du dga' ba spyod do/ /sha mdog dkar la nu ma 'bur/ /stod smad phyed la smin dkyus ②ring / /pad+ma'i dri yang dung ltar 'phro/ /pad+ma legs pa gro bos 'dra/ /zlum pa ②che chung snyoms pa'o/ /sha mdog dkar la sme ba can/ /stod smad phyed la sor mo ring / /nu ma chung zhing mkhrang (3)ba ste/ /dri yang pad+ma'i dri ru shu bro/ /mgul pa legs la ring ⑥thung ran/ /pad+ma dmar la mkhur tshos 57)legs/ /spyan yang zlum la 'og nas lta / /sha mdog ser (8)la nu ma zlum/ /rked pa phra la ro smad zlum/ /rkang pa'i sor mo nang du skyor/ /lus kyang legs la che chung snyoms/ /tshems kyang dmar la thags kyang dam/ /sor mo rnams kyang phra la ring / /dri yang tsan dan dri ru bro / /yan lag lcug 6)ma bzhin du mnyen⑩/ /pad+ma ser la phra la ring / /spyan yang phra la zur du gzigs/ /sha mdog gnag zhunyal sme ba gnag(nya /sha yang gnag 12la rtsub pa ste/ /skad gdangs tsomi snyan gnyid skor ro/ /rmongs la mi shes sub sub mo/ /nu rdog 7che la nu bshal ring / /rkang pa sbom la sor mo thung / /gdong yang leb la sme ba mthugayome /smin ma thung tu la mig mi sdug /lus po sbom thung mjing 37pa thung / /pad+ma gnag )la yangs pa ste/ /ba lang can gyi rigs zhes pa'o sto/ /gzungs 8rtam mtshan dang ldan pa btsal ba'i don ni/rang dbang thob pa nang lo yang / /bcos su btub sa la lung nyan pa/ /skad gsal lta sribs thag tsho 'chod pa/ /spyod pa la dor rtog pa choms/ /yid gzhungs blo rno dbang po gsal/ /sems dag gzhung bzang zhal ngo rtag /dam tshig phog las mi 'da' ba/ / tshig la brdzun na gyi gron theb med/ /dad pa skyo dang dub pa med/ /spyod pa blang zhing dor ba med/ /brtson 'grus thang dang lhod pa med//103—410

ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod pa/ /gom pa dal la spyod pa gzob/ /mig 'bru tshugs su mi lta zhing / /'og dang zur gyis rtogs par lta0)/ /dbu lo 'jam la lcang lor 'khyil/ /spyan bkra phra la dkyus ②ring ba/ /sna gzur zor la rgyud ma chad/ /ya yo nyag sridang chad pa med/ /so dkar sum cu ④thags bzangs ⑤la/ /kos ko ⑥sogs bu yul gzungs ga'adra/ /mdog sdug dkar dmar mdangs phyed pa/ / rked phan duchag gang (9)zlum pa dang / /mgul pa zlum la phra la ring / /ngang mo bya yi tshul dang 'dra/ /sna zlum blta mdzes chung ba dang / /phyag gi sor mo phra la ring / /rna ba gro ba gcus 7pa 'dra/ /lce ni dar bltab khug pa bzhin/ /dbugs rgyu phyi nang med pa 'dra/ /gnyid chung sha yang sdud 4nyapa med/ /kha snabs 7med la dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs spos dri lus la bro/ /bskyod par mkhas shing las la dpa'atshos/ /sbyor drod rig tsodang ting 'dzin rig /pad+ma dam la spyad 8na dog /nu ma dag ni 7chung la sra/ /kha mchu tu srab la bzang pa'o/ / lha yi 4)sbyor ba tsog ()bu/ mi'i gan rgyal( )/ yi dgas khri)zur gyis sbyor/byol song kha sbub tu sbyor ro/ /gzungs nyam mtshan dang ldan pa rnams la zhag zla'i tshad bzung ste/ dam du bcas nas mchod dus mi chag par phyi nang mi bsre/dam bcas pa la ( gem gtogs ( rigepa rkunagazhan dang sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan du sbyor ba byas na dam las 'das te/ mngal gyi srin bu kha dmar du ( yeskye'o/ /dam las ma 'das bka' bzhin du bsrungs na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sras su skye'o/ /gzungs ma 'di dag dang bka' mthun khri par bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas gsungs so/ /he ru ka rol pa las gsang ba'i sa lha mo mchod 103—411

pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas ru lu'i bsnyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs 0)so/ /zhugs nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo (mi/ /ru lu chos nyid du shes pa ni oṃ la dpal chen po yab lnga la yum khrag 'thung rgyal mo lnga yang sku la rdzogs so/ /de nyid lta bas srin por song gis dogs nas ye shes lngar bstan to/ /a ltar snang ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla tshes me long lta bu'i ①ye shes/ sna stiru so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ a la btags ⑤par bya ba nan tan ⑥gyi ye shes/ yab yum rnams kyang de bzhin du sbyar/ chos thams cad ma byung ma skyes pa'i ngang la skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan no⑦/ /ru lu dkyil 'khor du shes pa ni phung po lnga rigs lnga 'byung ba lnga (7yum lnga khams dang skye mched byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma dang sprul pa lcam dral/ phung po lnga he ru ka lnga/ 'byung ba lnga khrag 'thung rgyal mo lnga/ khams dang skye mched phra men ma bcu drug /sgal tshigs dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ ba spu nyag 6)ma re re sprul pa'i phra men ma dang pho nya/ yan lag sgo ba bzhi/ sprul pa thugs kyi rgyan te/ sngags ma hā yo ga'o / /dkyil 'khor la yang phyogs dang gral ma nor bar dgod do/ /sgo skyong yan chad rim 7bzhin du dgod/ ru lu lhar shes pa ni bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po byang chub sems kyi don rtogs na sangs rgyas yin par shes par bya'o / /ru lu mchod par shes pa ni bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems kyi don rtogs na11/ bdag byang chub kyi yigesems mchod pas 'phags pa'i tshogs mnyes 103—412

pa ste/ 'grangs ①shing tshim par ②'gyur ro/ /tshim pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /ru lu bsnyen par shes pa ni bsnyen pa ni dpal chen po'i sku'o/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni yum kro dhi ②sha ri'o/ /sgrub ④pa ni phra men ma bcu drug /sgrub dupa chen po ni 'di ltar bsgrubs pas 'bras bu drod rnam pa gsum dang sbyar ro/ /'od kyi drod ni bdag sgrub (6)pa ⑦byed pa'i dus su bdag gi lus la 'od 'byung nib ni drod dang po dang sbyar ro/ /'don pa'i drod ni bdag sgrub par 6)byed pa'i dus su bdag gi lus bal 'dab g.yengs pa ltar byed na drod 'bring po dang sbyar ro/ /drod kyi drod ni bdag gi sems tag tag rang rang nam mkhar ⑩'phur snyam byed na tha ma dag sbyar ro/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ don dam par bsnyen pa ni byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang po'i yinyanye ba'i bsnyen pa ni byang chub kyi sems kun du bzang mo'o de la gnyis su med pa ni sgrub ⑩pa/ rgyu byang chub kyi sems skye ba med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos la 'bras bu kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems phyag rgya sna tshogs cir snang yang sgyu ma ye shes kyi phyag rgya tsam du snang / snang tsam nyid na rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka ste/ rgyu 'bras ro gcig pa'i byang chub kyi sems shes par bya ste/thig le chen po'i ngang du ye nas ma bcos par lhun gyis grub par gnas pa ni lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ste/ sgrub 4 pa chen po'o/ /ru lu sgrar shes pa ni byi khung spun bung ba chen po'i skad tsam rang gi rna bas thos pa las ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis tshor bar mi bya'o/ /ru lu dbyangs su shes pa ni/tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dren stangs tshekyis/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho thugs dam bskul / /rdo rje srin po ngur sgra yis/ /khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud/ /103—413

'khun ①cing gdung ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro thugs dam bskul / /khong kun 'dren pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis/ /ke'u ri brgyad kyi thugs dam bskul/ /mkhur ba dbugs kyi rlung 'byin gyis/ /seng gdong la ②sogs thugs dam bskul/ /sngags kyi yig 'bru bzlas pa yis/ /rdo rje tshig la skad mdangs ①med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ④las kyi bzlas pa 'di gsungs so/ /dam tshig ye shes dpal 'bar ma/ /oṃ ni sku gsung thugs kyi ngang / /ru ni gzi brjid 'phrul po che/ /lu ni yum chen dpal 'bar ma bh+yo ni ma sring rgya mtsho (5)tshogs/ /ru lu gser phreng rgya mtsho ste/ /phar spros pas ni sku la thim/ /slar bsdus 96)pas ni thugs la thim/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūṃ/ /hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /paṃ las pad+mar gyur pa'i dbus/ /ma las ④nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /sha da pa la 98)sogs pa yi/ /bskul ba bdag po)ni tshul bzhin du / /bsnyen ⑩pa dang ni nye bsnyen pa'o(nya/ /sgrub tu)pa dang ni bsgrub 8chen po/ /yum ni pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus la/ /dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyin pas bstim/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /sku yi sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi sku/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /gsung gi sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi gsung / /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na / /thugs kyi ⑩sprul pa bsam 7mi khyab/ /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi thugs/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /kun kyang badz+ra he ru kur 7byin (1 brlabs nas/ /badz+ra he ru ka yi yoshedangos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /lho phyogs stong gi 'jig 103—414

rten na/ /kun kyang rat+na he rur byin ①brlabs nas/ /rat+na he ru ka yi ②dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /nub phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /kun kyang pad+ma he rur byin brlabs nas/ /pad+ma he ru ka yi ①dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /kun kyang kurma he rur byin brlabs nas/ /kurma he ru ka yi dngos grub dus 'dir stsol/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na / /gnas rab gnas ni bsam mi khyab/ /dur khrod chen po gnas kyi mchog /bde ba chen po gnas kyi mchog /yum gyi mkha' dbyings gnas kyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi gnas/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /zas rab zas ni bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje dri chen 9)zas kyi mchog /rdo rje ga pur ⑤zas kyi mchog /bdud rtsi rnam lnga zas kyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi zas / /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skom rab skom ni bsam mi khyab/ /rak+ta dri chu skom gyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi skom/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /skyogs (phyirarab skyogs ⑦ni bsam mi khyab/ / bhan dha (kyegasar rnying (1)skyogs kyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi skyogs/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /yab rab yab ni bsam tu )mi khyab/ /kun du bzang po yab kyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi yab/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /yum rab yum ni bsam mi khyab/ /kun du bzang mo yum gyi mchog /de yang dpal chen nyid kyi yum/ /oṃ ru lu 'di ni sku yi sku/ /ru lu 'di ni sku yi gsung / /ru lu 'di ni sku yi 6)thugs/ /ru lu 'di ni gsung gi sku//ru lu 'di ni gsung gi gsung / /ru lu 'di ni gsung gi thugs/ /ru lu 'di ni 103—415

thugs kyi sku/ /ru lu 'di ni thugs kyi gsung / /ru lu 'di ni thugs kyi thugs/ /skur gsal gsung gsal thugs kyang ①gsal/ /sku don gsung don thugs kyi don / /ru lur ma gyur gang yang med/ /stong khams thams cad ru lus bkang //ru lu dngos grub dus 'dir gsol/ /ru lu dngos su snang ba ni skul/ de nyid ma skyes pa ni gsung / snang ba dang ma byung ba gnyis su med pa ni thugs so/ /ru lu sku gsum gsung gsum/ thugs gsum/ dgu phrugs kyi don to/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ ni 9/skadapal chen he ru ka yab yum mo/ /ru lu gong ma brgyad ni ke'u ri ma brgyad/ ru lu 'og ma ④brgyad ni sing ha ma brgyad/ hūm̐ ni sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ bh+yo (snyeni dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ hūm̐ ni sdud ⑥pa byang chub sems/ lha re re la snying po grangs brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad ⑦dbul lo/ /khro bo rnams ni kro dha ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ de nas bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa'i ting nge (8)'dzin du zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro gnyer snying po chen po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra skṛ ku ḍi ma hā kro dha po)ma/ ha na ha na/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa/ mā ra mā ra/bhañja bhañja / da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hūṃ rdu (nyebyi bri/ bra ma ya bra ma ya/ bi dwan sar+pā 32pa ra na sarba du/tunye/ ma ta ma ta/ mo ta mo ta/ hūm̐ bri traṃ traṃ/bri hūm̐ tram̐ traṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms skipar zhugs sosnyi/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje thugs ka nas phyung ngo / /pad+ma dza la ma hā kro dha pad+ma ba mu ka kha kha7/ sarba du// kha hi kha gyisnyon/ sarba dusta ba/ dustan ma/ da ma da ( shem / badz+ra sho da ka /ta ma tha ma tha/ kro dha gro dha/ badz+ra kha ra tsa/ ba la du ru/103—416

ga be ga tra sa ya tra sa ya ma hā badz+ra pa da ba mu ka /pra ma pra ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ ti ha ha ti ha ti/ tsa tur mu kha'abye/ bi phra ②na sha na hūm̐ hri/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hri/ rdo rje chen po 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i khro bo chen po'i snying po 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs ye shes kyi snying ga dunas phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra be ga ma hā kro dha sarba du/④/ sa ma ya bak+ṣa ya/ rtsu hūṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra sa k+ṣa ha na ha dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po thams cad phyag rgya chen po mngon par sprul nas mche ba chen po 'khyil cing zhal mi sdug pa/ spyan stong pa/ nyi ma chen po stong gi gzi brjid can rab tu za bar byed pa'i mdog sngon po'i sku/ dur khrod chen po'i dpal chen gyi phyag cha mi'i keng rus khrag dang sha dang lud pa dang rkang dang tshil rnams zas su gsol pa⑥/ mi'i pags (7pa rnams g.yogs te bsdams pa/mi mgo'i phreng ba dbu la 'dzin pa/ seng ge dang / glang po dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / ma he dang / phag dang / ce (shesbyang dang / ra dang /khyi dang / 'ug yo)pa dang / bya rog dang / bzhad yidang / byi la dang /gzig yidang / stag la sogs pa khro bo'i byol song gi gdong la sogs pa brgya stong mang po rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyung tu ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshul gyis shar phyogs 'jigs byed 'dul ba/ zhal rnam par bsnyen patshoste/ 'jigs pa lta bu'i spyan dang / zhal rdo rje mche ba cher gtsigs 8pa/ 'jigs par byed pa'i khro bo chen po brgyad 8stong gi yigayog dang / shar phyogs dkyil 'khor du 'khyil bar gyur te gnas so/ /lho phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du khro gnyer can mang po brgya stong g.yog dang bcas par gnas so/ /nub phyogs su yang rta gdong khro bo chen po 7brgya stong mang po g.yog dang bcas te gnas so/ /byang du yang 'ur 48103—417

'ur chen po khro bo brgyad 6)stong mang po g.yog dang bcas te gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shin tu khro bo chen po'i tshogs brgya stong mang pos bskor nas dbus kyi dkyil 'khor na bzhugs te he ru ku'i khro bo'i tshogs chen po de dag dang / khro bo chen po brgya stong mang po'i ri rab kyi rdul phran dang mnyam pa bskyed byung nas nam mkha'i dbyings rab 'byam 90thams cad snang bar byas te/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag rithams cad gang bar byas so/ /shin tu dgyes ④pa'i khro bo chen pos 5khro bo'i tshogs rnams la bka' stsal pa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya / na ma :ṇa ḍa 56)badz+ra pā ṇa ye(pe/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa (snyeta ye/ tabya thā/oṃ bho bho/ ma hā ba re 79 ba da ra ba/ ma hā dhi/ ha ra ha ra/ groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍayi/ma ra ma ra/ bhañja bhañjaXlha/ k+ṣi kra na ma hā badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa 44dha/ sarba duṣ+ṭi du ku /ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di gsungs ma thag tu/ 'jigs byed chen po dbul bar byed pa/ rang gi sku nam mkha'i dbyings kyi tshul du byed do/ /khro bo brgya stong mang 12po zhal rnam par bsnyer ⑨ba/mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'khyil cing bsgyur lib phyag brgya stong mang po la mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa/ zhal brgya stong mang po me lce bzhin du 'bar ba'i sku/oṃ ma hā badz+ra ang / ha sa ha sa/ ha ha ha hūm̐ ha/ o ti oṃ ma hā/ be ra ba bes / shing shing / tra tra tram̐ tram̐/ ha ha i ti/ de nas 'jigs byed chen po 'dul bar byed pa'i khro bo des he ru ma'i nga ro 'byin cing mgo bo nas mnan to/ /rdo rje he ru ma'i rol pa'i bdag nyid kyi mthu chen pos 'jigs byed chen po'i nga ro 'byin cing rgyu 1 ma'i sbu gu 1shedrangs nas khrag dang rus pa dang rkang yo rnams za zhing chem chem mdzad pas/ de'i 'khor la rab tu ston par mdzad/ ma mo'i 103—418

tshogs thams cad kyang sgren mor byas te sma phab 6)nas he ru ma'i tshogs chen po'i mthu dang gzi byin sribaskyed nas/ 'khor thams cad thul skyabs ③'og tu yang btsud (snyanas dam tshig la gnas te yang dag par bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo drug ④po'i bzhad pas bzhad cing / oṃ badz+ra skṛ ku ṭi yiha na ha na / grohā grihāX/ ma ta ma ta/ ki dun tsa ri ya/ si su ra ma hā sa/ sra ti re ke ba su ra dza la na la ra tshi pra ti dza li ta/ ma yinyesu ra rta/ ā kuta ṭa ā gta tshuṭa/ a phya wa/ a phya wa/ kroṇ+ḍa (nyatsakra be tunyer brti da yan hūm̐ (3bri/ de nas khrag 'thung gi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya bh+ri ku ṭi/ khro da ma hā kri te④/ da ra pa da ra pa/ su ra du ra ti/ oṃ sa me dad ma ni tsa na/ oṃ bra bra bi spra ba de nas rta 8gdong gi khro bo chen po'i sngags/ pa hriyi/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra ba da/ ba mu gnyu /kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ tsa dur mu khang tunye/ ba ba bi ba/ a ru ti ram / ma kār+ya hro 4)da yan/ dra na/ da ma de'u/ badz+ra ba rda ba mu gzhu ) /hi hi / sha hi sha ma hā she sonyasha hi hi/ de nas rdo rje chen po'i rta zhugegad chen po mdzad cing bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen pos khros pa dang bcas pa'i lta bas gzigs te/ oṃ gu lu gu lu badz+ra ma hā kro dha ā 2 kar ṣa ya/ ā 6kur ṣa ya/ sha kra skṛ da yā ( lke na ma hā badz+ra rda/ ( g.ya/ hūm̐ bhak+ṣa ya thi( haṃ/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po rnal 'byor pa rnams dang rol cing rang gi shin tu dgyes pa'i kun du longs spyod pa'i khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'du ba shemadzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das la bskul ba 47mdzad do/ /oṃ ma hā su ra ta/badz+ra ma hā kro dha pa saṃ ha ra pa saṃ ha ras no/ sarba gro dha ma sha ma sha ma ge/ pra sha ma zhu 103wa 419

pra sha ma/ sarba kro dha utsurmi ①yo dha bha ②ba sa ma ya/ ma chahā ma dre dule sta ma ya/sarba duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭa pra duṣ+ṭa ⑧gro dha ma ba ba duya/ dz+wa rgyal ya sha kra bā rda/ bai dusha ra ma ye/ sha ra ma hā/ bha ga brnyadhi/ su ra ti/ sarba ta thā ga tā sā dā ⑩na/sa ma ye na tsa hoḥyi/ su ra ta/ sa ma i ti/ de nas bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ dzaḥtsos baṃ hoḥ/ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dza hūm̐ ṭāk+ki hūm̐ ṭāk+ki 0rtsu/ oṃ ga ta she hūm̐ dzaḥ/ ā kur ṣa ④ya/ pra tsobe sha ya/ bharnya ya/ pa shi tsoku ru/ sarba kro dha sa ma ya/ dzaḥrgyu yo hoḥ/ ṭāk+ki rdzu dzaḥdzaḥs/ ṭāk+ki tu 7rgyu/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi khro bo chen po 'di phyung ngo ske/ /oṃ sum bha ni sum bha ma hā kro dhī 0shwa yiri hūṃ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi'i khro bo'i dbang mo 'di ( )phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ⑥ta ma hā kro dhī dushā ri/ uts+tsha badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ āḥ ste/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma bdud rtsi chen mo 'di kun du khros te / ru lu ru lu zhes bya ba 'byin cing rang gi pad+mo la bcom ldan 'das kyi ④rdo rje bcug ( snyenas bdud rtsi yang dag par bsgrub ⑩pa'i rig pa 0phyung ngo / /oṃ a mṛ (3)ta sa man tsi ba ni a mṛ zhu)ta su mu te/ pra be so )sha ya sar+pā dunyan badz+ra/ pad+ma ma sa / yo gi ni ra/ ma hā bo dhi tsotsi/ bi ta bi ti mun+ti duya/ rdo rje khro bo'i dbang mo zhes bya ba nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma he khri )shwa ri sarba du/(ste/ su ta ni ma hā mā la sdin/ sma shā cin pi sha tsi tsho/ ma hā badz+ra kro dha rdas kā gyur le bi kṛ ta/ de ba 6)na/ sarba sha du pra ma ṇi )rtsu hūṃ ma hā kro dhī shwa ri 0rgyu phaṭa/ khro bo 'di rnams phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa/ zhal gsum 69pa/ mdog in+d+ra nī (nyala'i 'od 'dra ba/ rdo rje dang / tho ba 〉gcig khang pa dang / thod pa dang / mdung dang / dgra 103wa 420
