gtso / /zhing lpags rlon pas sa gzhi 'gengs mdzad ma/ /zhing chen rlon pa g.yang hu)gzhi ral pa can/ /gzig alpags rlon pa stong gis ④sku smad bklubs④ / /sbrul nag 'bum gyis yan lag rgyan du sgril⑤/ /thod rlon thod skam thod tshal mgur chu dpung rgyan se phyiral kha/ /khyod kyi rdo rje the'u gshog g.yas pa las/ /ye shes lha mo tshogs ni ⑦brgya yang 'tsher/ /khyod kyi rdo rje the'u gshog g.yon pa la/ /las byed lha mo brgyad cu niganas/ /nyin 7zhing rgya ⑩mtsho gting nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /klu rgyal 'bum gyis dkris (1shing mchod pa 'bul//mtshan zhing ri rab rtse la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /gnod sbyin bu mo khyod kyi pho nyar gtong / /bdud kyi bu mo 'khol 7zhing nga rgyal drag tu gnon/ /gshed tunyem don du gnyer zhing dgra snying tshal par 'gas/ /bsur 7chen dud pas 'jig rten ma lus 'gengs/ /sha chen ro la rngam zhing tsodapal chen zhal du stobasayi/ /rang yang za zhing grogs la bdar 7bar byed/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro dbyings nas bskul bskyod la/ /las la 'khril zhing chos kyi dbyings su bsten(snye/ /mkha' 'gro za byed mgyogs ma gshog pa can/ /mkha' 'gro 'jug byed yid 'phrog nu ma can/ /mkha' 'gro rngam pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba can/ /mkha' 'gro 'byung ba 'dzin pa'i sder mo can/ /mkha' 'gro khams gsum rngub zhu)pa'i mchu rings 6 )ma / /mkha' 'gro dug gsum za byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /las kyi mkha' la 'gro ba'i shugs can ma/ /don gyis ri gemakha' la 'gro ba'i ye shes yum/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma brgyad dpal chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi (2gelas byed par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das he ( noru ku'i rol pa ma dang mkha' 'gro ma de rnams dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba rtse gcig ma'i ting nge 'dzin du mdzad do/ /'dod 103—427

chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum la stiskyes pa'i bdud bag chags kyis ②mtshams sbyar te/ bdud ru tra nag po sems can dudang rnal 'byor pa la 'tshe zhing gnod par byed pa za bar byed pa de la bcom ldan 'das he ru ku'i rol pas pho nya'i ting nge 'dzin du zhugs te/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /til mar sna tshogs kyis lus bskus pa'i rdo rje mche ba can dang /nag mo mi thod thogs pa'i rdo rje phreng ba can dang / rnal 'byor ye shes rdo rje dam tshig ma dang / mgo bo cod ④pan legs spras rdo rje khrag 'thung ma dang /lag na mtshon thogs pa'i rdo rje phreng ma dang / dgra bgegs dbang du sdud (snyepa'i rdo rje g.yul zlog ma dang / sbrul gyi ska rags ⑥'ching zhing lag na mdung thung ral gri thogs lam dang / zhing lpags rked par dkris ⑧shing khrag gis myos ma dang / mig rtsa dmar por 6)gyur pa'i rdo rje 'khrug ma dang / mtshan mo dur khrod du rgyu ba'i 'byung mo dhisgrol ma dang / ko rlon smad dkris ()thod pa se ral khar thogs ma dang / mi ro rgyu ma tshems kyis 'dren pa'i rdo rje zab mo dang /khrag gi thig les brgyan pa'i rdo rje dri tshor ma dang / zhing chung 'dzin pa'i rdo rje 'khrug ma dang / rdo rje zhag gi tshom bu can chen mo dang / rdo rje mi ro sha la chem chem za ba'i rdo rje mche ba 'dzin ma dang / drag po 'dul ba'i rdo rje drag mo chen mo dang / ma mo skrag par byed pa'i khams gsum dbang du sdud ma dang / zhing la rkom yo par byed pa'i rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ (nyag dang / nag mo lus mdog gnag 8pa'i rdo rje me stag 'phro ba mo dang / zas su khrag tshil za ba'i rdo rje srin mo dang / kun la dbang mdzad rdo rje pad+ma 'dzin pa yidang / zas su sha rlon za ba'i rdo rje rnga mo dang ske/ e ma ma tshogs rdo rje za byed ma dang / dpal ldan chen po rdo rje lcang 103—428

lo can ma dang / kha nas rdo rje me 'bar rgya mtsho skems ①ma dang / lag na bdud rtsi rdo rje 'dzin ma dang / nag mo mig gcig rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin ma dang —/ sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs pa'i rdo rje gshog pa can dang / lcags kyi bya khra khyung gi g.yu mig can dang / thal ba'i mtshan mas rdo rje 'byug lam dang / rdo rje ral gcig chen mo za ①byed ma dang / rdo rje tri shul thogs dupa'i zhag gi tshom bu ducan dang / tsham skyongam drag shul spyod pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs can rdo rje bdud 'dul mo dang / rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdo rje gzugs can ma dang / cir yang 'gyur ba'i rdo rje rdzu 'phrul can dang / khro gnyer spyan bgrad rnal 'byor sngo nag chen mo dang / mche ba gtsigs pa'i ral pa 'khyil ma dang ⑦/ thod pa rlon pa'i rdo rje mun tsal dang / dbu gsum phyag drug rdo rje mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol pa dang / sti ra chung ngu mang po brgyus nas brgyan te rdo rje brjid ma dang / tsham (shengam brkyang bskum rdo rje 6)'jig rten skrag ma dang / bdud bzhi gnon pa'i rdo rje bhan dhar 0ldan pa dang / ster chen glo snying 'dren pa'i rdo rje khrag 'thung ma dang 'jigs su rung ba'i rngubs (7pa'i rde'u chung thogs pa'i rdo rje rkan sgra can dang / log par lta ba'i rdo rje bdud ⑫rnams 'dul ba dang / ro la rngam pa'i rdo rje za ba mo dang / gsod cing sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor sngo nag ma dang / khro gnyer spyan bgrad rdo rje mche gtsigs tsom dang / tsham cingam chen mo mdzad pa'i tri shul mda' 'phen rdo rje 'gengs ma dang —/ dgyes par byed pa'i rdo rje se gol debs tsom dang / 'gugs par byed pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar nag 'jigs pa'i sku dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yum chen mo dang / rnal 'byor chen mo dur khrod bdag mo dang / tsham tso103—429

ngam gar mkhan chen mo rdo rje stabs tshul can ①dang / rnal 'byor mthing phyinag rdo rje stir chen za ba mo dang / bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i rdo rje gdug pa klad 'gems lim dang / gsod pa'i las la dgyes pa'i khro mo rdo rje ljang ma dang /khro gnyer 'jigs pa'i dbu gcig phyag drug ma dang / rdo rje tri shul ④de'u 'dzin pa'i rdo rje rkan sgra rdebs brum dang / 'ching zhing sdom ⑥pa'i rnal 'byor ser nag dang / gtum mo zhe sdang stir chen za ba mo dang / zhing chen nang grol 'byin cing rdo rje tsham ngam (spyican dang / sgrol bar byed pa'i rdo rje mthing shenag dang / spyan bgrad mche gtsigs rdo rje chen mo dang / ste ra 6)'dren pa'i rdo rje khrag 'thung zhal du stobs skum dang / spu gris 'debs pa'i rdo rje bhan dhar (nyeldan ma dang / zangs gris 'debs shing kha ṭ+wāṃ (nya'aphen pa'i rdo rje sha za ba 8mo dang / ro la brkam ṣ+ṭha)pa'i rdo rje za stangs 7chen mo dang / rdo rje ser nag seng ge mgo can dang / mche yigatsigs spyan gsum 'jigs 6)pa'i rdo rje sdang mig can dang / mche 18tshogs mang pos bskor ba'i rdo rje zhe sdang 'joms ma dang /mthing nyartenag rdo rje seng ge ral pa can dang / rdo rje ye shes sku'i cha lugs 'chang ma dang 8 pho/ mi 'jigs sti ra'i g.yang gzhi 6stegasol ma dang / srog chags mang po'i rmo 2snying 'byin rdo rje klad so 'gems ma dang / dmar mo chen mo sti ra mgo can dang / ye shes lnga'i rdo rje cha lugs 'chang ma dang / mi 'jigs bzhi'i g.yang gzhi se ral khar thogs ma dang / bka' 8 nyelas mi 'da' thugs dam skong zhing las mdzad ma dang / bhan dha ( nyerak+tas bkang nas gtso la stobs shing ( 9dgra sdang klad ri tsho'agems ma dang / gsod byed sngo nag dur bya'i mgo can dang /mche 28tshogs 'khor du bskor zhing 'dod chags 'joms pa'i rdo rje za ba mo dang /103—430

thal chen rak+tas rdo rje sku la brgyan ma dang / spu gri mgo gcod bhan dha ①'thung zhing gsod la dga' ba mo dang / rdo rje zhags pa 'ching zhing khrag 'thung gzhal du stobs ①pa dang / mthing dunag 'gying stabs rdo rje shwa na khyi mgo can dang /glo snying 'dren pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin ma dang / phrag dog 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje za ba dang / dmar nag 'gying ba'i bya rgod mgo can dang / zhing chen rgyu 'dren gti mug 'joms par byed ma dang / gshog tshogs mang pos bskor ba'i thod rlon 'dzin ma dang / ser nag 'gying ba'i pho rog mgo can dang ske/ klu rnams 'dum par byed pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya 'chang ma ⑤dang /mthing nag 'gying ba bya rog mgo can dang / ser nag gsod par byed pa'i mgo can dang / sha khrag za ba'i mkha' 'gro dbu gsum ma dang / lcags kyus 'dren pa 6)mi 'jigs sbyor ba dang / rdo rje bka'i pho nya spyan gsum mche ba can dang / rdo rje bran mo gtum bag can dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs can rdo rje khrag 'thung ma dang / snying rje phag gi mgo can dang / rdo rje sbrul gyi mgo can dang —/ rdo rje gzig gi mgo can dang / rdo rje byi ba'i mgo can dang / rdo rje pha bang stimago can dang / rdo rje dred kyi mgo can dang / rdo rje dom gyi mgo can dang / rdo rje sdig pa'i mgo can dang / rdo rje wa'i mgo can dang / rdo rje stag gi mgo can dang / rdo rje rta'i mgo can dang / rdo rje spyang ki'i (nyamago can dang /rdo rje pu yonyeshud kyi mgo can dang / rdo rje sha ba'i mgo can dang / rdo rje skyin gyi mgo can dang / rdo rje phag gi mgo can dang / rdo rje rnga mo'i mgo can dang /rdo rje bya rog mgo can dang / rdo rje spang ti'i mgo can dang / rdo rje ske ma'i cimago can dang / rdo rje khra'i mgo can dang / rdo rje spre'u (rjemago can dang / rdo 103—431

rje khu byug mgo can dang / rdo rje seng ge 6)mgo can dang / rdo rje pha bang ②mgo can dang / rdo rje sha ba'i mgo can dang / rdo rje srin bya'i mgo can dang /rdo rje sre mo dumago can dang / rdo rje zer mo ④mgo can dang / rdo rje dmag pa thang gog gi mgo can dang / rdo rje nyi ma'i zhags pa can dang / rdo rje me lce glog (7phreng 'dzin dang / rdo rje srin mo mdung yithung ⑦'phen pa dang / rdo rje ral gri sgra 'byin ma dang / rdo rje klu mo thog ⑧'bebs mo dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed ba lang gi sna 99)dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin khyung gdong ma dang / rdo rje lag na khrag thogs ma dang / rdo rje zla ba skar mda' ltar gtong ba dang / rdo rje dam tshig bsrung bem dpal phreng ma dang / rdo rje lag na phur bu 'dril ma dang / rdo rje ri rab bsnyil ba'i rngam stangs can dang / rdo rje dmar mo spyan gsum shin tu mi srun ma dang / rdo rje cir (1yang 'gyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul can chen timo dang /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i mgyogs 6)ma dang / rdo rje smug yinag gtibs pa'i me dbal can dang / rdo rje keng 8rus 'cha' ba'i tshems rnon ma dang / rdo rje bzhad ma'i 7shin tu gad rgyangs chen mo (nyedang / rdo rje nang grol 'dren ma kung ku'i mgo can 18dang / rdo rje sgra 'byin 'brug sgrogs ma dang / rdo rje bdud rtsi rin chen char 'bebs ma dang / rdo rje shugs 'chang rdo rje sgrol ma dang / rdo rje dbang mo rdo rje sder mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje shan 67pa spu gri 2 )rnon po'i so can dang ske/ rdo rje go cha sra bar byed pa dang / rdo rje sprin tshogs mang po sdud ( sprepar byed pa dang / rdo rje 'ur 'ur shig shig g.yo bar byed pa dang / rdo rje rkan sgra rdebs 3 pa'i drag shul can chen mo dang / rdo rje za bar byed pa'i phaṭa phaṭa sgrogs ma dang / rdo rje brkyang bskum gshin rje gnon ma dang soge/ rdo rje zhing 103—432

chen khrag 'dzag thod rlon sku la brgyan pa dang / rdo rje drag po'i nga ro 'byin pa'i gdong gsum ma dang / rdo rje yud tsam 'dul phyogs bcur 'phro ma dang / rdo rje seng ge ①stabs su mchongs ②pa'i nga rgyal can dang / rdo rje sprul pa mang po 'gyed ②pa'i bya khra khyi sgyigs ④can dang / rdo rje sti ra gnas stsal ⑤bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje dam tshig gi tshogs myul dum bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang /rdo rje phyi nang mtshams myul ⑦ma bya khra khyi sgyigs ⑧can dang / rdo rje dam tshig gi rjes gcod ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje de bya'i sbyor myul ⑨ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje 'dod chags ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje dur khrod ro za 'dul ba'i bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje dmar mo bkra yigasal dbang sdud ma dang / rdo rje ser mo sbrul gyi ska yirags can dang / rdo rje gnam lcags 'ur mo thog 'bebs ma dang / rdo rje brgyal byed dngangs 5)par byed ma dang —/ rdo rje bsdams pas srin mo brgyal bar byed ma dang / rdo rje kha nas mi khrag rta khrag 'dzag ma dang / rdo rje dbu stong phyag stong bdud kyi dpung rnams 'dul bar byed ma dang / rdo rje 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro chen mo dang /rdo rje ral pa spyi gtsug 'khyil ma dang / rdo rje sku yis (sterol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bar ma dang / rdo rje gsung gi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed ma dang / rdo rje thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul mnga' ba tsochen mo dang / rdo rje thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul dbang phyug mo tsodang / rdo rje rin chen sku'i tsodabang phyug ma dang / rdo rje pad+mo yodabang phyug ma dang / rdo rje dbyings la sbyor zhing stan byed ma dang / rdo rje mgyogs ma dbu dgu ma dang / rdo rje sgra 'byin ma dang / rdo rje tsher tu ma dang / rdo rje myong ma dang / rdo rje reg 7byed kun la 'khyams dang / rdo rje dmar nag dbu 103—433

gsum ma dang / rdo rje sngo nag ral pa can chen mo dang / rdo rje ljang nag dbu brgya ma dang / rdo rje 6)ljang sngo dbu drug ma dang / rdo rje ba lang gi mgo can ma dang —/ rdo rje ser nag dbu bcwa lnga ma dang / rdo rje smug phyinag dbu brgya ma dang ske/ rdo rje ljang ser khro gtum sridabu dgu ma dang / rdo rje ser mo dbu gcig ma dang / rdo rje dkar mo dbu lnga ma dang / rdo rje nag mo dbu gsum ma dang /rdo rje bsnyems gisam bya khra khyi skyigs can dang / rdo rje ser mo bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang ske/ rdo rje dur khrod kyi bdag mo bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje gtun khung ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje mda' bsnyag ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang ske/ rdo rje skul byed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje rlung 'byin ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje rjod ⑤byed ma bya khra khyi skyigs can dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje bdud rtsi sbyor ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje 'phrog ma brlag (6)byed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang /rdo rje rmongs byed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje yid 'phrog ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje khrag 'joms ⑦ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje tshe 'joms ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje rmugs (nyabyed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje srin mo snying zan ma bya khra khyi skyigs can dang / rdo rje skul ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje 'bebs ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje dpal bdag ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje rkan (9)'jib 7ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje gnas ma mgyogs byed ma bya khra khyi sgyigs can dang / rdo rje sgrub pa tshe 'dzin ma bya khra khyi skyigs can dang / rdo rje thod rlon dang sbrul nag 'khyil ba can dang / rdo rje zhing chen stod g.yogs chu srin smad g.yogs can dang /103—434

rdo rje za byed kha 'bar ma dang / rdo rje nam mkha' lding dang / rdo rje khra dang 'ug pa dang / rdo rje bya rgod chen mo dang / rdo rje byan 0)lag dang / rdo rje kung ma'i lalus la chu srin gyi mgo can dang / rdo rje gshog pa gtams pa dang /rdo rje sder mo lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje mchu rtse chagacig ma'i gdong can ma ④dang /rdo rje so gri can dang / rdo rje kha gdangs ma dang / rdo rje kurma mud ka ra dang /rdo rje 'jigs par (gebyed pa'i gzugs can dang / rdo rje smigs bu'i mgo can dang ske/ rdo rje khra'i ⑥mgo can dang / rdo rje yid las byung ba'i mdun ⑦pa mo dang —/ rdo rje myos pa mo dang / rdo rje dra ba mo dang / rdo rje ting nge 'dzin dang /rdo rje byed pa dang / rdo rje dang ba mo dang / rdo rje kha spu can dang / rdo rje ral gri duspu can dang / rdo rje lcags kyi pags 6)pa can dang / rdo rje zangs kyi kha spu can dang / rdo rje ka li pi 7ka'i dbyings can dang / rdo rje dbang sbyin ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje dgyes pa chen mo'i (nyatshogs dang / rdo rje sgyu 'phrul gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ched 8du 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rab tu gtogs pa'i tshogs (nyedang / rdo rje gsang ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gzugs kyi tshogs dang / rdo rje sgra'i tshogs dang / rdo rje dri'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ro'i tshogs dang / rdo rje reg 8gi tshogs dang / rdo rje khro mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gos gyon 8pa'i tshogs dang /rdo rje bza' btung 7gi tshogs dang / rdo rje bro gar gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje ngo mtshar gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje klu khyenamo'i tshogs dang /rdo rje dbye bar byed ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje pad+mo phreng ba ma'i tshogs dang / rdo 103—435

rje bde ba mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sprin sdud ①ma'i tshogs dang ②/ rdo rje dgyes pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje mnyam pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje nyi zla'i 'od kyi tshogs dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje yid bzhin gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje mchog phran 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje zhing 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje nga rgyal can gyi tshogs dang / rdo rje thim par byed pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ngo mtshar chen po'i tshogs dang / rdo rje 'khor lo ma'i tshogs dang / rdo rje pad+mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje mnyam par rdzogs pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje bka' nyan sprul pa'i tshogs dang /rdo rje dngos grub las kyi tshogs dang / rdo rje spyod pas ci la'ang thogs pa med pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rigs su thabs mkhas pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje 'od 'phro ba 'bar ②ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje chags pa med pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rigs su skyes pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje me stag phra mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sems ma ye shes su ༅snang ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje med pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje snyom ⑤las med pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sgyid lug med pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje the tshom 6)med par bsgrub ⑦pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gsang ba ma'i nitshogs dang /rdo rje rab tu dgyes pa ma'i 6)tshogs dang / rdo rje rol mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rnam tshipar spros pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rgyan bkod pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje bstan pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje nam mkha' la rgyu ba mo'i tshogs dang /snying 11rje skyon dag pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje phyogs 'dzin pa mo'i tshogs dang /rdo rje gdul ba mo'i dgongs pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rten pa mo'i tshogs dang /103—436

rdo rje tshigs mtshon pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje gab pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sbas pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje thugs 'dzin pa mo'i ①tshogs dang / rdo rje 'byung ba mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje shes rab 'dzin pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje bde ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rol mo'i ①tshogs dang / rdo rje thugs kyi ye shes 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje drang snang mo'i ①tshogs dang / rdo rje rang 'byung (0mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje kun du mang ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje shes rab kyi mig dang ldan pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje kun bzang longs spyod gnas pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rmongs par byed pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje srog za bar byed pa mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje za ba ⑤mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje khrag za ba'i tshogs dang ske/ rdo rje tshil za ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rkang za ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje bsod nams gter 'chang ba'i tshogs dang / rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sgra mtha' yas pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje yon tan phrin (nyalas kyi (petshogs dang / rdo rje lhun gyis grub (kyepa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje sprul pa 'byung ba mo'i tshogs dang / rdo rje rgyu po)las 'byung ba mo'i tshogs dang /rdo rje gtum bag can dang / rdo rje gdug pa gtong ⑩ba sbrul gyi 7chun po yigecan dang / rdo rje 'jigs pa'i mgo brgyad pa dang / rdo rje mgo sna tshogs par sprul pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje lus stong la mgo bcu pa dang / rdo rje lus brgya la mgo gcig ()pa'i tshogs dang / rdo rje lus sna tshogs dang / rdo rje yan lag 'bum yod pa dang / rdo rje gdug pa'i lag yicha sna tshogs thogs pa yidang / rdo rje lus tsobargya la mgo stong yod pa dang / rdo rje lus brgya la mgo brgya pa dang /rdo rje lus bcu la mgo gcig pa dang / mgo brgya /napa la rkang pa brgyad pa dang /103—437

mgo dgu pa la rkang pa gcig pa dang / de'i 'khor gyi yang sprul gyi pho nya ①ni lcags kyi khyi ste rkang gsum po dang / long ba rgyab sbrel ②ba dang / nag po mgo dgu pa'o/ /shar gyi dkar mo spyang dung gi khyi mo chen mo dang / lho'i sbrul gyi zhags pa can dang / nub kyi dmar mo zangs kyi mche ba can dang / byang gi ser ②mo dril bu can dang / 'di rnams kyi pho nya mo ni shar gyi rdo rje sder mo dang /lho'i nag mo dung gdub ④ma dang / nub kyi dmar mo seng ge'i mgo can dang /byang gi ser mo las kyi bdag mo dang / rdo rje rus chen phreng ba can dang / rdo rje zangs kyi phreng ba can dang / rdo rje lcags kyi phreng ba can dang / rdo rje ral gri sa)so can dang / rdo rje nam mkha'i gung gcod (nyam dang / rdo rje nyi ma'i zer zhon ma dang / rdo rje chu bo'i gzhung 'dral ⑦ma dang / rdo rje rgya mtsho'i gting dkrugs (nyam dang / 'di rnams kyi sku mdog ni sna tshogs pa'o/ /phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'o/ /drag byed 6)bdag pos sgrol bar byed pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru gas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las pho nya'i las 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ hūm̐ pho nya sum brgya drug cu ⑩rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni kun 'dul zhing / /yud tsam gyis ni phyogs bcur 'phro/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra tumesgrogs shing / /bskal pa'i 'brug tu)sgra chen po ldir/ /mgo gsum po (3la lcags sder can/ /mi sha za zhing ⑩bdud dpung 'joms/ /bltas pas bdud rnams tshig byed cing / /klu yi khyim rnams rab tu 'joms/ /rab tu mi sun 'di dag ni / /'di yang dpal gyi pho nya ste/ /las rnams thams cad grub par gyis/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gnyis las 'phros/ /mgyogs pa mgyogs ma'i pho nyar ldan// glog 'gyu ma bodang 'dra bar grags/ /chos nyid khyab pas mtshan ma dbyings su 103—438

sdudam/ /ye shes thugs rjes 'brel pas kun la khyab/ /phrin 6)las dra bas 'gro ba rlabs ②kyis grol/ /de phyir lha mo rin chen dra ba ma/ /oṃ dz+wa dul badz+ra hūm̐/ye shes glog 'gyus mtshan ma dbyings su gcod/ /skad cig thugs rjes 'khor ba dbye bsal dubyed/ /phrin dulas glog 'gyus 'gro ba yud ⑥kyis sgrol/ /dra bas sdud la glog 'gyu ma yis 'dren/ /badz+ra a ma ka rtsu/ 'od zer dud ka 'phro ba ni / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /bskal pa'i 'brug sgra chen po bzhin/ /kun kyang mgyogs ma rlung dang mtshungs/ /mig gsum yo ⑦la lcags sder can/ /mgo gsum po la rkang gsum pa/ /mang du za zhing bdud khyim 'joms/ /bltas pas bdud rnams tshig nibyed cing / /klu yi gnas kyang nges par 'joms/ /'di rnams khro bo khyapho nya ste/ /ha ha ru lu'i sgra sgrogs shing / /gang gis rlung phyogs song ba yi/ /khro bo thams cad nges par 'jig /na mo byi tsir bh+yo/ ha ha ru lu ru lu bh+yo/ /mgo brgyad po la rkang brgyad po/ /lag pa brgyad la mig kyang brgyad/ /lag pa brgyad ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /rta mgrin tsoganas kyang nges par 'joms / /mgo drug po la rkang drug po/ /lag pa drug ni rgyud (1drug gcod/ /rkang pa gsum ni phur bu 'dril/ /g.yon pa gsum ni gtor ma sbyin/ /gang nas gang du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rkang pa lcags phur rab tu drag /'od zer dud gas reg pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i gnas kyang rab tu 'jig /lag pa g.yon pas bskyod (nyepa ni/ /phra men 'khor bcas ral par (nye'abar/ /lcags kyus dgra sta rab thogs shing / /zhing chen yan lag 'dzin pa 'phro/ /byang gi phyogs nas 'byung ba ni/ /lcags kyi khyi ste rkang gsum po/ /lcags kyi lus la nyi ma'i mig /spu ni lcags kyu bsregs pa 'dra/ /bang ni glog pas nges par skemagyogs/ /skad 103—439

ni 'brug pas shin tu che/ /rab tu mi srun 'di dag ni/ /phyag na rdo rje'i mthu yang 'phrog /mgo dgu po la rkang gcig po/ /lus kyang gnag 6)la 'od phung gnag② /yan lag gnag ①la sbrul gyis brgyan/ /ral pa gnag ④cing mche ba gnagatso /mig kyang gnag yil lag nag po/ /mgyogs kyang rlung gis bskyod du med / /'di dag pho nya'i mchog yin pas/ /las rnams thams cad grub par gyis / /long ba rgyab sbrel ⑦phyi ma nang / /yaṃ sa ⑧za zhing ri lu sgrol/ /mig kyang med la cang mi smra/ /yang na lag pa sbrel te 'gro/ /'di yang khro bo'i pho nya ste/ /las rnams thams cad grub par byed/ /shar gyi phyogs nas 'gugs pa ni/ /dung gi khyi mo chen mo la/ /dung gi ba lang sna khrid can/ /dung gi mi mo chen mo zhon / /lag na lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ / lho yi po)phyogs nas 'gugs pa ni//lcags kyi khyi ⑩ste rkang gsum pa/ /lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la/ /lcags kyi mi mo chen mo zhon/ /lag na zhags pa sgril ma thogs/ /nub kyi phyogs nas ⑪'gugs pa ni/ /zangs kyi khyi 7mo chen mo la/ /zangs kyi mi 6)mo chen mo zhon/ /lag na lcags sgrog 8sgril ma thogs/ /byang gi phyogs nas 'gugs pa ni/ /gser gyi khyi mo chen mo la/ /gser gyi mi mo chen mo zhon/ /lag na rdo rje phur bu 'dril7 / /'di yang dpal gyi pho nya ste/ /las rnams thams cad grub par gyis / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka pho nya bsgrub ⑩pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru tu bzhi la/ /dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs khri)bzhi la/ /dbus su bcom ldan 'das he ru ku'i rol pa/sku mdog mthing 1rtenag dbu sum brgya ( maphyag drug brgya (1pa zhig dgod/ shar du rdo rje til mar dgod/ lhor zhi stag gi mgo can dgod/ nub tu g.yag gi mgo 103—440

can dgod/ byang du sbrul gyi mgo can dgod/ de'i phyi rim pad+ma la brgya rtsa brgyad rim pa gsum la pho nya sum brgya bcu dgod do/ / de'i phyi rim snam bu la pho nya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad dgod do/ /①de'i phyi rim snam bu la yang sprul gyi pho nya dgod do/ /de'i phyi rim sgo ba bzhi/ /pho nya las byed bzhi dgod do/ /ci bgyi dang —/ bka' nyan dang / bka'i pho nya dang / sprul pa dang / ②yang sprul pa dang / 'di rnams yang dag pa'i bden du nges par rig ②par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gsang dub he ru ku'i rol pa las rdo rje pho nya'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las he ru ku'i las kyi bzlas pa 'di gsungs shing phyung ngo / /bdag med gnyis ⑤rtogs sgrib pa gnyis spangs pa/ /thugs rje sprul pas 'gro ba ma lus sgrol/ /yul med ma skyes byams pa'i chos dbyings las/ /'dzin pa mi rtog snying rje zhen chags khro/ /gnyis med dag las phrin (snyalas snying rje snyoms/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog 'joms spyod pa mthun (7pas 'gro 'dul zhing —/ /brda (7can yan lag len pa'i don go la/ /lha 6)brgyud ⑩brjod pas dngos grub kun dang 'brel/ /bka' don gtan tshigs rigs pas brjod par 'os / /zhes bya ba'i don to// //lung gsum man ngag gsum dang spyi don gsum/ /lung gi spyi gcod man ngag gdeng du bya/ /spyi khog bcu bzhis don gyi khog phub la/ /bzhi bcom drug ldan rtsis mgos sa gcad (1de/ /khro bo rtog pa mtshan ma'i gnyer (nyegyis bshad/ /103—441

'di ni khrag 'thung rngom ①brjid rgyal po'i lung zhes tshig nyung zhing mdor 'dus la don mang por 'byung bas mdo'i ①sde zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ lung gsum gyis sna grangs te rde'u bya'o/ /man ngag gsum gyis mjug chabasdus te blo la bzhag pa'i don to/ /spyi don gsum gyis lung (gethams cad kyi spyi gcad do/ /spyi khog bcu bzhis (snyedon gyi khog dbub po / /bdud bzhi bcom pas yon tan kun la snang ba'i che ba bcom mo rtsis mgo drug gis sa gcad (7do/ /khro bo rtog pa mtshan ma'i gnyer gyis bshad pas ni gol sa dang ni (7)sgrib pa spang ngo / /yon tan kun rngom (kyepas brjid gzhan la snang phyir rngom brjid chen po sum cu 6)rtsa drug bstan teyi/ rgyal po yin pa'i rtags ni rin po che sna bdun gyis 7rgyal por gsol lo/ / lung gis ⑩spyi dril de bshad do/ /de ltar rnam pa bcur nges nas/ de (3ni phye byang ngo bstan te gses nas bshad pa/ de la lung gsum ni zhi gnas mi rtog dngos po mkha' khyab 'dra/ /lhag mthong ma rmongs gza' skar mkha' la bkram/ /gdod bcas don dang bstun de 7'tsham par bshad/ /ting tso'adzin shes rab bka' lung gsum du nges/ /de la man ngag gsum ni bdag tu mi rtog sprul pa mdzod nas thong / /yul du ma grub gzhan med mdzad du gshegs/ /yul sems gnyis med ma skyes dbyings su gcig /nyan thos rang rgyal sems tsam aspong man ngag /de la spyi don gsum ni/ med rgyu btag tu chags sgrub 'grub bltas par snang / /spyod mthun kyi khro drag gdug pa'i dbal sos tu 'dul/ /rtog 'joms sman rdzas dngos len dngos grub rgyu/ /'di ni khro bo spyi yi don du bshad/ /de la spyi khog bcu bzhi ni/ gang khro gang la ci phyir gang gis khro( )/ /gang khro rnam pa bzhir ni 103—442

shes bya ste/ /ngang khro shugs khro ①bar bcas dang bcas sol/ /rtogs pa thugs rje rang bzhin 'dul ba'i dbang / /gang la snying rjes ①khros te yul dang gnas/ /las dang 'bras bu sems can sgrub pa'o/ /las bzhi sgrol mdzad 'bras su sku gsung thugs/ /ci phyir rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis la ni/ /dus gsum mi yang ④sha rus khrag la rol/ /gang gi ro (geni hūm̐ dang ha he phaṭa/ /gnas na lta yi'og mkha' stong ye shes thugs/ /bskyed thabs cho 'phrul gsum po khro bo'i sku/ /'bras bu dpal chen phra men tshogs kyis (7)bskor/ /phra men las drag 'gro ba cis (gu'adul mdzad/ /de la bdud bzhi 6)gzhom pa ni/ tsham ngam yidrag pos lha chen 'dar 'gyel brdzisahunye/ /brtul zhugs rol pas gdos bcas phung po bshig /dus gsum brlag phyir sha rus khrag la za/ /rnam shes 'chi med rgyal ba'i gnas su stobs/ /rtsis mgo drug ni dbang dang rab tu ldan pa dang / /dpal dang gzugs dang grags pa dang / /ye shes dang ni nan tan dang / /drug dang yang dag ldan phyir ro/ /de la dbang ni chags sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ni/ /mnyes tu stobs yum /snyedang 'jigs tshul sku yi sprul/ /dran med thod pa kham por g.yang gzhi ni/ /kha dang rgyal mtshan me tshudang lha chen gnon/ /de la dpal drug ni/ byams las khyab 7pa thugs dam dmigs kyis bsgral/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba thams cad bu ltar dgongs/ /smon lam dbang gis 'khor bar ji srid bzhugs/ /gzhan don mdzad pas bdag don lhun gyis grub/ /yongs su rdzogs pa bde ba chen po'i dpal/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung dpal te rnam drug yin/ /de la dpal yongs su rdzogs pa bde ba chen po'i dpal ni bsam gyis ⑩mi khyab pa bzhi ste/ de yang gang zhe na/ sku gsum sa gsum sems dpa' 103—443

rtogs dka' ba/ /bka' dhikhyab sprin 'dal ②char 'bab chu bo'i rgyun/ /ting 'dzin bsam yas bo dhis thogs pa de/ /bsam yas bsam khyab mkhas dul gza' skar gsal/ /klu mthu gdul phyir klu lngas sku brgyan pa/ /mang chen gsung sgra dbyangs dang pho nya'i dbang / /dug ⑤lngas gdos bcas 'du byed rgyan dhibyas pa/ /khrag sprul rtsigayang gzhi khwa ⑦ta dregs ⑧pa 'joms6)/ /de la gzugs rnam 7pa gnyis ni/ mi thung bus pa'i gzugs 'dra la/ /a gon la ni rkang lag gtams/ /drang srong khros pa'i cha byad la/ /shin tu mkhrang zhing skems pags tu)bri/ /gnod sbyin snying bags mi mthun gzugs dang ni/ /'dul dbang yi dgas kyisrin po drang srong 'dra/ /de la grags pa ni bud dha tsobo dhis ⑫bstod dam sras spun dgongs/ /gti mug gzengs bstod nga rgyal gnon par grags / /de la ye shes ni/ rnam dag dbyings mkhyen 'khor ba'i skyon dang bralam/ /'gro ba'i rgyud mkhyen 'khor ba'i mtha' las 'das/ /gnyis su med par mkhyen pas dbu ma'i ngang / /mdor na thams cad pa yi ye shes yin/ /de la nan tan ni/ nan tan snying po zag med zag bcas 'du/ /nan tan phrin tshalas 'gro ba gnas nas 'don/ /bsam yas nan tan 'gro ba chud mi gson / /nan tan mchog gis ⑩mchog tu shes par bya/ /da ()ni lung rnam pa gsum spyir dril te bshad do/ /de yang mi 'da' ba rgyan gyi lung dang / che mchog yon tan gyi lung dang / yan lag rtags kyi lung gis bshad do/ /ride la mi 'da' ba rgyan gyi khri lung ni/ glang (1chen 'dul stobs theg pa'i rgyan zhes pa( ) /bdud 'joms sman 31rdzas grub dang lta ba'i gzhung ⑫/ /stag ni dpa' rtun za byed rgyan zhes pa/ /ye shes thugs rje'i phrin ( nyalas ngang du bstan/ /sbrul ni 103—444

mnyen ①lhug phrin ②las rgyan zhes pa/ /'jigs tshul dug ③gnon 'khril dupa yum gyi rgyan/ /thod phreng dbang sgrol 'chad pa'i ⑧rgyan zhes pa/ /sku gsum theg gsum dus gsum dbang chad rjosgrol/ /g.yang gzhi tshul khrims gos kyi rgyan zhes pa/ /byang chub sems tshul dam (7khrims gos zhes ⑧bya/ /rak+ta thugs rje chags pa'i rgyan zhes pa/ /mi rtog 'byedabyings nas thugs rje'i yispyan/ /gzi chen don dam bcud kyi rgyan zhes pa/ /bcud kyi thig le don dam kun du 'ong / /thal ba 'dul byed phrin ⑩las rgyan zhes pa/ /yi ge 'khor los mtshan ma thal bar rlog /me ni 'bar 'phro 'du sreg klong yidakyil zhes/ /ye shes thugs rje dbyings 'dul phrin 8las te/ /zad par byed pa'i mtha' 'das dkyil zhes bya//me sgra sgra chen tha dad sgra zhes pa8/ /chos sku khyab dang ting 'dzin sna tshogs pa/ /ral pa kham nag snyil zhing phye ma niski/ /de nas chos yinyid dbang drag sprul pa 'phro / /sku mdog mthing dhinag nam mkha'i rgyan zhes bya/ /'dul dbang mtha' med (nyeyon tan dgongs pa gting mi dpogs/ zhes 4)bya'o/ /de la khrag 'thung zhes bya ba'i sgra ni gong du bshad par zad doru )/ /de la dpal te ru'i zhusku mdog dang phyag mtshan cir yang ma nges par 'byung ste gang ltar bsgyur yang 'grub po zhes bshad do/ /de yang mtshan nyid med pa'i phyag rgya dang / de la dngos byung phyag rgya rnams/ /nges pa med par dpa' bos bshad/ /mkhas pas bsgoms la ci dgar 'grub ces 'byung ngo / /'o na yang 'di'i gnas skabs su/he ru ka dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad 4)de/ de yang yan lag rtags kyi lung gis bshad na/ grub pa rtags kyi phyag rgya ( zhedang / mdzad pa rtags kyi phyag rgya dang gnyis so/ /de la grub pa rtags kyi phyag rgya ni dbu gsum dug gsum 103—445

sku gsung thugs lhun grub/ /lta spyod rnam gsum grub pa'i rtags/ /spyan dgu sa 0)gsum sku gsum ye shes gsum ste dgu/ /bgrod med thob med dmigs pa las 'das pa/ /rtag chad spyan gnyis mtha' yangs dbu ma'i spyan/ /shangs gsum srog la mnga' mdzad ting 'dzin gsum/ /de bzhin nyid du kun du snang zhes bya/ /sgra chen tha dad sgra chen chos sku ting 'dzin snyan/ /zhal gsum rnam thar sgo gsum lhun gyis grub/ /ljags gsum theg gsum mthar phyin shes bya'i rtags / /mche bzhi phrin (gyilas mthar phyin zhi ba'i tshul/ /ye shes drug ni mthar phyin phyag drug ste/ /pha rol phyin ①drug mthar phyin phyag mtshan drug /zhabs bzhi lam bzhir bgrod (4)pa med pa thob/ /de la mdzad pa rtags zhes ⑤bya ba ni/spyan dgu sa dgu 'dul ba'i bye brag gzigs/ /spyan gsum srid gsum mgo rgyud 6)so sor mkhyen/ /shangs gsum nas byung sprul pas stong gsum 'gengs/ /snyan drug 'gro drug gnas nas ci gsol gsan/ /dbu gsum srid gsum mgon mdzad sku gsung thugs/ /zhal gsum dbyings su dug gsum zad par rngub/ /ljags gsum 9 theg gsum bstan pa'i gdangs ngar sgrogs/ /khams gsum nyug byed rdo rje srin mo lce/ /mche bzhi skye (8)shi rtsa nas gcod par mdzad/ /phyag drug rgyud drug 'khor ba gting nas 'don/ /phyag mtshan pha rol phyin drug 'gro don mdzad / /zhabs bzhir phrin 99)las rnam bzhi bgrod med sgrol/ /yan lag rtags kyi lung gis 'di ltar yang dag bshadakyi/ /rdo rje ye shes pha rol skyen pa ni / /rang bzhin mi 'gyur las ni 'bigs shing 'joms/ /chos sku rdo rje rtog (1dang bag chags bsreg12 /ye shes yin phyir de la de skad bya/ / bhan dha (nyebazod pa'i pha rol phyin pa ni/ /chos dbyings spros med kha ye shes bzhi dang ldan/ /103—446

ye shes dbyings rtog ①zhen khrag thugs rje skyed②/ /mtha' gnyis skyon la mi bsngags bzod pa'i mchog /kha ṭ+wāṃ stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dug chagasum dga' byed dregs pa'i lha bdud 'joms/ /stong ④gsum srid pa yo 'dul rgyal po'i rtags/ /kun la mnga' mdzad 'khor rnams dbang du sdud⑤/ /zhing chen smon lam pha rol phyin pa ni/ /'bod pa'i g.yab mos 'khor rnams dbang du sdudakyil/ /sbyin pa'i za bas mkha' 'gro tshim par byed/ /rdeg ⑦pa'i dbyig pas gdon bcas phung po bshig /rtog ⑧pa chos nyid dran med shes lnga bzung / /ci ①ltar smon cing grub pas de skad bya/ /thong gshol 7thabs kyis 0pha rol phyin pa ni/ /nyon mongs tha ba thugs rjes zlog (nyemadzad cing / /ye shes chos dbyings mtha' dang bral ba'i rtags/be/ /thabs kyis sku gsum lhun grub 8sprul pa 'phro/ /brda ni shes rab pha rol phyin bstan pa/ /yul med ma skyes chos sku rnga 8sgo la/ /'dzin pa bdag med rig ⑩pa'i dbyu gus brdungs/ /gsung rab rnga sgras 'gro ba shes rab skyed/ /'khor lo bsam gtan lhag pa tshugasum gyi tsomatshan / /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gsum dang ldan/ /pad+ma 'dam skyes ma chags thugs rjes spyod/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa'i ngang du bstan/ /mi zad ⑩par ldan sbyin pa'i pha 6 )rol phyin0/ /ral gri ye shes thugs rje mtha' gnyis gcod/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin gnyis las brtson 'grus mdzad/ /dgra (3sta zhags pa (shel sogs phyag mtshan rnams/ /rang gnyer las kyi brda tsam ( ༷stechos sku rtogs par bstan/ /de la 'di man chad che mchog yon tan gyi lung gis spyir dril te tshanabashad pa ni/ yon tan gyi brjid la phrin rubelas kyi rngom dhisum cu ( shertsa drug bstan ()pa ni de la sku'i rngom pa bzhi la nam mkha' ce )ri mo phyag rgyar rngom/103—447

cir yang 'gyur bzhi bzhugs tshul rngom/ zil gyis gnon pa'i gdan rngom/tsham ngam chen po'i stobs rngom ①pa dang bzhi'o/ /de yang kun rdzob rang bzhin med pa la nam mkha' la sprin dra ba'i (getshul dang / lha dang 'phags pa tshangs pa dang —/ smon lam cir yang 'gyur ba'i bzhugs thabs kyi tshul dang / srid pa'i 'khor lo zil gyis gnon pa dri med pad+ma nyi zla 'od yon tan rtags de gdan khri'i tshul dang / stobs chen bcu'i tshul dang / rnam pa ni 'og nas 'chad ⑧do/ / gsung gi durngom bzhi la hom (5)lnga 'brel par 'byung ba'i zhal rngom/ zla gam cir yang 'gyur ba'i ljags rngom/ skye shi rtsa ba gcod pa'i tshems rngom/ gsung sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i dbyangs rngom pa'o/ /de yang zhal ye shes kyi phyag rgya rnam pa lnga'i bsreg khang du ro rnam pa lngas tshim zhing mchod pa 'brel ba rnam lnga'i tshul dang / gsung dbyangs tshul 'dus byas dang / rang bzhin zung ma 'dres par ston pa'i tshul dang / mche ba bzhi ye shes bzhi'i 'phro 'dus dug bzhi ye shes bzhis gcod pa'i tshul dang / 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i yan lag drug cu'i (6)dbyangs kyis snyan pa'i mdo sdes go bar sgrogs shing zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul dang rnam par bshad do/ /thugs kyi rngom pa bzhi la ting nge 'dzin phyag rgya'i rgyan gyi skar tshogs ltar rngom/ phrin las rgya mtsho rgyan gyi dba' rlabs ltar rngom/(7yon tan sa gzhi 98)rgyan gyi rtsi shing ltar rngom/ mdzad pa rol mo rgyan gyi gar thabs 997ltar rngom pa'o/ /de yang rgya chen po bzhi ni rang bzhin dang rgyan du dbye'o / /lhag mthong gi rang bzhin las lhag mthong gi rgyan ma g.yos par yisnang ba'i tshul dang / zhi gnas kyi rang bzhin las zhi gnas 9/mekyi rgyan khyad par du 'byung ba'i tshul dang / tinyazhi gnas kyi rang bzhin bzod pa las lhag mthong gi 103—448

rgyan gyis phan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang / zhi gnas kyi rang bzhin mi zad ma gol ba las lhag mthong gi rgyan gyis cir yang 'gyur ba'i dga' ba skyed pa'i tshul lo/ /mthu'i rngom pa bzhi la ru tra bcos 6)pa'i gnas rngom/ lha chen gnon pa'i gdan rngom / khams gsum sgrol ba'i zhing rngom/ rtogs (mi'ajoms spyod pa'i ②brtul zhugs rngom/ de yang gnas khyad par can bkra shis shing cis kyang mi tshugs pa'i tshul dang / gnas khyad par can thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i tshul dang /zhing khyad par can khams gsum yo sgrol ba'i tshul dang / spyod pa khyad par can srid pa'i rtog pa ④dus gcig du bcom pa'i tshul lo/ /rngom tshul sum cu ⑤ma gnyis bshad do/ /de la brjid chen po la/ sku che yan lag rags pas brjid che / grangs mang rkyen dang 'tsham ⑥pas brjid che/ bkur 'os rtsigatso bor mthong bas brjid che/ khyad zhugs yid dang 'thad (nyepas brjid che ba ste bzhi'o//de yang chos sku dang mnyam par 'byung ba'i sgo nas sku che/ thugs rje dang mnyam par 'byung ba'i sgo nas sprul rags/ sems 'du byed dang mnyam par 'byung ba'i sgo nas sprul pa grangs mang / smon lam gyi dzi)sgo nas rigs dang mthun tshupa'i rkyen du 'tsham/ spyod lam gyi sgo nas bkur bar 'os/ rigs btsun pa'i sgo nas gtso tsobor mthong / rang bzhin grub pa'i sgo nas khyad zhugs/ phrin 4)las kyi sgo nas yid dang 'thada'/ gsung gi brjid bzhi la gdangs che stong gsum gang bas brjid che/ tshig myur the tsom chagacod pas brjid che/ bdag la cher ston snyam pas brjid che/ khyad zhugs yon tan mthong bas brjid che de yang chos skus khyab pa'i sgo nas sgra che/ sgra tha dad pa'i 7sgo nas stong gsum gang / sgra dbyangs sgo nas kun gyis go bas myur/ nye bar bsgyur ba'i sgo nas the tsom tso103—449

gcod / byams pa'i sgo nas bdag la gzigs/ thugs rje'i sgo nas nyi tsher ston / shes pa'i bye brag gi sgo nas khyad zhugs/ tshig gi yon tan gyi sgo nas 'dul / thugs kyi brjid bzhi la/ yangs pa re dogs med pas brjid che/gsal ba mtha' gnyis spangs pas brjid che/ thugs rje 6)thugs dam mthar 'byin pas brjid che/ ma rmongs thabs kyis 'dul bas brjid che'o/ /de yang gnyis med pa'i sgo nas yangs/ spang blang med pa'i sgo nas re dogs med/lhag mthong gi sgo nas dbu mar (5)gsal/ zhi gnas kyi sgo nas mi 'gyur bas ①gnyis mtha' spangs/ mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sgo nas thugs rje che/ 'khor ba ci gosrid bzhugs pa'i sgo nas thugs dam mthar 'byin/ shes rab kyi sgo nas rmongs pa sel/ ting nge (5)'dzin gyi sgo rnams (7thabs kyis 'dul/ yon tan gyi brjid pa 57)bzhi la/ med pa zad mi shes pas brjid che/ gcig la 'dod dgur ston pas brjid che/ gnod sbyor phan par 'dod pas brjid che/thabs mkhas skyon gyis (nyami gos pa'i (9)brjid che'o/ /de yang bdag tu mi 'dzin yipa'i sgo nas med/ med pa'i sgo nas zad mi shes/ ye shes kyi sgo nas gcig /sems kyi sgo nas 'dod dgur tsho/ston/ /sems kyi sgo nas gnod par sbyor/ /grub pa rgyu'i sgo nas phan par mdzad/ /shes bya'i sgo nas thabs mkhas/ spyod pa'i sgo nas skyon gyis 62ma gos/ phrin khri las kyi brjid bzhi la/ mi mnyel nyams khaḥphag rol pas brjid che/ 'khor ba yun rings tshemi mnyel par yibarjid che / mgon skyabs rgyun du mdzad pas brjid che/ dgongs pa'i 6)don rnams mdzad pas brjid che'o/ /de yang sgyu mar gyur pa'i sgo nas mi mnyel/ rang bzhin gcig pa'i sgo nas phag tu rol/ spyod pa'i sgo nas 'khor bar yun rings yin103—450

por bzhugs/ bya ba med 0)pa'i sgo nas mi mnyel(mi/ mthu yi lasgo nas mgon skyabs che/ dam bcas pa'i ④sgo nas 'gro don rgyun du mdzad/ rtse gcig gi sgo nas mtha' gnyis kyi skyon dgongs/ nan tan gyi sgo nas bya ba grub/ brjid nyi shu dang sgo bzhi bcu ste spyir drug cu'o⑤/ /de la rin po che sna bdun ni 'khor lo rin po che'i dbang bcus skye ba bzhi la dbang bskur ro/ /btsun mo rin po ches ni yul gyi rgyal po la mnyes par dbul lo/ /dmag mi rin po che'i tshul dgus pha rol gyi dpung 'joms so/ /khyim bdag rin po che'i yitshad med pa bzhis ⑦rgyal po'i chab srid 'dzin to/ /glang po rin po che'i stobs bcus pha rol du ⑧bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed do/ /rta rin po che'i 6)myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis bgrod ⑩pa'i gnas sleb (7par byed do/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ni ⑩rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas sems can gyi re 'dod skong ngo / /lung rnam pa gsum ni mi 'da' ba rgyan gyi lung la sogs pa gong du rtsis mgo spyir sbyar bar zad(nye / de nas 'khor lo rin po che'i dbang bcu ni/ skye bzhi skur ston skye bzhi sgrol mdzad pa/ /lha mi sdig sbrul mche ba bzhi ru ston/ /yo byad brid pa'i 'dod yon lnga dang ni/ /rtog pa gzhom ④phyir sman lnga dang len rol/ /ci 8ltar mos bzhin 'dod dgu yigazugs ston pa/ /gar dbang 'thad dga'i tshul du rol pa mdzad / /rdzu 'phrul ba spu'i dbyings nas phra men 'phro/ /lus ni ci rdzu sems ni cho 'phrul ston/ /gad rgyangs gdangs ngar sgrogs ⑩pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mche ba zil 4nyaganon tha dad chos rnams ston/ /shes rab thabs ldan spyan gnyis dbu ma'i ngang / /dbyings las ma g.yos cir yang sa le mkhyen/ /sems kyi bye brag ting 'dzin tha dad 'phro/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bzhi la rol pa mdzad/ /rdo 103—451

rje ①sder mo pags ②pa spu phreng brgyan / /'khor ba ci srid bzhugs pa'i tshe dul dbang ske/ /lta ba rnam bzhi spyan zur gyis bskul bas/ /phra men bzhi 'phro phyogs bzhir las bzhi mdzad/ /smon lam dbang gis drag po duskur ston pa/ /dus mtha'i bskal pa bzhin du bshol ①du med/ /de la btsun mo rin po che'i dbang ni/ ma chags rdo rje gzugs kyi yum gyis 'khyudal/ /zhi gnas ting ⑧'dzin mi g.yo yum gyis sbyor/ /thogs med shugs 'chang don grub yum gyis bskyod6)ske/ /lhag mthong ye shes yum gyis mnyes byed 'bebs/ /'byung ba bzhi po rdo rje lha mo ste/ /bde ba chen po'i 7sku la mnyes par dbul/ /dmag mi rin po che yi 0tshul dgu ni/ bsgregs tunyepas 'gro ba shes rab bskyed pa'i tshul8/ /nyam nga med pa'i mdza' spyod ④dpa' bo'i tshul/ /gdug rtsub gdos bcad ⑫brgyan pas 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /log par ltar ⑩ba zhe gcod gshe ba'i tshul/ /rmad du byung ba'i chos sgrogs bzhad 6)pa'i tshul/ /shin tu gdul dka' tsol khro snying rje'i tshul/ /smon lam dbang gis mi shom rngam (7pa'i tshul/ /nyon mongs grub pa'i gyur mdzad ngo mtshar tshul/ /khro drag dbyings nas mi g.yo zhi ba'i tshul / /de la khyim bdag rin po che'i tshad med pa ( )bzhi ni/ khro gtum tshad med byams par snang / / bsod chen (nyesnying rje bdag nyid che/ /bsgral zhing bstabs tsha nyapa dga' ba'i mchog /yal bar mi 'dor btang snyoms so/ /de la glang po rin po che'i stobs bcu ni/ thugs rje chen po'i stobs ni dregs chen bsnyengs phyir gnon/ /chos nyid stobs ni mi dmigs nam mkha'i mdog /mi 'byed stobs ni dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ma spangs stobs ni gdos ( stebacas sku la brgyan9 mi/ /ma g.yos stobs ni don mthun (nyegrol ba'i brgyan( nya/ /103—452

smon lam stobs ni bskal par yongs grol mdzad/ /sprul pa'i stobs ni mgo brnyan ①phya men 'phro/ /phrag dog log lta 'khor bar gcig mi gtong / /'dod chags yud tsam 'phral 'dod spyan bzlog ②dmar/ /de la rta rin po che'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ chos dbyings med bzhin cir snang ba/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin du rnam par bkram/ /ye shes rdzu 'phrul chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa/ /mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du gsal la stong / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bye brag ni/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sprin phung bzhin du bdal / /sprul pa'i bye brag 'phro ba'i rdzu 'phrul ni/ /ro la cig car 'babs skyisnod bye brag phye / /de la nor bu rin po che'i rang bzhin ni/ 'gro rnams ci ⑤ltar 'dod pa'i re 'dod skong / /mi zad bdag nyid gter chen nam mkha'i mdog /srid gsum mun nag sel ba'i ye shes sgron/ /dus gsum rgyun mi 'chad 6)pa'i rin chen phreng (7/ /lung gsum ni rtsis (kyemago spyir sbyar ba yin no/ /da ni lha rgyud kyi rtogs 6)pa so sor bshad par yibya ste/ 'gro rnams ji yonyeltar 'dul zhing ⑫gshegs mdzad pa/ /shes rab nam mkha'i bskal pa dga' rgyud ston/ /gti mug tshul gyis gti mug 'joms mdzad pa/ /gti mug rdo rje budha he ru ka /ye shes rdo rjes nyon mongs rdo rje 'joms/ /thabs 'dzin mchod 8pa'i dngos po bshigatso /zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang rdo rje badz+ra he ru ka /rin chen dbyig ltar kun skong zhing / /bdag med zhi gnas chu yi bskal pas 'khru/ /nga rgyal tshul gyis nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pa/ /nga rgyal rdo rje rat+na he ru ka /'khor ba'i 'dam du pad ltar sku 'khrungs 7shing / /lhag mthong me chen 'bar bas thams cad sreg /'dod chags tshul gyis 'dod 103—453

chags 'joms mdzad pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje pad+ma he ru ka /phrin ①las rgya mtshos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /shes bya thogs med bskal pa'i rlung gis bskyod②ske/ /phrag dog tshul gyis phrag dog 'joms mdzad pa/ /phrag dog rdo rje kurma he ru ka / sku yi ⑧longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing / /shes rab mthar phyin dugati mug rnam par dag /phyag rgya gzugs kyi mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing / /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbang bskur khro mo rgyal/ /thugs kyi longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing / /brtson 'grus mthar phyin zhe snang rnam par dag /rtogs pa reg bya'i mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing / /sra brtan rdo rje dbang bskur khro mo rgyal/ /gsung gi longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing / /tshul khrims mthar phyin 'dod chags rnam par dag /gsung rab sgra yi mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing / /lhag mthong ye shes dbang bskur khro mo rgyal/ /yon tan longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing / /sbyin pas mthar phyin nga rgyal rnam par dag /ngar 'dzin bro mchog mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing / /bdag med zhi gnas dbang bskur khro mo rgyal/ /phrin (5)las longs spyod sna tshogs mi dmigs shing / /bzod pas mthar (6)phyin phrag dog rnam par dag /tshul khrims dri med mchod pas mnyes mdzad cing / /thogs med las la dbang bskur khro mo ⑦rgyal/ /thugs mchog rnam dag ye shes dkar mo'i tshogs/ /'gugs mdzad ye shes lnga yi dbyug to can/ /dran pas rgyud lnga sgrol mdzad zhi bar gzigs/ /srid gsum 'joms byed dbyug thogs gi (8)ri ma/ /sku yi yon tan tshogs sdud rkun mo'i tshogs / /mthu 'phrog zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel/ /bden gnyis lta bas khro tshul 'gro la gzigs/ /dam tshig dbyings mchog skul byed tso 5)ri ma/ /103—454

gsung gis thams cad zil gnon rmongs pa'i tshogs/ /dbang mdzad mtha' gnyis mi yong chu srin ni①/ /mi gnas rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing myos ②par lta/ /stong gsum dudabang mdzad rgyal byed pra ④mo ha/ /thal ba ⑤byed pas thal byed ma yi tshogs/ /kun gyi dngos grub rdo rje rtse ⑥dgu 'dzin/ /sa dgu rtog 'joms shi ba slong bar gzigs/ /'jig rten thal byed rnge'u thogs be+e tā ⑦yi/ /'byed med shes rab mi rtog sbos mo'i tshogs/ /'khor ba'i rgyud 'dzin 'ching zhing dbang 'dren las/ /khro gar gzigs tshul rgyun gyis ①thugs rjes sgrol/ /bde mchog dbyings su 'dren mdzad puk+ka 6nyesi/ /zhe snang tshul gyis don mdzad gtum ma'i 0tshogs/ /myos skyemadzad dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med pa'i/ /thugs rjes dkrug ⑩cing ro za'i tshul du gzigs/ /snod bcud dkrugs nas skongs tsomadzad ghasma ri/ /chags pa'i tshul gyis don mdzad sme sha can/ /ma ni rgyud 'phel gzung 8'dzin bral ba'i rtags/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pas rnam par g.yengs litshul bzhugs/ /'bar ba stong gsum stobs byed tsaṇ+ḍa li/ /thams cad 'byung ba'i lhun 'gyur ma tshogs ma/ /kun gyi las mdzad chos kun snying po 'dzin/ /kun la rol pas gzigs tshul kun dang ldan/ /thugs rje 'jig rten sgrol mdzad sma ⑩sha ni/ /'joms byed rtsal mchog rdo rje thugs kyi yumal/ /gnyen tsopo stobs kyis thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /shes rab thabs ldan sku gsum bdag gzhan (nyedon/ /sdug bsngal zhe sdang gsod 7byed sing ha pya ma / /dpa' brtun sa)za byed ye shes thugs rje'i las/ /brtson 'grus myur ba'i shugs 'chang 'gro don du/ /thugs rje ye shes rtse gcig so sor gzigs/ /nga rgyal 'chi bdag 'joms mdzad bya khra ma/ /mdzes byed dam tshig rnam dag gsung 103—455

gi yum/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas bdag dang gzhan don mdzad/ /don gyi chos sku ting 'dzin ljags la gtang / /'dod chags dur khrod 'joms mdzad sri ka ma / /mi ma byed spyod pas mchog rigs kyi yum/ /g.yer 6)ba'i phrin ②las 'gro la thugs rjes srung / /chos nyid sku la ye shes spyan gyis gzigs/ /phrag dog ③las grub za byed shwa na ma/ /yid kyi ye shes so so kun la rtog /rnam shes kyis bsad god 'brang tshul khrims srung / /'khor ba'i rgyun gcod rgyud 'dzin rgyu gri 'dzin / /mgyogs mas snyags 4)byed khrag 'thung kyi gya ma/ /rnam shes mnyam nyid yid 'grogs (snyematshan ma 'joms/ / gsad pa'i (nyagod rnams sbyin pas pha rol phyin/ /mtha' 'das chos sku gzugs 'dzin spangs ( tshul bzung / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal che 'phrog ka ka ma/ / bslad pas ⑧mi 'gyur bkrus pas mi 'dag 99༄cing / /mi mthun gnyen pos mi shigs tibazod pa'i mchog /chos sku thugs su chud phyir zhal na thogs/ /yon tan yid bzhin bdag nyid kung ka ma/ /dbyings la mi rtog 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ /gnyis la mi gnas shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dbyings kyi thugs rjes phrin (melas 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i rngam tshul ka /bcu drug zhag gis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs//dpal chen bcu drug sa la lhun gyis grub/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sku/ /thog ma med cing yon tan zla ba med/ /sbyin pas rigs tsopa'i klung du mtsho drang ltarayi / /'khor bas 'jigs nas thugs rje'i yilcags kyus 'dren/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin don mdzad pa/ /thugs rjes yishar mdzad rta gdong 9lcags kyu ma/ /don dang mthun 1 7pas kun kyang dga' bar mdzad/ /byams pa'i zhags pa 'khor ba'i rgyun 'dzin cing / /rin chen 103—456

phyag rgyas sems can re 'dod skong / /yon tan tshogs rdzogs phag gdong zhags pa ma/ /gzhan gyi don du spyad pas bdag gi don/ /shes rab sgrol mas hu)mun pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ /don nyid (gyimi 'da' dga' ba'i mchog /kun gnyen ma rig nub (kyemadzad nyi zla'i spyan/ /snyan par smra bas ①kun kyang bka' bzhin byed / /btang ⑤stoms thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro don du/ /phab nas rnam shes thal ba'i gzugs kyang 'tshoyi/ /chos ston bag chags byang (pemadzad dril 'khrol ma/ /da ⑧ni srin mo'i ④lha rgyud bshad de/ bcwa brgyad spyan gyis bcwa brgyad khams la gzigs/ /bcwa brgyad shangs nas bcwa brgyad sprul pa 'byung / /bcwa brgyad khams la bcwa brgyad skur ston cing / /bcwa brgyad thugs ⑩kyis bcwa brgyad 'dul thabs mnga'/ /bcwa brgyad snyan gyis bcwa brgyad khams gsan cing ⑪/ /bcwa brgyad ljags kyis gsung rab bcwa brgyad 'chad(rte/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dgongs pa bsam ()mi khyab/ /sa dgur thugs rjes don mdzad dbu ④dgur ldan/ /brjod gnon zhabs brgyad phyogs brgyad lha brgyad gnon/ /ci ⑫ltar rol yang spyan dgur tsodabyings mi g.yo/ /'dul ba'i dbang du bskal pa'i tshul ston cing / /rdo rje srin pos ci 'dul yid bzhin rdzogs/ /rnam thar gsum las sku gsum phrin thonalas 'byung / /spyod pa rnam dag smon lam stobs kyis gshegs/ /ral gsigs (shesprul pas 'gro don rtse gcig rol/ /bcwa brgyad stong pas mnyes mdzad rtsa bting ma(7/ /brjid pa'i stobs kyis klu rnams zil gnon cing / /phra ma'i so )skyon spangs ngag gi dbang phyug che/ /'bad pa ( spemed pa'i brtson 'grus shugs 4 shedang ldan/ /chos la dbang mdzad ha ya spyi ru ba dpal / /'dzin tshul stabs (sekyis drang srong tshar gcod cing / /log lta'i nyes 103—457

'dzin skyon spangs bsam gtan ngang la gnas/ /tshe la dbang mdzad 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed/ /ye shes thugs rjes zin pas mthar mi 'ching /thugs rjes zin pa'i srid las grol/ /gnyis la mi gnas mtha' bral dbu mar bsnyems6) / /'dod pa'i rgyal po mnyes mdzad la se (mi ki/ /rig ②pa'i sder chen chos kyi dbyings nyid 'dzin/ /thugs rje lcags kyus 'khor ba mi gtong ④zhing / /shes rab thabs kyi (9lcags kyus mtha' gnyis 'dzin/ /gtso bo dbyug sngon mnyes mdzad dra ti zhiraru/ /ye shes mtshan sdud thugs rje khrod (pe'abyung zhing / /sprul pas 'gro bsgral sku dang ye shes 'phro/ /shes snying ma skyes dbu ma'i rig pa skye / /sta na pa tis (7khro rgyal gshin rje mnyes/ /dbyings su mtshan ma shes rab tho bas brdungs/ /thugs rjes sems can phrin (9)las mtshan ma 'joms /dbu mar ye shes snying rje mi rtog tsodang / /mi g.yo mgon po mnyes mdzad mu ha la / /rdo rje gtum mo mtshan ma'i dngos po bcom/ /thugs rje rngam tshul srid pa thal bar brlagayonya /gnyis la mi gnas mtha' bral dbu mar bsdigs/ /ha ya spyi 7ba mnyes mdzad tsaṇ+ḍa li/ /phra mor 'jigs pa'i ye shes dbyings su 'phen/ /'bigs pa'i ye shes gnad du thugs rjes rdeg /ma khyogs dbu ma chen po'i don ston she pa/ /gzhan gyis mi thub mnyes byed sha ya ti/ /mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings thos rig pa'i sgra/ /dbyings nyid rig shes dbyings la nyan pa'i sgra/ /de la bstan yipa gsung gi sgra 'byin pa/ /bdud rtsir 'khyil pa sha ya ya tis mnyes / /bdag rtog log lta'i mtshan ma kun bcom zhing / /za byed mche bas skye bzhi rtsad gcad 8de/ /sku dang ye shes ma skyes mi dmigs pa/ /pad+mo 'khyil pa mnyes byed ma ra na/ /thugs dam dbang gis rnam dag dbyings nas bskul/ /103—459

thugs rje'i 0)shugs kyis 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren/ /gnyis med mchod bskul ②dbu ma'i dgyes pa stobs / /ma ha ha la mnyes mdzad tsun da ma/ /bskyod ④pa'i ye shes sa rnams dus gcig gcod/ /thugs rje (5)shugs kyis 'gro ba gnas nas spor57/ /thabs dang shes rab bskyod ⑦pas mtha' gnyis sporani/ /ba ya ba tis khams gsum hūm̐ mdzad gnyisapo)/ /sdug bsngal thugs rjes mi bzod phrin ⑩las dpa'/ /yal bar mi 'dor brtson (nye'agrus shugs kyis brtanatso/ /gdod nas don mdzad 'khor ba mthar thug sgrol/ /de phyir dpa' brtul ()za byed bya khra ma/ /sdang mig mi 'gyur thugs rjes zhi yil gnon/ /mthu rtsal rngom 8brjid 'gyur med bdud dpung bzlog(lha /tsham ngam ral gsigs ( stagadangs ngar 4)'jig rten 'gengs6rte/ /de phyir 'gyur med phra men tsa sa ra/ /rtog ( kye pa'i dgra spangs dran pa'i dgon par gnas/ /'khrul skyon dri med shes bzhin rdzi mtshor spong / /'gro don dus la bab na thugs rjes 'jug /de phyir 'jug par byed pa'i ha ri na/ /chos dbyings gnas mal rtog pa'i skyon sel zhing / /thugs rje spu ris sprul pa bsam mi khyab(21/ /dug gsum 'joms mdzad sha rus khrag la rol / /sel byed sprul pas don mdzad dh+ya ma/ /yang dag zon chags 'gro don thabs 32mkhas ldan/ /mi 'dul zing thub btang snyoms chen por bzhugs/ /dus la bab nas brtson 'grus shugs dang ldan/ /de'i phyir mkhas brtson mdzad pa'i rtsa la ma/ /ye shes dbyings la 'jug pa shes bya za/ /dbyings nyid shes la 'jug pa nyon mongs za/ /gnyis med ye shes phrin 6gelas 'khor ba za/ /de phyir za byed pu ka mu ka ba/ /rigs btsun gnyen por gyur pas ( )thams cad 'dul shā / /phrin ( tsholas rtsal gyis bdud dpung thams cad 'joms/ /stong nyid 103wa 460

sgra bsgrags mu stegs wa tshogs 'jigs0)/ /de phyir 'joms byed rtsa mchog sing ha ma/ /dbyings la ye shes nyal zhing thugs rje mi②/ / snying nag ninag po drag po sku ston pa/ /thugs mchog rnam dag chos nyid dbyings su mkhyen/ /de phyir rmi byed phra men rik+ṣa ma/ /ye shes thugs rje stobs kyis mtha' gnyis gnon//tsham ngam ral gsigs (9sprul pas bdud dpung 'joms/ /las ⑤su ci mdzad brtson 'grus stobs kyis rol/ /de phyir stobs ldan phra 6)men ha k+ṣa ma/ /lhag mthong chos dbyings zhi gnas rlan ⑦gyis brgyal(nye/ /thugs rje 6)'khor bar smon lam stobs kyis myos/ /rtog ⑩'joms rdzas la gtsang sme med par rol/ /de phyir phra men myos (nyabyed u ka ra/ /yid g.yo las can sems par tu gyur pa ni/ /ye shes dbang gis thugs rjes 'gro la g.yo/ /don mdzad god 'brang ye shes dbyings su mkhyen/ /de phyir tshul khrims chen po kyi kya ma/ /bsam pa'i dngos po 'dod la 'dun pa ni/ /dbyings nyid mnyam nyid ye shes mkhyen pa tsho za/ /thugs rje 8'dun pas 'khor ba bag chags sbyong ⑫/ /de phyir phra men za byed don ka ma/ /dbyings la sems 'dzin yid la byed par 'gyur/ /ye shes dbyings rtogs drangs pa nyin mo tenyal/ /'gro mdongs tshonarmongs la thugs rjes mtshan mo ldan/ /ye shes thugs rjes drangs pa'i u lu ka /brtags pa'i dngos la rtse gcig ting 'dzin 'gyur4she/ /mnyam nyid mtha' bral dbyings las mi g.yo ba / /rtog ge 4)spyod yul byis rdu dpas mi mthong ba/ /de phyir sbed 6stebyed phra men ba ya ta/ /las 'bras bden la yid ches dad gyur te/ /mnyam nyid dbyings su ye shes thugs kyis mgyogs/ /zhi gnas spyan rdzi lhag mthong bgrod tshags chung / /de phyir phra men mgyogs 22byed bhag shi ta/ /nges pa'i dngos la 'dzin 103—461

bsgoms na①/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu yang dag byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems kyis deng 'dir dbang bskur ro/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/ /mgon chun de las gzhan med do/ /rnal 'byor dam nyams gzhan gyis mi skongs kyis②/ /bdag gi sems nyid kun tu bzang po'i ngang gyur na/ /bya tsa ②dang ni bral zhing 'das pa yin/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das pa yang / /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa dbyer med mnyam pa chen po dang / /de la sangs rgyas gang nas btsal kyang rgyal bas rnyed ④par ma gsungs so/ /byang chub sems kyis deng ⑤'dir dbang bskur ro/ /glang po dpal gyi thugs ka yinas/ /lcags kyi zer chen bzhi ⑦'phros te/ /glang po dpal chen he ru ku'i/ /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /'od zer dgu 'phros gdug pa ma lus bcom/ /'gro ba mtha' dag rnams kyi don byas te/ /bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad kyang / /kun gzhi snying la 'dus pa'i he ru ka /de ltar lags pas rtogs na (kyebyang chub sems/ /gang nas btsal kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /byang chub sems kyis deng 6)'dir dbang bskur ro/ /bdag med khams kyi snod gang du/ /rgya che gsal ba'i khams bkang ste/ /re dogs med par phung 'gro yang / /nyam nga med par kyilam gyi mchog /gza' gtad med pas don du bde/ /de bas rang sems bgrod pa'i sa/ /byang chub sems ni yangs shing (nyargya che ste/ /de bas bdag gis lus rtogs natuhe/ /snod bcud la sogs rtogs pa'i skyes mchog rnams/ /shes gsal blo ldan rnams la ye nas rnyed pa gsal/ /bla ma'i rgyud mchog de la yod 4 ces gsungs te rdzogs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ro/ /bsgoms pas rnyed par mi 'gyur ma 103—471

bsgoms stong bral med/ /thugs nas zhal du byung ba 'gro ba'i don du gsungs/ / rna rgyud tu)ston pas thugs ②brtol te/ /lus dang sems las ma gtogs bsgom du med/ /bsgoms nas sems nyid gzhan nas btsal yang rnyed par ma gsungs sol/ /dus gsum rgyal bas ye nas ma bcos te/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes chos kyi sku/ /chos nyid bsgom par bya ba gang yang med/ /man ngag shes rab sbyin chen des gsungs pas/ /lus dang sems las ma gtogs na/ /bdag gi sku gsung thugs la tshang chabar gnas/ /gal te brjod pa'i mtha' bzhi yod na ni/ /don rdzogs sgom pa po yang yod par gyur④/ /lus sems skye ba med (57bden pas/ /bsgom du med par 'jog pa gang / /don kun rdzogs shing chub par der gnas so/ /byang chub sems kyis deng (nya'adir dbang bskur ro/ /zla gsang dkar dmar rlung ka lci/ /zla ba shes rab gsal ba thabs chen te/ /thig le byang chub sems nyid dkar la 'tsher ri7)ba yi/ /dmar ba yug gi (nyarak+ta byang chub sems/ /rlung la shor du mi rtsal 9)thig le sgrom du 7sba/ /de las ma gtogs sangs rgyas gzhan na med/ /man ngag tshul du zla ba'i gzugs yin te/ /gsang ba'i tshul du yid kyi rnam shes nyid kyang zla ba yin/ /thig le sems kyi rang bzhin snum la 'dril/ /man ngag len par byed pas sems kyi thig le yin/ /sems las ma gtogs sangs rgyas gzhan na med/ /byang chub sems kyis deng (1'dir dbang bskur ro/ /rang 'byung khri che ba'i ye shes mi 'gyur la/ /chos nyid rang gis gnas pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dmigs bral ting 'dzin rgya mtshor rab sprul te/ /yid ni 'phags pa'i lam ni gnas pa ni/ /phra zhing zab pa bstan dka' rgyal ba'i sku/ /dran pa khri byed pa'i rtsol dang srog chags gsum/ /kun 1003—472

gzhi ①pad+ma'i yig 'bru gsal bar byed/ /byang chub sems kyis deng ②'dir dbang bskur ro/ /rgyu ni skye ba med pas rnam par dag /'bras bu 'gags pa med pas byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems de skye med ye shes dbyings/ /skye med mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i don/ /sems la rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgom / /byang chub sems kyis deng (5)'dir dbang bskur ④ro/ /'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /nam mkha' rdo rje snang ba ston pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /sa rdo rje chos nyid ye nas gnas pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /me rdo rje chos nyid rin po che'i sangs rgyas so/ /chu rdo rje snying rje chen pos brlan pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /rlung rdo rje 'dod pa sgrol ba'i sangs rgyas so/ /'byung ba bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur ro/ /dngos grub stsol ba rnam gnyis te/ /nges pa'i lung dang rang bzhin no/ /chos kyi dbyings las mnga' brnyes (5)nas/ /gang ltar bsgrub ⑥kyang dbyings kyi don/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'char ba dang / / dbang chen (7dbang sgyur (kye'achi ba med/ /sprul pa kun du bzang po nyid/ /sgrib dang 'chi bar kyi)mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems kyis dzodabang bskur ro/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang chen ni/ /de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gser dang 'dra ba'i byang chub sems/ /byang chub sems ni sa zhes bya/ /zla ba me dang 'dra ba yin/sto/ /byang chub sems nyid kun du bzang / /gsal zhing dro la nyon mongs sreg /byang chub sems kyis tsodabang bskur ro/ /don ni dbyings dang ye shes yin/ /yab yum gnyis med rol pa yi/ /rak+ta byang chub sems dkyil na/ /ma skyes rdzogs pa'i he ru ka /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyud/ /yon tan phrin nyugelas rdzogs mdzad pa/ /gsang ba'i don gyis mudabang bskur ro/ /gsang ba yum 103—473

chen kun du bzang / /rak+ta byang chub sems dkyil na/ /ma hā su kha'i dkyil 'khor dbyings/ /sems kyi thig les thig btab ste/ /dkyil 'khor skum po 'khyil pa la/ /chos kyi dbyings las spros pa'i sku/ /don gyi dbyings nas lha dang lha mo dgod/ /nges pa'i don gyis 6)dbang bskur ro(gyi/ /nga dang rang bzhin bdag nyid chen po ste/ /lhun gyis rdzogs dang spros pa med pa yi/ /thugs kyi dkyil nas 'byung ba rigs kyi sras/ /kun du bzang po yum dang don gyi thabs chen las/ /man ngag dang bcas pa yi ye shes snying po'i don/ /bcom ldan gsang ba'i mchog gi ( dkyil 'khor na/ /dpal chen kun du bzang po ye shes te/ /gsang ba'i byang chub sems kyis (4)dbang bskur ro/ /dkyil 'khor ma hā su kha'i gnas/ /ma hā su kha'i dbyings nyid na/ /byang chub sems nyid de kho na/ /ye shes chen po lhun gyis rdzogs nas gnas/ /ma hā su kha (snyegasang ba chen po 'di/ /don dang ldan te kun du bzang po yin/ /ngang (6)las ma g.yos kun du bzang po ni/ /gnyis su med par rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ro/ /yum gyi nags tshal chen po 'dul med du/ /rtag tu mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhugs/ /ngang (7)ni dus gsum bzhugs shing rang 98bzhin 'gyur ba med pa yin/ /bdag nyid 'dus ma byas pas skye ba med par lhun gyis grub/ /gsang ba'i byang chub (9)sems kyis dbang bskur ro/ /srid pa byang chub sems su ma bcos thig ler zlum/ /sngar 'das dang ldan bzhugs dang phyis 'byung ba'i/ /sems nyid rtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /nyon mongs dri ma ye nas med pa'o/ /ye nas sangs rgyas ma skyes lhun gyis grub/ /byang chub sems nyid gsang ba'i dbang 103—474

bskur ro/ /dpal chen kun du bzang po dbye ba med pa'i don/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las sprul pa mang po 'phro/ /lhag pa'i ye shes bye brag gcig 'du'o//phyag rgya 'gyur ba med pa rgyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /sku ni thams cad chos kyi sku ru 'dusal/ /lam ni thams cad rol pas chub pa'o/ /yum gyi ①dbyings chen rang bzhin rnam par dag /zas ni thams cad bdud rtsi lnga yi don/ /spyod pa bya ba med pa chen po'o/ /thugs ni rtog pa mi mnga' sa le ba'o(mi/ /ldem dgongs don dam byang chub sems kyi don/ /byang chub sems kyis deng (mi'adir dbang bskur ro/ /rnar brgyud ston pas thugs brtol te/ /nges pa'i lung dang don yang sangs rgyas yin/ /sangs rgyas mnyam dang dbyings su 'gro ba zhes/ /byang chub sems ni kun du rtag pa'i don/ /rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po nyid/ /dbang mchog 'dis ni dbang bskur ro/ /sku rgyan 'khor lo lung chen zab mo nang nas gsal/ /lnga bzhi (4)nang du 'khor 55༄ba yang / /ye shes sangs rgyas de las med/ /lta ba 'di la gnas shing rnal 'byor skal ba bzang (ye/ /bder gshegs (7kun gyi thugs dam byang chub sems kyi don/ /don dam dbang mchog 'dis ni dbang bskur ro/ /dbyings nas gsal shar bdal ba la/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byam 8)re yas/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yid la thim/ /'greng ldog spyi'u (9tshugs gar 'gyur yang / /gang ltar byas pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mun nag langs kyang khams gsum gsal/ /ye shes khrus kyi rdzing bu ru/ /dri la dag pas rdul mi 'go/ /dbang mchog 'dis ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid las gzhan pa'i 'khor rigs bzhis 'khor ba'i phra men ma dang / khro bo rdo rje 103—475

bka'i pho nya rnams la bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams su grub bya'i phyir①/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long (9/ /shes rab thabs kyi phyag rgya 'dzin/ /rnam grol dag pas gsung skad sgrogs/ /dril bu 'di ni sgra snyan gyis/ /phyogs bcu kun du sgrogs par byed/ /dbang mchog 'dis ni dbang bskur ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor khru /shegang tshad du bya/ /rak+ta'i mgo ma yin gyi sa byugs lil/ /de ru dpal chen dgod par bya/ /phra men 'khor dang pho nyas bskor/ /de ru slob ma gzhug (5)par bya/ /de nas rigs kyi bu mchog des/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus / /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /rab (6)tu gces dang yid 'thad dbul//dbang phyug longs spyod lngas mchod na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod pa yin//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyi dang nang dang gsang ba gsum gyis bka' stsal to / /phyi'i (77dbang rin po che sna bdun la sogs te dbang rdzas lnga bcu rtsa lngas dbang bskur ro/ /nang dbang dpal chen po yab yum kladang / khro bo dang phra men rnams kyi (9phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur ro/ /gsang dbang thabs dang shes rab byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa gsang ba zab mo las dbang gi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo / /chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas kyis kyang mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sku gsung thugs mnga' ba'i rtags su dang po phyag rgya chen po drug dang ldan par bsgom mo/ /de nas kun mkhyen ye shes kyis thabs 103—476

mkhas pa'i thugs rjes go shag gis phye la kun du snang gi ting nge 'dzin du bsgom mo / /de nas rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin du yi ge rtsu mthing 6)nag las sku smug nag 'jigs pa'i sku/ gsung gi drag shul spyod pa'i sngags/ thugs ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ mthing (minag las 'phags pa'i skur bsgom mo/ /de nas he ru ka rol pa nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang gnyis su med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'khyil pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mnyes pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / grub pa rdzas kyi li ting nge ④'dzin dang / rdo rje tshogs kyi (5)ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje bza' ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdud rtsi btung ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lha'i rnal 'byor gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bla na med pa'i 56)ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje gsang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dgyes pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / don yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa 57)dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du 'dus pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rtog pa 'joms 97pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / tshul khrims chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbu ma chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bden pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / sgra sgrogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dam tshig gi ting nge 'dzin dang /lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun du bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang /'bar ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gtum po rngam pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin dang /byu 103—477

rdo rje 'gugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje las kyi ting nge 'dzin dang /khrag 'thung zhi)chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lbos pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /seng gdong chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bzhad ②gdong chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje mtshon cha'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje'i ①dur khrod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / dregs pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje ngo mtshar gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / bsnyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'thor ④ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / brgyal ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rngam par zhu)byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / glo snying nang grol ⑥'dren cing za ba'i 7)ting nge 'dzin dang / sprul pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / byin gyis brlabs kyi ⑤ting nge 'dzin dang /mchod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang yonye/bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa'i rgyud gsang ba zab mo las ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa'i mnyes pa chen po'i mchod pa 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /de la mchod pa dam pa ni//thog tshamar rtog bsgoms bdag nyid bsgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan 'jig rten snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya/ /'khril ba'i 'jig rten mnyam sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid mnyes pas mchod par tu)bya/ /mnyam pa'i grub rdzas lho chen po dag /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bulayi/ /bza' dang btung dang bca' dang bgo/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /103—478

dkyil 'khor la ni 'bul ①bar bya/ /mnyes pa'i mchod pa chen pos rab tu mchod / /sha chen dang ni dri chen dang / /ga pur rak+ta ②dri chu dang / /ma he rta dang khyi sha dang / /na ge ge rgya gshog pa can/ /'di dag 'phags pa'i tshogs la dbul/ /pad+ma can dang dung ①can dang / /ba lang can dang ri mo can/ /'di dag mnyes pa'i mchod par dbul/ /zhing gi rgyal mtshan sha chen togadu /ras chen dag gi bla res ⑤dang / /zhing gi dbyug pa tsit+ta'i toganya /til mar dag tu bcas pa rnams/ /'di dag mchod par dbul bar bya/ /mnyes pa'i mchod pas rab mchod na/ /thams cad ma lus mngon sangs rgyas/ / phyi yi ⑦mchod pa dudang nang gi mchod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa las mchod pa gsang 6)ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 0phyung ngo / /bla med mi spang ba dang / bla ma bkur ((nyeb dang /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / yang dag pa'i lam la zhugs pa dang /gsang tsoba'i don du mi smra ba dang / rtsa ba lnga dang sgrub pa dang / bsrung /— rib dang ske/ gti mug dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / nga rgyal dang /phrag dog dag mi spang ngo / /dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri chen sha /dag pa'i snod bcud mi 'dor ro/ /yan lag bcu yi dam tshig ste/ /ye nas tsom nyams rtogs pas spyada'/ /bsrung zhing bsgrub pa'i dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ba yin te rigs med 'gyur/ /mi spong mi 'dor gnyis po nayi/ /yan lag dam tshig 'da' dka' ba'o/ /mnyam la mnyam par sbyor ba ni/ mnyam pa'i dam tshig la gnas 103—479

nanyar / /mnyam rdzogs chen po thob gyur nas/ /'das na sangs rgyas ma yin no/ /rtsa nyams pa 90yi phyal ba dag /gso la nye bar mi brtson dang / /skad cig yud tsam smra mi byed/ /nyams gyur (5)nyes pa brjod mi lang / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams 'gyur gi)na/ /bsgrub (5)pa thams cad nyams par 'gyur/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs pa'i/ /'bras bu mi 'dod bzhin du 'du/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /'bras bu med cing ngan 'gror ltung 6)/ /dam tshig rnams ni rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi (7)bdag nyid yin/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig lnga la ni//gcig la gnyis dang bcu phrag gsum/ /yan lag dam tshig lnga gnyis la/ /gcig la bcu phrag gnyis su zhus med/ /bsrung bar bya ba dang mi spang ba brgya nyi shu/dang du blang ba brgya nyi shu/ spyad par bya ba brgya nyi shu/ spyir sum brgya drug cu'o9 / /dam tshig 'di rnams ma nyams na 'tshang rgya'o⑩/ /nyams na dmyal ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa las dam tshig gi le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka rol pa nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo / /blang bar bya ba'i snod ni gang / /spang bar bya ba ci lta bu/ /mtshan nyid rnam pa du zhig mchis/ /spyad par bya ba du zhig mchis/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis he ru ka rol pa'i don bka' stsal pa/ dum bu gcig dang dum bu gnyis/ /gsum dang bzhi dang lnga (/stepa dang / /drug pa dang ni bdun pa dang / /dum bu brgyad pa tsorab tu grags/ /bram ze rgyal rigs 12rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs (7)rigs bud med rigs ma 103—480

nges / /dkar dang dmar dang dkar sngo dang / /sngo dang de bzhin ser skya ste/ /thal ba'i mdog dang mdog mi sdug /kha dog bdun du rab tu grags/ /nyi rim 6)dang ni glang po'i rgyab/ /'khor ba de bzhin bya rog rjes/ /dung sngo gcig dang dung gnyis dang / /chag pa dang ni mtshams kyis pa/ /'di dag thams cad rab brtags te/ /rab tu brtags te ②spyad par bya/ /shin tu mnyam pa'i sa phyogs sam/ /snyi ba'am yang na dul (gyiba'i sar/ /sngags kyis btab ste ④gnam du bskyur⑤/ /ltung ba'i mtshan nyid 'di rig bya/ /lho phyogs kha bltas bram ze med/ /srin po'i phyogs bltas glang po snyol/ /nub kyi phyogs bltas rigs ngan te/ /rlung gi phyogs bltas gsang mi thub/ /byang gi phyogs bltas phyug por 'gyur/ /dbang ldan phyogs bltas sngags grub ster/ /shar du bltas na bdag nyid gsod/ /me yi phyogs bltas she'u (6)shing med/ /'og tu bltas na rkun por spyod/ /steng du bltas na bud med gsod(7ni/ /glor bltas de ni rigs ngan te/ /snod kyi mtshan nyid 'di rnams so/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad (8)bya ste/ /dge ba sprul pa'i snod dag ni/ /dum bu gcig pa sa la dbang / /gnyis pa de ni rgyal phran 'gyur/ /gsum pa de yang nor la dbang / /bzhi pa de yang sngags sgrub 'gyur/ /lnga pa de yang chos kyang sgrub/ /drug pa de ni slong ba yin/ /bdun pa de ni brtul zhugs nyu༄so/ /brgyad pa yongs su spang bar byayi/ /dum bu gcig pa bram ze'i rigs/ /gnyis pa de ni rgyal po'i rigs / /gsum pa rje'u rigs yin pa ste/ /bzhi pa de ni dmangs rigs so/ /bu gu med dang mang ba ni/ /mkhas pas shin tu spang bar bya/ /bong chung ba dang srab tshostepa dang / /gang dag ser por 'gyur ba sna ni/ /bud med yin par 10(3—481

slob dpon gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i khyad par las/ /sprul pa mang po'i tshogs dang gshegs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ①ma hā badz+ra/ sarba duṣ+ṭi sa ma ya mu dra pra be sha ya shrī he ru ka rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ dzaḥ.e baṃ hoḥcha/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba du/ sa ma ya mu tra pra bhan ④tsakra ⑤ju phaṭa/ bder ⑥gshegs pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'gro ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /don gyi dbang du dgongs nas kyang / /'khor bcas rab 'bar gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba gas ma ya hi/ sarba du/ kā ya wāka tsit+ta (shebadz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed cing / /ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /mi gnyis don phyir dngos grub mchog gi (9)rnams/ /bdag cag stsal cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭa 7sa ma ya mu tra a ma (7ba stam bha ka hūm̐ 8phaṭa/ oṃ gu h+ya tri sha sa ma ya/ gu h+ya tri sha sa ma ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya tri sha sa ma ya hūm̐/ dam tshig sa la bzhengs pa yi/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma (gegashegs sam / /grub pa mchog dag ma stsal chan/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'o8/ /dzaḥrgyu bam̐ hoḥ/ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭi sa ma ya mu dra bra bhan ṇitsakra bhak+ṣa ya bāk+ṣa dzi 7ya bi to 4snyeg sa ya bi to 67ga sa ya/ he bha ga banas )/ bud+dha k+ṣe traṃ pra ti stam bha ka rtsu phaṭa/ sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor bas/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor rang las sprul/ /nga ni bdud kyi bdud bdag ste/ /mkha' 'gro tshogs bcas bsdus pa'o/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ka ni snar mu ka sha ra yā ya na maḥ/ oṃ badz+ra ra ga sa ma yā ya na maḥ( ge/ oṃ shrī badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pra ma ri zhi'i ya na maḥ ste/ oṃ shrī gan dhe (shedza (lha'i ( 7ya na maḥ( she/ a ti pu ho/ pra ti pu ho/ ta thā bhan dha sa/rna ka ro ya mi 103—491

sems dpa'i tshogs chen gyiyonye/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i mchog /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid 'di/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod ②la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā am+bha ①pa tits+tsha ④sto/ dpal ldan shrī he ru ka (snyedang / /yum chen kro dhi ⑥sha ri la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod ⑦la/ /'phrul gyi (nyadangos grub bdag khyil stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā arnya 0pra tits+tsha tiho/ dpal chen tu badz+ra he ru yidang / /badz+ra kro dhī 0shwa ri la/ /dam tshig gi ni mchod pa 'bul/ /dpal chen rat+na he ru dang / /rat+na kro dhī tishwa ri la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /dpal chen pad+ma he ru dang / /pad+ma gro dhī tsosha ri la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /dpal chen kurma he ru dang / /kurma kro dhī shwa 4 7ri la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā aghi nyushepra tits+tsha hu)ho/ dpal chen mi pham rdo rje dang / /ma tshogs dbang phyug 'khor gyi rkyen/ /gi ( )ri la zhu stesogs brgyad rnams dang / /sing ha la (gesogs brgyad rnams la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /ma mo chen mo bdun rnams dang / /sring mo chen mo bzhi rnams dang / /mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /dam tshig mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod tsol/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma hā arnya ( stem tits+tsha (2 ho/ shrī ban khe ( sgonyi/dpal chen sems dpa' 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa dang / dpal chen po shrī he ru ka /badz+ra ḍāk+ki so nī 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa dang / gzhan ( sheyang rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi ( 7dbang phyug chen mo mched lcam dral 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa 103—493

thams cad dgongs su gsol lo/ /ding 0)gnas mchog dam pa 'dir 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa dang / rdo rje mched lcam dral phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa dang ske/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i thugs dam bskang (geb dang / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i gnas su bsgral ba'i phyir rgyu zhi)mchog rkang bzhi pa zhig yon du 'bul zhing mchis na/ thugs rjes bzung zhing bsgral du gsol lo④/ /rgyu ⑤mchog 'di thugs rjes bzung nas ma bsgral (61na/ 'di la spyod pa zhig mchis te/rnal 'byor theg pa'i 6)gzhung las kyang tshul bzhin du ma bgyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshad ma khyad du bsad pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon dang / mched dang lcam dral la ngan 87sems dang dpya (9 /sems bskyed pa dang / mched la 'khus pa dang / dam las 'das pa dang / spa lo dang sgyu gsog /brdzun 7dang kha gsag /phyi tshul dang rgyab nyan bgyis nas rdo rje slob dpon snying nas smod )1cing bla ma la dbang zos pa dang mnyam pa'i spyod yul sun phyung ⑩ste/ sbyor sgrol sgo bkag pa dang / dad pa can gyi tshogs bcag ste/ gdung sems kyi rgyun bcad pas phrag dog dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi gdung 'tshob pa'i bar chad kyis da ltar ngan song gi gnas na 'khyams shing yo rtog pa'i dra bas ni bcings / 'khor ba'i rnyis beni zin nas dmyal khams kyi gting brgyud par nges te/ zhing bcu 15dang ldan pa 'di dam tshig tshul bzhin 17du bsgral bas/'di'i rnam par shes pa bla na med pa'i gnas su bsgral ba yang gnas stobs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lnga phung gi yan lag ni kun du bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung du gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes dgyes pa'i ngang du thim par smon 1 to/ /smon lam brjod de bsgral bar bya'o/ /spyi gtsug 103wa 494

min gnas mchog bla med 'dir/ /gtso bo lnga dang gtso mo lnga/ /sems dpa' ①dang ni sems ma dang / /khro bo dang ni khro mo yi/ /sbyor ba'i lhums su phaṭa kyis 'phang —/ /zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas pas/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam ②kun / /skad cig yud la brlag mdzad de/ /brlag par ma gyur gang yang med/ /'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam ①kun / /yud tsam gyis ni dbang mdzad de/ /dbang du ma gyur gang ④yang med/ /nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam ⑤kun/ /dpal ldan gzi brjid chen po rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzod/ /gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /'jig rten khams ni rab 'byam ⑥kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad de/ /zhi bar gyur pas dbyings la rol/ /bdag cag mched lcam dral rnams kyis rdo rje slob dpon dbang zos pa dang / phrag dog gi stidabang gis mched lcam dral 6)ngan 6)sems dang dbye sems bgyis pa dang —/ gnyid dbang gis le lor gyur pa dang / sems g.yengs pas sngags dang phyag rgya zur chag pa bidang / dam tshig yodang du len rngo ma thogs ⑩pas smad pa'i dam tshig nyams so 'tshal thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ /rgyu mchog rkang bzhi pa 'di phrin 6)las rnam bzhis bsgral ba yonayang gnas stobs (stepar smon to/ /bdag cag mched lcam dral 'di tshogs pa rnams kyis yid la rtag pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig /shrī yihe ru ka bya sha na/ badz+ra be ra ba na shan/ badz+ra ka 7ra dza li ta/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ur ta ke sha pra la ban/ sha ta sha pra dra/ sha ma ba ra na shra ma la ha ha ha hūm̐/ ka ra baṃ/badz+ra ka ra baṃ/ badz+ra kur na ta/ tri shu la yoshes gu dza/ pa ra sha ra na su sho ma 6)103—496
