ste ra'i 6)rgyu ma'i zhags pa dang / /thod rlon dmar gyis bkang ba dang / /sti ra phra mo gsus pa nas/ /glo snying nang grol ②'byin cing za/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sham thabs can/ /thod rlon phreng bas rgyan du byas/ /ma lus pa dag gsan du (migasol/ /rgyu las byung bas ④de bzhin gshegs / /ston ni ma nor don mdzad pa/ /mngag pa'i gnas su yud ⑤tsam gyis / /thams cad kho nar dbang mdzad mdzod(6)/ /srungs shig myur du rnam rgyal dpal/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlogasaspyi/ /rol cig dgongs shig (nyade bzhin gshegs/ /mā ra na ta tha/ 'byung po'i sha ni zan pas zhim/ /'byung po'i khrag ni chang bas zhim/ /'byung po'i rus pa zhim pa ste/ /thams cad gsol te dgyes par mdzod/ /dpal chen he ru ka /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs chen po/ /shin tu mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par sprul/ /mthing (9rinag gcer bu ral pa can/ /mi lpags rlon pa gos su gyon/ /thal ba'i mtshan mas byugs 7pa ste/ /khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /phreng ba 17mang pos rgyan du byas/ /lag na tri shul yo thod pa thogs / /dug 12gsum bshigs 7par dam bcas pa'i/ /rdo rje me phung da'akhrug pa'i tshul/ /re ba thams cad skong tsomadzad pa'i/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab / /theg 7chen rnal 'byor spyod pa la/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs gtan nas phyung / /thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas kyang / /rdul phran bzhin du /nyabarlag pa dang / /sems nyid theg pa chen po yi/ /rnam thar la ni dgod par mdzod / /rnal 'byor bde yi mchog sgyu mas sprul/ /dam tshig dag la 'jug tu gsol / /nyon mongs kun las )rgyal bar mdzod/ /ma lus pa dag bsnams su 10(2—500

gsol / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'dod chags rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro bde mchog sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /de na te the rgyu/ rnam pa sna tshogs dag pa'i rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i bde mchog thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐/ rnam pa sna tshogs khro bo ①rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ rnam pa sna tshogs thabs kyi rgyud kyis sems can ma lus lus pa med par 'dul mkhas pal/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi mkha' 'gro sgyu mas thams cad rab sprul rnam par sprul/ /hūm̐ e sha hūm̐ be sha hūm̐/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcaṇ+ḍa dha badz+ra pā ②ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pā ta (0ye/ tar+ya thā/ e h+ye hi rtsis ma ya/ ā ⑤na ya badz+ra shān ting ⑥/ badz+ra ⑦gro dha na(kye/ badz+ra tsa kro ⑨badz+ra gan/ badz+ra mu snying /badz+ra ti 7ba ti/ badz+ra gan ti/ badz+ra gan da/ badz+ra a kring / badz+ra rak+ṣa/badz+ra dang ṭ+wāṃ/ badz+ra shan ting tunye/ badz+ra e ka ra tsa ma/ badz+ra ma no ha tsoram/badz+ra dun ting / badz+ra nī lam/ badz+ra na lam/ badz+ra gri ta/ badz+ra mu kring nyunye/badz+ra ki lam/ badz+ra us smacha/ badz+ra ma ka rad wa/ badz+ra bir+ya tsa ra tsa ni ka /kha na kha/ tu ta kha/ sarba a/ sha sa kha/ sarba ma ā likar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ bhan dha ya bhan dha tsoya/ sarba ḍā tsho tshoki ni nan/ e a ra li ma nusma ra ya phaṭa/mi yi srin mo tshangs ma 4shedang / /khro bo dang ni 'jug srid mo/ /gzhon nu ma 4 chedang dbang po dang / /rdo rje dmar mo bdud rtsi mo/ /zhi ba ma dang be con mo/ /103—501

brang gis 0)'gro chen po dang / thod rlon gyis bcings shing bshams la/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad de/ phyag g.yon pa'i phur bu la gzigs(mi/ mche ba gtsigs ①pa/ rab tu rngam pa/ dur khrod kyi me phung gi nang du lte ba man chad lcags kyi phur pa ⑦zur gsum pa/ e'i nang du sum cha tsam nub pa la phyag bzhi la g.yas kyi gong ma sta re kha yar bstan te brdeg par bya ste/ g.yon pa ri rab kyis gnon pa'i stobs (5)su 'dzin pa/ g.yon dang pos rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khrol zhing bdud kyi khams 95)'jigs pa/ 'og ma phur bu zur gsum 'debs pa'i stabs su gzas shing / ngan song gsum du 'jigs pa/ stobs dang mthu la sogs pa khro bo thams cad 'dus pas kyang che ba gcig phyung ste/ rtag pa chen po bzhugs ⑦par bstan pa (8)ni sprul pa'i skur byin gyis brlab po6)/ /de la rigs lngar byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ 'bru lngas gnas lnga byin gyis brlab po/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ/ rked par hri/rtse mor phaṭa bsam mo/ /de'i 'og tu thugs kyi ye shes rtse gcig par byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ zur gsum du phaṭa gsum/ ngos kyigasum du hūṃ gzhag (1go/ /de nas sku bltas pa dang / rigs so so'i khro bo thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bya ste/ khro bo dkyil 'khor de dag nyid phyogs bcur 'phros pa slar 'dus nas / hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi kyisgra 'byin cing / de'i sku la bstims te/ dbang dang byin rlabs 1 thams cad brlan 7par bya'o/ /de nas 'gro ba'i don la gshegs nas phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa 35thams cad dang / sngon (9thugs dam du zhal gyis bzhes pa lags pas des gros yo mdzad cing bskul ba la bzhugs pa dang / bdag nyid kyang bdag nyid chen po yin pas phur pa 1042—504

yang bdag nyid chen po nyid du dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir / lag pa g.yas ①par ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i steng du hūm̐/g.yon pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du ①gyur pa'i steng du ta chabasam mo / /gung mo la oṃ/ mthe bo la hūm̐/ mdzub 4)mo la /⑤/ srin lag la ཿyi/mthe'u chung la hasti/ 'di rnams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i steng du gzhag ste / su rad ②snyi zhes brjod pas thal mo mnyam par sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra a dza li ⑨rdzu / zhes brjod pas sor mo cung zad bsnol lo/ /oṃ badz+ra ban dha hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sor mo rgyab tu bsnol la bsdam 7mo/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ⑩zhes brjod pas phur pa blangs te chang 8pa'i nang du bcug la/ lag pa chang pa phye la mthe bo dang srin lag dang mthe'u chung dang gnyis kyi bar du yang gzhug /mthe bos cung ⑫zad bskul zhing drud do/ /oṃ badz+ra ā chabe sha ya/ a a zhes brjod pas phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa yab teyum sras dang bcas pa thams cad zhe sdang rjes su dran pa'i sku yungs 'bru tsam par mtshams med par phur pa la bsdu zhing bstim mo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po chen po nyid du rdzogs pa'i byin gyis brlab ⑩cing dbang bskur tsobar bya ste/ sor mo rgyab tu bsnol la gung mo gshibs ( te/ bsgreng ba'i bar du phur bu bcug hu/la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa zhu )ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa zhes (nyabarjod pas bzlas so/ /de nas sor mo pug phug ()byas te/ lag pas phur pa bzung la/ oṃ hūm̐ hriḥkhri / phur bu ba phaṭa zhes ( stebarjod pas de nas sor mo rgyab tu bsnol la mthe zhinabong gnyis gshibs ( sgopa'i chang par bcug nas/oṃ ce sbyin da sbyin da/ ha na ha na/ ti ba ta tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod nas dril te/bdag nyid chen po thams cad gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa'i gzi byin 103—505

mo / lhor rdo rje gtum mo/ nub tu dur khrod bdag mo/ byang du rdo rje sgrol ma/de'i mtshams bzhir rdo rje tib tib dang / rdo rje teg teg dang / rdo rje 'dzin ma dang ①/ rdo rje yid g.yo ma dang / sgo bzhi dgod/ dkyil 'khor 'dom ②gang gru bzhi la/ dbus su sing ha mu kha pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ chu srin gyi lus la seng ge'i mgo can brgyad kyis bskoral/ sgo ④bzhi dgod/ dkyil 'khor 'dom (gegang gru bzhi la/ dbus su bya skṛ 0mu kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la / gang ku'i lus la stag gi mgo can brgyad kyis bskor/ sgo ⑦bzhi dgod/dkyil 'khor 'dom dugang gru bzhi la/ dbus su sri la mu kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la 6)seng ge'i lus la wa'i mgo can brgyad kyis bskor/ sgo ⑩bzhi dgod/dkyil 'khor 'dom yigang gru bzhi la/ dbus su shwa tson mu kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la pho rog gi lus la khyi'i mgo can brgyad kyis bskor/ sgo 0bzhi dgod/dkyil 'khor 'dom chagang gru bzhi la/ dbus su kṛ dha tsos kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la kung ku'i tsolus la bya rgod kyi mgo can brgyad kyis bskor/ sgo (nyebazhi dgod / dkyil 'khor (nya'adom ()gang ( )gru bzhi la dbus su kung ka mu kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ spyang ki'i 4)lus la kung ma'i mgo can brgyad kyis bskor/sgo tsobazhi dgod/ dkyil 'khor 'dom so gang gru bzhi la dbus su kung ka mu kha/pad+ma 'dab ma (gebargyad la 'ug pa'i lus la pho rog gi mgo btags pa brgyad kyis bskor / sgo (nyebazhi dgod/ dkyil 'khor 'dom ligang gru bzhi la dbus su u lu mu kha/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad khrinal pho rog gi lus la 'ug pa'i mgo btags pa brgyad khri)kyis bskor/ sgo ( /bzhi dgod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phra men ma'i ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs zhu )nas 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad do/ /bcom 103—515

ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka rol pa las phra men ma bsgrub 0)pa'i le'u ste bcwa lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku dang gsung dang thugs dngos grub kyi ting nge 'dzin du zhugs te/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'di phyung ngo —/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs las (misprul pa'i he ru ka /chos dbyings don dam rig pa'i dbyings na bzhugs/ /phyag rgya yum gyi mkha' la bzhugs nas kyang —/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /ye shes khro rgyal sprul pa mang po 'phro/ /phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'gro don mang por mdzad/ /las byed mkha' 'gro chos dbyings sku la 'khril/ /ye shes khro rgyal dngos grub bdag la stsol / /phra men za byed mche gshog 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /dbang phyug 'jug byed yid 'phrog nu ma can/ /rdo rje mchu can sder chen gshog pa can/ /phra men za byed chen mo sridangos grub bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje yang sprul chen po chos dbyings mkha' la shar/ /mtshon thogs sprul pa sna tshogs 'gro don mdzad/ /rtag tu don mdzad thugs rje shugs las byung / /phra men yang sprul chen po dngos grub stsol/ /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /sems can rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /ye shes chos dbyings skad tshogs zla nya'i ④zhal / /las mdzad ye shes nan tan don la bzhugs(5)/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /sgo ba yab yum dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbyings kyi ye shes yum/ /las byed ma mo kun la dbang mdzad ma/ /103—516

phyag brnyan sprul pa sna tshogs 'gro don mdzad/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje gshog ①pa thogs pa'i ②yid 'phrog ma/ /rdo rje sder mo phyogs bcur sprul pa 'phro/ /rdo rje las byed ma mo brgya yang 'gyed/ /dbang phyug pho nya'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mi mnyam ①pa yi lha khyod rtag tu ni/ /thugs rje can ④gyis gzigs shing 'gro ba'i dpal/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub ⑤par dam bcas pa/ /bdag cag las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'khor rnams 'dus nas gsol pa/ sngon tshe ye shes brnyes ⑥pa'i lha/ /de yi 'khor du gtogs pa ma dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtse gcig bsnyen kyang ye shes lha dang phra men khyod bsnyen bsnyen/ /bsnyen ⑦pa'i dus na rgyang ma ring / /bsgrub (7pa'i dus na mthu ma chung / /yang bsnyen ni yang yang bsnyen na/ /dpal chen phra men khyed ltar ma lags kyi/ / lang ka 6)tshogs kyi srin mo yang / /pha bas byams shing khu 0bas gdung / /yang bsgrub yipa ni tu yang bsgrubs (snyen/ /lang ku'i tshogs kyi srin mo yang / /ma bas byams shing sring bas skigadung / / gdungs pa'i tsomachi ma'i tshul du dku/ /ye shes lha yi tsothugs kyis bzod lags yi sam/ /dngos grub skal dang ldan par mi dmigs kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis tshonadangos grub stsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi //sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i dngos grub 'khor rnams la stsal to/ /'khor rnams kyis kyang rdo rje chos kyi sdud pa por zhu nodangos grub stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa las sku gsung thugs kyi ( spedangos grub dbyig bsgrub 2pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //103—517

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka'i 6)dam pa'i don gyi gsang ba zab mo 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung nas sprul pa lcam dral 'di mgo mjug (7gi don rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis/thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis/ mdor bsdus na don dam la lhun gyis grub pa'i byang chub sems su bsdu'o/ /rgyud 'di'i mgo mjug ②gi don dpal kun du bzang por 'dus so/ /kun du bzang po sku mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo dang / sku gsung thugs bde ba chen po ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang gobyang chub kyi sems kyang smyoge'adus so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i kun du bzang por 'dus pa'i don ni bcom ldan 'das kyis sdud pa po rdo rje chos la gtad do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi don gsang ba zab mo 'di rdo rje chos kyi sdud pa po la gtad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rdo rje chos kyi sdud pa pos lus ngag yid gsum rjes su yi (6)rang skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa/ kun gzhi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rgyal ba'i sku bzhugs so/ /sprul pa mang pos 'gro don rdzogs par mdzad/ /dpal chen kun bzang khyod la phyag 'tshal lo ye shes khro bo chos nyid dbyings na bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i khro bos las rnams rdzogs par mdzad/ /phra men yang sprul ye shes dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro bo 'khor mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung dngos grub ya mtshan cho 'phrul can/ /sku gsung thugs las 7 sprul pa mang po 'phro/ /mkha' 'gro za byed phra men pho nya ma/ /mgyogs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las rnams drag shul mdzad pa'i khro rgyal 103—518

sku / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ①man ngag gsang chen rnams/ /klung nas grol bar mdzad pa ye shes yum/ /sgo ba sgo ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams ②rjes su yi rangs te / legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ bka' dam pa gsang ba zab mo'i tan tra 'di sdud pa po rdo rje chos la gtad do/ /de nas sdud pa ④po rdo rje chos kyis bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang bo he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi bshags pa phul lo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang du gyur pas na/ /lus ngag sems kyis sdig bgyis mthol zhing bshags/ /theg pa dman pa'i dbang du gyur pas na/ /thabs chen spyad dang ma spyad mthol zhing bshags/ /ma rig log pa'i dbang du gyur pas na/ /yang dag don ma rtogs pa mthol zhing bshags / /snying rje chung zhing (gezhe snang dbang du gyur pas na/ /'gro ba'i don ma bgyis pa mthol zhing bshags/ /le lo gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bsgom (phyiradang bsgrub ⑦la g.yel ba mthol zhing bshags/ /ser sna 'jur 'gegs ⑧dbang du gyur pas na/ /mchod pa lo zla 'das pa mthol zhing bshags/ /nga rgyal khengs sems dbang du bsdus pa dzinan/ /slob dpon sku ma tsomanyes pa mthol zhing bshags/ /brtso (nyegadung chung ba'i dbang du gyur pas na/ /grogs mched thugs dang 'gal ba mthol snyizhing bshags/ /za rog (nyengan pa'i dbang du gyur pas na/ /phud dang lhag mar gyur pa mthol zhing bshags/ /phud dang lhag ma nyams pa'i skyon dbang gis/ /phud nyul 8thugs dang 'gal ba snyimathol zhing yibashags / / phud nyul nyu thugs dang 'gal ba'i skyon dbang gis/ /mkha' 'gro bka' chad gnas su gyur pa mthol zhing bshags/ /sgrol ba'i dus su snying rje 103—519

chung ba ①yis/ /sems can gnas ma stobs ②pa mthol zhing bshags/ /nyon mongs gnas ma stobs pa'i skyon dbang gis/ /yun gyi sgrib par gyur pa mthol zhing bshags/ /sbyor ba'i dus su ting 'dzin ma gsal bas/ /gzungs ma thugs dang 'gal ba'i skyon dbang gis/ /chags shing 'khor ba'i gnas su mthol zhing bshags/ /bshags nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /de skad ces bzod pa phul nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang tshangs pa gnang ste/ bka' dam pa 'di yang nas yang du rdo rje chos kyi sdud pa po la gtad do/ /de gnas rdo rje chos kyis gobaka' dam pa 'di ma chags pa'i dbang gis bka' bzhin byas so/ /de nas 'khor de dag thal mo sbyar nas rjes su yi phyirang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /bcom ldan 'das he ru ka rol pa las yongs su gtad pa'i (6)le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi ⑦rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /(8)gsang ba'i snying po zab mo mchog dpal snying rje rol pa'i rgyud rdzogs sto9947// //rgya gar gyi lots+tsha ⑩ba mkhas par lobs pa bal po shrī khrir tis (nyagatan la phab ste / skad gsar pas bsgyur nas sog po mchog gi snying po dang / an bkra shis dang / bal po 1 bzang bkra shis rgya mtshos yon bdag bgyis nas mang yul byams sprin 1gegatsug lag khang gi ya thog gi dbu rtser shin tu gsang ste/ skad gsal bar bsgyur ro// 103—520

spag /thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/dngos grub chen po nye ba'i snying po mchog bam po chen po brgyad pa/①༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ sarba pañca a mṛ ②ta/ sa ra sidhi ①ma hā du ka / skṛ da ④sdi na pa ra bid tan aṣ+ṭa/ bod skad du/ thams cad bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ dngos grub chen po nye ba'i snying po mchog bam po chen po brgyad pa/dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan (snyegasang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor na/ /shin tu rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /skal ldan rnams dang thabs cig (6)bzhugs/ /gnas mchog yum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /gnyis med lilhun gyis gnas pa'i tshe/ /de tshe nyan thos dge 'dun dang / /rang rgyal theg chen mdo sde dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / /nyan thos dge 'dun chen po dang / /dgra bcom 987ming yang med nang du/ /kun bzang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dgongs te 99'di skad bstan pa'i lung / /bshad cing 'grel pa'i 7dus gcig 103—560

dang ske/ /'di skad bstan pa'i dus gcig na/ /srid gsum ye nas bdud rtsi lnga//ma bcos ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun du bzang po'i thugs dkyil ①nas/ /dus gsum srid ②gsum sku gsung thugs/ /ye nas bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir/ /nges pa'i klong nas bka' stsal pa/ /zab mo'i klong nas phyung ste bstan/ /de nas bder nigashegs thams cad dang / /thabs cig ④bzhugs te dgongs pa ni / /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /ye shes mnyam nyid nyams rnyed ⑤nas/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i gral bkod de/ /kun gyi dam par 'di gsungs so/ /bka' yi dam pa mchog gi lung / /nges par phyung ⑥ste gsungs pa 'di'o/ /sgrub dang bsgrub ⑦par bya ⑧ba dang / /'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /bdud rtsi dam pa mchog gi lung / /snying por bsdus pa'i nges par 6)'di/ /byang chub 'byung ba snying po mchog /lta ba dang ni spyod pa dang / /dam tshig bsgrub yipa phrin (spelas dang / /nges par sgrub dang bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /zab mo bsdus pa'i lung 'di gsungs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bstan pa dang / /brgyad khri bzhi stong rnam grangs kyang / /theg pa'i sgo ni gsum du gsungs/ /gsang nyid theg par bsdus dang bzhi/ /ldem por dgongs dang don dam yang / /bkri ba'i don de tsosangs rgyas yin/ /rna brgyud bstan pas thugs brtol te/ /thig le chos skus khyab pa'i phyir/ /nges pa'i lung yang sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas mnyam dang dbyings su 'gro/ /nges pa'i lung yang rnam gcig tu/ /gsang sngags gsang bas sangs rgyas te/ /byang chub sems 'di kun du dag /rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde chen nyid/ /ma lus mtha' dag nyid kyi rgyas / /ye nas yibya med bya mi dgos/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khrul pa'i sgra//103—561

mi rtog sbyong ba'i yul min no/ /de lta'i yul du rtog 'dzin gyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gyur pa yin/ /nges 'byung chos sku chen po la/ /bha gar ji bzhin bzhag pas na/ /byang chub nyid de ltung gnas med/ /bu gcig ma rtsol bde bar gnos/ /rgyud dang lung dang man ngag kyang / /dmangs ①dang rje'u dang rgyal po'i tshul/ /khyad par rtsal 'phang thag ring yang / /gcig la gcig rten gcig gi ngang / /dbyer ②med tshul gcig rang bzhin pas/ /cig ②ste rnam grangs yongs kyis ④med/ /dbyer med ngang du rtogs pa la/ /bdud rtsi zhes ni de la bya'o/ /de bas lisku gsung thugs kyi bdag /sku dang rgyan dang 'khor lo yang la/ /lung chen zab mo'i nang na gsalayi/ /lnga bzhi nang du 'khor ba yang / /ye shes sangs rgyas de las med/ /dbyings su gyur pas mnyam gnas pas/ /ye nas sangs rgyas bde chen nyid/ /bdud rtsi zhes ni de la brjod/ /skye shi med pa'i dbyings su gyur/ /dbyings 'gyur dag ⑦mnyam lhun grub pas/ /lta ba 'di la gnas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni skal ba bzang / /ci spyad ci bsgoms ci bsgrubs yon kyang / /bdud rtsi nyid de 6)sman gyi mchog /bder tshugashegs nyid kyi thugs dam nyid/ /byin brlabs ngo (nyamatshar rgya cher 'byung / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi gsos/ /sangs rgyas bde chen nyid las byung / /thams cad ma lus bdud rtsi 'di/ /spros med thig ler gnas pa las/ /mtha' yas sems can don gyi phyir/ /rang la mchod cing rang gis bza'/ /sgrub (nyepa pos ni nan tan byos/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang pos/ ye shes chen po'i thugs nas dgongs te bka' stsal pa'o/ /bdud rtsi chen po mchog gi lung las byang chub sems de kho na nyid lta bar bstan pa'i man ngag chen po gsang 103—562

gshegs kyis/ /sman gyi rgyal po bdud rtsi mchog /nges pa'i lung 'di bka' stsal to/ /de nas thugs rje'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /sa rnams rab tu g.yos nas ni//stong gsum 'jig rten sa stengs bu①/ /thams cad sman chen ra sa yan②/ /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /de ltar smin par byed pa yang / /thugs rje rgya mtsho chen po las/ /thugs rje sprin ni khyab pa yis/ /sprin chen glog gi phreng ba can / /yud ①tsam sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /sa stengs ༷khengs par char phab nas / /de nyid thugs rje snyoms ⑤pa'i mgon/ /chu yi phung po bdud rtsi yis/ /ma lus par ni ngoms par byas/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho thigs chen gyis/ /sa dang sman rnams kun gyi 6)gsos/ /ri rab rtse dang skyori sul dang / /sman ljongs dang ni nags tshal (8)dang / /lcang lo can gyi 'khor kun du/ /sprin ①chen bdud rtsi char gyis brlanayi/ /chu de thams cad ro gcig ste/ /chu yi bcud las (nyaskyes pa ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang gel pa'i shing / /ljon shing dang ni tsu ta'i shing / /sa stengs khebs par 8skyes pa ste/ /bdud rtsir gyur te thams cad rgyas/ /sdong po dang ni sdong chen dang / /rtsa ba sdong po tu)shun lpags dang / /snying po yal ga lo ma dang / /'dab ma me tog 'bras bur bcas/ /de bzhin 'bru yi rnam grangs kun/ /thams cad bangs shing smin par mdzad/ /'thungs na ngoms te rgyas par gyur/ /so so'i yul dang gnas dag dang / /mdog dang ro dang dri dang mthu/ /gang gi 7sa bon de nyid las/ /de dag rang rang 'byin par byed/ /de bzhin srog 7chags thams cad kun/ /ra sa ya na'i rdzas la spyodakho / /'gro ba drug 7gi gsos su 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi sgo (steni rnam par phye/ /'jig rten mgon pos bka' stsal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems 103—566

dpa' chen po 'jam dpal rnon pos bsdus te bka' stsal pa/ lha dang klu dang drang srong dang / mi'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge bsnyen ①chen po dri ma med par grags pa lits+tsha bī ②la sogs pa la bdud rtsi ra sa ya na ta nan dzha ya 'di dag bstan no/ /dang por bsgrub pa'i yul dang gnas ni/ u hu si ti pa tsa zhes bya ste / ba tri dus zhes kyang bya ba/ ri'i rgyal po gser mdog can gyi rtse mo rta rna ri zhes bya ba der/ ra sa ya na zhes bya ba drang srong rnams kyis bsgrubs so/ /de yang thang cig ①yud kyis 'grub/ /la la nyin zhag gcig ⑤gis 'grub/ /la la nyin zhag bdun gyis 'grub/ /mtha' nyam nyi shu gcig gis 'grubatso/ /de la the tshom med pas 'grub/ /de dag kun gyi mtshan nyid ni/ /rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga dang / /lo ma 'dab ma me tog dang / /shun lpags 'bras bu ①snying por bcas / /ro dang mthu dang mdog dang las/ /rtsa ba gcig la 6)yan lag brgyad / /yan lag brgyad las ⑩yon tan stong / /'di dag kun gyi yon tan yang —/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel zhing ⑩/ /bdud bzhi nges par 'joms par byed/ /sman gyi rgyal po bdud rtsi'i mchog /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /drang srong chen po 'di kun kyang / /mngon shes lnga dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /rig pa'i gnas mchog bcwa 7brgyad shes/ /de nas sman ni bsgrub par bya / /stegs bu khru gang ba gcig la/ /maṇ+ḍal yi gtsang ma'i dris byugs la/ /de yi dbus su sman gyi mchog /bdud rtsi cong zi rnam gsum dang / /ser skya ba las byung ba yi7/ /'o ma bre gang btsags nang du/ /a sho kun da'i 'phye ma dang / /bsres tshenas bskol ba'i nang du gdabayi / /lcags las byas pa'i snod du blugs4she/ /stegs bu'i dbus su bzhag nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab /9pa'i 103—567

sngags 'di dag /stong ngam ①brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tal/pa la li ga① /pe ④la lig tsan da ⑤lig swā hā/ dngos grub blang ba'i sngags 'di'o / /a mṛ ༷ta sidhi ④byi tsurna ⑧ya swā hā/ pu tsa lha ha kun/ byin gyis brlab 6)cing bza' ba yang / /nyi ma'i gung tshul bza' bar bya/ /don dam thig le bden pa las/ /snying po med las snying po blang / /rnam smin 'bras bu rig ⑪'dzin 'grub/ /nad med lo brgya 'tsho bar byed/ /de nas drang srong nyi shu gcig /grub pa'i rig 8'dzin mchog tu gyur/ /de yi 'og tu drang srong mchog /bcwa tsolnga yis ni bdud rtsi sman/ /ra sa ya na dam pa 'di/ /tshe yi rig dhi'adzin 'dod pa'i phyir/ /gzhon nu sred ces bya ba dang / /'dron skyob ces ni 8bya ba dang ske/ /rtsibs kyi mu khyud la tshusogs pas/ /chu bo gang gā'i 'gram du bsgrubs/ /lha rdzas dge ba ⑩a ru ra/ /rigs bdun sa la lhung ba ni/ /brgya byin bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i tshe/ /thigs pa tsobadun ni kha nas ltung yi/ /rlung gis 0khyer te ⑥sa las skyes9 nye/ /bdud rtsi'i gtso bor rab tu grags/ /rlung dang mkhris dupa bad kun dang / /'dus pa'i nad dang dus kyi nad/ /dus min 'chi las thar bar byed/ /rlung mkhris ( stebad kun (nye'adi kun yang / /gcig la'ang lnga lnga yod par bshad/ /de kun rab tu bsal ba'i 0phyir/ /phung po'i bdud dang nyon mongs bdud/ /lha bu ( 7bdud dang 'chi bdag bcom/ /bdud rtsi 'di yis sel bar byed/ /shar lho nub byang gang yang rung / /brag phug stong pa yod pa las / /bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i khu ba ni/ /rin chen sna lnga 'byung ba'o/ /ming ni shi la mdza' du zhes/ /ra sa ya na bdud rtsi'i mchog /a ru ra brgya rtsa brgyad dam / /yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /sul bu skum por gyur btsos te ste/ /de 103—568

khud ①par dro ba bzhin/ /bdud rtsi rgyal po dbang chen 'di byin pas/ /rig ②'dzin rgyal po gtso bo'i go 'phang thob/ /tshe dang skongs nidang yid du 'ong / /bgegs rnams zhi ba la sogs te④/ /nad dang bral nas ci 'dod pa'i/ /yon tan rtsa brgyad 'di yis thob/ /zhes ⑤bka' bstsal yinas/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pas bka' stsal to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦lung 'di las/ /dbang bskur gnang ba gang yin pa/ /'khor rnams kun gyis thob par shog /zhes (glebaka' stsal to/ /yang 'khor nye ba'i sras mchog dam pa 'jam dpal la sogs pas dbang mnos nas/ yang rigs ⑨lnga dang rigs rgya mtsho'i gtso bo la lung gi don zhus pa/ rtog ⑩pa dang mi rtog pa'i don ji ltar blta/ don gyi 'bras bu gang lags (rjezhes gsol pa las/ kun du bzang po dang rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pas bka' stsal 7pa/ tshangs dang drang srong gtsang ma za/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/ /klu dang bram ze gtsang ma za/ /de dag grol bar / ngas ma bshad/ /byol song rtswa rdzimachog za ba yang / /ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du za/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/ /yang dag don gyi lung 'di nyon/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang ldan pas ni/ /chos sku gcig las tha dad pa'i/ /rigs lnga'i kha dog 'di bshad do/ /'di ltar rtogs yin grol zhes bshad/ /rang bzhin ye nas dag pa'i rdzas/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings su rab rtogs na/ /gnyis med don gyis zin pa yin/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /dngos dang dngos med rtog 9pa'i mtshan/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rtog pa'i mtshan/ /mkhas pas dbus la gnas mi 'gyur/ /ye shes sku lnga bstan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems ni dkar bas na/ /dri med 103—599

ron po la phyag 'tshal lo 6)༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga bān (tsamañju shrī khri: na maḥsidhe / bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rnon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal nyid sku rdo rje lta bu byang chub kyi dgongs pa nyid la bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems rdo rje kun du bzang po ni/dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i/ yum gyi tshal chen po na dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings zhi ba chen po la bzhugs so/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyang / gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang / 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang /sems ma'i tshogs94)/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor na/ sras mchog dam pa nye ba'i 'khor/ rigs kyi rgyal po ma lus pa rnams dang (5)/ tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / drang srong chen po dang / lha dang klu dang / lits+tsha bī 95)la sogs pa'i mi rnams kun la dpal kun du bzang pos dzo bka' stsal pa/ nan tan gyis 103—626

ni brtson 'grus bskyed/ /the tshom med na nges par 'grub①/ /bdud rtsi chen po rnam lnga 'di/ /spyad cing bcangs pa'i ②yon tan dang / /rang bzhin dang ni ngo bo dang / /mthu dang byin gyis ①brlabs ④kyis 'grub/ /mi brjed 0rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin/ /nges par bsgrub ⑥pa'i yon tan ni/ /nges pa'i man ngag gsum du bstan zhes bka' stsal nas/ sdud pa po chos kyi don/ 'jam dpal rnon po la gtad ⑦do/ /de nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyisal/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha 6)'khor tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams la 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma hoḥkyisangs rgyas kun du bzang / /gsang chen thig le nyid la rdzogs/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron/ /dpa' bo khyod la skyabs su mchi'ol/ /rang 'byung 7dri med bdud rtsi 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'i mchog /mi shes dri ma kun bcom nas/ /nges pa'i dbyings la 'god tso mdzad pa/ /gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang mdzad rdo rje rgyal spyan tunyedang / /mi bskyod nyi ma snang mtha' yas/ /don yod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la/ /dgyes shing gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyings phyug yum gyi tshogs rnams la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /lag na rdo rje rgyal po dang / /kun bzang blo gros chen po dang / /don rab sa snying la ④sogs la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i 'jig rten dbang po dang / /'gro ba 'dzin mchog dam pa la/ /gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag la rang bzhin dri med sku/ /tshul bzhin phreng ba dbyangs dang gar/ /spyod mchog dga' sdug phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdug pa me tog mar me ho/ /gzugs mchog mnyes mdzad lha mo la/ /mos pas 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig 8byed tshogs kyi bdag 103—627

po mchog /rdo rje srin po 'dul mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal yab yum ①'khor bcas la / /gus pas bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams kyis legs so legs so/ /a la la hoḥlazhes brjod nas gnang ngo —/ /de nas dbang byin te/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po khyod kyis/ thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la/ mkhyen rab chadang pos kun gyi mchod pa chen po mdzad do/ /de yang nyid kyis nyid la mchod debya/'di man chad ye shes kyi lha rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi chen por thim nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings la mi snang bar byas nas/ ma hā su kha 6)la sbas te bzhugs pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po dang / rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ⑥mkhyen rab kyi dang ⑦so khyod la / da nged kyi chos 'di bsdus ①te bshad do/ /'jam dpal rdo rje chos 'di lta ste/ e ma hoḥ6)gsang ba las byung ba'i/ /ma rig mun sel sgron ma'i kyimachog /dpa' bo khyod la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nan tan gyis ni brtson 'grus byos / /zhes pa dang / 'jam dpal bdud rtsi 'di'i chos kyi don ni/ dper na me dang 'dra ste/ chung 7ste rdul tsam nas che ste srid pa'i ri bo yang sreg go/ /de bzhin du bdud rtsi 'di ni dper na nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ nyi ma'i 'od zer chen po ni 'dzam bu gling du thog ma nyid du ri'i rgyal po chen po brgyad la snang bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu kho 3nyer khor yug tu snang bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu ri bo che rnams la snang bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu ri nag po rnams la snang bar byed do/ /de'i 'og tu gangs ri mthon yi po rnams la snang bar byed do/ /de'i 103—628

'og tu 'dzam bu gling 'dir sa phyogs dma' ba rnams la snang bar byed do/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer chen po de la/ blang dor med de mi rtog mi sems so/ /rnam par yang mi rtog mi sems so/ /rdo rje chos dang 'jam dpal nyi ma'i 'od rnams ni / dbri ①bskol med do/ /de bzhin du sems can gyi rnam par shes pa la yang / de dang 'dra ste dbri bskol med do/ /phye ②ba dang bskyed pa dang /bskyungs ②pa yang med do/ /de bzhin du chos bdud rtsi 'di yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings su bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdud rtsi chen po 'di dudabu las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan zhes smos pa yin no/ /de bzhin du chos bdud rtsi chen po'i lung 'di yang ma skyes mi (snye'agag mi rtog pas/ mtshan rjodang mtshan ma med pa dang / mi gnas pa la rnam par khyab ste gnas so/ /de bzhin du chos bdud rtsi chen po 'di yang nyi ma'i 'od zer dang 'dra bar kun la khyab par gnas te / skal ldan rigs lngas 'byung ba lnga la khyab cing / 'byung ba lnga nyid rigs kyi yum lnga'i tshal chen po ste/ yum lnga dang yab lnga yang gdod nas dag ste/ nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du shar ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho ⑦rnams la (kyebashad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la khyab bo/ /de nas srid pa'i 'jig rten du mi mjed 6)kyi bdag po tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang klu rnams la khyab bo/ /de nas mi'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang rim pas nam mkha'i nyi ma bzhin khyab cing shar ba ste/ thugs rje'i bdud rtsi 'di yang srid pa gsum du nyi ma bzhin du shar bar bya ste/ 'jam dpal stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing phra rab snyed la bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lus phul bas ni/ bdud rtsi chen po 'di 103—629

lus la bcangs pa bsod nams che'o/ /'jam dpal dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba bas ni/ bdud rtsi 'di lus kyi mgul du brtags ①pa 'bum gyi char yang mi pod do/ /'jam dpal bskal pa gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams la spyi bos bkur gzhing phyag bya ba'i don ni/ bdud rtsi chen po 'di spyi bo la bkur (geba'i yon tan ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkur ba yin no/ /'jam dpal bskal pa stong gi bar du sems can gyi don bya ba bas ni/ bdud rtsi chen po 'dis lan cig (nyegis 'gro ba'i don byas pas/dmyal khams brgyad kyi 'jig rten yang thar pa'i lam du 'dren pa yin no zhes gsungs pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yitshigs su bcad de rtsibaka' stsal pa/ bdud rtsi chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ /kha dog dbyibs dang mtshan ma med / /'gog pa med cing dbye ba'ang med/ /rtsa ba med cing rten ⑧pa'ang med / /bdud rtsi che la brjod pa 'ang med/ /nyon mongs dug dang bdud bzhi bcom / /dri med dag pa'i byang chub sems/ /nges don de la 'dud par yonyebyos / /de nas bcom ldan 'das dang dam pa'i chos bdud 7rtsi'i lung 'di la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis slar la lan gsum du bstod pa/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid sangs rgyas te/ mtshan nyid med pas nam mkha' 'dra'o/ /bya ba med pas grol ba ste/ /bdud rtsi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu zla bzhin du dri bral bas/ /thams cad rtog pa yongs su spangs/ /bdag tu 'dzin med rnam par dag /bdud rtsi rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam / /bdud dang ngan song gsum las thar/ /len pa med cing gtong ba'ang med/ /dri med dag pa'i byang chub sems/ /bdud rtsi mchog la phyag 103—630

'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed ①pa'i rgyu/ /khams gsum sems can 'dren pa'i dpal/ /'gro ba drug gi sgrib sbyong ba②/ /bdud rtsi rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol nas/ phyi nang gi snod bcud ril sman ra sa ya na sridang / bdud rtsir gnas so zhes lung dang man ngag dag ①tu bsdus te bka' stsal pa'o// //bdud rtsi chen po mchog gi lung / lung gi rgyal po chen po rtog pa'i mchog las 'khor lo bskor bo'i nang nas lung gi bam po buchen po brgyad pa'i 'grel ⑥ba chen po'i don/ bam po chen po brgyad pa rdzogs stog// //spyir bdud rtsi 'bum sde las myur (bshas tsam cig khyabi ma la mi tras bshad cing glu/ lots+tsha ⑩ba dz+nyā na ku ⑩ma ras bsgyur spre)ba'o/ /rdo rje yang dbang tigater gyi lags ⑫ca(gas ༄stedhi// //༄༅gi /rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba'i ngang / /nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi sgo ru bsgom ⑩par bya/ /snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ / gsad cing gnan ⑩pa ma yin te/ /phung po rdo rje gtams tunyebyas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li tī tu)la ya/ sarba baspyon ( )bo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gzhon nu rig 0'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig /srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes skul/ /ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi dbyig tu bdag gyur cig /thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin (gyelas rdzogs mdzad nas/ /dbang 103—631

dang byin brlabs ①'dir gsol cig /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ kā char rgyu/ gardzo gardzo ⑧hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po hūm̐ kā byar dang / yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma/ sprul pa'i phra dumen ma phag gi mgo can dang / smigs 0bu'i mgo can no/ /o badz+ra gro dha bi dza ya hūṃ/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba dang / yum rdo rje rnam snyems ma/ sprul pa'i phra ⑦min ma stag 2gi mgo can dang / bya rgod kyi mgo can no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa 0rtsu/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po dang / yum rdo rje sder mo/ sprul pa'i phra 0men ma g.yag gi mgo can dang / bya rog gi mgo can no/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha ya mān+ta 4)ka hūṃ/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po dang / yum 8dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ sprul pa'i phra 8men ma sha ba'i mgo can dang / 'ug pa'i mgo can no / /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ/ brnya brnya yirgyu phaṭa/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon po dang / yum rdo rje gtun khung ma/ sprul pa'i phra 8men ma gzig gi mgo can dang / khu'i tsomago can no0/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha ha ya spyi tsob rtsu/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa67/ khro bo chen po rta mgrin dang / yum rdo rje gtum mo/sprul pa'i phra 5)men ma byi la'i mgo can dang / pu ( 7shud kyi mgo can no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi (steta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po dpal ldan gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / yum rdo rje mda' snyems ma/ sprul pa'i phra (stemen ma spyang ki'i ( stemago can dang / khra'i mgo can no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ⑥ta kuṇ+ḍa po lhali hūm̐/ tshirnya tshirnya hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / yum rdo rje rlung 'byin ma/ sprul pa'i phra ( )men ma seng ge'i mgo can dang / pha wang gi mgo can no/ /oṃ badz+ra gro dha tre+e lo kya bi dza ya sa)rtsu/ birnya birnya 9 )rtsu phaṭa/ khro 103—632

rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzangs rtsa ①/ byang shar gyi mtshams ②byang chub kyi shing drung na/ rin po che'i khang pa bdun brtsegs kyikyi gzhal yas kyi khang na/ rin po che'i khri stengs ④na/ gser dngul bai ḍūr+ya'i ⑤dbu rgyan dang mgur chus brgyan te/ lus 'gying bag tu bzhugs so/ /lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos kyang longs spyod dang / glu 6)dang dbyangs dang / rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod pa byed do/ /brgya byin nyon cig /de nas yul laṅka pu ri ru srin gapo'i grong khyer bdun 'bum yod pa la/ lha rnams kyis skyon phab (kyeste/ srin po da sha spyi 6)ba dang / de'i sring mo rna la rtse gnyis lus so/ /de nas srin po da sha spyi ⑩bas / lha dang mi 'dul 'dod pa'i don ched du/ sring mo lha ma hā de ba la btsun mor phul lo/ /de nas lha dbang phyug ma hā (stede ba dang / sring mo rna la rtse gnyis tshogs pa las/ phas ni khye 'ur smon lam btab/ mas ni bu mor smon lam btab/ ma'i smon lam mthu btsan ⑩pas/ ya mtshan can gyi bu mo gcig 'o)byung / pha khros pas thal khung du bor ro/ /mas slar blangs nas lus kyi drod la btsas nas/ ā yu bh+rūṃ ⑩zhes tshe drangs gsos 8te/ phas ming btags pa sbas pa'i thal mdog mar ming btags7/ mas ming mi pham khro gnyer ro langs mar ming btags/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes dmod btsugs tshinas ming btags pa/ dus thams cad du nag mo re ma ti zhes bya bar grags par gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i 9/)nus mthu dang ldan par gyur cig ces ming du btags pa'i tshe/ bar snang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad po yongs kyis kyang de ltar gyur cig ces bzlas so/ /de nas skye ba thams cad du nag mo re ma ti zhes bya bar grags so/ /lha mo dung skyong mas ming 103—648

btags pa ni/ srin mo dmar 'dab phur pa'i lha gser can zhes bya bar ming btags so/ /dus der srin po da sha spyi 6)ba des/ nga ni lceb po 0lceb bo'i sgras 'jig rten du grags so/ /sring mo dang rna dul rtse gnyis kyis ming po ma lceb par ci 'dod pa nga la smros shig ces gsol to/ /da sha spyi dubs gsol pa/nga ni lha mo dung skyong 'dod do zhes gsol to/ /sring mos smras pa/ nga'i bu dumo phur pa'i lha 'di ni khyilha mo dung skyong gi khol mo byed du gsol ⑦te/ de nas gdod bslu'o zhes smras so/ /de nas rna la rtse yis nibu mo khrid nas dkar mo dung skyong gi g.yog du phul lo/ /de nas re ma tis dkar mo dung skyong la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye che zhe chen mo rigs kyi yum/ /bdag nyid chen mo ga gar ma / /dbu bzang 6)rin chen thor tshugs kyil/ /be+e ḍūr 0sngon mo 'od lam lam /zhal bzang 8pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nyi zla phrugs gcig rgyan tsobakod de/ /tshems bzang tsodung la ljags bzang 8me/ /khyod 'dra 'jig rten khams na medatshul/ /bdag ni khyod kyi gtan 'bangs bgyi/ /khyod kyis bdag la thugs ⑩ brtser dgongs/ /bdag kyang glo ba nye bar bgyi/ /ces (nyegasol to/ /de nas lha mo'i g.yog mo byas nas glo ba nye bar byas te lha mo'i yid la ci 'dod pa dgos pa 4)byas so/ /de nas lha mo yang khol ( kye mo de la dgyes nas gces par byed de/de'i tshe de'i dus na yul lang ka 0pu ri ru()/ spre'u 'bal le dang mgrin bzangs (nye'athabs pa la lha thams cad ltad mo la 'gro bas/ lha mo u mas so )bu mo dung skyong ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de (nyering khyod kyi gan du su 'ongs pas khyod bslu ste 'ong bas/ de la ma lta cig khrigaces bstan tsam na/ khol mos skabs der da sha spyi ( )ba la sbran no/ /der srin po da sha spyi (stebs/ srin gyi bong bu ( 6dmar gwa ru bye103—649

la zhon nas/ lha mo'i pho brang sgor phyin te hu)srin po kho bdag ni mi'i cha byad la shin tu gzugs bzang la mdzes pa cig ②tu sprul/ bong bu ni ri dgas gwa ③dor smug po cig ④cu sprul te⑤/ lha mo dung skyong ma'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ rol mo'i 4)sil snyan dang glu ⑦dbyangs sna tshogs byas pas bslus so/ /lha mo rol mo la dga' bas 'dzum cig lashor ro/ /de nas srin pos glags rnyed de/ lcags kyi lham sgrog sngon po bkrol nas bzung ste po)glu 'di skad blangs sotshu/ /kye yongs 'du shing gi gnas mchog na/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang nas/ /bde ldan 'phrul gyi lding khang na/ /'gying bag tshul du gar mdzad pa/ /dbang phyug sras mo ma lags sam/ /dga' byed dung skyong ma lags sam/ /lha mo mang po'i tshogs dang rol/ / dbu yi 9/nyasnyan cha gdub 'khor lha ni/ /rin chen mdzes pas kun nas sprasaXge/ /spyan ni ut+pal 'dab ma 'dra/ /shangs ni bil ba'i 'bras bu 'dra/ /zhal nas ut+pal ngad kyang bro/ /sku ni 'khril ldem gzhon tshul 'dra/ /gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan mchog /nu 'bur stod smad phyed 8pas 'gying / /khyod 'dra'i sku ni gzhan na dkon/ / lha yi 7longs spyod mdzes yipas mi brel yang / /zhabs kyi chas su lcags sgrog nye 'di 'bul zhes/ /ci mdzad ci sdug ci yang gsung ba snyan/ /khams gsum dag na khyod 'dra shin tu dkon / /sems can kun gyis lta 12bas mi ngoms khyod/ /bdag gis dbul 'di bzhes par gnang bar mdzod/ /ces phul ba la/ lha mos lcags sgrog blangs so/ /de nas rang gi rkang pa g.yas pa la dkris te rgyan byas so/ /de nas khol mo des/ jo mo dung skyong ma la zhus pa/ kye jo mo bde mchog dung skyong ma / bdag zhu ba gcig /rtamachis na gnang ngam byas pa la/ jo mo na re khyod glo 103—650

ba nye bas ci zhus pa gnang ngo zer ro/ /de nas lha ni ngag bden pa'i sdom pa yod pas/ ji skad smras pa ①ltar byed pa yin no/ /de nas khol mos gsol pa/kye bdag gi yun ②gyi rjer gyur dung skyong ma/ /khyod 'dra 'jig rten gzhan na med / /'grogs pas zla med skar ma gcig gshar 'dra/ /deng 'dir mchis pas ༷lcags sgrog 'bul mkhan ⑤de/ /gtan gyi grogs zlar mdzad par zhu ba sti'abul / /bdag kyang rtag tu khyod kyi bran mo byed/ /zhes stizhus pa la/ lha mo des (nyesngar khas blangs pa des mi bya ba'i dbang ⑨med nas/ lha mo na re khyor bya'i mi de gang na 'dug /su yin byas pa la/ khol mos smras pa/ de ni bdag gi zhang 7po srin po da sha spyi yib yin/ yul laṅka pu ra na (nya'adug ces smras pa dang / de nas dung skyong ma dbang med du srin po'i chung mar song ngo / /de nas lha mo u mas tu bu mo dung skyong ma la dmod pa bor ba nga'i 8bu mo rab tu gces 8par byas te/ lha'i 7longs spyod mdzes pas mi brel yang / nga la gsangs la 6)srin po'i chung mar song / / phyin cad tu)bu mo khyod kyang srin dang 'grogs / /mi sha za yi (7mi lpags gyon par gyur/ /srog gcod byed cing mi yi thod khrag thogs/ /bong bu zhon la lha yi kha dog nyams/ /srin gyi kha dog nag la 'jigs par shog /de yi khol mo re ma ti khyod kyang / /nga yi bu mo bslus te srin la byin/ /khyod kyang mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gdong du gyur/ /tshe rabs kun du khyo dang ma phrad cig /ces dmod pa bcu gnyis pa bor ro/ /de nas bu mo la ma'i dmod pas bsdigs ( )nas lha'i kha dog dkar po nyams te mthing nag tu gyur / mi sha za sa mi khrag 'thung / mi lpags gyon bong bu zhon/ gcer bur bud nas 'dug go/ /bu ni srin po phru gu seng ge zla dang / me tog cod pan 103—651

dang ske/ gangs can dang / mche ba bdun yo)la sogs pa lnga brgya skyes tsam na/khyo srin po da sha spyi ②ba shi'o/ /de nas bu mo dung skyong ma yang yugs sa'i cha lugs byas te/ skra mdun skra lan bu gcig la niblas so/ /bran mo phur pa'i lha yang dmod pas bsdigs ④pas/ srin gyi phag rdzi byed tsam na⑤/ phag rdzi dun bu srin bya bas mo la dbang med du chags pa spyad do/ /de nas phur pa lha yang nal yibu sbrum mo/ /de nas dpon g.yog phyaganyis kyis srin po'i bong bu brkus ⑧pa zhon nas/ da sha spyi 6)ba'i ral gri sdig pa can brkus pa g.yas na thogs/srin tsopo'i nor bu rin po che brkus (7nas ne'u le'i rkyal bur sbas nas/ lag pa g.yon du thogs nas bros so/ /phyi nas srin po'i dmag gis bsad kyis dogs nas/ bong bu bskyod kyinas kha phyir bstan te/ phyi na srin po bya ra ⑫byed cing phyin no/ /tha mar ④dur khrod gcig snyitu phyin na skyes pa g.yul du bsad pa'i ro gcig ⑩dang phrad do/ /de nas khong gnyis sha de bsregs nas za tī'adod pa la gtsub shing med tsonas/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na rdo sol gyi ri la char bab nas rka/)me 'bar ba mthong nas rdo sol me blangs nas sha bsregs nas zos so/ /phyi na khyi dkar po gcig 'brang ba zho )yang bsad nas zos so/ /pags (7pa la rgyal mtshan byas so/ /de nas khol mo re ma ti la nal phrug skyes so/ /khong gnyis kyis snyonal phrug (nyagi sha yang zos so/ /de nas jo mos ( stebong bu la zhon khol mos kha khrid byas nas rgya mjo'i khar phyin nas/ gshin rje rlung gi 'khor lo can zhag bdun bsgoms pas/ rlung nag tshub ( nyam nag po gcig ⑩drung der grub po/ /de nas lha mo dpon g.yog gnyis kyis/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre mthu bo che bos nas smon lam btab pa/ nga yang tshe 'di 'phos ma thag ( natu gsang 103—652

sngags kyi grub pa thob nas rgyal ba'i zhal mthong ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug mar shog shig6) /nga'i bran mo ②phur pa'i lha 'di yang dus thams cad du nga'i 'bangs ka ma lar shog shigadu /nor du mi mgo la longs spyod par shog shig④ /zhon pa bong bu la byed la/ lag cha ral gri la byed par shog shig 0ces smras so/ /rgya ⑥mtsho bskor ༅zhing rlung tshub ⑧ma la bā ya be bā ya 0be zhes bos ⑩tsam na/ tshub ⑩ma byung bas dpon g.yog gnyis ka rgya mtsho'i nang du bskyur te btang ngo / /de nas lha mo dung skyong ma des mi 8sha zos pa'i mthu dang —/ rang gi smon lam gyi dbang gis/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du dur khrod chen po ro'i tshal zhes bya bar/ gshin rje'i lha mthu can gyi bu mor skyes te/ gnod sbyin ma chen 0mo la kha dog mthing nag la rab tu 'jigs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba mche ba zang tsoyag la ral pa ting za pang du 'dug pa cig 8tu gyur te/ gshin rje ma tsoru rtse dang sbyor ba byas pa la bu bdud 8khram nag po bya ba byung / bong bu yang dmar gwa (nyal g.yu'i rna ba can rlung gi gshog ⑩pa can/ mig mjug mar 0yod pa cig ⑩ tu byung nas nor skal byed do/ /de nas khol mo re ma ti ro langs ma 'di ni ⑤skye ba gang blangs zhe tson/ rgya mtsho'i nang du bud med (9lus po phyed skams (snyel chu srin gyi mgo can gcig tsoku skyes te/ ming yang klu mo gzhigs skams (nyechu srin mgo klu mo re ma ti zhes bya bar btags (nyanas/ zhag dgu bcu na tshe 'phos nas/skye ba blangs pa ni yul dri za'i grong ( )khyer gser sdings skyed mos tshal ( )zhes bya ba na / dug shing nag po 'gyur med kyi rtsa ba na bdud ri ti 'gong nyag dang /dran (nyapa dbang byed gnyis byi byas pa la zhag drug cu (nyartsa gcig na bu mo gcig du skyes te/ phas ni srid pa gsum gyi blo 'phrog mar btagasaskyi/ mas ming 103—653

btags pa ni ya mtshan 6)'phrul gyi gshog (snyepa can du btags/ bdud pho mo geganyis kyis rang gi bu mo la skra nyag re la gser dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i rtsichun 'phyang dang ske/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / nyi zla'i thod gdengs ⑤dang / thod pa'i mgur chu dang / sbrul gyi gdu bus brgyan yite/ byi byas pa'i nal phrug yin pas/bdud kyis rin po che sna lnga'i khang pa'i dbus su thod pa'i gzhal yas khang byas/thod pa'i nang du yang thod 'phrul gyi lding khang grubatso)/ de'i nang du khang pa bdun brtsegs (kyikyi bdun tshogs kyi nang du/ mi ro 'bum gyi khri stengs su 6)bu mo de sus ma mthong sus kyang ma tshor bar sbas te/ sgo smra bo lag rings yidang /nam gru khrab (7thogs kyis bcad do/ /bdud kyi dmag gi rgyal mo dang / gling bzhi'i rgyal mo dang / sa bdag gi rgyal mo dang / de rnams kyis khang pa de rab tu srung zhing 'khod do/ /brgya byin nyon cig /de'i tshe na lha mo dung skyong ma ni/sngon 3stegyi khol mo re 1gem miti ro langs ma bdud kyi bu mor skyes pa bkug nas khol 'dod pa las/ phyag na rdo rje nga'i gsang sngags bye ba phrag bcwa 8brgyad bzlas pas / gsang sngags de'i byin gyi brlabs yilas/ mkha' 'gro'i ting nge 'dzin grub pa mo7/ lag na pad+ma he ru ka thogs pa gcig (sterang byung bas/ ma bdud kyi yul dang pho brang kun byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe na/ bdud kyi rgyal po (6dang /blon po dang / 'khor rnams dran pa med par myos par gyur to/ /bdud kyi bu mo re 3 ma ti des sngon gyi jo mo lha mo dung skyong ma dran pas/ yid phyogs te (nyadung skyong ma'i spyan sngar 'gro 'dod pa'i bsam pa drag po byung nas/ bdud ri ti 'gong ( 2nyag gi mtshon bdud kyi khram bam nag po de ste/ bu mo re ma tis brkus nas / lag pa g.yas su thogs/ ma'i tshon gyi gru r+ṣa )gu sngon dmar de brkus nas 103—654

lag pa g.yon na thogs nas/ nam phar phyed tshur phyed na jo mo dung skyong ma'i gan du bros te phyin nas/ lus gcer bur 'dug pa la/ khyim bdag rab sbyin gsal gyi ba ༅rdzi mo dmangs rigs mo bya ha mu zhes bya ba de re lde nag po gyon ②nas 'dug pa dang phrad/ mos dmangs rigs mo bsad nas sha zos/ pags ①pa rked la dkris④/ de'i gos re lde bshus nas bdud mo nyid gyon nas phyin tsam na/ lam khar srin mo purna shi ⑤ba'i gsur khrag /nad kyi rdzing bu cig duyod pa'i khar phyin pa las/ bdud mo re ma tis skom nas thog cig 'thungs tsam na/ kha rlangs las nad du song bas/ mo'i kha rlangs gar phog pas rims nad byung ngo / /der mo rang yang ngo tsha skyes nas/ sngar gyi dmangs rigs mo bsad pa'i rlud ⑦bu rked las bgrol te/ nang nad kyi rdzing bus bkang nas/kha sbrul gyis bcings te/ mchan (shekhung du sbas nas/ sems can la gdug par bya bar bsams te/ phyin tsam na/ btsan kyi)skya rdo rje zla ba dang phrad pa na re ⑩bdud mo chen mo chags pa spyad dgos/ rngan pa yang sbyin zer nas/ mo bzung nas chags pa spyad pa'i khu ba thigs pa gcig 'dzam bu'i (nyegling du bo ba ni jong ji tsodakar por song / der btsan skya rdo rje zla ba'i lag na shod ()rde'u dkar nag gang la tsobor ba phung bar byed pa bdun yod pa la/ mo la 8byi ngon du byin pa de blangs te/ lag pa g.yon du bzung nas/ grong khyer sbrang tsoldan zhes bya bar phyin tsam na/ rgyal po seng ge rtsal la bsod snyoms byas te/ sbrang rtsi lhung bzed gang phul nas/ sbrang rtsi lag tu len khar yiphyag tshang bas hub byas nas mo la sbyin(nya/ mos blangs tsam na/ bar snang gi lha rnams kyis bdud mo / rgyal po'i khol mo'i ()lhag ma dang kha 'phro 'thung ngam/ che ba nyams so zhes 103—655

zer tsam na/ bdud mo ①re ma ti khros pas yid 'khrugs te/ rgyal rigs la ②der rims nad btang ngo / /der rgyal po'i dkor zangs kyi dra ba dgu phul nas rims bcad do/ /de nas nag mo re ma ti des/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du dur khrod chen po ②ro'i tshal du sngon gyi jo mo dung skyong ma'i spyan sngar phyin to/ /de nas dpon g.yog gnyis 'grogs nas/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can zad cing stongs par byed pa'i dus de tsam na/ jo mo dung skyong ma'i zhon pa srin gyi bong bu ④dmar gwa ⑤dang /⑥ srin mo rna la dun rtse'i rgod ma zangs kyi so can gnyis chags pa spyad pa las/ dre'u ⑦mo 2sngon mo rlung gi gshog pa can gcig po)byung ba de / rgyu ma'i mthur ⑩la zangs kyi sga yonyebastad nas/ lha mo dung skyong mas 'khol mo re ma ti la zhon par byin/ der jo mo ni bong bu dmar gwa la zhon/ khol mos dre'u sngon mo la 7zhon/ rje mos mi pags yigon thod pa dang ral gri lag na thogs / khol mos re lde nag po gyon/ lag na khram bam dang / shod 8de'u thogs / de nas shin tu mthu rtsal 0che ste skye ba rnam bzhi'i sems can yo zad cing stongs pa tsam du zos so/ /'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dkar mo'i tshogs dang / sngon mo dang dmar mo dang / ser mo'i tshogs dang / lha mo dang —/ bdud mo dang / srin mo dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po yang lha mo rje khol gyi 'bangs bgyi zer zhing bran du 'ongs so/ /brgya byin nyon cig ⑩dus de tsam na lha mo dpon g.yog gnyis/ bud med kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa nyid kyis/ rtag par 'dod pa'i 'khrig (nyapa spyad pa'i ched du khyo dgu dang sbyor ba byed de/ jo mo la khyo lnga khol mo la khyo bzhi yod de/ rje mo'i khyo lnga ni/gza' rā 46tu la/ srin po sgra ldan/ gshin rje mā so )ru rtse/ bdud char ka nag 103—656

po / klu kun+d+ra 6)la dang lnga/ khol mo'i khyo bzhi ni/ 'byung po dge ba dang /bgegs bī na ②ya ka chadang / gnod sbyin yaklu ka pa ④la dang / rlung bā ya dube dang bzhi'o/ /de ltar dpon g.yog gnyis kyi khyo dgu ni/ nyin par ni ⑥mchan khung g.yon du bskungs shing sbed la/ mtshan mo dur khrod du bskung zhing ⑦sbyor ba byed do/ /brgya byin ③nyon cig de nas lha'i bu mo la sngon gyi las 'phros 'brel zhing dge ba spyod ⑨pa'i shugs kyis/ byang chub kyi shing drung na/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ lha mo des byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ⑩de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas rang gi snying po 'di phul lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ ru ru be ti (nyesta ba do si/ ru ru ro ru be ⑩ste sta ba do si/ tsa pa la a shugle hūṃ 'abh+yo dzaḥ8/ zhes phul lo/ /khol mos rang gi snying po phul ba/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ 8ru ru be ro ru hūm̐ tista to si/ raglo yitsit+ta ⑩kha ragla dun bh+yo/ ma ma tragyuka tsokha mun+t+ra ba tra rak+ta tsit+ta ()kha ragla rdu hūm̐ bh+yo/ ru lu sa ma ya phra ma ma hāste 0phra bh+yo zhes phul lo/ /de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas lha mo dpon g.yog gnyis kyis a su ra'i brag phug tu phyin pa las bram ze mchog sred sgrub ⑥pa byed pa ()dang phrad do/ /lha mos khyod 'di na ci byed (nyebyas pa la(nye/ bram ze mchog sred kyis smras pa/ sngon khams 'di nyid na dge slong brtan ⑤pa'i sde dang / dge slong ma dar ri sde gnyis khrims nyams te rgyal po'i chad pas bsad do/ /de skye ba 'phos pa ni/ bdud lo nga 'ge'u zhunyeri dang /ro sha kha 'dar gnyis su gyur te/ yul mi ci yod zad par zos nas/ de nas nga la za res bab pas/ nga ni ( chubadud 'dul ba'i phyir/ yum e ka dza ṭi 'i ral gcig ma/ bsgrub 0po zhes zer ro/ /dung skyong sum̐ )ma na re 'o na nged dpon 103—657

g.yog kyang bsgrub ①par bya na/ yon tan de lta bu yod dam byas pa ②na/ bram ze na re khyed gnyis dngos grub ci 'dod pa yin/ lha mo na re nged gnyis 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang mo cher gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung niba'i grub pa 'dod byas pa la/ 'o na grub par bya'o zhes zer nas/ bram ze dang lha mo dpon g.yog bsgrub ④pa byas pas yum e ka dza ṭi ①zhal mthong nas grub pa thob bo/ /yum e ka dza ṭis⑥/ lha mo dung skyong ma'i ming ni/ dpal lha mo nag mo ma hā kā (chuli zhes btags so/ /khol mo'i ming ni yaklu chare ma ti zhes po)bya bar btags so/ /'dod khams 'dul ba'i dbang mo cher dbang bskur ro/ /ma hā kā ⑩lis kyang chos bskyang (7zhing bstan pa bsrung 3 bar khas blangs so/ /rang gi snying po 'di phul lo/ /oṃ ru ru be ⑩ti sta ba do siskyo/ ru ru ro ru be tista snyib do si/ tsa pa la a shug me bh+yo dzaḥtsore ma tis kyang / oṃ ru ru ro ru be 7tista ba do si/ rag mo tsit+ta kha rag ma 8rgyu bh+yo/ ma ma trag rag kha mun tra yib tra trag rag/ tsit+ta sa )kha rag me 0re ma ti sa ma ya phra ma ya phra ma ma hā te phra (nyedun (stebh+yo / / dzaḥdzaḥ( rizu lu bh+yo zhes phul lo/ /bdud lam̐ nga 'ge'u ( nyeri dang ro sha kha 'dar phubasgral lo/ /de nas sa'i lha mo brtan ()mas kyang nam gru mched brgyad kyang 'bangs su phul lo/ /srin yul du dmag drangs pas/ srin po yag ko sum̐ shere bsgral lo/ /brgya byin nyon cig /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis / dpal rta mgrin 6)du sprul pa'i bsgrub pu )pa byas te/ rta mgrin gyi (1zhal mthong ra zhing gsang ba'i gzungs ma byas te/ rje mo'i ming dpal lha mo nag mor btags so/ /khol mo'i ming (nyani rdo rje glog ma (nye srin du ming btags so/ /des phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /las kyi lhar byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i 103—658

tshe na dpal lha mo nag mos/ dpal rta mgrin hu)la snying po mdongs gsol ②du phul lo/ /bstan pa bsrung bar ①khas blangs so/ /de nas sngon 0gyi u ma de ba dudang rna la rtse gnyis kyang / sngon gyi bu mo gnyis la srin lag rtse la nu zho blugs ①pas bros nas/ dred mo'i ral pas ⑦g.yab mos 'bod deni/ bu mo gnyis ma'i drung du phyin tsam na/ dbang bskur zhing dam bsgrags/ /bstan pa bsrung ⑨bar dbang byin to/ /'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i rgyal pos kyang rang gi rtsa dang khrag dang khu ba'i mchod pa byas nas/ lha dang mi'i rgyal srid phul nas/ rma bya rin po che'i gshog 7pa can spyi bo na nor bu rin po che yod pa/ jo mo la nor skal ⑫du byin no/ /bya de mo nag mo spyi bo na nor bu rin po che yod pa cig 'khol mo la nor skal du byin nas/ lha mo rje khol gnyis 'khor los sgyur 0ba'i rgyal pos byin pa'i rma bya dang / de mo nag mo gnyis gtan gyi nor skal byed cing chags/de nas dpal lha mo ni gsang snyiba'i gnas dur khrod ro khang nag po'i dbus mā ru rtse'i 7sgo 'gram du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i he ru ku'i dngos grub 8sgrub 8pa'i tshe/dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dngos grub grub ste/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes lha mo dpon g.yog la spyi bo yigatsug tu dpal rta mgrin gsang 4 )ba'i dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum la khrag 'thung he ru ga'i dbang bskur khwa/ thugs kyi dpal be'u dunarigs lnga (nyasangs rgyas kyi dbang bskurasaste/ sku stod kyi rgyan du phra ( gemen ma bcu drug gi dbang bskur/ ljags kyi dkar dmar la lcags kyu gsang 4nyaba'i dbang bskur ro/ /gnad mdo chen drug tu tshom bu gsang ( rteba'i dbang bskur ro/ /gsang ba pad+ma la thig le ye shes shar ba'i dbang bskur/ rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu ( nyertsa bzhi 'khor du dbang bskur/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ni sprul pa dang yang 103—659

sprul du dbang bskur①/ de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos sol/ /de nas dpal phyag na rdo rjes jo mo'i ming ni dpal ma hā kā duli zhes btags so/ /khol mo'i ming ni gnod sbyin shan pa nag mo re ①ma ④ti zhes btags so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar 6)gnyer gtad do/ /de nas dpal phyag na rdo rje nyid la/ dpal lha 0mos rang gi snying po phul te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus rtag tu bsrung bar tshukhas blangs so/ /de nas dpal lha mo de mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur to/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug mar gyur pa'i tshe/ lha tshangs pas nyi ma'i rgyan phul/ khyab 'jug gis ⑧za ba'i rgyan phul/ rnam thos sras kyis seng ge'i rna cha phul/ nam mkha'i lha bran rnams kyis gser gyi 6)dril bu'i rgyan phul/ srin po dang sha za rnams kyis thod phreng dang khrag dang zhag gi thig le phul lo/ /klu yidaga' bos sbrul gyi gdengs ka phul/ lha mo de srid pa gsum na 'gran pa'i zla med par gyur to/ /de nas brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po/ /'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma 'di/ dang por (stelha'i bu mor yonyegyur pa dang /bar du srin po'i chung mar gyur pa dang / da ltar 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug mar gyur pa 'di/ sngon gyi rkyen ci las grub pa yinyalags zhes gsol pa dang /gsang ba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ brgya byin nyon cig /da ltar lha mo nag mo 'di sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi skyobastan pa la lha mo 'od zer can du gyur te dge ba bcu sha stag spyad do/ /de nas sangs rgyas gser thub kyi bstan pa la lha mo dpa' brtan mim zhes bya bar gyur te zhe snang rang 7kha mar spyad do/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od sung gi bstan pa la lha mo mañju (1zhes bya bar gyur te/ dus 103—660

de tsam na shākya thub pa ni dge slong dbang phyug dpa' bo zhes bya bar grags so/ /dge slong de la lha mo mañjus ①mchod gnas byas shing smon lam gcig tu btab po//brgya byin nyon cig② /de da lta na ni lha mo 'di la sangs rgyas gsum gyi ring ②gi rnam par smin ④pa shākya thub pa'i bstan ⑤pa la dus gcig tu smin no/ /lha mo 'di dang por ma hā de ba'i bu mor skyes pa ni/ dang por dge ba spyad ⑥pa'i mthu'ol/ /bar du srin po'i chung mar gyur nas rang lceb pa ni zhe sdang spyad pa'o/ /tha mar da ltar 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug mar gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur nas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa srung ⑦ba ni sngon shākya thub pa la sdig bshags ⑧byas kyi smon lam btab bo/ /khol mo re ma ti sngags kyi bsod nams las grub pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i ①rgyud las gleng gzhi'i kyile'u ste dang po'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ gsang ba'i bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye bcom ldan 0mgon po gsang ba'i bdag /ma 'ongs phyi ma'i sems can rnams/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor rab bsgrub ()pa'i//slob dpon slob ma'i mtshan ma'i rgyud/ /gang yin bdag gis nyan par 'tshal/ /zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ gsang tu ba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /thun mong ma yin kun gyis tsobya ba min/ /de yang slob dpon mtshan nyid bshad/ /slob dpon chos la rab 'dud pa/ /tshad med bzhir ldan snying rje can/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang thob nas/ /dam tshig srog bzhin 'dzin byed cing / /bden pa gnyis rtogs lta ba can/ /sngags 103—661

dang phyag rgya mi spong zhing / /rtag tu phyag rgya che la gnas/ /sems can don byed man ngag ldan/ /de ni slob dpon mtshan nyid de6)/ /slob ma dul la dad pa can/ /bla ma'i zhabs la rab 'dud cing / /dad dang gtong laphod snying rje can / /'dul dang sdom ①pa dam tshig 'dzin/ /lha dang slob dpon rtag tu bcang ④/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i snod ldan la/ /slob ⑤mar bya ba nga yis bshad / /dpal mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid 4)bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpa' bo gache/ /dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bskyang slad (87du/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /lta ba dam pa bdag nyan 'tshal / /zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ bdag dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /gdod nas ma skyes gzung 'dzin yul dang bral/ /nga dang bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa bcom/ /don dam kun rdzob skye ba med pa'i gzhi/ /gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med cing / /stong nyid chos sku nam mkha' ye shes lnga/ /sprul pa'i phyag rgya lha dang lha mo'i mtshan mar snang / /mkha' la 'ja' 'dra rang bzhin ga la yod/ /snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro don byed pa na/ /mdor na sangs rgyas sprul pa yin pa ste/ /khol mo byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'o/ /mtshan ma'i srin mo bdud mor blta mi bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las lta ba bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //103—662

de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gsang ba'i bdag po ye nas thugs rje can/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 6)dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir / /dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi rgyud bshad 'tshal/ /zhes zhus pa'i tshe/phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ brgya byin la sogs ②'khor rnams rab tu nyon②//dkyil 'khor rnam ④gsum mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ni/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor byang shar ri rab rtse/ /ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor sems kyi yul/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor gnas bzhi'i (gyes la bya/ /tshon stirtsi mi rus sdong ros rams dang skyegs0/ /mthing nag gru bzhi'i dbus ni e gru gsum/ /dbas sa gtso bo phyag na rdo rje ste/ /de yi g.yas sa lha mo nag mo ste/ /g.yon du riri me rigaci dmi rgyum mo'i ting 'dzin grube ⑧pa mo/ /gtso bo'i mdun 5)du khol mo re ma ti/ / de yi ( )phyi rim ()srid pa'i ma mo dang / /stag spyang bya rgod seng ()ge khyung gis tho)bskor / /phyi rim cithod phreng me ri 7keng rus bri/ /tsa ka li 'am yig 'bru phyag mtshan bri/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// // de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye 'jigs 'byed che mchog 'gro kun 'dul ba'i gtso/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag mo dam pa yi7/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rdzas rnams gang lags pa'i(she / /gsang ba'i bdag po bdag la bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa dang /phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub 'dod pa'i mis/ /rdzas rnams med na dngos grub mi thob ste/ /rmongs pas sa bon gtsub shing 103—663

gtsub stan 6)'dra/ /kun ka tshang na dngos grub mtshan ma ster/ /mkha' 'gro ma la rdzas ni rnam pa bdun/ /bod ②pa'i rdzas dang ma mo bsten rdzas dang / /mchod pa'i rdzas dang dam tshig bsre ba'i rdzas/ /bskul ba'i rdzas dang mtshan ma dbab pa'i rdzas/ /tha mar gnad ②la 'bebs shing bzlog pa'i rdzas/ /bdun po 'di tshang grub pa'i mtshan ma 'byung / /gtso bo phyag na rdo rje'i dam rdzas ni/ /go ro tsa na gtso bo bod ④pa'i rdzas/ /gtso bo'i rten ni seng ldeng mi rus phur/ /gsal ba lnga dang bdud rtsis gtso (gyebo mchod/ /dam tshig bcu yis ⑥rdo rje sa ni mchod / /gu gul (chunag po yungs nag til gyis bsku/ /spos dang lce pog mi tshil nimatshan ma 'bebs/ /gtso bo gnad la 'bebs pa a mṛ 6)ta/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag 7mo'i bod 0rdzas ni/ /g.yab dar dang ni hasta mi tshil dang / /cong zhun 8sgos lngas bsregs la bod()/ /lha mo'i rten ni bu mo gtsang ma dang / /rgya mtshor shi ba'i bud med thod pa gnyis/ /mkhar du brtsigs yil dkyil 'khor dbus su kha sprad la/ /mi gsod 8mtshon gyi ral gri sor brgyad pa/ /yu ba ma bris dkyil 'khor dbus su gzugs/ /rma bya seng ge g.yang gzhi tsogo zung nag po'o⑩ / /rje mo lha mo nag mo'i dam rdzas ni/ /dge slong sha dang mi ro seng ge'i snying —/ /gri 6)rgod sha dang dbang po rnam pa lnga/ /ru tra nag po'i snying dang bdud rtsi lnga/ /sman ma'i khrag dang sha khrag sna tshogs dang / /phye ma lnga yis gtong 6)bas gur gum ( 7brdzi/ /pad+ma'i rak+tas byugs la rgyun gtor bya/ /lha mo nag mo 'di dang dam tshig bsre ba'i rdzas/ /ru hi rdo rje pad+ma mi de sngags/ /bskul rdzas mi yi tshil dang gu gul bsreg /mtshan ma 'bebs pa bu mo gtsang ma'o/ /gnad la 'bebs shing bzlog pa yugs sa'i rkang / /khol mo re ḍo nyam ti yi bod ()rdzas 103wa 664

ni / /dred mo'i ral pas g.yab cing srin lag bstan/ /gu gul dang ni mi tshil gsur gyis bod①/ /re ma ti yi rten du lug nag gam/ /de mo nag mo dri ②mo'i ②thod pa'o④/ /khol mo re ma rjo ti yi dumachod rdzas ni/ /bum pa gang ba'i khrag dang a mṛ ⑦ta/ /nal bu'i sha dang mi sha chang phud do/ /dam tshig bsre nizhing rtag tu mchod pa'i rdzas/ /ru hi rdo rje pad+ma dag gis shisal/ /bskul rdzas gu gul nag dang cong 0zi'o/ /mtshan ma 'bebs pa bu mo gtsang ma'o/ /gnad la 'bebs shing bzlog rdzas dre'u yi rkang / /'di rnams gtsang zhing ma nyams tshogs 'gyur yin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yi 8tshogs rnams ni/ / bung bas 0u dum bā ra tsomathong ba ltar/ /dga' ba skyes nas mi la dngos grub byaster/ /de bas nan tan bskyed la brtson par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las dpon g.yog gi dam rdzas bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'dul ba'i gtso/ /bsgrub ⑩pa'i rten gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku/ / thang ka 'dri ba'i ⑩nan tan 'dri bar tso'atshal/ /zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ gsang ba'i bdag pos bka' stsal pa/ mkha' 'gro'i rten gyi sku gzugs 4)ni/ /mis ( )ma 'phrigs par dur khrod 'gro/ /dang po 0phyag na rdo rje dang / lha mo'i bsnyen dupa 'bum 'bum bzlas(nye/ /de la sbyin sreg gtor ma 'bulaluste/ /ri mo mkhan la dbang bskur (gero/ /dam tshig rab tu sbyin par bya / /de nas bud med zhabs ma dang ( 9/ /ro dkris dag gi ras dag ni/ /ro bsregs mgal ( spreba'i shing gis kyang / /bri ( nyaba'i tshon rtsi rnam pa lnga/ /dpa' bo 103—665

dang ni mchod sbyin no/ /g.yon na ghun+dhe ①dang ni bgrang phreng rab tu 'dzin/ /de yi snying gar ②phyag na rdo rje dang / /lha mo nyid dang khol mo re ①ma ti/ /gsal bar bskyed ④la sbyin sreg dbul bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dugatso bo phyag na rdo rje mchod/ /gsum pas lha mo nag mo de la dbulayi/ /de bzhin tha mas re ⑦ma ti la mchod/ /so so'i (shesnying po bzlas 6)shing dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ⑩sbyi/ ma hā de bi kā tunyeli hūṃ/ yak+ta re ma ti rtsu/ asna ye ha bya ka 'bya/ ma hā ti ba ti ba ti bya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan bka ()ni kha raṃ khā hi 8swā hā/ de nas thal ba dur khrod du bskyal/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pas 8rab bshad bya / /dngos la mkha' ⑩'gro gsal lam ting 'dzin la/ /gsang (nyeb ye shes hūm̐ dang oṃ tsoganyis la/ /rdo rje pad+mas (perab tu dkrugs gu nas kyang / /zla bas mkha' 'gro rab tu mnyes 'gyur 67te/ /thugs kyi thig les ( gyebadag gi gzi byin bskyed / /thugs kyi dngos grub dam pa'i man ngag go/ /ma hā kā li sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta( ste/ ma hā pu dza gu h+ya s+t+waṃ spro ba'o(ste/ /ma hā kā li sa ma ya/ ma hā rak+ta gu h+ya s+t+waṃ/ ā 82be sha a/ bsdu ba'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las mchod pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin des/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ye shes lngar 9 9ldan dpa' brtan thugs rje can/ /dpal ldan mi ( zhebaskyod rdo rje sems dpa' khyod/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma yi ( stedangos grub ni/ /srog dang 'dra ba'i dam tshig bdag nyan 'tshal/ /zhes gsol pa dang / dpal phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ mkha' 'gro ma yi 9 7dam tshig ni/ /gsang gu ba'i 103—674

phyag rgya 'da' dka' ba/ /mi shigs rgyal pos dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje mtshan ma 'joms pa'i rgyu/ /dam tshig de nyid rab bshad bya/ /'das na rdo rje dmyal ba'o / /ma 'das dngos lagrub dam pa'i rgyu/ /gtso bo phyag na rdo rje dang / /lha mo nag mo dpon g.yog la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /gtso bo'i sku yi ⑧dam tshig ni/ /sku yi phyag rgya mi spong zhing / /lha dang slob dpon mnyes par bya/ /rdo rje spun la gdung ba bskyed/ /gtso bo'i gsung gi dam tshig ni/ /bzlas brjod snying ③po rgyun mi gcod/ /mi yengs rdzun spangs gsang sngags 'dzin/ /gtso bo'i thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /gsang ba gzhan la mi spel zhing / /stan gan ④'bras bu lnga la spyod/ /de nas gtso mo'i dam tshig bshad/ /lha mo'i sku yi dam tshig ni/ /bong bu la ni byams par bya/ /khal gyis mi mnan dudabyug mi brdegadu /rma bya'i mdongs ⑦ni rtag tu bcang (nye/ /me yi dkyil 'khor mthong ba na/ /me tog skyes ltar dga' bar bya/ /rtag tu yi dam mi 'da' ba'iṇi/ /zhag re phyag rgya gnyis gnyis ⑩bstan/ /lha mo (spregasung gi dam tshig ni/ /rgyun du bzlas pa byed pa dang / /ne'u le mthong na bstod pa bya/ /phyag rgya bstan zhing dga' bar bya/ /zhing pags (gerdzas kyi snod du bya/ /tshub ma dag dang phrad gyur na/ /rked par mi gcod rgyab mi bstan/ /tshes grangs shis dang nam gung la / /phyag rgya bya zhing bstod pa tsobya/ /lha mo'i thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /'jig rten gang dang gang dag na/ /bud med yugs tsos yod pa la/ /byams par tsobya zhing chags pa spyad/ /rtag tu bu mo gtsang ma bsten/ /lha mo zla mtshan rgyu dus su / /gsang ba'i mchod pas dam bsre'o/ /lha mo'i khol mo re ma ti'iyi/ / de yi dzinasku yi dam tshig ni/ /byis pa dag gi nal phrug la/ /gos dang kha zas 103—675

mgron du sbyin/ /rtag par de la byams par bya/ /shing lo sor bzhi rked par gcad① / /phyed la ma mo'i sku bris te/ /phyed ②la dngos grub gsol bar bri/ /de ni rtag tu bcang ba'o/ /khol mo chagasung gi dam tshig ni/ /ma phebs bar du srog snying drang / /nub re gtor ma 'dar mi rung ④/ /kha 'phro dag kyang bsre ba min/ /phreng ba la yang reg 0pa bsrung du/ /bdag gis dgra la byad ④byas te / /phyis ni bcos par ma bshad do/ /khas blangs yol du ga la rung / /phud kyang nyams par bya ba min⑧/ /rdo sol chur ni bskyur mi bya/ / khol mo ⑨thugs kyi dam tshig ni/ /nal bu yod pa'i sbrum ⑩ma la/ /me tog gtor zhing byams par bya/ /kha zas sbyin zhing dngan ⑩mi bgrang / /sna khrag zla mtshan blang bar bya//dam tshig yod rung med rung ste/ /bdag ma yin pa'i rnal (nye'abyor la/ /rang gi lha dang snying po dang / /rdzas dang phyag rgya mi bstan no/ /mtshan ma rdo sol zhu bas bsku/ /bya nag lug nag rtag tu bcang / /the tshom skyozar ni mi rung ngo / /dpon g.yog spyi yi dam tshig ni/ /ru hi rdo rje pad+ma'i mi'/ /rtag tu bcangs la bsten 7cing mchod/ /de dang bral du mi rung ngo / /rnal 'byor dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig bstan/ /brgya byin dag gis rab zhus pa/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon ni gang / /dam tshig bsrungs pa'i tsoyon tan gang / /'byung po'i gtso bos bshad du gsol/ /phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ /rab tu bshad kyis 7brgya byin nyon/ /gtso bo phyag na rdo rje yi//sku yi dam tshig nyams pa na/ /mtho ris go 'phang rgyud (nyalam 'chad/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa na/ /bsgrubs kyang tu)dngos grub mi 'thob cing / /sngags 6 )la nus mthu ( 1med par ro/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa na/ /mkha' 'gro'i 103—676

tshig ma nyams na/ /bdud dang dgra yis mi tshugs shing / /rtag tu rims nad mi 'byung zhing / /dgra rnams the tshom med par 'chi/ /lha mi yongs kyis bkur ①bar 'gyur/ /tshe ring nor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de nas nag mo re ma ti'i/ / sku yi (gyidam tshig ma nyams na/ /'khor ni bkra shis dar zhing ①rgyas/ /dgra dang bgegs ④rnams phung bar byed/ /gsung gi dam tshig ma nyams na/ /bu dang chung ma dar (5)ba dang / /nor dang longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur/ /mig rnon rkang mgyogs (6)ro langs 'grub/ /thugs kyi dam tshig ma nyams na/ /tshe ring grags pa thob pa dang / /lus la chad kyis mi thebs shing / /sems la sdug bsngal med par 'gyur/ /mthu rtsal chen po thob par 'gyur/ /spyi yi dam tshig ma nyams na/ /gtso bo phyag na rdo rje dang / /lha mo nag mo dpon g.yog kun / /rtag tu bdag dang mi 'bral lo/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i don de 'grub/ /gang ltar mngag pa'i las de byedaphya/ /mkha' 'gro me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las/dam tshig gi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /r+ghaṃ mdzad hūm̐ gi rgyal po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i drod tshad mtshan ma shod/ /ces zhus pa dang / dpal phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/skyes bu blo ldan man ngag rtsal (kyican gyis/ /gsang sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgyar rab ldan na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i grub rtags 'di ltar 'byung / /grub rtags ⑨phyi nang gsang ba gsum du bshad/ /nang gi grub rtags mig dang rna ba dang / /sna dang lce dang lus dang snying la 'byung / /gal te mig gis srid pa gsum mthong 103—678

na / /gtso bo phyag na rdo rje'i mtshan ma yin/ /mig gis lha mo mthong na lha mo yin / /mig ni 'dar zhing 'gul na re ma ti/ /rna bas srid pa gsum po ①thos na rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gros gtam zer thos na lha mos bstan/ /bud med 'brug sgra sgrogs na re ma ti/ /sna la ga pur dri ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /ku mu da ②yi dri ni lha mo nyid/ /spos sam gur gum bro na re ma ti/ /lce la dam chos 'chad na rdo rje 'dzin/ /lce la gsang sngags zlos chan lha mo yin/ /legs nyes mtshan ma smra na re ma ti/ /lus ni 'phro na phyag na rdo rje yin④/ /lus las ⑤'od 'byung ba ni lha mo'i rtags/ /lus po 'dar ram skyi sha bung ba dang / /sha rtsa 'gul na re ⑥ma ti yi rtags(pe/ /glal lam skyugs shing (nyamachi ma 'ong ba na/ /lha mo dpon g.yog yo ga phebs pa yin/ /gal te snying gis skye ba dran pa na/ /phyag na rdo rje'i dngos grub mtshan ma'o/ /snying ni dga' la 'tshig yonyen rje mo yin/ /snying 'di khri la 'tshig tshun khol mo yin/ /da (meni gsang ba 'grub rtags bstan par bya / /sngags dang ting 'dzin nus pa skyed 4)tsam na/ /rdo rje dbus kyi rtsa yi nam mkha' la/ /byang chub sems kyi dga' bde skye ba na/ /mkha' 'gro rang la shar bar bshad/ /da ni phyi yi grub rtagaso bstan par bya/ /phyi yi rtags ni rab 'bring tha ma chagasum/ /rab ni lha mo nyid kyi sku mthong ste/ /nam mkha'i dbus su phyag na rdo rje mthong / /bud med dkar mo bzhad 7cing byung ba na/ /gsang ba'i ye shes dngos grub ster 7ba'o/ /nag mo ral pa can du byung ba na/ /'dod khams 'dus pa'i tshonamathu rtsal dngos grub bdag la ster/ /dmar mo bse yi ral pa can du byung ba na/ /'jig rten dbang du sdud pa'i dngos grub ster/ /ser mo thod /shepa'i phreng ba can du byung ba na/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i grub 103—679

pa ster/ /mkha' 'gro grub rtags 'bring po ni/ /rdo rje nam mkha' las dbab ①gtso bo yin/ /rje mo lha mo dung skyong grub rtags la/ /rdzas lud ②dang ni mun pa shin tu nag /me tog char 'bab 'brug dang rlung dmar dang / /bud med gzugs/ dang gzha' ①tshon ston pa'o/ /khol mo re ma ti yi dugrub rtags ni/ /'brug dang rlung dmar sgo rdung khang thog 'tshegadu /thibs thibs mnan dang thul thul dusmra ba'o/ /grub rtags tha ma rmi lam dag tu ston/ /byang chub sems dpa' rmis na gtso bo yin/ /ma dang sring mo mis na jo mo yin/ /chung ma khol mo rmis na g.yog mo yin/ /bong bu sha ba mis na rje ⑦mo yin/ /dre'u ⑧dang bya nag rmis na khol mo yin/ /ma mo grub nas dbang du 'dus pa na/ /bud med dag gis bdag la phyag 'tshal na/ /'dzum zhing 'khrig go byed pa spyod pa yin/ /ma mo grub nas dbang du ma 'dus na/ /mi sdug gzugs su ston zhing rje mor rdzu/ /gcan gzan zar la'ong ma mo phyag sgugs so/ /dam tshig nyams nas ma mo 'khrugs gyur na/ /ma mo nang 'thabs ⑩mtshon gyi char pa 'bab/ /bya nag nang 'thabs (1khrag gi yin bun 'khrigs/ /ltas de mthong na bka' 'chad 'ong ba'i rtags / /gal te lte phur nag mo la sogs pa'i/ /dam sri rnams kyis bsgrub ⑫par bar gcod na/ /grong 8la 'khrigs shing khyim ⑩du 'gro snying 'dod/ /kha bla smra snying 'dod la khro zhing 'tshig /bud med rkub dang mo mtshan ston pa rmi/ /gal te gtor ma dus las yol ba na/ /mo mtshan dang ni sngon gyi dbang rtags ston / /du ba 'khrigs nas bud med glal ba mthong / /bud med ngu ba mthong na nyams pa gnod/ /mig ni btsums pa ting 'dzin g.yel ba'i rtags/ /thal mo deb na dam tshig ma tshang zer/ /lce rtse ston na snying bo chad pa yin/ /so sgra 103—680

gzhug /thod pa dong gi nang du gzhug /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bsgomadhi/ /dam sri bkug cing bstim ②byas la/ /mi rus sor brgyad phur pa yis/ /mi g.yo mgon por gsal bsgoms gdabadu/ /mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog sngags bzlas/ /de steng 0rdo ba nag po la/ /ri rab rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /'brub khung de yi kha bcad la/ /de steng ②sku gdung nag po brtsigadu /de ni dam sri mnan ⑦par bshad/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams pa la/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi chad pa 'byung / /nyams tshad che na bka' ⑧cad ①che/ /bsgrub ⑩pa grub rtags med pa dang / /rang nyid srog la bab ⑩pa'o/ /nyams pa 'bring gi bka' chad ni / /'khor la rkyen dang rims nad 'byung / /nyams pa tha ma'i bka' chad ni//dgra dang nor la god ka 'byung / /de nas nyams pa bskang ba bstan/ /nyams pa chen po ⑩bskang 8ba ni/ /gtor ma khri dang sbyin sreg khri/ /de bzhin ra tsa ⑫gsum 8gyis bskang ⑫/ /des kyang skongs par mi 'gyur na/ /dang po mkha' lding gsum gyis bskang ⑩/ /de nas shel nag gsum gyis bskang ⑫/ /bka' chad 'bring po byung yib na/ /gtor ma stong tshudang sbyin sreg stong / /mkha' lding gnyis dang spyi nag gnyis/ /de bzhin ra tsa gnyis kyis bskang ⑥/ /mdangs kyi mar me bcwa dubargyad dbul/ /bka' chad tha ma byung ba nas/ /gtor ma brgya dang sbyin sreg brgya/ /mkha' lding gcig dang shel nag gcig /ra tsa gcig gis skongs par ( stebashad/ /mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud las spogs shing thugs dam skong byaba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dpal phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces 103—684

phyag na rdo rjes bka' stsal pa/ lha mo 'bebs shing slob ma dbang bskur ba'i/ /slob dpon nyid kyis ma mo grub pa gcesadhi/ /de nas ma mo grub pa'i slob dpon des / /dur khrod chen por zhag bdun bsnyen pa bya/ /sngags dang man ngag rdzas su ldan par bya/ / dang po charang la ma mo phebs ①par dbab/ /de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor 'jug pa dang / /me tog dor dang lha ngo bstan bya dang / /dpal gaphyag na rdo rje'i dbang bzhi bskur/ /dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar ba'i dbang / /gnyis pa shes rab dril bu dag gi dbang / /de bzhin gsum pa la ni dbu rgyan te/ /bzhi (snyepa rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi 6)dbang / /de nas lha mo nag mo'i dbang bzhi bskur/ /dang po la ni thod pa'i dbang / /gnyis pas ⑦shes rab ral gri'i (nyadabang bskur te/ /gsum pa la ni ne'u po)le'i rkyal yibu'o/ /de bzhin bzhi pa dpa' bo hasta sbyin(nyu/ /de nas re ma ti yi dbang bzhi bskur/ /dang po dur khrod g.yang gzhi'i dbang / /gnyis pa rdo rje ḍa ma ru yi 7dbang / /gsum pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 7bdud kyi khram bam dbang / /de bzhin bzhi pa chu gri 'dod ⑫pa'i dbang / /dbang ni bskur ba'i sngags kyang bzlas par bya/ /bcu gnyis rim pa sngon du rjes 7pa dang / /sku dang gsung gi dam tshig dpog ⑩par bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang la 'jug par 7bya ste/ dbang po bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs kyi/ /bu mo brgyad dang bcu drug nyi shu ma/ /mig gi dkyus rings sngo bsangs 1nyan ma rgyas()/ /skra bzang ( )so dkar ut+pal bro/ /de la khrus byas me tog gser gyis brgyan/ /dbang po lnga la bdud rtsi dag gis gdab/ /dpral bar phyag na rdo rje'i gsang sngags bri/ /de yi snying gar (27lha mo'i snying po la/ /lte bar re ma ti yi snying po bri/ /sman lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi zas byin la/ /gsang ba'i 103—686
