gnyis char zhin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdud kyi rigs kyi lha'i tshogs dang bcas nas rings par lhags so/ /de bzhin du 'chi bdag gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /mdog nag thod pa gri gug 'dzin/ /chung ma gshin rje za byed ma/ /gri gug thod pa phyag gis 'dzin/ /khyo shug zhing nyalpags rlon ②pa bgos/ /ma he chu glang zhon nas ni/ /gshin rje pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'gal byed gzor ①zhing myur du lhags/ /srin po gsod byed yab yum yang / /mdog nag zhing gi pags ④pa bgos/ /ral gri gri gug g.yas kyis bzung / /g.yon gyis mi ⑤mgo thod khrag thogs/ /stag dang seng ge zhon pa skyod/ /srin po'i tshogs bcas myur du 'khod/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang / /chung ma sha za ra la gcig 97dang / /mthing stinag mgyogs byed rta la zhon/ /zhing lpags gyon ②te phyag gnyis kyis/ /ral gri dar nag zhing lpags bzung / /gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas te 'khod/ /drag sngags bdag po'i sde dpon teyonye/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs dag gi⑩/ /gnas su gtso la 'dud ⑩cing 'khod/ /dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba/ /'jig rten lha yi sngags dag gis/ /dkar po ba dan shel gri 8thogs/ /dar dkar gos can gnam ru zhon/ /dregs pa lha yi bdud 'khor bcas/ /rings par bcas te shar phyogs 'khod/ /thar pa nag po zhes bya ba/ /mdog nag mchod gtor dug thun 'dzin/ /dom nag zhon te zhing lpags bgos/ /sde dang bcas te lho phyogs 'khod/ /rmu rje 7nag po zhes bya ba/ /dar nag dang ni zhags pa thogs/ /ber nag gyon yite rmu rta zhon/ /rang gi sde dang nub phyogs 'khod/ /mu stegs nag po chen po yang / / kha ṭ+wāṃ yidang ni tri shul 'bazung / /mi lpags bgos zhing ma he zhon/ /rang gi sde bcas byang du 103—732

'khod / /khyab 'jug rog ①te zhes bya ba/ /mthing ②nag khram shing dgra sta 'dzin / /sprin nag bgos shing 'brug sngon zhon/ /gza' bdud 'khor bcas steng phyogs 'khod/ /klu rgyal sone ①ma med ces ④pa/ /gos nag sbrul lpags na bza' can/ /bum pa dang ni rus dusbal 'dzin/ /chu srin zhon te klu tshogs bcas / /'og gi phyogs su 'khod cing 'dug /gzhan yang li byi lag dgu dang / /the se gtso dang yam shud kyi6)/ /so so'i sngags kyi bdag po dag /dkar ser dmar po'i stimadog ldan zhing / /shel gri thogs shing lag dgu 'gyed / /dar dmar mdung rings (kyelag gis 'dzin/ /rta dkar bya rgod ra skyes dang / /rta dmar zhon te zhing lpags bgos/ /so so'i sde dang g.yog bcas shing / /phyogs kyi sgo bzhir gnas bcas 'khod/ /gzhan yang lha klu gnod sbyin dang / /ma mo gshin rje srin po bdud/ /ru tra mu stegs 'gong the dang / /ging rmu gza' dang rgyan bran sman/ /snang srid lha srin dregs pa can/ /ded dpon chen po rnams kyi 'khor/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /yang gsang 6)dang ni drag po dang / /btags shing chags pa smas ⑩pa dang / /las byed shan pa thor shong yidang / /che 8grags rtsal (sridang ma mo dang / /mun thibs stong 'khrugs srog gcod 'dang / /glen zhing dbang che la tsosogs rnams/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang ba yiyi/ /bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub 4)byed pas(nye/ /ma thogs 6)dur khrod gnas chen du/ /'dar zhing myur ba'i shugs dang bcas/ /rang gi nus pa rab bstan tezhu )/ /bka' nyan gsung bstod (nyarjes 'brangs gnas / /de ltar 'khod pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa'i bdag po sngags kyi stobs dang ldan pa de dag gis/ rang rang gi 'khor dang / rigs kyi sde dang /103—733

mthu dang / longs spyod kyi khyad par dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bstan nas6)/ 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ bdag cag la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i/ma rungs pa'i tshogs gdug (snyepa can sdang ba/ gnod pa dang / shugs pa dang /'tsho (cib dang rtsod pa'i bsam ④pa dang ldan zhing / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / phan pa'i sems skye bar mi nus pa rnams kyis te/ rang rang gi khams dang ske/ byed pa dang / rigs dang / las kyi bya ba dang / rten dang / nus pa dang / dbang gi khyad par dag dang / mthun (9pa'i bstan pa mi yibazad pa stobs dang ldan pa dag bka' stsal par gsol zhes gsol to/ /drag ⑦sngags 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu bkod pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /sku yi che ba rab ston cing / /gsung gi snying pos gnad skul (8)te/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa gtsor mdzad nas/ /'jig rten dregs pa can dang mthu stobs can/ /'dus pa'i 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ /hūm̐ 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs chen rnams/ / nga yi (9)bka' bzhin nyan par bgyi / /nga ni chos sku bde chen te⑩/ /ye nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub/ /snang ba'i sku la dngos po med/ /ye shes sku ste sku yi (1mchog /nga ni sngags gsung mthu chen te12/ /ye nas tha snyad sgra dang bral/ /brjod pa'i gsung la 'dzin pa med / /ma 'gags gsung ste gsung gi dpal/ /nga ni bden pa'i thugs mchog ste / /ye nas mtshan med yang dag bral/ /gnyis med thugs las rtsol tu ba 103—734

med / /skye med thugs te thugs kyi dpal/ /nga ni yon tan tshogs chen te6)/ /lhun gyis grub cing bsam mi khyab/ /smon med dgos ②pa ma lus 'byung / /dngos grub chen po bskyed pa'i gzhi / /nga ni phrin ④las mdzad pa'i ①ste/ /yongs rdzogs brtson ⑥pa'i bdag nyid can/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon du spyod//sna tshogs gzhan don lhun gyis ④rdzogs/ /'jig rten sngags bdag dregs pa can / /gtso chen dbang sgyur khyed rnams kyang / /nga dang dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /gsung dang dbye ba yod ma yin//sku la so sor mi blta ste/ /yon tan mnyam pa nyid du rdzogs/ /phrin (kyilas gcig ste po)thun mong bsgrub/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /nyon mongs las kyi rgyu 'bras kyis/ /gnas ngan len gyi phung por 0smin/ /nga rgyal dregs pa'i lus ngag sems/ /stobs dang nus pa dpag med rdzogs/ / che btsan (nyedabang phyug ldan gyur kyang / /yang dag nges pa'i don ma rtogs/ /don dam bden pa khong ma chud/ /spros bral dge la blo (nyam phyogs/ /rang rig rgyal ba'i stobs ma rnyedakyi / /skye med dbyings kyi rtsal ma shar/ /bde cherne gnas kyi gdeng ma thob/ /mtshon med bcud kyi ro ma myong / /chos nyid sku yi chagazugs ma mthong ye shes klong skig sgo ma phyed/ /de bas rigs kyi bu rnams kyis/ /rang gi gnas la rab tu rtogs/ /lus la bdag tu yod tsom 'dzin/ /ngag la brjod par ma smra cig⑩ /sems la dngos por gang ma rtog /gnas yul rigs khams sde dang dpung / /brten yinyerdzas longs spyod dbang skal 4)rnams/ /nga dang nga yir gzung bya min/ /thun mong dang ni tha dad gcig( ki /de dag ma lus stong pa ste/ /stong pa nyid kyang de dag go/ /de las gud na gzhan med de/ /gzhan las gud 103—735

na'ang de med cing / /ma skyes ma 'gags mtshan nyid med/ /ma phri ma bsnan ①ma bslad ②cing / /ma bcos ma bsgyur ③ma byung la/ /ma skyes dum bsgrubs ma bshad pa'i/ /don chen de ni rang nyid las/ /phyi nang snga phyi steng dang 'og /phyogs mtshams (5)'khor 'das lus dang sems/ /kun nas rnyed ⑥pa ma yin te/'di na'ang yod pa ma yin no/ /sha khrag pags ⑦dang rus pa dang / /snying dang glo (sheb snod rnams dang / /dbang po yan lag bcas pa la/ /bde chen dam pa de mi gnas/ /de las gzhan na'ang gnas min te6)/ /gnas ma grub la gnas zhes brjod/ /gnas yod mnyam na der rtogs shig /ci ⑩'dra ci zhig ji lta bu / /gang nas 'ongs shing gang du song / /gang na 'dug cing ci zhig byed/ /dbyibs dang kha dog ming dang mtshan/ /rigs dang khams la rab tu rtogs/ /de la de yis der bltas (1pas/ /mthong (nyeb med pa blta ba yi7/ /gang la gang gis gar bsgoms pas/ /bsgom dang bral la sgom zhes bya/ /ci la su zhig spyir spyod pas/ /spyod dgu mi gnas spyod pa che/ /su las sus 8thob ci bsgrubs pas/ /ma grub rang gnas 'bras bu ste/ /ma lus med cing rnam pa yi7 / /yon tan yongs rdzogs dbang phyug go/ /zhi dang rgyas dang mngon du spyod / /dbang du bsdu ba phrin 7las yin/ /rang la rdzogs shing charang gis grub//thag chod pa dang bstan pa dang / /tshad ldan tu mthar phyin la bzla ()dang / /'das dang ma 'das ston pa dang / /bshad dang nyan dang sdud zhu )pa dang / /gnas dus yon tan skyon rnams ni/ /rang gi de nyid rtogs pas 'grub/ /ces 31bka' stsal to/ /drag sngags 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las don dam pa'i gnas nye bar bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //103—736

de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dgos ①pa chen po 'di gsungs te/ /ye ②nas ma byung ma skyes pa'i/ /chos nyid don gyi snying po ni/ /gzung 'dzin mtha' bral don rtogs te②/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /dregs shing gzir ba'i ru tra de/ /ma bsgral ④ba ni nyes pa ste/ /thabs dang shes rab snying rje gsum/ /mthun ⑤zhing mtshungs ②ldan sras kyis bsgralaspyi/ /dam pa'i don de ma rtogs par/ /dngos por spyad pas 'khor bar ltung / /mkhas rtogs ldan pas spyad pa yis/ /'phags pa nimanyes shing sems can sgrol/ /tshogs nyid 7rdzogs te sku gsum thob/ /rnam rig mthong ⑩bas la thag bcad⑩/ /brtul zhugs 'drag pos bsgrub pa brtsamatso/ /dbang du bsdu dang gdul ba'i phyir / /'jig rten las kyis bsdus pa'i rgyud/ /nga dang ston pa rnams kyis bshad / /chos dbyings rang gnas dur khrod du/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis ni / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du sdud8/ /snyigs ma rab tu bdo 8ba'i dus//bsdod ⑩cing btsugs las ltos ⑩pa'i chos/ /skyon dang yon tan tshul du 'byung / /bstan pa 'jig byed las ngan can/ /drag sngags stobs kyis bsgral (shebyas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i rten 7yin no/ /lha dang sngags dang ting nge 'dzin/ /rdzas rnams rgyu dang rkyen du 'gyur/ /ling ga nya'o dmigs pa'i rten( )/ /ming rus byang bus 0rnam shes dang / /bla tshe 'khor ba'i rten yin te.e/ /'gugs 'dren 'gyis ni de dag 'gugs/ /pho nyas las kun sgrub ( stepar byed/ /sngags dang rdzas kyi ( gedapal skyed cing / /thun rdzas rnams kyis (namyos pa dang / /rengs lkugs mtshon 103—737

'bebs rdul du rlogs/ /gnad 6)du 'bebs shing snying nas 'dren/ /lha dang 'byed cing rtsa ba gcod/ /byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni/ /don po khrag gi lan bu'i mgo/ /kun gzhi til 'bru tsam zhig gnas/ /rtsa ba rlung gnas 'dra bas te/ /phur ba me sbal lta bu yis/ / bsdus shing ②bsregs te gcad ③pa yis/ /dmigs pa rten ④dang bral bar byas/ /bkrag ⑤dang gzi mdangs rang la 'dus/ /phrin las rnam bzhis 6)gzir ba la/ /dge sdig ngo bo nyid du mnyam / /lta spyod ldan pas zhing bcus te/ /pha rol bla med gnas su bsgral/ /bar ma do yi ⑦rnam shes ni/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /sbyang dang spar ba'i las rnams bya/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i sras su (gyibaskyed/ /phung po yo)lhag ma tsam nyid ni/ /rten gsum gyis yini rab tu sbyang / /chos sku'i gzugs brnyan bstan (7par bya/ /'dis ni pha rol bla na med/ /sprul pa dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spyod pa rlabs chen spyad pa'o / /zhes bka' stsal to/ /drag sngags 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las sgrol ba'i ⑫ting nge lhage'adzin gyi dmigs pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /las kyi bye brag 'di gsungs te/ /thog mar 'di la shis 7pa'i gnas/ /dur khrod chu gling ri yi sul/ /khros shing gdug sgyu 8pa'i gnas de ru/ /rab tu mnag cing gdeng 4ldan pas/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub po ste/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma yis/ /sngon du bla ma mnyes byas shing / /lhag pa'i lha nyid stobs dang ldan/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa he ru ka /nye yonadang ldan pa gnyis su med/ /tshad dang ldan par gyur pa 1 ste/ /yang dag nges 103—738

pa'i rtags 0)mthong nas/ /rab tu 'bad par bya ba ni/ / smin 'byor gdug ②cing shis pa'i sa/ /las la mngag ①pa de dag la/ /dregs pa gtso 'khor dmigs pa'i rten④/ /'dom gang la (9sogs tshad dang ldan/ /lte ba las ni 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /bzhi 'am drug gam brgyad du 'god/ /bar khyams phyogs bzhir (5)sgo bzhir bcas/ /rim pa gsum gyi thod phreng ldan/ /rang gi rigs la sngags pa yiphya/ /dbyibs dang kha dog rgyan dang rtagasal/ /thams cad ldan pa nyid du bya/ /dregs pa can rnams sku yi rtenaponye/ /bris sam bkos yisam brtsigs pa dgatso /rang gi gnas su mdzes par dgod/ /gsung gi snying po'ang de bzhin no/ /thugs rten rang rang phyag cha 'am/ /sngon nas bsags pa'i rdzas yin no/ /rang sngags bsags pa'i 'khor lo dang / /mthun ⑫gzugs srog gi rgyal mtshan rnams/ /nang du mtshon pa'i rten du gzugs(nye/ /de dag tsit+ta 8so so ru/ /dmigs pa'i snying po dril te gzhugatso /gsang zhing sbas pa'i rten du 'gyur/ / de yi 7byang shar phyogs mtshams 7su/ /nga yis (3sngar bshad rgyud (7nyid la/ /e dbyibs bzhi dang brgyad cu sum̐ )gnyis/ /khru gang 'dzub ( nyagang thur du brko/ /gdug so cing drag po'i rdzas kyis byug /gdug ( rtecing bsreg pa'ang de yis so/ /de nyid dgod pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /rgyud med gzugs ngan ka pā ( stel/ /seng ldeng gser shing yan lag skyes/ /dpal ldan drag po'i phur pa dang / /shel nag gnam ru gnag ( shepo dang / /gi ling dkar dang gdong dmar dang / /zla mi gcig 5 sgodang srid shing dang / /tsa ra ka dang mgrin shu /snyan dang sashe/ /sa spyod chu spyod rnams kyi lus/ /phyi nang khri7bar dang gsang bas brgyan( )/ /bsreg du chen spyi yi zhinamanyes pa'i rdzas/ /rgyan ldan 103—739

gzugs dang rnga gling sgras/ /bsung ①chen dri dang sha khrag ro/ /tsha rtsub reg dang 'bru bcud bshos/ /sha chen dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ /rab tu bstar ②zhing 'bad pas sbyar/ /dpa' zhing rtul niphod skyes bu yis/ / nga yi ⑤sngon gyi phrin dulas bzhin/ /khro la khros pas zhi mdzad de/ / tha mas duganas pa'i 'byung chen lnga/ /drag po sngags kyi 'byung bar bsgom/ /keng rus 'bar ba'i ri rab bam/ /dur khrod 'jigs ༷pa'i gzhal med khang / / bhan dha ⑧gnas rigs gsum gyis brtsigs/ /ste ra gsar rnying khyatshogs kyis gtamasayi/ /rak+ta dmar po brub ⑩cing 'bab/ /tshil chen dud pa 'khyil zhing 'phyuratso/ /dbang po don snying 'phyo zhing 'brul/ /bdud rtsi bshang gci dri bsung ldan8/ /yan lag nying tshulag rkang zhing snyil/ /shun dang pags 8pa brgyangs shing 'phyar/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams ⑩dang steng dang 'og /gcus tshudang 'phyang ba bskum tsodang brgyangs / /rgyal mtshan dang ni za ra tshags/ /ba dan bla re ⑩lhab lhub dang / /phur pa dang ni ltab (nyam dang / /yol ko ka ma la gtams 0ni/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gzhal yas 'bar ba de 'dra ba/ /rab tu sngags ⑥pa 'di las bshad/ /dregs pa'i bdag po yum dang bcas/ /sbyor zhing dgos phyipa de nyid kyis/ /bdag gi rang bzhin yongs su bskyed/ /'phro dang chas kyi khyad par dang / /bsdu dang rang gi gnas su brtag /skur gyur gang gi ( stematshan nyid ngo bo dang ‘ spya/ /byang chub sems kyi bya ba yis/ /yum dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs/ / de yi (9las kyang sngar bzhin du/ /rgyal mdzad rang gi phyag rten du / /dmigs pa myur lhags de yi (me'akhor/ /bdud dang gshin rje srin po dang / /gnod sbyin drag po'i klu dang lha(ste/ /rang rang chung mar bcas pa dag /103—740

ngas bshad bzhin du 'jigs par bsam/ /sgo bzhir gnas pa de dag stephyi/ /lha dang ma mo rgyal po ging / /btsan ②'gong rmu dang mu stegs dang / /rang gi sde dang dpung du bcas/ /ma lus dregs pa can gyi tshogs/ /'di las rab brjod gang yin pa/ /de nyid ①du ni gsal ④bar bya/ / nga yi ④sku dang gsung dang thugs/ /ye shes rigs kyi dbang bskur 6)zhing / /byin gyis brlabs ⑦nas rgyas btab ste/ /de la rang bzhin gnas pa bstimatshu/ /yongs rdzogs sku yis bstan pa bsgrub/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul zhing bstod/ /rab tu mnyes pa rgya cher bya/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yis/ /bsdu dang sbyor dang 6)sgrol ba dang / /gnas dang ring dang rim pa dang / /bskyed dang dbab pa mnyes pa yi/ /gnas lugs lhun grub ma bcos pas/ /drag sngags rol ba ma 'gags spyod/ /rang gi las la sbyar ba ni/ /bdud kyi khram dang gshin rje'i lto//srin po'i dmar dang gnod sbyin byad/ / lha yi chad ⑩dang ma mo'i rims/ / gza' yi nyunyekyi kung klu yi 7dug /tshe chad 4)pa dang khri mon bcug /gcan gzan 'dzums skyodang lcags sgrog tshud/ /nad dang mtshon nyid khong zhugs dang //dug 'thungs thog libabs bzhin du drag /thar zhes bya ba gdags su med/ /bdud ni ma brtags srog la rgol/ /gshin rje 'khor ba'i 'khor los tsogacod/ /srin po ral gri'i so yis 'gems/ /gnod sbyin gnam lcags thog gis 'joms//lha ni 'dod pa'i mdung gis sor/ /ma mo dpag med mda' bzhin 'bigs/ /gza' bdud stobs chen skyogs kyis brdegazhu /klu ni sa 'og ral gri yonyesogs/ /thams cad 'dul zhing gcod pa'i sngags/ /mun pa gling 'khrugs bdud kyi skad//ngu 'bod lta bu gshin rje ste/ /ro len dur ba srin pos 'gren47/ /lce mdud 103—741
